Tragically, she was killed by Fitzroy, having recently returned to life in the mutant nation of Krakoa.

name: Clay Quartermain
deck: Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D., a close friend to Nick Fury and a major player in battles with the Hulk.

name: Blockbuster
deck: Blockbuster is the super-strong member of the Marauders who has died in battle, yet has returned thanks to Mr. Sinister's cloning techniques.

name: Master Mold
deck: Master Mold was created by Bolivar Trask, with the Primary Directive of controlling the mutant "menace." Its AI grew exponentially, and it realized it needed to create more Sentinels to achieve this goal.

name: Charlotte Jones
deck:
A police officer with the New York City Police Department.  She is a single mother who was romantically involved with Archangel for a time.

She is an ally of the X-Men.

name: Arakko
deck: The older, militant twin mutant nation to the newly minted mutant nation of Krakoa. Formed by Genesis, the original horseman. Arakko is one half of the original mutant island of Okkara, the other half being Krakoa. The two were separated by the Twilight Blade of the Amenthi god Annihilation, and Arakko was sealed away in Amenth's dimension.

name: Reaper
deck: Reaper was an original member of Stryfe's MLF, later a member of the Malibu Universe's Exiles.

name: Nanny
deck: A cyborg who used to be a scientist.

name: Silvermane
deck: Silvio Manfredi has always been some kind of villain. His body is almost completly made up of cybernetic parts and he is almost like a human robot.

name: Sprite
deck: A Chinese girl enrolled at the Jean Grey School for Higher Learning.

name: Wolverine
deck: This version of Laura was resurrected when the original was presumed dead. For a time, she was one of two versions of Laura that existed, however, with the Fall of X, Laura is now the one and only version.

name: Diablo
deck: Diablo is a 9th century alchemist with aspirations of world dominance. He is able to produce any number of amazing potions that defy scientific analysis. Diablo does not seem to age. He is an enemy of the Fantastic Four.

name: Marrina
deck: Marrina is a member of the Plodex alien race. Raised on Earth, she becomes a member of Alpha Flight before she marries Namor the Sub-Mariner and becomes a member of the Avengers.

name: Fancy Dan
deck: Long time member of the Enforcers

name: Sugar Man
deck: Refugee from the Age of Apocalypse alternate reality where Sugar Man operated Apocalypse's Seattle Core power plant/slave camp. Sugar Man escaped to establish the mutant slave system of Genosha.

name: Montana
deck: A long-time member of the Enforcers and one of Spider-Man's oldest foes. Montana and his team ususally where hired by criminals to do 'criminal jobs'.

name: Living Monolith
deck: Ahmet Abdol is an Egyptian mutant with the power to absorb cosmic energy, which allows him to increase his size, strength and power to potentially unlimited levels.

name: Whizzer (Stewart)
deck: The Whizzer is the super fast member of the Squadron Supreme. Stanley Stewart is the third individual to use Whizzer name.

name: Blue Marvel
deck: When Adam discovered his super-powers, he fashioned a secret identity with which to protect his country, and became Blue Marvel. He served as a hero for years, and was one of the most popular heroes of his time. Adam was pressured by the government to retire, because of how much power he had and for being black. He was forced out of retirement to face his greatest foe and former best friend, Anti-Man.

name: Wallflower
deck: Wallflower, (Laurie Collins) was one of the students in the Xavier Institute, and a member of the former New Mutants squad therein. After the events of M-day, she was one of a handful of mutants to keep her pheromone based powers.

name: Whizzer (Frank)
deck: The Whizzer is a war-time superhero possessing superhuman speed. Acting as a member of the Invaders and Liberty Legion during World War II, the Whizzer continued his crime-fighting career decades after the war and even joined the Avengers.

name: Marla Jameson
deck: Marla Jameson is the second wife of J. Jonah Jameson. She was a scientist specializing in robotics and helped create weapons to be used against Spider-Man - specifically the Spider-Slayers. When Smythe came after Jonah and his family, Marla was unfortunately killed by him.

name: Ringo Kid
deck: A western outlaw and crimefighter. Half white and half native.

name: Belasco
deck: Belasco is a Black Sorcerer who once ruled Limbo, the dimension where Illyana Rasputin's mutant teleportation brings her as a halfway point between destinations. He also trained Illyana in the art of black magic, and took her in as his apprentice. She eventually rebelled and defeated him.

name: Ozymandias
deck: A slave of Apocalypse. He serves mostly as a scribe and Apocalypse's right hand man but has also schemed against his master. In modern times he has become the unoffical leader of the Clan Akkaba.

name: Ego
deck: Ego is an intelligent, living planet that is millions of years old and devours anything in its path.

name: Gideon
deck: Gideon was a member of the Externals, a unique type of immortal mutants, and often battled the X-Men and X-Force.

name: Titan
deck: A member of the Imperial Guard who can change into a giant titan.

name: Star Brand
deck: A young man who receives the Star Brand and winds up with more power than he knows what to do with.

name: Zero
deck: The Mutant Liberation Front's teleporter bringing the team to various sites for their attacks.

name: Gwenpool
deck: A reality-manipulating wannabe hero from a world in which the Marvel universe is just a bunch of comics

name: Candy Southern
deck: Candy Southern was the girlfriend of the X-Man, Angel.  She supported him during his time with the Champion, and even became leader of the Defenders.  Later, she was kidnapped, tortured and eventually murdered for their relationship.

name: Elsa Bloodstone
deck: As the daughter of the immortal monster-hunter Ulysses Bloodstone, she followed in her father's footsteps after inheriting the bloodstone from him.

name: Martinique Jason
deck: Martinique is the daughter of the original Mastermind Jason Wyngarde and half sister of Regan Wyngarde aka Lady Mastermind. Martinique has used both aliases during her stints as a member of incarnations of the Brotherhood and Sisterhood of Mutants

name: Tippy-Toe
deck: Squirrel Girl's pet sidekick who took the mantle from the deceased Monkey Joe.

name: Cyber
deck: Cyber is a mutant and an enemy of Wolverine and the X-Men. He is also well known throughout the criminal underworld.

name: Malekith
deck: Ruler of the Dark Elves of Svartalfheim and a powerful practitioner of Dark Faerie Magic. Malekith is a very powerful enemy of both Thor and Jane Foster, and was the chief threat in the War of the Realms

name: Ghost
deck: Ghost is an industrial saboteur and mercenary who possesses an incredible stealth suit that grants him invisibility and intangibility, among other capabilities.

name: Frenchie
deck: A longtime friend of Marc Spector who has been with him since before the birth of Moon Knight.

name: Sublime
deck: An ancient sentient bacterium that possesses and operates through human hosts.

name: Marvelman
deck: Mike Moran transforms into a superpowered adult individual called Marvelman by shouting the word, Kimota!

name: Jetstream
deck: Jetstream was given cybernetic implants by the Hellfire Club. They were to protect him from his powers and to travel with self generated jet-like propulsion. He led the Hellions until his death.

name: Prism
deck: Prism is a member of the Marauders and has been resurrected by Mister Sinister several times. His clones managed to retain his abilities after M-Day.

name: Abyss
deck: A Genoshan born mutant with dimensional powers tied to the Brimstone Dimension. He is a half-brother of Nightcrawler.

name: Wolf Cub
deck: Wolf Cub was a member of the Paragons training squad up until they disbanded following M-Day. After Messiah Complex, Donald Pierce tricked him into joining the Young X-Men team. He was subsequently murdered by Pierce.

name: Shalla Bal
deck: Shalla Bal is Norrin Radd's companion from the planet Zenn-La. Her memory and his loss of her haunts him.

name: Talisman
deck: Elizabeth Twoyoungmen is the only daughter by the Alpha Flight resident magician, Shaman. Estranged from her father for many years, a magical discovery brings them back together. She has taken on a powerful native American artifact and with its prowess joined Alpha Flight also.

name: Grandmaster
deck: An incredibly ancient being, the Grandmaster possesses a high level of cosmic power.

name: Smasher (Kane)
deck: The first human member of the Shi'ar Imperial Guard.

name: Abraham Cornelius
deck: Doctor Cornelius for the most part was blackmailed into joining the Weapon X Program. He was a fugitive on the run from the United States known as the "Mercy Killer" quack.

name: Kade Kilgore
deck: Child genius who killed his father to take over his weapon manufacturing company during the Schism event. He is the new Black King of the Hellfire club.

name: Jean DeWolff
deck: Jean DeWolff is a New York cop and ally of Spider-Man. Her brother, Brian DeWolff, was the troubled villain/vigilante known as "The Wraith".

name: Melter (Horgan)
deck: Bruno Horgan is a former competitor of Tony Stark. He becomes the Melter and is considered one of Iron Man's deadliest foes. The Melter is eventually killed by the Scourge of the Underworld.

name: Willie Lumpkin
deck: Willie Lumpkin is a fictional supporting character in the Marvel Universe, who is best known as the mailman of the Fantastic Four in their self-titled comic book.

name: Viv
deck: Viv is a Synthezoid created by Vision to be his daughter, she is programmed to act like a 16-year-old.

name: Outlaw
deck: Outlaw is a mercenary that sometimes works with Deadpool, and recently had a relationship with him. She helped Taskmaster train Alex Hayden, whom she also dated. She is a mutant with superhuman strength, durability, and incredible skill and accuracy with firearms.

name: Orphan Maker
deck: Orphan Maker is an enigmatic mutant, whose powers (though unrevealed) remained after Decimation. As a boy, he was nearly killed by Mr. Sinister. Nanny rescued & recruited him for her team, the "Lost Boys." He kills the parents of mutant children, creating more soldiers for Nanny.

name: Marlene Alraune
deck: A girlfriend and later wife of Marc Spector, Moon Knight.

name: Hate-Monger
deck: Hate Monger is the name adopted by Adolf Hitler's consciousness throughout multiple cloned bodies. Armed with a gun that controls hatred, he wishes to plunge the world into racial purging. Hate-Monger has died several times, but his consciousness has always transferred itself to other bodies prolonging his existence.

name: Scanner
deck: Scanner was a loyal Acolyte of Magneto, who through her naivete and innocence occasionally aided the X-Men.

name: Korg
deck: Korg is a Kronan warrior from the planet Ria that becomes a member of the Hulk's Warbound.

name: Immortus
deck: Dupe of Kang

name: Satana
deck: Satana is half-human, half-succubus. She is the daughter of Marduk Kurios, a high level demon who controls multiple hells and sister of Daimon Hellstrom also known as Son of Satan.

name: Widget
deck: Widget was a small, floating robot that became attached to Excalibur and took them on a journey through multiple parallel universes. Then later evolved into the Psycho-Cybernetic Temporal humanoid version of Widget.

name: Nikki
deck: Nikki was born on Mercury and joined the Guardians of the Galaxy after her planet was attacked by the Badoon.

name: Matsuo Tsurayaba
deck: A Japanese Crimelord of the Yakuza and leader of The Hand, Matsuo has been associated with many crime & terrorist organizations throughout his criminal career.

name: Jason Macendale
deck: Jason Philip Macendale, former agent of CIA, turned from the first Jack O'Lantern to the second major Hobgoblin and once the host of Demogoblin. He was rebuilt as a cyborg and remained Hobgoblin until the first Hobgoblin who was thought dead returned and killed him.

name: Phyla-Vell
deck: Phyla is daughter of Mar-Vell. After her death, she was eventually replaced on Earth-616 with a variant of herself from a dead universe.

name: Fang
deck: Fang is an alien member of the Shi'ar Imperal Guard. He is mostly known for having his costume taken by Wolverine, whom used it for some time.

name: Maestro
deck: The Hulk's future counterpart, a true tyrant in every sense. He survived the great apocalyptic war and proceeded to kill the remaining heroes and villains that dared to oppose him. He possesses the intelligence that is equal to or greater than Bruce Banner, while also possessing enhanced power that is greater than that of the Hulk.

name: Molten Man
deck: Molten Man is the stepbrother of Liz Allen.  He has had several run-ins with Spider-Man. He was recently cured of his condition.

name: Titanium Man
deck: The Titanium man is a Soviet Super Soldier Assassin.  The original was Boris Bullski, but he was killed in action.

name: Sharon Ventura
deck: Sharon Ventura was a former pro-wrestler who fell in love with the Thing and subsequently joined the Fantastic Four as Ms. Marvel. During an adventure in space, she was exposed to Cosmic Rays which mutated her body into a rock-like form similar to that of the Thing. She is not to be confused with Darla Deering (a.k.a. Ms. Thing).

name: Annie Ghazikhanian
deck: One time X-Men Nurse, mother of Carter. Love interest of Havok. Current whereabouts unknown.

name: Puma
deck: Puma is a powerful Native-American Werecat.  Puma was raised to fight the Beyonder and became an ally to Spider-Man.

name: Howard Stark
deck: The father of Tony Stark and founder of Stark Industries.

name: Ink
deck: Ink was thought to be a mutant, but is actually a human empowered by another mutant. He was a member of the Young X-Men.

name: Steven Lang
deck:
Head of Project: Armageddon  -
Mutants killed: 29

name: Super-Adaptoid
deck: An artificial being created by the terrorist group A.I.M. for their plans to assassinate Captain America, it holds a fragment of the Cosmic Cube that serves as its limitless power source, and can copy the powers of any being it wants.

name: 3-D Man (Garrett, Jr.)
deck: Delroy has three times the physical abilities of someone at the peak of human conditioning as he has been bonded with the spirit of 3-D man.

name: Cr'reee
deck: The semi-sentient (or very sentient) pet (or partner?) of Ch'od of the Starjammers. The extent of Cr'reee's intelligence is widely unknown

name: Wiz-Kid
deck: Dyslexic & Aphasic, Wiz-Kid was a wheelchair-bound, mutant, technopath. Taki assisted in stopping N'astirh from fusing Limbo to Earth together forever during Inferno.

name: Michael Pointer
deck: Michael Pointer is a mutant with the power to absorb other superhuman energies and powers. He was unaware of being a mutant until all the lost powers from M-Day selected him as a host. In this state he accidentally murdered Alpha Flight. He has been trying to make amends since but has almost constantly been manipulated by others.

name: Miss America
deck: Miss America was a Golden Age hero and part of the superhero teams the Invaders and the All-Winners Squad.

name: Thena
deck: Thena is a member of the Eternals and the daughter of Zuras and Cybele. Thena is also the niece of A'lars and cousin to Thanos and Eros Starfox. She is also the mother of Deborah and Donald Ritter, as well as Joey Eliot. Thena is the occasional lover of the Deviant Kro and once served as the Prime Eternal.

name: Kyle Jinadu
deck: Kyle is Northstar's husband. He doesn't have any powers, and is supportive of Northstar's heroic lifestyle.

name: William Drake
deck: Father of Bobby Drake, better known as the X-Men's Iceman.

name: Reptil
deck: While acompanying his parents on an archeological dig, Humberto Lopez found a peculiar stone that grants him the ability to partially transform into a dinosaur. After being tortured heavily by Norman Osborn, Humberto has been inducted into Avengers Academy in hopes of keeping him on a healthy path.

name: Courtney Ross
deck: The one time girlfriend of Brian Braddock aka Captain Britain, though he went missing, they were reunited after she found out he was with Meggan.

name: Dragoness
deck: Dragoness was the slightly crazy member of the Mutant Liberation Front before it was disbanded.  She retained her powers after M-Day.

name: Angel
deck:
The Golden Age hero that had his debut in Marvel Comics #1 from Timely Comics.
A doctor that became a costumed detective who had the "mystic cape of Mercury" that allowed him to fly.

name: Onyxx
deck: Onyxx was a student studying at Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters. A close friend of fellow student Bling!, Onyxx often accompanied her on adventures and helped the X-Men battle against Apocalypse. He joined the X-Men full-time when the team relocated to Utopia and helped battle the Dark Avengers, Emplate and Selene.

name: Arno Stark
deck: The real son of Howard and Maria Stark.

name: Predator X
deck: Predator X is a deadly enemy of mutants, such as the X-Men, and itself is the product of extreme genetic engineering.

name: Flashfire
deck: An alien who is a member of The Imperial Guard of the Shi'ar Empire. He can be considered a veteran.

name: Cerise
deck: An member of the Shi'ar Empire who hid out on Earth, joined Excalibur and dated Nightcrawler before being pardoned for her crimes

name: Black Mamba
deck: Former call girl and member of many organizations, most notably the Serpent Society and B.A.D. Girls Inc.

name: Blizzard
deck: Constantly striving to prove himself to his peers, Blizzard has wavered between being a lousy frequently defeated crook and a hero desperate to be worthy of the title. Despite all of this, the man behind the mask has a kind heart and only wants to be accepted by those around him.

name: Recorder
deck: Recorder is a robot designed by the Rigellians to gather and analyze data and has accompanied Thor and Hercules on several adventures.

name: Arishem the Judge
deck: Arishem the Judge is the leader of the Celestial hosts, and second-in-authority only to the One Above All. He judges the worthiness of species influenced by the Celestials, deciding which planets and its species will continue to live.

name: Hijack
deck: Hijack (David Bond) is a new mutant that appeared in Atlanta. He has the power to control machines, and was recruited by Magik and the Stepford Cuckoos, who saved him from two armed police men.

name: Death's Head
deck: Death's Head a Robot bounty hunter (or rather, as he calls himself, a "freelance peace-keeping agent"), that got his start in the UK Transformers comic series. Eventually, he later on made his way into mainstream Marvel comics and has had different incarnations. He has recently resurfaced as a bounty hunter capturing alien fugitives for SWORD.

name: Victor Mancha
deck: Victor is a cyborg created by the villain Ultron and a member of the Runaways. He was also part of Avengers A.I. team.

name: Kong
deck: In the Ultimate Universe, Kenny McFarlane is friends with Peter Parker and Mary Jane Watson. He was also friends with Flash Thompson and developed a crush on the popular transfer student, Kitty Pryde.

name: Hussar
deck: Hussar is a member of the Imperial Guard and her duty is to protect and defend the ruler and the Shi'ar galactic empire. She defends herself with a whip that can channel a bioelectric shock.

name: Fatale
deck: Fatale is a mutant assassin, once an agent of Dark Beast, and later joined the Brotherhood of Mutants. Recently, she joined X-Cell, a new terrorist group that blames the government for M-Day.

name: Bonebreaker
deck: A member of the Reavers who originally served as the team's leader. His lower body is comprised of a heavily armed chassis with tank treads.

name: N'astirh
deck: A demon lord of Limbo infected with a techno-organic virus.

name: Major Domo
deck: Major Domo is the strange human assistant of Mojo, and one of the few beings aloud to question Mojo's decisions.

name: Purple Man
deck: A former spy, professional criminal, and would-be world conqueror, Zebediah "Purple Man" Killgrave is a master mind-controller with violet-hued skin.

name: Mr. Hanover
deck: Millie the Model's boss at the model agency where she worked.

name: Ord
deck: Ord is an alien from the planet Breakworld.  He trained for decades and was sent to Earth, under the belief that Colossus is destined to destroy his home planet.

name: Bambi Arbogast
deck: After serving as Tony Stark's secretary for many years, Bambi Arbogast became a manager for one of Stark's companies. She also worked for the Heroes for Hire Corporation, and remains a good friend to Tony Stark.

name: Zero
deck: Zero is one of the Five Lights, five new mutants to emerge since the return of Hope Summers. He is a techno-organic body sculptor, as well as a world-renowned artist.

name: Mammomax
deck: Mammomax is a bipedal elephant-like mutant who was a member of the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants and the 198. He was killed by Predator X and the Facility.

name: Armadillo
deck: Armadillo is a slow-witted man tricked into an inhuman form. He is a criminal by circumstance with few other options in front of him.

name: Griffin
deck: John Horton was a petty crook who was changed by a scientist working for the Secret Empire organization.

name: Negasonic Teenage Warhead
deck: One of Emma Frost's students who died on Genosha. Phimister was later resurrected by Eli Bard, sacrificed to Selene and later resurrected again with a new powerset similar to her powers in the Deadpool movie.

name: Phantom Rider
deck: An identity used by a number of western and modern crime fighter. One of the Phantom Riders, Lincoln Slade, besmirched the name as he was responsible for drugging and raping Mockingbird when the Avengers became stuck in the past.

name: Peter Corbeau
deck: Solar Physicist, UN administrator, ally of the Avengers and X-men and an old friend of Charles Xavier. Also a two time noble prize Winner.

name: Firebird
deck: Born a hero the night a fireball from the heavens landed near her on her walk home from church, Bonita Juarez became Firebird. She has fought as a member of both Avengers and West Coast teams, and the Southwest-based superteam the Rangers.

name: Squid-Boy
deck: Sammy Pare was a young mutant that was picked on by bullies until he befriended Juggernaut. He idolized Juggs but was devastated when he thought he had turned evil again. Black Tom Cassidy killed him.

name: Living Tribunal
deck: The Living Tribunal is a single entity existing across the entire Marvel Multiverse. He is the Judge of the Marvel Multiverse and the arbitrator of cosmic justice. He is above the likes of the Celestials, Galactus, Eternity, Death, and Infinity. The Living Tribunal doesn't have his own free will, as he serves the will of the creator of the Marvel Multiverse, The One Above All.

name: Orphan
deck: Orphan, also known as Mister Sensitive, was a suicidal mutant and the de facto leader of X-Statix. He possessed superhuman senses and greatly enhanced reflexes, and was also a master of martial arts and mental discipline.

name: Battlestar
deck: Battlestar received strength augmentation process from the Power Broker and acted as sidekick to his close friend John Walker when he assumed the role of Captain America. He later joined with Silver Sable and the Wild Pack.

name: The Rose
deck: Son of Wilson and Vanessa Fisk. Took up the identity of The Rose to become a rival to his father, and later became Blood Rose to act as a vigilante who openly fought against his father.

name: Patriot
deck: The Golden Age Patriot and third Captain America.

name: Amphibius
deck: One of Magneto`s mutant creations in The Savage Land. A member of The Savage Land Mutates. Amphibius is a batrachanthrope (Were-Frog) or a human/frog hybrid. He has the leg strength and nautical abilities of a frog.

name: Razor-Fist
deck: A villain with large blades for hands.

name: Manuel Enduque
deck: Son of one of the richest families in the eastern hemisphere. A wealth built on the back of slaves. He manages to eliminate his competition and kills all his seven older brothers. He is part of the newest Hellfire Club.

name: Krang
deck: Warlord Krang is a nobleman of Atlantis and a long time foe of Prince Namor the Sub-Mariner.

name: Peepers
deck: An old enemy of the X-Men and Captain America, Peepers was a member of various villainous groups.

name: Jigsaw
deck: Billy "The Beaut" Russo was known for his handsome appearance until confronting the Punisher who sent Billy through a glass window, severely damaging his face. After the incident he took the name Jigsaw and is a deadly force with a vendetta towards the Punisher.

name: Sikorsky
deck: Sikorsky is the Chr'ylite doctor for the Starjammers.  His medical knowledge far exceeds that of Earth's.

name: Crimson Commando
deck: A mutant operative for the U.S.A allies during WWII. Sometime later a vigilante to a former member of the group Freedom Force. He has since lost his mutant powers.

name: Crossfire
deck: A former CIA Agent who became a criminal and organized an army of mercenaries, Crossfire lost his left eye and left ear in an explosion, replacing them with cybernetic implants. He primarily antagonizes Hawkeye, and by extension Mockingbird and the Avengers. However, he ultimately goes where the money is.

name: Romulus
deck: Little is known about Romulus. He has been shown, however, to be extremely intelligent with connections with various governments and government programs. Romulus was ultimately behind the Weapon X Program. Given his great lifespan, and the few instances revealed about his past, Romulus is an exceptional warrior, planner and tactician.

name: Power Man (Alvarez)
deck: Victor Alvarez is a young chi wielding hero with a short fuse. After discovering his abilities, he became a self employed Hero for Hire and dubbed himself "Power Man." Following the events of Shadowland, Power Man became an under study of Iron Fist. He later enrolled and graduated from the Avengers Academy.

name: Brothers Grimm
deck: The Brothers Grimm are two sets of twin supervillains who are brothers, They are an Enemy of Spider-Man, Spider-Woman and the Avengers.

name: Diamond Lil
deck: Canadian mutant with an impenetrable bio-aura force-field protecting her outer body. Initially a reluctant villain, Diamond Lil redeemed herself and became a valuable member of the mutant community.

name: Shard
deck: Shard was Bishop's younger sister, and was a member of the XSE with Bishop in the alternate reality Earth-1191.

name: Neutron
deck: Neutron is a veteran member of the Shi'ar Imperial Guard. He was recently killed during the events of Realm of Kings.

name: Sydren
deck: An Agent of Sword. Sydren is a telepath with the ability to sense things remotely. He also possesses some animalistic abilities, such as a heightened sense of smell.

name: Miss Locke
deck: Miss Locke is the right hand woman to the villain Arcade.

name: Silhouette
deck: Shadowmelding, paraplegic mutant & reformed gang member, Silhouette Chord fought alongside the original New Warriors but set out on her own to find herself.

name: Dai Thomas
deck: Chief Inspector Dai Thomas of Scotland Yard is a police detective in Britain who is good friends with Captain Britain. He was briefly possessed by the spirit of Sir Gawain, becoming a member of the Knights of Pendragon.

name: Wilhelmina Kensington
deck: 11-year-old pageant and martial arts enthusiast, she is a member of the Hellfire Club's latest incarnation.

name: Nebula
deck: Nebula was a space pirate who believed that she was the granddaughter of Thanos. She often had conflicts with Starfox and Earth superheroes such as the Avengers. However, when she actually encountered Thanos, he denied having dropped progeny.

name: Bushmaster
deck: Bushmaster is a human being with cybernetic arms as well as a cybernetic serpent's tail in place of his legs after his limbs were destroyed in an accident.

name: Christian Frost
deck: Christian Frost is the only Male heir to the Frost fortune, he is also the only sibling that Emma Frost could truly confide in.

name: Maximilian Frankenstein
deck: Orphan prince from the Bavarian Alps, and a young scientific genius. Despite his presence in the Hellfire Club, his family is in fact the disgraced family of Doctor Frankenstein, and Maximillian is indebted to Kade Kilgore.

name: Kylun
deck: A feral mutant with the power to replicate any sound he hears, and wields two magical swords. He briefly became a member of the British mutant group Excalibur.

name: Brainchild
deck: One of Magneto's first Savage Land Mutates, Brainchild often fills the role of their leader.

name: Vivisector
deck: Vivisector is a mutant that displayed lycanthropic powers and is a member of the X-Statix.

name: Bushwacker
deck: Bushwacker is a mercenary and assassin with arms that can morph into a variety of projectile weapons. Working for the Marauders, he would kill mutants for money. His activities brought him into routine conflict with Wolverine, Daredevil and the Punisher.

name: Sharon Friedlander
deck: Originally a Caucasian nurse, Sharon Friedlander was transformed into a Native American from an attack by the Demon Bear.  She went on to support the New Mutants and Moira MacTaggert with her medical knowledge and eventually joined the X-Men.

name: Betty Dean
deck: A policewoman in the 1940's. She often helped out Namor during World War II

name: Jefferson Davis
deck: Jefferson Davis is the father of Miles Morales (Ultimate Spider-Man)

name: Marlo Chandler-Jones
deck: Marlo Chandler-Jones is the wife of Rick Jones and former lover to both the Hulk and Moondragon. Due to her relationship with Rick, she has often found herself in several superhero adventures and cosmic conflicts.

name: Silver Fox
deck: Originally thought to have been killed by Sabretooth on the North American Frontier, Silver Fox was romantically involved with Logan (aka: Wolverine).

name: Azazel
deck: Azazel is a mutant from biblical times who leads the Neyaphem and is father to X-Men member Nightcrawler, Abyss & Kiwi Black.

name: Weasel
deck: Deadpool's friend/henchman, technology expert and weapons dealer. More recently he wanted revenge against Deadpool for being a lousy friend. He was killed and, in the afterlife, struck a deal with Mephisto as Patient Zero.

name: Whiplash (Scarlotti)
deck: Whiplash is a research engineer and weapons design specialist and long-time enemy of Iron Man whose signature weapons are a pair of cybernetically-controlled titanium whips that he can use to perform amazing feats.

name: Fever Pitch
deck: Mutant who changes alliances all the time, to who ever it suits him. Is completely composed of organic fire.

name: Lee Forrester
deck: Lee Forrester works as a ship captain of the fishing trawler, Arcadia. She also had brief romantic relationships with Cyclops and Magneto and became a trusted sight to many X-men.

name: Bentley 23
deck: Bentley 23 is a clone of the Wizard who was liberated from his "father" by the Fantastic Four. He rebels against his evil bloodline as a member of the Future Foundation.

name: Sleepwalker
deck: Sleepwalker is a guardian of the Mindscape, a dimension that borders on the minds of all intelligent life. Now trapped in the mind of Rick Sheridan. When Rick sleeps, Sleepwalker escapes.

name: Turk
deck: A delusional low-level thug who has fought Daredevil many times.

name: Graviton
deck: Graviton was a physicist, named Franklin Hall, who was involved in an experiment in a private research facility in the Canadian Rockies. A mistake in Hall's calculations causes graviton particles to merge with his own molecules, and Hall later discovers that he can mentally control gravity.

name: Electron
deck: Electron is a long-time member of the Shi'ar Imperial Guard who has been both a friend and foe to the various heroes of Earth.

name: Micromax
deck: Micromax is a size changing mutant trained as a British spy.

name: Adam X
deck: Adam-X has the power to "flash fry" or burn the blood of an adversary once it has been oxygenated, usually done by opening a wound on them using his Thet'je blades.

name: Jeff the Land Shark
deck: A baby Land Shark that was adopted by Gwenpool and later by Deadpool.

name: Barbarus
deck: Barbarus is a quad-armed mutant with super strength and one of The Savage Land Mutates.

name: Frederick Foswell
deck: Frederick Foswell was a reporter for the Daily Bugle and was also known as the mobster, Big Man. He later died after he bravely sacrificed his life for J. Jonah Jameson. His daughter later took up his Big Man identity.

name: The Director
deck: A dark and sinister man who has played a major role in Wolverine and Weapon X series.

name: Vashti
deck: Vashti is Vizier of Atlantis

name: Nathan Lubensky
deck: A retired vaudevilian and love interest to Aunt May. He was also friends with Adrian Toomes, the original Vulture.

name: Korvus
deck: Shi'ar warrior that wields the Blade of the Phoenix. He became a member of the Starjammers after the events of the Rise and Fall of the Shi'Ar Empire.

name: Tarantula (Rodríguez)
deck: Antón Miguel Rodríguez was a mercenary and assassin best known as the Tarántula; a foe to Spider-Man. Since his suicide, the Tarántula mantle has been passed on to other people.

name: Dead Girl
deck: A mutant whose powers didn't activate until after she died. She became a member of the new X-Force and later X-Statix.

name: Black Widow (Clone)
deck: Spider-Woman of Earth-1610. She is a female clone of Peter Parker - Spider-Man. Despite the circumstances of her upbringing, she is determined to be a force of good. She works for SHIELD, and is a recurrent member of the Ultimates.

name: Tyrannus
deck: This telepathic immortal roman emperor is as ruthless as he is handsome! Having been banished by the wizard Merlin to the underground world of Subterrnea, Romulus Augustlus uses technology created eons ago by a alien race called the Deviants to frequently attempt to defeat the Hulk as well as conquer the world.

name: Unicorn
deck: A long time enemy of Iron Man and a foe of the Winter Guard.

name: White Rabbit
deck: The White Rabbit is a young woman with a dangerous obsession with Lewis Carroll. She is an enemy of Spider-Man.

name: Black Jack Tarr
deck: Black Jack Tarr is a friend of Shang-Chi and a member of the CIA. He is also an Enemy of Fu Manchu

name: Happy Sam Sawyer
deck: Captain in the United States Army and a member of Nick Fury's Howling Commandos.

name: Gladiator (Potter)
deck: One of Daredevil's first enemies who eventually reformed and became one of his supporters.

name: Old Lace
deck: Old Lace is a genetically engineered deinonychus that once shared an empathic bond with Gertrude Yorkes of the Runaways. Since Gertrude's death this bond has been shifted to Chase Stein.

name: Lifeguard
deck: Heather Cameron is Human/Shi'ar mutant. She briefly served as a member of the X-Treme X-Men team and later, X-Corporation.

name: Nathaniel Richards
deck: Time travelling father of Mister Fantastic, he often has mysterious plans and ulterior motives.

name: Vanessa Fisk
deck: Wilson Fisk's beloved wife, and apparent Art connoisseur.

name: Grizzly
deck: A costume-wearing criminal who is rumored to have cannibalistic tendencies. He went on to join the Masters of Evil and was later appointed to Norman Osborn's Thunderbolts squad to aid them during the Siege of Asgard.

name: Slipstream
deck: Slipstream was a latent mutant who's powers were stimulated by Sage.

name: Norah Winters
deck: A journalist who worked at the Daily Bugle along with Peter Parker and after Civil War in Front Line newspaper. She seems to like sarcastic humor and Peter is usually the joke.

name: Impulse
deck: Impulse is a veteran member of the Shi'ar Imperial Guard.

name: Red Wolf
deck: Originally, the modern bearer of spiritual mantle of the Cheyenne people handed down by the god Owayodatta to champions of peace and avengers of justice. Since Secret Wars, he has been redesigned as a Battleworld denizen who traveled to present day Earth-616

name: Nekra
deck: Nekra is a mutant who can change her angry emotions into super strength, endurance & resistance to injuries.

name: Fury
deck: The Fury was created by Mad Jim Jaspers to kill all superhumans.

name: Blackheart
deck: Blackheart is the son of Mephisto, and being so, planned to seize his father's power and succeeded.

name: Tag
deck: Brian Cruz (Tag) was selected early on by Emma Frost as one of her proteges and later joining her squad, the Hellions. Ultimately depowered due to M-Day and met his death in a bus bombing by Stryker.

name: Cosmo
deck: A telepathic Russian space dog who serves as the Head of Security of Knowhere. He has proven to be an invaluable ally to the Guardians of the Galaxy.

name: Finesse
deck: Jeanne Foucault is a polymath with the ability to instantly master any action by looking at it once. It is suspected that she might be the daughter of the Taskmaster. She was one of the first students enrolled in the Avengers Academy.

name: Knull
deck: Knull ruled the primordial universe alone until the arrival of the Celestials, who began filling his domain with matter, light and life. He went to war against them and their creations to return the universe to the dark void, creating many powerful weapons to aid him, including the Necrosword and the Klyntar symbiotes.

name: Nitro
deck: Nitro is a supervillain in the Marvel Comics universe. He is known best for being responsible for the death of Captain Marvel and later the mass killing in Stamford triggering the superhuman Civil War.

name: Anarchist
deck: One of the long-lasting members of X-Force/X-Statix. Has the ability to secrete acidic sweat.

name: Brood Queen
deck: The mother and matriarch of the parasitic aliens known as Brood. More than one Brood Queen can reign at the same time, so long as they are all subservient to the Brood Empress.

name: Spot
deck: Formerly a brilliant scientist, Jonathon Ohnn gained the ability to create teleportation portals when his research went wrong. Turning to a life of crime and adopting the moniker of 'The Spot', Ohnn has since become a semi-frequent adversary to Spider-Man and is oft treated as a less than serious threat despite his capabilities.

name: Griffin (Franklin)
deck: A former member of the Circus of Crime, Griffin is a gamma-irradiated member of the Gamma Corps.

name: James Power
deck: James Power is the father of Alex, Julie, Jack and Katie Power; aka the superhero team known as Power Pack. and an inventor.

name: Uranian
deck: A classic 1950 hero, Robert Grayson, using bands given to him by rogue Eternals, would find a never ending battle against the forces of evil. Years later, he returned to aid the Agents of Atlas.

name: Eric Koenig
deck: German member of the Howling Commandos and founding member of S.H.I.E.L.D.

name: Bethany Cabe
real_name: Bethany Anne Camilla Cabe van Tilberg
deck: Bethany Cabe is a former bodyguard and private investigator.  She worked as Tony Stark's bodyguard and eventually became his lover.  She is one of the few people in Tony's close knit inner circle. She was the most prominent love interest of Tony Stark.

name: Vanguard
deck: Older brother to first Darkstar and son of Presence.  He is a powerful mutant with the ability to repel any force directed at him, be it electromagnetic, kinetic, or gravitational.

name: Mentor
deck: A'lars - descendant of the Titan Kronos, Father to the Demi-Gods Thanos and Eros, Grandfather of Thane. Mentor, more commonly referred to as The Mentor, became the founder of the colony orbiting the planet of Saturn. Engineer, physicist, father - The Mentor would shape many cosmic characters.

name: Ogun
deck: Ogun is Wolverine's teacher and once father figure. Little is truly known of Ogun Ryu; it is said that he once encountered the legendary Miyamoto Musashi, placing him as early as the 17th century. What is known about him is that he was once a noble warrior corrupted by evil.

name: Solo
deck: Terrorism's greatest enemy, Solo is an adept soldier with the ability to teleport himself certain distances. As long as he lives, terror dies.

name: Okoye
deck: Leader of the Dora Milaje and a staunch patriot, Okoye will defend the country of Wakanda with her life.

name: Young Marvelman
deck: Dick Dauntless is one of many people given superpowers in a experiment by Gargunza.

name: Frank Drake
deck: Drake is an experienced supernatural detective and a vampire hunter. One of his experiences was when he was dwelling in Transylvania, and  faced Dracula and escape with out death.

name: Billy Connors
deck: William ''Billy'' Connors is the son of Martha and Curt Connors (the Lizard).

name: Psycho-Man
deck: Former chief scientist on Traan, a planet in the Microverse. He traveled to Earth to conquer the planet with his psycho ray. He remains a constant foe for the Fantastic Four.

name: Kevin Masterson
deck: Son of the original Thunderstrike, Kevin Masterson has recently become the new Thunderstrike after inheriting the enchanted mace. An alternate take on him becoming the new Thunderstrike was told in the MC2 Universe, where he is a founding member of A-Next.

name: Magus
deck: The evil doppleganger of Adam Warlock, Magus believes Good and Evil are tools to chain sentient beings.  His goal is to give all lifeforms a purpose: To Worship him or Die.

name: Asp
deck: Asp has the ability to discharge "venom bolts" that can paralyze or even kill someone instantly. She has been a founding member of both the Serpent Society and B.A.D Girls Inc.

name: Proxima Midnight
deck: One of Thanos' generals in the Black Order.

name: Controller
deck:
This mind sapping villain felt unappreciated and superior to other genius of his time like Reed Richards and Tony Stark. 
The man formerly known as Basil Sandhurst was a  scientist who was crippled in a laboratory accident and later developed mind controlling technology that allowed him to move as well as being directly linked to his exo skeleton. Having made alliances with people like Thanos to improve his technology, The Controller remains dedicated to his ultimate goal, the defeat of Iron Man.

name: Amiko Kobayashi
deck: Amiko Kobayashi is the surrogate daughter of Wolverine. Saved by him as a young child and cared for since. Its been revealed that she is the last descendent of the Shosei Clan, Mystical Guardians of Japan.

name: Vector
deck: The leader of the villainous group called the U-Foes.

name: Bella Donna
deck: Bella Donna is Gambit's  first love and former wife. Heiress to the highest rank in the Assassins Guild and the current leader of the Unified Guild of New Orleans. She is a ruthless mercenary, but still harbors a soft spot for Gambit.

name: Stick
deck: A brilliant blind master of martial arts who trained both Daredevil and Elektra.

name: Kristoff Vernard
deck: Kristoff Vernard is the adopted son of Victor Von Doom and heir to the Latverian throne.

name: Nancy Brown
deck: A college friend to Patsy Walker and Hedy Wolfe

name: Striker
deck: A boy who craves the spotlight and was a childhood celebrity. Striker is enrolled in the Avengers Academy.

name: Crimson Dynamo (Bukharin)
deck: Former KGB operative known as the Crimson Dynamo and Airstrike. After primarily being an Iron Man villain, he's now a member of the Russian superhero team, the Winter Guard.

name: Rio Morales
deck: Rio Morales is the mother of Miles Morales (Ultimate Spider-Man.)

name: Ironclad
deck: Ironclad is a member of the U-Foes, a small group of criminals that tried to duplicate the crash that gave the Fantastic Four their powers.  Ironclad never accepted that Hulk is stronger than him.

name: Blood Brothers
deck: The Blood Brothers were two linked alien brothers who served as minions of Thanos.

name: Marionette
deck: Princess Mari was the daughter of the King and Queen of Homeworld. When Baron Karza killed her parents and enslaved their planet, she helped lead the underground resistance fighters on Homeworld, before joining Commander Arcturus Rann as a member of the Micronauts.

name: Justin Hammer
deck: A longtime foe of Iron Man who as a criminal mastermind employed super-villains and organized criminal operations.

name: Healer
deck: The Morlock healer. He died to restore Callisto to her natural form.

name: Blonde Phantom
deck: The Blonde Phantom is a masked crime-fighter and detective. She is one of the first costumed heroines to appear during the Golden Age of Marvel Comics.

name: The Wild Sentinel
deck: The Wild Sentinel was originally one of the two Mega-Sentinels that obliterated Genosha. It was thought to have been destroyed but later returned to wreak havoc on The X-Men after being reprogrammed by Danger.

name: X-Ray
deck: X-Ray is an original member of the U-Foes and is the younger brother of Vapor.

name: Clive Reston
deck: Friend of Shang-Chi and Black Jack Tarr. He is also an enemy of Fu Manchu

name: Clay Harder
deck: The first person called Two-Gun Kid. Clay Harder starred in dime novels that exaggerated his adventures. which inspired Matt Hawk to become Two-Gun Kid.

name: Yellowjacket (DeMara)
deck: Rita DeMara became Yellowjacket after stealing the identity from the former Avenger, Hank Pym. She was a member of the Masters of Evil and the Femizons but ultimately joined the Avengers and the Guardians of the Galaxy in their quest to keep the universe safe.

name: Killraven
deck: A warrior from Earth-691, Killraven led a group known as the Freemen against the tyranny of Earth's Martian Masters.

name: Heathcliff
deck: Heathcliff the cat was a very popular tv-character. This made it so that he even got his very own series at Marvel Comics, witch lasted for 56 issues among other titles.

name: Demon Bear
deck: The Demon Bear was originally an entity who haunted the dreams of Danielle Moonstar, threatening that he would eventually come and kill her. He was seemingly responsible for the deaths of her parents.

name: Famine (Rolfson)
deck: Member of the Horsemen of Apocalypse and Mother of Genocide. Famine represents hunger and lack of food and as such was anorexic.

name: Leiko Wu
deck: Leiko is a young Chinese-British woman and also a lover and ally to Shang Chi.

name: Harlan Kleinstock
deck: Harlan Kleinstock was a member of Magneto's Acolytes, along with his twin brother Sven and his other brother Eric. He & Sven were able to merge together into one super being with enhanced strength and durability

name: Sven Kleinstock
deck: Sven Kleinstock was a member of Magneto's Acolytes, along with his twin brother, Harlan, and his other brother, Eric. He & Harlan were able to merge into one super being with heightened strength and durability.

name: Dylan Brock
deck: The son of Eddie Brock (Venom) and Anne Weying (She-Venom). Human/ Symbiote Hybrid.

name: Senyaka
deck: Senyaka is from Sri Lanka, was a part of Acolytes and has energy-based whips. He is one of the more violent members of the Acolytes and embraces Fabien Cortez's view of human extermination.

name: Venus
deck: Venus was a Siren cursed by a magician "making her soul as beautiful as her physical form". Ashamed of her past, she began claiming to be Aphrodite the Olympian Goddess of Love, a claim which fooled even the Gods themselves. Becoming a member of the Agents of Atlas, Venus found herself officially receiving the position of the Olympian Goddess of Love after an encounter with the real Aphrodite.

name: Super Sabre
deck: Member of Freedom Force. Currently part of Necrosha

name: Pretty Boy
deck: A member of the Reavers. He is a cyborg and has telepathic powers.

name: Machinesmith
deck: A former criminal who became a cyborg after his death.

name: Forbush Man
deck: Irving Forbush was a fictional office gofer at Marvel Comics. As Forbush Man he wears red long johns, a cape and a metal pot on his head.

name: Nightside
deck: Nightside is a longstanding member of the Shi'ar Imperial Guard. She has the power to generate darkness.

name: Macon
deck: Macon is a member of the Reavers, cyborg enemies of the X-Men.

name: Margaret Power
deck: Margaret Craig-Power is the wife of Dr. James Power and mother of Alex, Julie, Jack and Katie Power, better known as Power Pack.

name: Mettle
deck: From being an easy going surfer from Hawaii, then misleadingly set in the grasp of Norman Osborn,  who removed his skin revealing the armoured sheath beneath. He is now a member of the Avengers Academy. With his red skin and determined mind, he was surely born to fight.

name: Gauntlet
deck: Gauntlet is an Inhuman outcast who was one of Apocalypses Dark Riders, later worked for Genesis.

name: Mandrill
deck: Mutant Mandrill super-villain. His true power lied in the incredible ability to control females with his pheromones.

name: Michael O'Brien
deck: Michael o'Brien was a police sergeant who believed Iron Man was responsible for his brother's death. After fighting Iron Man as the Guardsman, he discovered his mistake and became an ally to Iron Man and the Avengers. He acted as Iron Man briefly and fought Sunfire and the Mandarin.

name: Ursa Major
deck: Ursa Major is a Russian mutant that transforms into a giant bear. He becomes a valuable member of the Soviet Super Soldiers and the Winter Guard.

name: Arcturus Rann
deck: Arcturus Rann was an explorer, kept in stasis for 1000 years while touring the microverse through the eyes of his mechanical companion Biotron. Rann awoke to discover his home planet, Homeworld, was subjugated by the tyrant Baron Karza. He helped form the Micronauts to save Homeworld and end Karza's reign of terror.

name: Cole
deck: Cole is a member of the Reavers, cyborg enemies of the X-Men.

name: Throg
deck: Wielding the mighty Frogjolnir, Simon Walterson is Throg.  Although he physically resembles the amphibian form that Thor was once trapped in, Throg is a different being who shares a portion of the Thunder God's powers.

name: Death's Head II
deck: Created in the year 2020 by Dr. Evelyn Necker of A.I.M., Death's Head II's psyche consists of 106 different personalities including that of the original Death's Head.

name: Peotor
deck: A cosmically empowered orangutan able to project magnetic force.

name: Silver Samurai (Shingen)
deck: Illegitimate son of Keniuchio Harada, the original Silver Samurai. A technological prodigy he makes up for his lack of mutant abilities with a self created set of armor that replicates his fathers abilities.

name: Moon Boy
deck: Part of the Moon Boy and Devil Dinosaur duo

name: Aarkus
deck: Aarkus was once the Golden Age villain-turned-hero called The Vision, whose people came to our reality to serve as midwives to beings born from Cosmic Cubes.

name: Battlin' Jack Murdock
deck: The father of Matt Murdock who boxed for a living. He was told to take a fall in a boxing match but refused. In order to save his son, he placed him in an orphanage.

name: Living Mummy
deck: N'Kantu is a mummified African tribesman with heightened strength and dexterity.  He is also considered immortal due to his "life" of over 3,000 years.

name: Grand Director
deck: Steven Rogers [formely William Burnside] was the fourth Captain America and was active in the 1950s. He has resurfaced since often fronting extremist causes and appearing as an antagonist to the real Captain America.

name: Earthquake
deck: A member of the Imperial Guard, Earthquake can psionically cause earthquakes and tremors in land.

name: Jennifer Ransome
deck: Girlfriend to Phillip Moreau and Genoshan ex-patriot

name: White Tiger
deck: As the first White Tiger, Hector possessed magical items called the Jade Tiger Amulets.  The amulets give him enhanced strength, speed, stamina and agility.  The Jade Amulet's power is addictive.

name: Gertrude Yorkes
deck: Gertrude "Gert" Yorkes was a founding member of the Runaways. She shares a psychic bond with her pet deinonychus, Old Lace. She was also the daughter Dale & Stacey Yorkes; members of the Pride.

name: Jolt
deck: Receiving her powers from Arnim Zola's cruel experimentation, Helen Takahama joined the original Thunderbolts team as Jolt, unaware of their hidden agenda. She still managed to become a fine hero in her own right, and helped several other members of the Thunderbolts do likewise.

name: Lei Kung
deck: The immortal teacher of the legacy of Iron Fist.

name: Flint
deck: Jason also known as Flint is one of the new "Nuhumans" activated after the terrigen bomb.

name: Jennifer Kale
deck: As a young woman Jennifer Kale encountered the Man-Thing, and became a powerful and skilled sorceress with extensive knowledge of magic and arcane lore. She is the protector of the Nexus, and the cousin of Johnny Blaze and Dan Ketch.

name: Reese
deck: Reese is a member of the Reavers and former guard for the Hellfire Club.

name: John Wraith
deck: John Wraith was a member of Team X during the Cold War, and later became a test subject for Weapon X. He was the team's extraction expert, using his teleportation powers to get the team out of trouble.

name: Vapor
deck: Vapor (Ann Darnell) a fictional character in the Marvel Comics Universe whose first appearance was as a member of the villainous group, the U-Foes.

name: Roxanne Simpson Blaze
deck: Roxanne is the late wife of Johnny Blaze, the Ghost Rider. She became the Black Rose after her death.

name: Lady Bullseye
deck: Lady Bullseye is an assassin that works for the Hand. A former sex slave of the Yakuza, she escaped after Daredevil's enemy Bullseye infiltrated and slaughtered the gang. His martial prowess served as the girl's inspiration.

name: Crosta
deck: An Atlantean mutant secreted away by his mother after the abandonment of Atlantis. He has since been forced to become Namor's ward and join the ranks of the X-Men. He is currently enrolled at the Jean Grey School for Higher Learning.

name: Korvac
deck: A denizen of the 31st century, Korvac betrayed humanity to Badoon invaders and became the enemy of the Guardians of the Galaxy.  Gaining untold power from the Worldship of Galactus, he then traveled back in time to become an enemy of the Avengers as well as a threat to the entire universe.

name: Gaea
deck: Gaea is one of the Elder Gods and mother to all the pantheon of Gods on Earth. She is known as Mother Earth and embodies the spirit of life, harvest and renewal on Earth. Gaea is associated with all the creatures of the Earth as well as the Human Race.

name: Abraham Erskine
deck: The creator of the Super Soldier Serum that created Captain America. He was assassinated before writing down the formula, which led to several parties attempting to recreate the formula from scratch with little success.

name: Igor
deck: Red Ghost's baboon capable of shapeshifting.

name: Tom Corsi
deck: Former Vietnam veteran and police officer for Westchester Police Department, Tom Corsi was transformed by the Demon Bear into a super strong Native American.  Although rarely seen in action, he is a long-standing support for the New Mutants, Generation X and the New X-Men.

name: Threnody
deck: Threnody is a mutant called an "energy vampire". She is a former slave of Mr. Sinister and lover of X-man Nate Grey.

name: Cottonmouth
deck: Cottonmouth is a vicious member of the Serpent Society with the ability to unhinge his jaw.  With a row of steel teeth, he enjoys biting the heads off of his victims.

name: Grand Vizier
deck: Magician god of Asgard, adviser to Odin

name: Carmen Pryde
deck: Carmen Pryde is the father of Kitty Pryde, better known as the X-men's Shadowcat. He died in Genosha during the Sentinel attack.

name: Lucinda Guthrie
deck: Lucinda Guthrie is the mother of the X-Men, Husk and Cannonball.

name: Bob, Agent of HYDRA
deck: Kidnapped (or liberated) from his post at a HYDRA base by the mercenary Deadpool, Bob is a surprisingly normal guy.  Deadpool's feelings for Bob range from friendship to considering him a pet.

name: Killer Shrike
deck: Mercenary for hire

name: Zzzax
deck: Zzzax is an electromagnetic intelligent being that was created when stray bullets from terrorists caused an explosion that started a chain reaction in the atomic reactor of a nuclear power plant. Zzzax is a recurring enemy of the Hulk.

name: Katherine Summers
deck: Katherine Anne was wife to Corsair and mother to Cyclops, Havok, and Vulcan.

name: Queen Mother
deck: Former Queen of Wakanda, wife to T'Chaka, surrogate mother to Hunter and T'Challa and mother to Shuri.

name: Melita Garner
deck: Wolverine's ex-girlfriend. A reporter working for the San Francisco Post, than the Daily Bugle in New York. She was saved from robbers by Wolverine. They were in a relationship.

name: Max Modell
deck: Max Modell was the head of Horizon Labs and also the employer and good friend of Peter Parker.

name: Turbo
deck: Michiko Musashi, former member of the New Warriors, is one of the many users of Brock Jones' Torpedo armor.

name: Shola Inkosi
deck: Shola Inkose is a former citizen of Genosha who met Kitty Pryde, Shadowcat of the X-men, while attending college in Chicago. He eventually joined the ranks of Excalibur for a brief stint in Genosha.

name: Madame Web
deck: Madame web is a mutant with precognitive powers. She retains her powers after M-Day. Madame Web also is the one who reminds Peter Parker who he is when he starts to think about not being Spider-man. Was played by Stan Lee's wife Joan in the 90s cartoon.

name: Yellow Claw
deck: A crime lord who wants total world domination. He sure deserves his reputation as the Master of Terror.

name: Bernie Rosenthal
deck: Bernie Rosenthal is the former girlfriend of Steve Rogers and well-known glass blower in New York City.

name: Doctor Faustus
deck: Doctor Faustus is a villain mostly conspiring against Captain America. He deems himself "Master of Mens' Minds" for using psychological combat against his enemies.

name: D'Ken
deck: Former ruler of the Shi'ar Empire and brother to both Lilandra and Deathbird.

name: Face
deck: One of the mutant babies kidnapped by demons during the Inferno. Face was raised in Limbo by the Government-funded Project Purgatory. His mutation caused him to lose his face. He is blind, deaf and mute. He is currently enrolled at the Jean Grey School for Higher Learning.

name: Gaza
deck: Gaza was one of Magneto's first Savage Land Mutates.

name: Kangaroo
deck: Frank Oliver with his superhuman leaping abilities was the criminal better known as the Kangaroo. After Frank's death, another person named Brian Hibbs took over as the Kangaroo.

name: Astra
deck: One of the members of the Shi'ar Empires Imperial Guards, Astra is an alien with mass altering abilities which allow her do become intangible. She has seen all the major changes of the Guardsmen allegiances and membership throughout the years.

name: Linda Carter
deck: A student night nurse, Linda Carter started aiding superheroes in need of medical care and began dating Doctor Strange.

name: Stonewall
deck: The first Stonewall was a former WWII fighter and group member of Freedom force.   The second Stonewall is part of Nick Fury's Secret Commandos.

name: Chewie
deck: Carol's pet cat from an alt. universe. Actually an alien.

name: Beetle (Lincoln)
deck: Janice Lincoln, daughter to the mobster Tombstone, is the current Beetle, formerly a member of Boomerang's Sinister Six, and now the leader of an all-new Sinister Syndicate.

name: The Professor
deck: Professor Hudson was one of the scientists of the Weapon X Project. He is first seen in the closing days of World War II, discovering journals of Mr. Sinister. Later he has Wolverine captured and laces his bones with Adamantium.

name: Martha Connors
deck: Martha is the wife of Curt Connors, mother of Billy Connors.

name: Opal Tanaka
deck: Opal Tanaka is  former girlfriend of Bobby Drake, the mutant Iceman.

name: Stegron
deck: A former assistant to Curt Connors, Vincent Stegron used stegosaurus DNA to augment his body.

name: Bova
deck: A human-cow hybrid created by the High Evolutionary, Bova is somewhat of a professional nursemaid; having in large part singlehandedly raised both Quicksilver and the Scarlet Witch at Wundagore Mountain.

name: Hrimhari
deck: Hrimhari is a wolf-prince of Asgard and is therefore likely centuries or millennia old.  He has werewolf shape-shifting capabilities similar to Wolfsbane, and was unable to reach a human form until recently.

name: Monica Chang
deck: The chief of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Artificial Intelligence Division.

name: Christian Walker
deck: Formerly a superhero, Christian Walker is now a homicide detective who specializes in powers-related cases. He is the star of the creator owned Powers series by Brian Michael Bendis and Michael Avon Oeming.

name: In-Betweener
deck: The In-Betweener is a servant of the forces of Order and Chaos.  He makes sure there is always a balance between the two worlds and draws his powers from both as well.

name: Jumbo Carnation
deck: A famous mutant fashion designer. His death was used to create the Omega Gang, which lead to the Xavier School riot.

name: Man-Bull
deck: An extremely deadly ex-convict with superhuman strength, endurance and resistance to injury.

name: Black Box
deck: Black Box, formerly known as Commcast, is a cyberpath who used to work with Cable.

name: Genesis
deck: Tyler Dayspring was born in an alternate future era ruled by the eternal mutant Apocalypse. He is the son of Cable.

name: Alexi Vazhin
deck: Head of Russian Executive Security Committee, working directly with The Winter Guard.

name: Miss Sinister
deck: Claudine was created by the geneticist Mister Sinister to act as a fail-safe in the event of his death. When that ultimately occurred, Claudine was activated. Becoming Miss Sinister, she joined the Hellfire Club and briefly romanced Daken. Last seen unconscious in the presence of Mr. Sinister himself.

name: Red Guardian (Shostakov)
deck: Alexei Shostakov is a Russian patriotic hero and the second man to assume the Red Guardian mantle. He was married to the Russian spy Black Widow and was assumed dead for years.

name: Phillip Moreau
deck: Son of the Genegineer, who fled Genosha to save his girlfriend, Jenny Ransome.

name: Inferno
deck: Dante was a resident of Des Plaines, Illinois until the Terrigen Mists appeared and turned him into the Inhuman, Inferno.

name: Punisher 2099
deck: Police officer Jake Gallows follows in the bloody, bullet-riddled footsteps of Frank Castle, bringing his one-man war on crime into the year 2099.

name: Terror Inc
deck: Originally created for a mature readers imprint called Epic before being moved to Marvel proper, Terror Inc. is an undead detective with the power to assimilate body parts, along with core memories, skills, and superpowers associated with that body part.

name: Yelena Belova
deck: Yelena Belova was trained and brainwashed by the Red Room and made it her mission to defeat Black Widow (Natasha Romanoff). Instead, Natasha helped Yelena move away from Russia and the Red Room and Yelena now serves as the White Widow and Natasha's ally.

name: Maddie Drake
deck: Maddie Drake is the mother of Bobby Drake, better known as the X-men's Iceman.

name: Ernesto Gambonno
deck: Luigi and his brother Ernesto are the Flying Gambonnos in the Circus of Crime.

name: Sadie Sinclair
deck: Mayor of San Francisco and ally to the X-Men.

name: Eric the Red
deck: Davan was a member of the Shiar Empire and protected their leader with his life.

name: Outlaw Kid
deck: A western crimefighter with a split personality

name: Gilgamesh
deck: His true name lost in the mists of time, The Forgotten One is a member of the immortal race called the Eternals. He has been known by many names but he is once more who he must ever be: The Forgotten One.

name: Princess Fen
deck: Atlantean royalty, Princess Fen was the daughter of Emperor Tha-Korr, the wife of Leonard McKenzie and the mother of Prince Namor.

name: Fabian Stankowicz
deck: Fabian Stankowicz is a technical whiz who tried to make a name for himself by attacking the Avengers as the Mechano-Marauder. He would eventually reform as Mechanaut and use his talents to assist the Avengers and Captain America.

name: Rain Boy
deck: Rain Boy was a member of Gambit's Squad up until he was depowered on M-Day.

name: Deathlok (Collins)
deck: Formerly known as Deathlok when his brain was placed inside the cyborg body.  Recently Michael has been cured, able to transform between his cyborg and human bodies at will.

name: Slapstick
deck: High School practical joker Steve Harmon was transformed into a being of living electroplasm during a trip to a different dimension in the Multiverse, referred to as Dimension Ecch.

name: Luigi Gambonno
deck: Luigi and his brother Ernesto are the Flying Gambonnos in the Circus of Crime.

name: Cerebra
deck: Cerebra was created by Forge from old parts of a sentinel.

name: Carter Ghazikhanian
deck: Carter Ghazikhanian is the son of Annie Ghazikhanian.

name: Dorothy Walker
deck: The mother of Patsy Walker.

name: Zuras
deck: Zuras is the son of Kronos, brother of A'Lars (Mentor) and father of Thena.  He rules Earth's Eternals, from Olympia, as the Prime-Eternal.

name: Morlun
deck: A member of the Inheritors, a race of beings that feed on totems, a fusion of humans and animals with powers of both. He is instrumental in Spider-Man's transformation, where he eventually "embraces the Other".

name: Sha Shan
deck: Sha Shan is a Vietnamese national who has saved Flash Thompson’s life many times. After a brief stint as a Spider-Man villian called Sister Sun, she gave up crime.

name: J. Jonah Jameson, Sr.
deck: The father of the former editor of The Daily Bugle, J. Jonah Jameson, and currently married to Peter Parker's Aunt May.

name: Pluto
deck: Ruler of Hades, the Underworld. God of the Dead.

name: X-Cutioner
deck: A former government agent out to assassinate violent mutants using weapons and paraphernalia collected from former X-Villains.

name: Grizzly
deck: Grizzly is former member of the Six Pack. He was killed years ago and was recently ressurrected on Krakoa, along with many other mutants.

name: Lance Bannon
deck: Lance Bannon was a former rival photographer of Peter Parker and boyfriend to Amy Powell. He was later murdered by the man known only as F.A.C.A.D.E.

name: Lindsay McCabe
deck: Lindsay McCabe is an actress and is Spider-Woman's (Jessica Drew) best friend. She also spent time with Wolverine in Madripoor.

name: Arkon
deck: The imperial ruler of the extra-dimensional world of Polemachus. More recently, Arkon found himself in Weirdworld, a strange otherworldly dimension.

name: Dreaming Celestial
deck: Tiamut The Dreaming Celestial, exiled to Earth by his fellow Celestials, has had interactions with both Mutants and Eternals influencing their development.

name: Adversary
deck: Adversary is an ancient being who comes from a dimension of chaos and wishes to bring this chaos to all dimensions.

name: D'Spayre
deck: D'Spayre is a 20,000 year old creation of the Fear Lord called Dweller in Darkness. Since then he has tortured Humanity, instilling fear and despair wherever he goes.

name: Trinary
deck: A technopath mutant rescued by Jean Grey in Delhi who has joined her X-Men team.

name: Erik Killmonger
deck: A powerful warrior and strategic genius well versed in politics, science and economics. Bearing a deep resentment of Wakanda and its royal line, N'Jadaka will stop at nothing to take the hidden Kingdom for his own and see the world trembling before him.

name: Ulysses Bloodstone
deck: Ulysses Bloodstone is the adopted name of an ancient hunter turned adventurer, soldier of fortune, and monster hunter after contact with a fragment of the mystic Bloodgem rendered him virtually immortal. He lived for well over ten thousand years.

name: Power-Skrull
deck: Paibok the Power Skrull was bionically re-engineered to posses more power than the Fantastic Four. A Captain in the Skrull empire that is relentless and ruthless.

name: Porcupine
deck: Alex Gentry, the Porcupine, was one of the first Marvel silver age villains and most notably fought against Ant-Man and Captain America, but also faced the Avengers, the X-Men and the Defenders.

name: Skullbuster
deck: A cyborg and member of the Reavers. He encountered the X-men multiple times.

name: Black Swan
deck: A mysterious woman that came to kill the world.

name: Scourge
deck: The Scourge of the Underworld is a vigilante committed cleansing the world of costumed criminals through the means of assassination.

name: Gamesmaster
deck: One of the most powerful, if not the most, mutant telepaths on Earth. The Gamemaster's mind is linked to every psyche on the planet where he could toy with their lives to ease the pain from his powers

name: War (Kieros)
deck: As the result of war injuries, Abraham Lincoln Kieros was paralyzed from the neck down and forced to stay in an iron lung Apocalypse restored his health and made him his Horseman War.

name: Queen Cat
deck: Harry Osborn's fiance who absorbed a unique variation of the Goblin Serum that allows her to shapeshift into a goblin. After losing those powers, she assumed the persona of Queen Cat.

name: Swarm
deck: A former Nazi scientist, von Meyer's expertise in cosmic radiation allowed him to mutate a colony of bees, thus becoming Swarm. As Swarm, von Meyer's body is completely made of bees.

name: Deena Pilgrim
deck: Deena is a unique detective and a partner of Christian Walker.

name: Charles Lehnsherr
deck: Charles is the son of Rogue and Magneto in the Age of Apocalypse.

name: Shuma-Gorath
deck: A Lord of Chaos and Master of the extra-dimensional gods known as the Old Ones, Shuma-Gorath rules over hundreds of dimensions. He is best known for being one of the most powerful and terrifying adversaries of Doctor Strange. It is seemingly impossible to permanently destroy this evil god.

name: Post
deck: A Mutant who was the one who tried to assasinate Robert Kelly for the second time.

name: Aleta Ogord
deck: Aleta Ogord was an Arcturan alien raised by her father, Ogord.

name: Ivan Petrovitch
deck: A Russian soldier who rescued an infant from a burning building during the Battle of Stalingrad, Ivan later became the guardian of the young child, Natasha Romanoff.

name: Tyler Stone
deck: The original owner of the Alchemax corporation

name: Magda Eisenhardt
deck: Magda was Magneto's wife, and mother of his children; the late Anya and twins Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch. More recently, it was hinted that Magda was not really the twins' mother.

name: Kro
deck: Kro is a well-known shape-shifting Deviant and love-interest to the Eternal known as Thena. Because of his love for her, Kro sometimes became a relunctant ally of the Eternals.

name: Master Man
deck: Master Man was a frail Nazi powered by the Super Soldier Serum who fought Captain America in World War II.

name: Dr. Ashley Kafka
deck: Ravencroft Sanitarium for the Criminally Insane psychiatrist. She has been the Doctor to Carnage, Shriek, Carrion, Vermin, Chameleon, Massacre and Venom to name a few. Later she becomes the villain called Goblin Queen.

name: Debra Whitman
deck: Fellow student and brief girlfriend of Spider-Man

name: Monica Rappaccini
deck: Monica Rappaccini was the Supreme Scientist of A.I.M. Her daughter, Carmilla Black, is the Scorpion.

name: Miek
deck: Miek is an insectoid warrior, one of the last of his kind from the planet Sakaar. He becomes warbound with the Hulk during Planet Hulk.

name: Mikhlo
deck: A gorilla that gained enhanced strength after being exposed to cosmic rays.

name: Emily Preston
deck: An agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. who recruited Deadpool to be a part of a top secret S.H.I.E.L.D. mission that involved killing undead United States Presidents.

name: Arcanna
deck: Arcanna is a powerful sorceress and member of the Squadron Supreme from the alternate universe of Earth-712.

name: Basilisk
deck: Basilisk was a student in Xorn's special class, and was also killed by him.

name: Matthew Risman
deck: Matthew Risman is the leader of the Purifiers, an extremist cult which seeks the eradication of all mutants. He is the successor of the late William Stryker, who founded the Purifiers.

name: Egghead
deck: Egghead is a loathsome scientist who quickly became a nemesis to Hank Pym.

name: M-11
deck: A human consciousness within the metallic body of a humanoid robot, better known as M-11, teammember of the Agents of Atlas.

name: Candra
deck: A member of the immortal Externals, Candra possesses extremely powerful telekinetic abilities. She was believed to have been killed by the X-Men after her power gem was destroyed, but has since returned with a new-found ability to feed on others' lifeforces.

name: Human Cannonball
deck: A somewhat weak member of the Circus of Crime.

name: Demogoblin
deck: The second Hobgoblin, Jason Macendale, became possessed by a demon after making a deal with N'astirh for power. When Jason rid himself of the demon he was host to, it became a seperate entity known as Demogoblin.

name: Shapeshifter
deck: The alien shapeshifting member of the Sh'iar Imperial Guard he has gone by both Shapeshifter and Hobgoblin. One of the founding members of the Guardsmen he has fought against the X-Men, Starjammers and the Avengers on service to the Royal Family of the Sh'Air.

name: Nightmask
deck: An artificial human created by Ex Nihilo who was endowed with cosmic powers by the White Event.

name: Marduk Kurios
deck: The being mostly being referred to with the name Satan is Marduk Kurios. He is the father of Daimon Hellstrom and Satana.

name: ISAAC
deck: ISAAC is the near omniscient computer on Titan. All information travels through him to the residents and leaders.

name: Lyra
deck: Hailing from Earth-8009, Lyra is the genetically engineered daughter of Thundra and the Hulk. She traveled to Earth-616 where she became an agent of A.R.M.O.R. and later joined the Defenders before enrolling at Avengers Academy.

name: Skybolt
deck: Formerly of the Omega Gang, Vin has since been incarcerated, lost his powers on M-Day, and joined the New Warriors as Skybolt, along with his former Omega Gang mates Tattoo and Radian.

name: Jack O'Lantern (Levins)
deck: Steven Mark Levins is one of several people to call themselves Jack O'Lantern. He has been an enemy to Captain America, Ghost Rider and the Punisher.

name: Lucky
deck: Also known as "Pizza Dog". He was owned by a member of the Tracksuit Mafia. After Hawkeye fed him some pizza, which wasn't even that good, he bravely came to Hawkeye's rescue during a fight.

name: Elizabeth Guthrie
deck: A sister of Cannonbal and Husk, and one of the many siblings of the Guthrie family

name: Tessie the Typist
deck: A very temperamental secretary in 40's Marvel.

name: Zarrko the Tomorrow Man
deck: A mad scientist from the 23rd century that has mastered time travel and seeks to use it to conquer reality.

name: Joshua Walker
deck: Joshua Walker is the father of Patsy Walker, the super-heroin known as Hellcat.

name: Margali Szardos
deck: The self-proclaimed Sorceress Supreme of Earth and Mistress of the Winding Way, she is morally ambiguous, often using black magick for good intent and, although her true origins remain a mystery, Margali is a powerful witch-priestess with a familial heritage of magick and healing.  Margali is the foster-mother of Kurt Wagner, Nightcrawler as well as mother of Jimaine Szardos, AKA Amanda Sefton, Magicienne.

name: Blind Al
deck: Deadpool's former roommate/hostage who has been known to share a love/hate relationship with the wisecracking mercenary.

name: Puff Adder
deck: Puff Adder is a member of the Serpent Society. He has the ability to expand his size and musculature. He also can spew an acidic cloud from his mouth at a very close range.

name: Microtron
deck: Microtron is the personal robot of Mari, princess of Homeworld. He never abandons her while she joins the underground and the micronauts, fighting Baron Karza.

name: Baron Blood (Falsworth)
deck: Baron Blood is a vampire foe of the Invaders, especially Union Jack and Captain America.

name: Risque
deck: Formerly involved with X-Force and X-Corporation, Risque was a menacing vixen who seduced Warpath as part of a deal with Sledge.  She gained real feelings for Warpath. She was killed by the U-Men and afterwards resurrected as part of Selene's undead mutant army.

name: Gen. Nguyen Ngoc Coy
deck: General Coy is a crime boss in Madripoor.

name: Phaser
deck: Former student at the Institute then one of the members of Omega Group, Christian has since joined the New Warriors as Phaser, along with his sister Christine.

name: Scintilla
deck: A member of the Shi'ar Imperial Guard who can change her size at will.

name: Ultimaton
deck: Ultimaton aka. Weapon XV is a Human-Sentinel hybrid created by the Weapon Plus program.  He was cloned or ressurrected by Fantomex in order to monitor the World facility however upon Fantomex's death he reverted to his original programming and personality.

name: Mik
deck: An evolved Moloid

name: Corvus Glaive
deck: Former servant of Thanos.

name: Doctor Stasis
deck: A clone of Mister Sinister with a Black Club on his forehead.

name: Bevatron
deck: The electrically charged Bevatron was the last individual to become a member of the original Hellions. He made only two appearances until he met his demise and was slaughtered by Trevor Fitzroy.

name: Lupo
deck: A feral member of the Savage Land Mutates that is able to communicate with beasts.

name: Adrienne Frost
deck: Adrienne Frost is the sister of Cordelia and Emma Frost, known for her psychometry, backstabbing ways, and conniving plots.

name: Phat
deck: Phat was the larger member of X-Statix that could enlarge and decrease the mass in his fat cells.

name: Chthon
deck: Chthon is an Elder God and Archdemon that resides in a nether dimension adjacent to the earthly plane. He is responsible for the creation of Witches, Werewolves and Vampires and is portrayed as the equivalent of the primal Devil that predates the Judeo-Christian teachings.

name: Superia
deck: Scientific genius, time-altering terrorist and would-be World Conqueror, Superia is a misandrist and villain who has fought Captain America on several occasions.

name: Delgado
deck: Delgado was one of the original Acolytes. He died when Asteroid M crashed.

name: Jonathan
deck: A pet wolverine.

name: Chimera
deck: Chimera is an extra dimensional pirate who commits crimes in multiple dimensions.

name: Lord Chaos
deck: The living embodiment of Chaos.

name: Beverly Switzler
deck: Beverly Switzler is the closest thing Howard the Duck has to a sidekick and friend.

name: Plague
deck: Plague was a member of the Morlocks who had the power to transmit diseases to people on contact. She was chosen by Apocalypse to become Pestilence, one of his Four Horsemen.

name: Bliss
deck: Bliss is a mutant and member of the Morlocks. She has a very strange power, a giant tongue that can alter peoples minds.

name: Leong Coy Manh
deck: Leong Coy Manh is the younger brother of Karma and twin brother of Nga Coy Manh

name: Tong
deck: An evolved Moloid.

name: Bats
deck: A basset hound which was adopted by Doctor Strange after he became a veterinarian after deposing from his Sorcerer Supreme title.

name: Rachel van Helsing
deck: A vampire hunter whom fought alongside the Dracula Hunters, she is the great granddaughter of Abraham van Helsing.

name: Collective Man
real_name: Ho, Sun, Chang, Lin, and Han Tao-Yu
deck: Ho, Sun, Chang, Lin, and Han Tao-Yu are five Chinese quintuplets and mutants that can merge into a single powerful being, and draw strength from all the people in China.

name: Ahura
