deck: The son of Black Bolt and Medusa.

name: Texas Kid (Temple)
deck: Masked western hero

name: Frog-Man
deck: Frog-Man is Eugene Patilio, the son of the former super-villain Leap-Frog, who hoped to do good and become a hero. He clumsily tried to battle crime to redeem his father's name. His only "power" is the ability to leap great distances with electrical coils in his boots.

name: Elloe
deck: Elloe is a native of the planet Sakaar that becomes warbound with the Hulk during Planet Hulk.

name: D.O.A.
deck: Emplate's butler and driver, D.O.A. is a creepy little gray man with a big, equally creep smile on his face. Nothing else is known about D.O.A.

name: Nga Coy Manh
deck: Nga Coy Manh is the younger sister of Karma and older twin sister of Leong Coy Manh

name: Ragnarok
deck: Ragnarok is a cyborg clone of Thor created by Tony Stark, Reed Richards, and Hank Pym by fusing the DNA of an Asgardian and Stark tech. Together to help the team of Avengers during the events of "Civil War". He has all the powers of the Asgardian god and none of the humanity emotions and such.

name: Tito Bohusk
deck: Tito is the only child of Beak and Angel Salvadore to retain his powers after M-Day. He has five siblings, two of which are named Axel and Kara.

name: Rikki Barnes
deck: The Bucky Barnes counterpart on the "Heroes Reborn" Earth. So far, there are two versions of Rikki Barnes in known existence.

name: Apache Kid
deck: Alan Krandal is a kid who was raised by Apache Chief that fights for anything threatened in his homeland

name: Big Bertha
deck: Wisconsin's most famous super model, Ashley Crawford possesses the mutant ability to transform from trim and svelte to remarkably obese and back through the power of regurgitation.

name: Man-Ape
deck: M'Baku is a worshipper of the sacred White Gorilla who was exiled from Wakanda because of his actions in leading the cult and betraying The Black Panther. A sacred ritual gives him apelike strength, agility and stamina, earning him the name Man-Ape.

name: Master Pandemonium
deck: A supernatural villain responsible for stealing the souls of the Scarlet Witch's twin children.

name: Eel (Stryke)
deck: Leopold Stryke was the original super-villain known as the Eel and was the brother of the late Jordan Stryke, the original Viper.

name: Vengeance (Badilino)
deck: In his superhuman form, Michael Badilino was called Vengeance and originally attempted to kill Ghost Rider, believing him to be Zarathos.

name: Brent Jackson
deck: Brent Jackson was a Weapon X agent who ascended to the position of Director after The Director himself was forced out of said position in an overthrow of leadership.

name: Skrull Wolverine
deck: Skrull that impersonated Wolverine. There has been two different Skrull Wolverines, one in X-Men, and another in the Secret Invasion Event.

name: Madcap
deck: The villain known as Madcap is a disturbed man who is trying to make everyone see that the universe does not make sense. He has amazing recuperative and healing powers.

name: Gravity
deck: Greg Willis was a normal teenager until a mysterious accident changed his life forever. Now known as the hero Gravity, Willis sets out to make his impact on the Marvel Universe.

name: Cerebra
deck: Cerebra is a mutant mentalist and an original founding member of the X-Men in 2099. She also founded the team known as X-Nation. She later moved to the present.

name: Ben Parker
deck: The son of Peter Parker and Mary Jane. He possesses abilities similar to his father and older sister, Mayday, and has recently been moonlighting as his sister's sidekick.

name: Eson the Searcher
deck: Eson the Searcher's sole duty is to seek out specimes for Gammenon to gather.

name: Turg
deck: An evolved Moloid

name: Anna Maria Marconi
deck: A chemistry and physics tutor who offers her help to Otto Octavius/Peter Parker.

name: Shiklah
deck: Once destined to be Dracula's bride, Shiklah is a ancient royal succubus who fell in love and married Deadpool instead. However, the marriage wasn't stable for too long, with the two eventually going to war with one another. During said war, Shiklah ends marrying Dracula, like originally intended.

name: Captain America (HYDRA)
deck: As the result of changing the timeline by Kobik on behalf of Red Skull; an alternate Steve Rogers was created. This version was a HYDRA sleeper agent whose memories were replaced with the original timeline Steve Rogers. He imposed an authoritarian control over the world, anouncing absolute freedom as chaos and an impediment to order and peace.

name: Courtney Duran
deck: Classmate of May "Mayday" Parker a.k.a. Spider-Girl.

name: Brian Banner
deck: Brian Banner is the mentally unstable and abusive alcoholic father of Bruce Banner, the Incredible Hulk.

name: Giganto
deck: Giganto is one of the Mole Man's pets from Monster Isle.  Giganto appears on the cover of the legendary Fantastic Four #1, squeezing the Invisible Girl, who is unable to turn invisible fast enough.

name: Shriek
deck: A drug dealer/rock groupie whose mutant abilities were activated after a confrontation with Cloak and Dagger. She later became Carnage's girlfriend during Maximum Carnage.

name: Richard Parker
deck: Richard Parker is the father of Peter Parker (Spider-Man), the husband of Mary Parker, and the younger brother of Ben Parker. Richard worked for the CIA.

name: Bloodscream
deck: A long-lived nemesis of Wolverine, Bloodscream is a powerful vampire-like being with a bloodlust and capabilities similar to them, but possesses none of their traditional weaknesses.

name: Mad Jim Jaspers
deck: An insane mutant from Earth-238 with nigh-omnipotent reality warping powers. It took the destruction of the entire reality to stop him. On Earth-616, in the main Marvel universe, he had even more power.

name: Litterbug
deck: A Morlock with roach characteristics.

name: M.O.D.O.K. 2.0
deck: A clone of the original M.O.D.O.K. created by A.I.M. who currently works for S.H.I.E.L.D.

name: Ebony Maw
deck: A thin razor of a man, Ebony Maw wins his battles not through the application of force, but through the webs of lies and manipulation he weaves. Though his methods are unconventional, his knack for results has earned him the respect of Thanos. He is one of the five generals of the Cull Obsidian.

name: Naja
deck: Naja is a Nuhuman who befriended Inferno and Flint.

name: Death
deck: Death was the first of Apocalypse's Horsemen and the son of Apocalypse and his wife Genesis. Like his mother and siblings, he was separated from Apocalypse when the island of Arakko was sealed away in the dimension of Amenth.

name: Bei the Blood Moon
deck: Arakko-born warrior who did not speak for the first fifty years of her life. When she did, she discovered she had a "Doom Note," a voice capable of destroying a mountain that desires to be understood but remains impossible to translate.

name: Umar
deck: Clea's mother and Dormammu's younger twin sister who briefly was the Queen of the Dark Dimension.

name: 8-Ball
deck: 8-Ball went from a brilliant inventor to a bitter re-occurring villain for the hero Sleepwalker. He was eventually killed and brought back. Since his resurrection, Moon Knight has been keeping tabs on him.

name: Naze
deck: Nazé is a Cheyenne mystic and ally of Forge.

name: Joy Mercado
deck: A reporter for the Daily Bugle as well as one-time partner and potential love interest of Peter Parker.

name: David Moreau
deck: The creator of the Genoshan mutate process and a true patriot to his country.

name: Maria Castle
deck: The deceased wife of Frank Castle, The Punisher

name: Katu
deck: Katu is an Inuin and a living conduit of interatmospheric anomalies. He lost his arms in a battle with Omega Red and had cybernetic arms attached.

name: Ferris
deck: A robot that works with Magneto.

name: Cyttorak
deck: Cyttorak is an immensely powerful deity, ruler of the Crimson Cosmos and supplier of power to his avatar, the unstoppable Juggernaut.

name: Champion
deck: An Elder of The Universe, Tryco Slatterus was born over 5 billion years ago. His fighting supremacy has earned him the title of Champion...Champion of The Universe.

name: Persuasion
deck: A former member of Alpha Flight and Beta Flight, Persuasion is the daughter of the Purple Man and is able to control people through her pheromones, making them responsive to her commands.

name: Toxin
deck: Toxin is the symbiote spawn of the vicious symbiote, Carnage, and grandson of Venom.

name: Fat Cobra
deck: Fat Cobra is the Immortal Weapon of Peng Lai Island one of the Seven Capital Cities of Heaven. His size and strength are only outclassed by his speed.

name: Beef
deck: The super-strong mutant Beef, Buford Wilson, would be the second to the last mutant youth to be recruited into the original Hellions.

name: Ajak
deck: The Eternal spokesman for the Third and Fourth host of the Celestials on Earth.

name: Francine Frye
deck: An ex-girlfriend of the original Electro, Max Dillon, whom accidently killed her. She was later cloned by the Jackal and became the new Electro.

name: Isca the Unbeaten
deck: Sister to Genesis and sister-in-law to Apocalypse, Isca is an Omega-level mutant with the power to never lose. Often this power controls her rather than the other way around, and forces her to take actions she may not like in order to remain on the winning side.

name: Heather Glenn
deck: A former girlfriend of Matt Murdock AKA Daredevil. She was a former head of the now closed Glenn Industries. She commited suicide after she thought that Matt had ended the relationship.

name: Lady Octopus
deck: Otto Octavius' apprentice, who took the title of her mentor after Octavius' death, and has fought Spider-Man many times.

name: Obadiah Stane
deck: Obadiah Stane was the first man to use the identity of the Iron Monger. The billionaire industrialist used the Iron Monger armor in a battle against his rival and arch-nemesis, Anthony Stark/Iron Man.

name: Longstrike
deck: Was one of the members in Quentin Quire's team Omega Gang, following that she was imprisoned and depowered on M-Day, and finally became a New Warrior with her brother Christian.

name: Synapse
deck: An Inhuman member of the Avengers Unity Squad whose presence on the team was personally vouched for by Steve Rogers.

name: Davida Kirby
deck: Davida Kirby is May Parker's best friend in the MC2 universe.

name: Becky Blake
deck: An attorney who represented Matt Murdock when he was charged with illegal vigilantism. She later joined the law firm of Nelson and Murdock.

name: Rocket Racer
deck: Robert Farrell was a misguided youth, stealing to feed his hungry family. After several confrontations with Spider-Man, he has since learned the errors of his ways.

name: Everett K. Ross
deck: A U.S. State Department employee, whose job was to escort foreign diplomats on American soil. His world changed forever when he was assigned to T'Challa, the Black Panther. He is the boyfriend of Nikki Adams.

name: Zaladane
deck: Queen of the Sun People of the Savage Land and proclaimed to be the half-sister of the mutant Polaris.

name: J2
deck: J2 is the son of Cain Marko, the Unstoppable Juggernaut, in the future timeline of Earth-982, (the MC2 universe.)  He is a heroic member of his timeline's Avengers.

name: No-Name
deck: No-Name is a nameless broodspawn that was stranded on Sakaar after a failed Brood attack. She later became part of Hulk's Warbound.

name: Lord Deathstrike
deck: Lord Deathstrike is a professional assassin hired by the Red Right Hand to kill Mystique.

name: Mach 2
deck: Nomi Blume is a mutant in the Ultimate Universe and a rival to Kitty Pryde for leadership of the remaining mutant population.

name: Lorelei Travis
deck: Lorelei Travis is one of The 198. Her power is prehensile hair and her first appearance was District X #1.

name: Nightshade
deck: Nightshade is a biochemist with a strong interest in lycanthropy. She uses potions, manipulation and seduction as a means to get her own way and if that doesn't work she also has an army of wolves ready to tear you apart.

name: Death Adder
deck: Death Adder was a mute killer who was a member of the Serpent Society. He was killed by the Scourge of the Underworld, but later was brought back by The Hood in order to eliminate the Punisher. Most recently Death Adder joined Crime-Master's Savage Six.

name: Tusk
deck: Tusk is a native of Attilan and therefore an Inhuman. Employed by Apocalypse to join the Dark Riders, he is very large in stature, with heightened invulnerability and super strength, as well as an ability to create small duplicates (about 1/4 of his size) that have his same strength and resistance.

name: Man-Mountain Marko
deck: Small time thug who gained super-strength, and eventually terminal illness, through abusing an experimental horse steroid.

name: Rattler
deck: Rattler is a member of the Serpent Society with the ability to create vibrations with his bionic tail.

name: Gammenon the Gatherer
deck: Gammenon, The Gatherer has been a member of the Celestials' first, second, third, and fourth hosts.

name: Looter
deck: Norton Fester discovers a small meteor and it gives him superhuman powers when gases from the meteor seeps into his body. He becomes a one man crime wave known as the Looter.

name: Hannibal King
deck: Hannibal King was an ordinary private investigator until he was killed and turned into a vampire by Deacon Frost. He was a founding member of the Nightstalkers and one of the prophesized Mystic Nine that would stand against Lilith.

name: Tha-Korr
deck: Former emperor of Atlantis. Father to Fen, maternal grandfather to Namor. He underwent a transformation that turned him into the Highlord; leader of the Aqueos, an Atlantean Sect of vampires.

name: Stinger
deck: Young, reckless and deadly, Stinger is a mutant with bio-electrical powers that she could release through her hands.

name: Xavier
deck: Son of Charles Xavier  and Mystique from an alternate future.

name: Iso
deck: Xiaoyi is a new Inhuman that was discovered by Reader in China.

name: Aaron Davis
deck: Aaron Davis is the uncle of Miles Morales and originally served as the Ultimate Prowler. After dying in an accident during a fight with his nephew, Aaron was resurrected years later after Secret Wars. He's now assumed the identity of the Iron Spider, and formed a new Sinister Six.

name: Zaran
deck: Zaran is Master of All Weapons.

name: Alistair Smythe
deck: Alistair Smythe is the son of Spencer Smythe: a mad scientist responsible for the creation of Spider-Slayers; robots designed to hunt and kill Spider-man. After his death Alistair carried on his work.

name: The Answer
deck: A hit man with an angle, a costumed villain with the solution, he is The Answer!

name: Alysande Stuart
deck: Alysande is the twin sister of Alistaire Stewart and a Brigadier in the Weird Happenings Organization, otherwise known as W.H.O.

name: Albert
deck: A robotic replica of Wolverine created by Donald Pierce to kill Wolverine. He managed to grow beyond his programming however and became instead somewhat of an ally to him.

name: Barrage
deck: Barrage is a member of the Dark Riders, and has Inhuman heritage.

name: Blackout
deck: A human-demon hybrid who creates light-canceling darkness fields and has vampire-like abilities enhanced by metal fangs and claws.

name: Sir Percy of Scandia
deck: The first Black Knight. A hero whom lived during the Dark Ages and was a friend of Merlin among others.

name: Progenitor
deck: The first Celestial who set foot on Earth.

name: Khora of the Burning Heart
deck: Mutant of Arakko and replacement of Fabian Cortez in SWORD.

name: Javitz
deck: Acolyte loyal to Magneto, who died at the hands of Holocaust when he broke free. Strangly enough he later returns without explanation.

name: Milan
deck: Milan was one of the Acolytes who helped kidnap Moira MacTaggert, until she was later rescued by the X-Men. Milan later died on Avalon, the homebase of the Acolytes, when Holocaust attacked

name: Kate Cushing
deck: Kate Cushing is a City Editor for the Daily Bugle

name: Kismet
deck: Formerly known as "Paragon," then as "Her," Kismet is an artificial life-form created by the Enclave and intended to be the mate of Him (Adam Warlock).

name: Dominic Fortune
deck: David Fortunov was an adventurer, whom fought against the Nazi's during World War II. He was the first to use the Dominic Fortune identity, later his son Jerome took up the mantle. After the death of his son, David, now a senior, returned to his former identity.

name: Hildegarde
deck: Warrior goddess of Asgard, Hildegarde is a Valkyrie and member of the Warriors Four.

name: Terri Pryde
deck: Terri is the mother of the mutant Kitty Pryde, better known as the X-men's Shadowcat.

name: Evangeline Whedon
deck: Lawyer who turns into a dragon when she comes into contact with blood.

name: Korr
deck: An evolved Moloid

name: The Serpent
deck: The enigmatic Asgardian God of Fear locked away by Odin himself countless ages ago. Thanks to Sin, the Red Skull's daughter, he has been unleashed upon the world once more. Cul Borson as he was named, was born to Bor Burison and to the Giantess Bestla and was the older brother of Odin.

name: Vargas
deck: Vargas claims to be the next step in human evolution, the true Homo Superior.

name: Dog Logan
deck: Wolverine's secret half-brother and first rival.

name: Lyla
deck: Holo-servant in the future, year 2099

name: Itsu
deck: Itsu was the wife of Wolverine and mother of Daken. She was killed by the Winter Soldier.

name: Minotaur
deck: The CEO of the Roxxon Energy Corporation, who as a young boy merged with King Minos' Minotaur. His obsession with finding new markets and resources has often put him at odds with other superhumans.

name: Thornn
deck: A former Morlock, Lucia Callasantos shares the same powers of her sister, Maria. She has overcome a life filled with tragedy and violence, and briefly joined Brotherhood of Evil Mutants.

name: Professor Horton
deck: Professor Horton was the original creator of the Human Torch.

name: Mangog
deck: Mangog is a tulpa begotten of the fury from a mysterious Alien race. Supposedly said to be the manifestation of their unending fury towards Odin and Asgard born of the combined hatred of these billion billion murdered beings. Mangog is a powerful enemy of Odin, a dire threat to Asgard, and one of Thor's deadliest foes.

name: Master Order
deck: The living embodiment of Order.

name: Spoor
deck: Spoor is a mutant with the power to induce violence and hatred in others through a pheromone he produces. He is a member of the Acolytes.

name: Worldmind
deck: The Xandarian Worldmind or just Worldmind is the political and spiritual leader of the Xandarians and the Nova Corps.

name: Bombshell
deck: Lana Baumgartner is known as Bombshell with her mother when they rob banks. She, along with Miles Morales where transported from the Ultimate Universe into the prime Marvel Universe 616 after Secret Wars.

name: Brian Falsworth
deck: First became the Destroyer, then later followed his father's mantle as Union Jack the second. He was the brother of Spitfire, whom also became part of the team of Invaders

name: Angela Del Toro
deck: An ex-FBI Agent who worked on the Daredevil case. She became the White Tiger after the death of her uncle, Hector Ayala, the previous White Tiger, when she inherited his Jade Amulets.

name: Jean-Luc Lebeau
deck: Former leader of the Thieves' Guild.  When a young Remy tried to pick his pocket, Jean Luc caught and then adopted him. He has raised Gambit up as his own son. He seems to be a widower.

name: Red Raven
deck: Red Raven is a World War II era hero and a member of the Liberty Legion. In modern times, he has continued his career fighting alongside the Defenders and the X-Men among others.

name: Modred the Mystic
deck: A magician with tutorship from Chthon, Modred the Mystic possesses immense mystical abilities, especially when in contact with the Darkhold.

name: Jester
deck: Former actor and criminal, there has been two different Jesters.

name: Fly
deck: A small-time thug who battled Spider-Man on several occasions, the Fly was killed by the Scourge of the Underworld.  He was later brought back by The Hood, and received power enhancements. Now Fly is member of Crime-Master's Savage Six.

name: Siena Blaze
deck: Siena Blaze is a mutant with the ability to control and become magnetic energy at the cost of damaging Earth's electromagnetic field. After battling the X-Men, she found herself in another reality where she became a member of Warstrike's Exiles.

name: Angar the Screamer
deck: A crook and companion to the Thunderbolt Songbird, after his death, she started a new life as a hero.

name: Foolkiller (Salinger)
deck: Greg Salinger was the second and most well-known Foolkiller. He was an insane crusader, a mercenary. He was in excellent physical condition and a fairly decent hand-to-hand combatant though mostly self-trained. Besides he was an amateur poet. More recently, he joined Deadpool's Mercs for Money.

name: Robbie Rider
deck: Brother of Richard Rider aka Nova. Former member of the Nova Corps, currently the leader of Fraternity of Raptors.

name: Petra
deck: Petra was a mutant with the power to manipulate earth.

name: Bloodhawk
deck: Bloodhawk is a superhero and a member of the X-Men 2099.

name: Tam Anderson
deck: Tam Anderson is a Chief Magistrate for the Genoshan government. She switched sides during the events of the X-Tinction Agenda and helped the X-men to defeat Cameron Hodge.

name: Briar Raleigh
deck: Magneto's mysterious human ally. Despite being accidentally crippled by Magneto, she became his friend.

name: Bob Diamond
deck: A good friend to Iron Fist and Luke Cage, Bob Diamond is martial artist, actor and former member of the Sons of the Tiger.

name: Justine Hammer
deck: Justine Hammer, aka "The Crimson Cowl", was the leader of the Masters of Evil and battled the Thunderbolts. The daughter of Justin Hammer and mother to Sasha Hammer she has recently followed in her fathers footsteps and took control of Hammer industries. She was ultimately killed by Zeke Stane.

name: Criti Noll
deck: Criti Noll is the super skrull chosen to replace Hank Pym, Yellowjacket. Her position as Pym made her a key part of the Skrull Invasion.

name: J'son of Spartax
deck: Star-Lord's father and the former Emperor of the Spartoi Empire.

name: Crusher Hogan
deck: Wrestler from the Spider-Man comics.

name: Xemnu
deck: Xemnu is an alien who can mind control other beings to do his tasks and wants to conqueror.

name: Alexandra Rasputina
deck: The late mother of Colossus, Magik, and Mikhail Rasputin.

name: Golden Girl
deck: Golden Girl was a Golden Age heroine who once served as Captain America's sidekick.

name: Cammi
deck: A normal girl who got mixed up with Drax the Destroyer. While she possesses no superhuman abilities, she is not to be underestimated. Cammi doesn't seem to be able to filter ideas that would be considered rude before stating them.

name: Faiza Hussain
deck: A British doctor for the NHS, whose powers over organic matter awakened during the Skrull's invasion of Earth. Faiza Hussain is the wielder of the mythic sword Excalibur, and uses her healing powers to protect the United Kingdom.

name: Zelma Stanton
deck: Doctor Strange's former librarian. Currently, she's a teacher at Strange Academy.

name: Iron Lad
deck: He is an adolescent version of Kang the Conqueror, armed with a bio-metal suit that responds to mental commands. He is responsible for assembling the Young Avengers. Even though being a human, his aging is slowed down, significantly.

name: U-Go Girl
deck: Edith Sawyer was a young woman who wanted to become an actress in Hollywood. Sometime after learning about her mutant abilities, she renamed herself U-Go Girl, and was a member of X-Force with the ability of teleportation.

name: Hammer
deck: Part of Cable's old Six Pack. He used his knowledge of machines to create a one-man tank for himself.

name: Vera Cantor
deck: Vera was X-Man Beast's girlfriend, during the first X-Men team formation, back in the 1960s. Mimic was introduced as her former boyfriend.

name: Black Talon
deck: Black Talon derives his power from the mystic Voodoo arts. He can raise zombies and control them at will.

name: Emmanuel DaCosta
deck: The father of Roberto DaCosta (Sunspot). White Rook of Hellfire Club Inner Circle.

name: Quill
deck: Quill was a student at Xavier's until he was killed by William Stryker and his Purifiers.

name: Leper Queen
deck: The Leper Queen is an anti-mutant terrorist who once had a mutant daughter of her own. Her two year-old daughter was killed when the child's powers burned down their home, also resulting in the Leper Queen's disfigurement.

name: Francis Castle Jr.
deck: Frank Castle's son.

name: Raze
deck: Shape-shifting son of Wolverine and Mystique from an alternate future.

name: Marie Lathrop
deck: Romantic interest of Black Rider.

name: Flatman
deck: Dr. Val Ventura, a.k.a. Flatman, was created by John Byrne and debuted in Avengers West Coast (Vol 2) #46, July 1989. He's one of the only openly gay superheroes.

name: Space Phantom
deck: Space Phantom is a name given to a number of characters in Marvel Comics.

name: Starshine
deck: Three characters have assumed the mantle and armor of Starshine, all have been Spaceknights, allies and at least one a love interest to their fellow Spaceknight Rom, in his fight against the Dire Wraiths, alien shape-shifters who evolved off of Skrulls.

name: Agamotto
deck: Agamotto is one of three vastly powerful benevolent beings who are collectively known as the Vishanti.

name: Living Brain
deck: I.C.M. built a computer in the form of a human body in order to dramatize its powers. It was the greatest mechanical brain ever built. It has been recently seen as the newest member of the Sinister Six.

name: Sgt. Duffy
deck: A Sergeant in the United States Army during the 1940s.

name: Druig
deck: Druig is a member of the Polar Eternals. And related to Valkin (father), Ikaris (cousin), Virako, (uncle), Tulayn (aunt, deceased). He possesses the power of mind control.

name: Serafina
deck: Serafina of the Children of the Vault, a supervillain group, possessed a wide range of abilities.

name: Simon Trask
deck: Simon Trask is the leader of "Humanity Now" Coalition and a mutant hater.

name: Ana Kravinoff
deck: 13 year old daughter of Kraven the Hunter. Now walking in her father's footsteps, she continues the hunt for Spider-Man.

name: Shou-Lao the Undying
deck: An immortal dragon whose heart grants people the power of the Iron Fist. he has been defeated and reborn 66 times so far.

name: Redeemer
deck: The man who calls himself The Redeemer was once Prince Acroyear of the planet Spartak, who had given his life to undo the catastrophic damage Baron Karza inflicted upon Homeworld, for reasons unknown he came back to life as the living embodiment of The Enigma Force within the Microverse.

name: Bruno Carrelli
deck: Kamala Khan's best friend.

name: Cosmar
deck: A young mutant rescued by the New Mutants when her mutant powers manifested.

name: Sphinx
deck: The first Sphinx, Anath-Na Mut, was the chief wizard under Ramses II. After his banishment, he discovered the Ka Stone. Granting him Immortality and superhuman powers, Sphinx wandered the earth for 5000 years.

name: Radius
deck: Jared and his younger half-brother Adrian were raised in an orphanage both brothers manifested mutant powers after puberty,Jared manifested a personal force field that could not be shut down.

name: Moses Magnum
deck: Moses became President of Deterrence Research Corporation, which is the world's independent weapons manufacturing firm. This would lead to several conflicts with heroes. Moses Magnum is an arms dealer, terrorist, and a supervillain

name: Jarella
deck: Princess of K'ai and lover of Bruce Banner and the Hulk.

name: Orka
deck: Orka is an Atlantean who was augmented by Dr. Dorcas to fight Namor the Sub-Mariner.

name: Sidewinder
deck: Formerly the leader of the Serpent Society, Sidewinder is a retired villain with the ability of teleportation.

name: Lady Lark
deck: The tragic lady with the voice of a lark, violated by villain and friend alike, now reborn into a raptor in the skies for justice.

name: Zoe Culloden
deck: Member of Landau, Luckman, and Lake.

name: Manoli Wetherell
deck: Manoli Wetherell is a news reporter who covered the X-Men's battle and deaths against the Adversary in Dallas. She has since covered several events relating to the superhero community.

name: Abe Brown
deck: A martial artist and member of the Sons of the Tiger.

name: Ziran the Tester
deck: A member of the powerful race called Celestials.

name: Kimura
deck: A sadistic and invulnerable operative created by the same group that made X-23 for the purpose of keeping her in line and punishing her when she failed.

name: Rose O'Hara
deck: James Howlett's (Wolverine) caretaker and friend. Rose was also Wolverine's first true love.

name: T'Chaka
deck: T'Chaka, The Great is a former king of Wakanda and Black Panther. He is the father of T'Challa (King of the Dead) and Shuri (Queen of Wakanda).

name: Vil
deck: Female heir to the Uhari throne of Old Atlantis and member of the Future Foundation

name: White Fox
deck: Ami Han is Director of the South Korean National Intelligence Service and the last Kumiho, a mystical race of fox spirits. As White Fox, she is leader of the superhero team Tiger Divison and a member of the international Agents of Atlas.

name: Toni Ho
deck: Ho Yinsen's daughter, who once led A.I.M.'s engineering division after Sunspot took over and repurposed them as an Avengers team.

name: Dallas Riordan
deck: Dallas Riordan was originally the Thunderbolts mayoral liaison then became their enemy as Citizen V. Eventually joining the team and merged with Atlas before being the ion-powered Vantage. She has worked with the NYPD, V-Battalion, Department of Homeland Security and most recently the Commission for Superhuman Activities.

name: Amphibian
deck: On a different Earth than our own a hero from the seven seas joins the premiere super team, the Squadron Supreme, as Amphibian. He was the resident aquatic member of the Squadron Supreme from Earth-712. The second Amphibian is a creature of mysterious origins.

name: Ruby Thursday
deck: A scientific genius, Ruby Thursday remade herself into an living human gynoid with a shape-shifting head. She is a member of the villainous Headmen.

name: Corruptor
deck: The Corruptor was a worker at a pharmaceutical company who manufactured psychoactive substances. He was exposed to the chemicals in a fire and gained the ability to bring out others worst tendencies.

name: Topaz
deck:
Topaz is a powerful mystic in the Marvel Universe who has unique empathic abilities.
She has adopted to two female forms, one Caucasian and one Indian.
She fights with a group of teens called the Witches.

name: Nikolai Rasputin
deck: The late father of Colossus, Magik, and Mikhail Rasputin.

name: Hiroim
deck: Hiroim was a failed Shadow Priest turned Shadow Warrior turned slave then revolutionary alongside the Hulk on the planet Sakaar. He met his end on Earth after first coming to get revenge on the humans for the Hulk, yet he died saving human lives.

name: Night Raven
deck: Night Raven is an immortal vigilante who began operating in the 1930's. He is an expert at hand-to-hand combat, highly skilled with guns and knives, and is seemingly unkillable.

name: Scott Adsit
deck: An agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. who is a close friend of Emily Preston and Deadpool.

name: Venus Dee Milo
deck: A young African-American hero and member of X-Statix. Turned into a being of pure energy upon the activation of her mutant powers, in which Professor X made her a containment suit to retain humanoid form.

name: Devil-Slayer
deck: A former soldier whom came into possesion of a cape which made him Devil-Slayer, the demon hunter. Devil-Slayer served with the Defenders, and more recently, the Hawaiian Initiative team The Point Men and Wonder Man's anti-Avengers team.

name: Man-Beast
deck: An evolved red wolf created by the High Evolutionary, the Man Beast was made to be a balance to Adam Warlock, making him a being of havoc and destruction.

name: Justice
deck: An enigmatic man of power emerges from the shadows to act as judge, jury, and executioner for those who would visit harm on the innocent. His name is Justice.

name: Mary Parker
deck: Mary Parker is the mother of Peter Parker (Spider-Man). However, she and her husband, Richard Parker, were killed in a plane accident when Peter was still very young.

name: Timebroker
deck: An artificial life-form used by the 'Timebreakers' in the Crystal Palace to brief the new Exiles members.

name: Caiera
deck: Former slave to the Red King, she worked her way up to becoming  the Lieutenant of his army.  Eventually she turned on the King and allied with the Hulk.  The two eventually married and she died pregnant with her twin sons of Hulk, Skaar and Hiro Kala

name: W'Kabi
deck: Wakanda's Chief of Security and commands the Black Panther armed forces.

name: Black Knight (Garrett)
deck: The second Black Knight, this time an evil villain. He is the uncle of Dane Whitman.

name: Eric Kleinstock
deck: Eric Kleinstock was a member of the Acolytes along with his younger, twin brothers, Sven & Harlan. Unlike his brothers, he was able to fly, fire pulse beams, and create/manipulate force fields.

name: Ellie Camacho
deck: The daughter of Deadpool and Carmelita Camacho.

name: Jack O'Lantern
deck: A sadistic mercenary abducted as a kid by Crime-Master who raised him to be a stone-cold killer. He assumed the persona of Jack O'Lantern after killing all of the people who previously used this name.

name: Last Son of Kraven
deck: After he was resurrected, Kraven convinced the High Evolutionary to create 87 clones of himself. This last clone hunted and killed his 86 brothers to become Kraven's sole heir, and after killing his "father," he became the new Kraven the Hunter.

name: Anti-Venom
deck: When Mister Negative cured Eddie Brock of his cancer the traces of the Venom symbiote left in his body reacted spawning Anti-Venom.

name: Phantazia
deck: A powerful mutant with the ability to manipulate electromagnetic fields, Phantazia was most often seen with the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants. She was among the majority of mutants who lost their powers after M-Day.

name: Eon
deck: One of the first beings in the universe, Eon was the offspring of Infinity, Eternity, and the Celestial Axis. He chose champions and endowed them with the Quantum Bands to protect the universe.

name: Prester John
deck: Prester John was a former crusader, chronicler of Avalon, and served as Cable's director of security on Providence during the events of Cable/Deadpool.

name: Sack
deck: Sack is a mutant with a gelatinous body that can possess people.

name: Harddrive
deck: An Inhuman who possesses the ability to teleport and control machinery.

name: Seamus Mellencamp
deck: The Noble Knight of the Acolytes. This "knight" however is anything but noble, and is actually as monstrous and vicious as his own appearance suggests.

name: Skein
deck: Formerly known as Gypsy Moth, Skein is a telekinetic who prefers fabrics.

name: Tamara Devoux
deck: Former Avenger and Captain Universe. She was granted her power after a car crash.

name: Eel (Lavell)
deck: Edward Lavell took the mantle of the Eel from the deceased Leopold Stryke, and has upgraded his armor and technology to enhance his criminal lifestyle.

name: Mother Righteous
deck: A clone of Mr. Sinister's late wife, Rebecca Essex designed to explore the possibilities of magic as opposed to science.  A dealmaker who trades in hope, faith, magic, and cosmic power.

name: Cutthroat
deck: A minor thug and assassin who is proficient in the use of edged weapons.  Brother of the hero Diamondback.

name: Jim Wilson
deck: A young man who was an ally of the Hulk and a good friend. He died of AIDS, most likely gotten through a blood transfusion.

name: Magus (Technarchy)
deck: Father of the techno-organic alien hero, Warlock. Just like his son, who is often confused with the cosmic hero Adam Warlock, as this Magus shares the name of Adam Warlock's evil counterpart, Magus.

name: Agent-X
deck: After being caught in an explosion along with Black Swan and Deadpool, Nijo Minamiyori awoke with no memory his past and his indescribable desire to become the #1 mercenary of the world. To pursue this goal, he became Agent-X.

name: Neophyte
deck: Neophyte is a pacifist member of the mutant fanatical group the Acolytes, who are religious followers of Magneto.  Neophyte was tried for treason against the group, but has since rejoined their ranks. He was most recently seen as a resident of the mutant island Utopia.

name: Pipeline
deck: The Genoshan Press Gang's transportation

name: Strobe
deck: A powerful heat generating mutant with a fiery personality. Once a follower of Stryfe as a member of the Mutant Liberation Front.

name: Krystalin
deck: Krystalin is a mutant with the power to spin crystal and is a member of X-Men 2099.

name: Ezekiel Stane
deck: The son of Tony Stark’s late business rival and archenemy Obadiah Stane.

name: Mr. Immortal
deck: The first and only known member of a species called Homo Supreme, Craig Hollis is the immortal founder of the eccentric superhero team known as the Great Lakes Avengers and was the team leader until the team moved to Detroit.

name: American Dream
deck: Shannon Carter is the daughter of a typical mid-western family. Her father was a small town police officer, her mother was a school teacher, and her aunt is Peggy Carter. She joins Avengers Next.

name: Aquarian
deck: Wundarr the Aquarian is a powerful pacifist who was attached to Project Pegasus. He is friends with the Thing among others. More recently, he proved to be the only person ever to be bitten by a Marvel-Zombie and live to tell the tale, purging the disease out of his body.

name: Sway
deck: Sway was a mutant with time-stopping powers, and was a member of the X-men.

name: Meanstreak
deck: Meanstreak is a mutant who can move at superhuman speeds and joined the X-Men in 2099.

name: Sally Avril
deck: A student who became the costumed hero, the Bluebird.

name: Mortis
deck: Lois London is a mutant with powers that can drain life force from other humans or disintegrate inorganic matter. As Mortis, she was part of Selene's Inner Circle.

name: Colonel Reyes
deck: The Brother of Mutant and X-Man Cecilia Reyes who was a part of the ONE team that pilots MARK VIII sentinels designed by Stark Enterprises.

name: Hedy De Vine
deck: Timely Comics character. A famous actress and model.

name: Derek Morgan
deck: Derek Morgan is a mutant from Chicago (Ultimate Universe) and lived with his brother before the appearance of Karen Grant (Jean Grey).

name: Namora
deck: Namora hails from a world in which she destroyed all of Earth's non-Mutant heroes and became its Queen. She later joins the Exiles, in an effort to defend all realities from threats to the multiverse.

name: Llyra
deck: Llyra is a half-lemurian mutant. She was born in Hawaii to Rhonda Morris and Llyron (a Lemurian). Llyra suffers from mutiple personality disorder.

name: Dakota North
deck: Fashion model turned private investigator who works closely with the superhero community of New York, including a brief affair with Daredevil.

name: Wicked
deck: Wicked is a young mutant with the ability to control and summon the spirits of the dead. However due to the effects of M-Day she lost her mutant abilities.

name: Bolt
deck: Bolt was a mutant with the power to absorb and channel electrostatic energy. He idolized the mutant Maverick, even taking his namesake and look after the original disappeared.

name: Bird-Man
deck: Two men have taked the identity of Bird-Man and has served as a member of the Ani-Men.

name: Man-Killer
deck: A villain formerly known as Man-Killer, she loosely reformed and re-established herself as Amazon among the Thunderbolts.

name: Stacy Dolan
deck: A Homicide detective for the NYPD.  She has had run-ins with Ghost Rider (Danny Ketch) in the past.

name: Lorelei
deck: Lorelei, the sister of Amora the Enchantress, is an immature and petty Goddess who desires nothing more than to be the Queen of Asgard and worshipped by all for her beauty.

name: Ebony
deck: Agatha Harkness' mystical black cat.

name: Magique
deck: Magique is a founding member of the the Shi'ar Imperial Guard. She is a sorceress whose primary ability is the creation of intricate and convincing sensory illusions.

name: Sally Floyd
deck: Sally Floyd is a non-super-human. She is a reporter for the Alternative.  She has covered both M-Day, Civil War and World War Hulk extensively.

name: Hulk 2099
deck: The Hulk of a possible future in an alternate reality, who was unwillingly exposed to gamma radiation (by the Knights of Banner, who wished to recreate the accident that created the original Hulk) and transforms into The Hulk of the year 2099 whenever he wills.

name: Mattie Franklin
deck: Mattie Franklin was the third person to be a costumed super-heroine called Spider-Woman.

name: Perro
deck: Perro is a member of the Children of the Vault, having survived the group's initial encounter with the X-Men under Rogue's leadership.

name: Centurius
deck: A genius in numerous fields, Centurius discovered ways to evolve living things at an accelerated rate. Using these methods on himself, he is now virtually ageless and seeks to remake the world as he sees fit.

name: Veil
deck: A self-conscious girl who was manipulated, tortured and experimented on by Norman Osborn's Initiative after her powers manifested. Now she goes by Veil and is enrolled in the Avengers Academy.

name: Wu
deck: Male heir to the Uhari throne of Old Atlantis and member of the Future Foundation

name: Orb
deck: A successor to the original Orb, this one has an actual giant eyeball for a head.

name: Iron Boy
deck: During The Crossing, Iron Man went mad and became violent following the manipulation of Immortus. Hoping to save him, the Avengers travelled to an alternate reality and recruited a younger Tony Stark. As Iron Boy, he fought alongside the Avengers until his death at the hands of Onslaught.

name: Tiberius Stone
deck: Tiberius Stone was a scientist, owner of his own multinational corporation (Viastone) and who then later worked for the Kingpin. He started working for Horizon Labs as a double-agent.

name: Spider-Man Noir
deck: An alternate universe version of Peter Parker, who became Spider-Man in the 1930s.

name: Jake Fury
deck: The angry younger brother of Nick Fury, Jake Fury has been known both as the criminal Scorpio and undercover as the terrorist leader Kraken.

name: Yinsen
deck: An ally of Tony Stark and co-creator of the original Iron Man armor.

name: Black Tarantula
deck: Allegedly for over 700 years, the title of the Black Tarantula has been passed down from father to son.

name: Lilith
deck: Lilith "Mother of Demons" is originally a goddess, dating back to Pre-Sumeria.

name: Rintrah
deck: Rintrah is an alien sorcerer in training who is studying under Dr. Strange.

name: Captain U.K.
deck: Originally the Earth-238 counterpart to Earth-616's Captain Britain, Linda was reassigned to Earth-794. A good friend and ally to Brian Braddock, Captain Britain of Earth-616.

name: Gardener
deck: Gardener is an Elder of the Universe whose obsession is cultivating beauty.

name: Daniel Drumm
deck: Deceased twin brother of Jericho Drumm (Doctor Voodoo),  former Lord Of The Loa & Brother Voodoo. Now active as a ghost.

name: Aero
deck: Aero was a student at Xavier Institute as well as sister to the X-men Cannonbal and Husk. She was de-powered after M-Day and returned living in Kentucky.

name: Gauntlet
deck: Gauntlet is a recruit of The Initiative and is the program's drill instructor. Joseph is a rough and tough human being. He never gives up and will keep pushing you till you are over the edge.

name: Lisa Castle
deck: Daughter of frank Castle, The Punisher.

name: Deathcry
deck: Sharra Neramani is a young and skilled Shi'ar warrior, who joined the Avengers, when she was exiled to Earth, and took upon the name Deathcry.

name: Beautiful Dreamer
deck: A Morlock telepath with the ability to alter other peoples memories.

name: Rex
deck: Apocalypse´s personal multitask assistant in Age of Apocalypse story arc.

name: Ariel
deck: An alien from a glamourous planet, Ariel has the natural ability to teleport through doorways.  She gathered young mutants to form the Fallen Angels and later discovered that she was also a mutant, albeit one of her alien species.

name: Nanny
deck: Nanny was a robot constructed by Magneto to do his bidings. She took care of the X-men when they where captured by Magneto

name: Ex Nihilo
deck: A member of The Garden, Ex Nihilo is an avatar of creation and a former enemy of the Avengers. He plans to terraform worlds, including Earth, and create his own species to populate them. His name in Latin means out of nothing. He and Abyss were ordered to join the Avengers by Captain Universe.

name: Amazing Baby
deck: A baby warwolf adopted by Rachel Grey

name: War
deck: War is the daughter of Apocalypse and his wife Genesis and was one of the first Horsemen of Apocalypse. Like her mother and siblings, she was separated from Apocalypse when the island of Arakko was sealed away in the dimension of Amenth.

name: Ricochet
deck: Ricochet is a mutant that took on one of the mantles that Spider-Man used during his "Identity Crisis". He is also a member of the Loners and former member of the Slingers

name: Kyte
deck: Former member of the Imperial Guard, who was turned into a member of the Fraternity of Raptors

name: Satannish
deck: Satannish was created by the Dread Dormammu. He is sometimes referred to as the son of Dormammu and father of Hellstorm and Satana. Satannish has been one of many demons to be called Satan.

name: Skullfire
deck: Skullfire was a troubled mutant. He absorbs electrical energy and rechannels it as electric blasts.

name: Sobunar of the Depths
deck: Sobunar is an Omega-level mutant from Arakko whose body contains an entire oceanic ecosystem.

name: Blake Tower
deck: Blake Tower is a lawyer in New York City and helps Daredevil with information to capture criminals. He was also a runner-up to the position of District Attorney.

name: Gorgeous George
deck: Gorgeous George is a mutant and member of Sinister's Nasty Boys.  He can reshape the mass of his tar-like body, as well as vary his size.

name: Quasimodo
deck: An evil creation of Mad Thinker made to destroy Fantastic Four.

name: Terminus
deck: A lethal creation by a dying race to get their revenge on the Celestials. Terminus is an incredibly powerful and gargantuan cosmic scavenger, who exists in various stages and has threatened the Earth a number of times.

name: Aliya Dayspring
deck: Teacher and wife to the mutant named Cable in the future. She and Cable also had a son, Tyler.

name: Whiplash (Vanko)
deck: The newest Whiplash.

name: Mordred the Evil
deck: The bastard son of King Arthur and his half-sister Morgause.

name: Sara Wolfe
deck: Sara Wolfe was the secretary of Doctor Strange and the love interest of Dr. Strange's assistant, Wong.

name: Lin Sun
deck: Lin Sun is a master martial artist and member of the Sons of the Tiger.

name: Power Broker
deck: Curtiss Jackson is the head of The Corporation's west coast division and the founder of Power Broker, Inc. - a criminal organization that would augment the strength of paying individuals to superhuman levels.

name: Professor Mendel Stromm
deck: Mendel Stromm is a chemist and robot expert. He was   Norman Osborn's business and scientific partner until Norman betrayed him. His consciousness operates out of a robotic body.

name: Ultragirl
deck: A Kree Super-Heroine.

name: Thomas Logan
deck: Worked on the Howlett estate and often abused his son Dog, he may also be James Howlett's (Wolverine) real father after having a long affair with his mother.

name: Stonewall
deck: Jerry Sledge is the young hero known as Stonewall; he is an important part of the Secret Warriors. His power comes from his father, the Absorbing Man.

name: Maureen Logan
deck: The wife of Wolverine (Old Man Logan) and mother of his children. She lived in a future in which the villains had taken over.

name: Grady Scraps
deck: A co-worker of Peter Parker's at Horizon Labs.

name: Enigma
deck: Aikku Jokinen is a Norwegian girl who became bonded to a power suit known as the Planetary Operational Defense System. After the suit evolved, Aikku joined Roberto Da Costa's Avengers as the hero Enigma.

name: Cardiac
deck: Inspired by the death of his brother, Elias Wirtham set out to right the wrongs that slip through the cracks.  He is the vigilante heart of justice. He is Cardiac.

name: Master of the World
deck: The Master is a super-villain and an arch-nemesis of Alpha Flight.

name: Blazing Skull
deck: A war-time hero, the Blazing Skull was an ally to the Invaders and remains active to this day although with far less sanity. In modern times he has fought alongside Thin Man's Invaders squad and the Defenders.

name: Luther Manning
deck: Manning was a high ranking officer in the world's US Army. When he was wounded in battle, he was transformed into the cyborg known as Deathlok.

name: Zheng Zu
deck: Zheng Zu is a father of Shang-Chi. He and his brother formed the Five Weapons Society.

name: Alex Wilder
deck: Alex was a founding member of The Runaways. He's the son of Geoffrey & Catherine Wilder who were also the leaders of the villain supergroup The Pride. He served as the Runaways' first unofficial leader.

name: Darkdevil
deck: The son of Ben Reilly and Elizabeth Tyne, Darkdevil has proven to be a tempestuous ally of his "cousin" Spider-Girl. His powers stem from his biological inheritance, as well as the souls of Daredevil and Zarathos.

name: Kurt Marko
deck: Kurt Marko was the father of Juggernaut and stepfather of Professor X. Notably abusive.

name: Ransak the Reject
deck: Ransak was a Deviant who was rejected because he's not deformed like other Deviants. He later joined the Eternals.

name: Rampage
deck: Stuart Clarke was a villain known as Rampage. Driven by hatred of Iron Man, Clarke pursued an insane quest for revenge against the Avenger, becoming an enemy of Wonder Man and the Champions in the process.  Clarke worked alongside the Punisher for a time until the vigilante discovered his past and the two became bitter enemies.  It was thought that Punisher killed him, but he has recently reappeared causing problems for Moon Knight.

name: Roughouse
deck: Invulnerable enemy of Wolverine.

name: Spyne
deck: Spyne is a former member of the Dark Riders and was killed by Wolverine but resurrected during Necrosha.

name: Cylla
deck: A former pilot who was transformed into a cyborg by Donald Pierce and became the second Reaver to be known as Skullbuster.

name: Malcolm
deck: Member of XSE, along with Bishop and Randall.  He travels back in time to stop Trevor Fitzroy but ends up dying before he can complete his mission.

name: Waldo
deck: Waldo is the robotic, semi-sentient extension of the Starjammer's spacecraft. It has since been destroyed.

name: Leap-Frog
deck: Leap-Frog, former criminal and father of the costumed hero, Frog-Man.

name: Tex Dawson
deck: One of Marvel's many Cowboy heroes during the late 1950's. Notable for his use of a dog.

name: Franklin Storm
deck: Franklin Storm is the father of Johnny Storm and Susan(Storm)Richards.

name: Chemistro
deck: Calvin Carr, the brother to the original Chemistro, became the third and most well known man to use the Chemistro identity.

name: Phobos
deck: Child of Ares and an unknown mortal woman, Alexander was a mortal boy whose godhood awoke from drinking the blood of Amatsu-Mikaboshi. He joined Nick Fury's Secret Warriors with the codename Phobos and became the new God of Fear. Later, he died at the hands of the Gorgon.

name: Kate Kildare
deck: Public Relations Agent of the superhero Initiaitve group known as the Order. Later on, she became the public relations agent of the X-Men

name: Sajani
deck: Sajani worked in Horizon Labs and currently, in Parker Industries. She is the creator of the Reverbium.

name: Spiderling
deck: Anna May Parker, called Annie as a nickname, is the daughter of Peter Parker and Mary Jane on Earth-18119. She inherited her spider powers from her father and now fights crime alongside her parents as Spiderling.

name: Ape
deck: Morlock shapeshifter.

name: Karkas
deck: A Deviant who turned sides and became an ally and trusted friend to the Eternals.

name: Lightmaster
deck: Lightmaster is able to transform his body into light, and travel at light-speeds. He was also a member of the One World Church.

name: Fiz
deck: A mutant Skrull with the ability to change his size.

name: Martha Robertson
deck: Martha Robertson is the wife of Robbie Robertson, former editor at the Daily Bugle and mother of Randy.

name: Starlight
deck: The brilliant Russian neurosurgeon Dr. Tanya Belinsky would take first the mantle of the Red Guardian for sometime. An encounter with a powerful villain made her the nuclear powerhouse Starlight.

name: Scorcher
deck: After losing his job, Steven Hudak became "Scorcher" to extract his revenge.

name: Flaw
deck: Flaw was a War-Skrull whose powers were augmented with cybernetic implants. He was a powerful X-men and Starjammers foe who is one of many responsible for the deaths of Jean Grey's family members. Following the death of Black Cloak he has taken command of the Shiar Death Commando's.

name: Curse
deck: Curse is a young new mutant resident of Krakoa.

name: Crimson Dynamo (Vanko)
deck: Anton Vanko designed an armor controlled by electromagnetism. With its red covering, he named it the Crimson Dynamo. The Soviet government asked him to use his armor to serve them. On his first mission, he was sent to sabotage Stark Industries, but was convinced to stop by a young Anthony Stark.

name: Thor Girl
deck: Thor Girl is an alien who was saved from Thanos by Thor. She transformed herself into a young version of Thor and followed him to Earth.

name: Reverend Craig
deck: An abusive priest who raised Wolfsbane, later revealed to be her biological father. He lives somewhere near Muir Island, Scotland.

name: Mister X
deck: Mister X is a mutant telepath capable of reading an opponent's mind in order to anticipate their moves in combat. Having mastered every fighting style known to man, he considers himself "The Best There Is".

name: Bi-Beast
deck: The Bi-Beast is comparable to a combination of Bruce Banner and the Hulk together. Super strong, durable, feral, yet has the intellect of Bruce. This makes the Bi-Beast a dangerous foe.

name: Offset
deck: A member of professional killer group, Shi'ar Death Commandos.

name: Gabriel O'Hara
deck: The brother of Miguel O'Hara (aka Spider-Man 2099)

name: Black Dwarf
deck: Black Dwarf is one of Thanos' generals in the Black Order.

name: Rasputin
deck: A chimera mutant from the future, created from the DNA of Colossus, X-23, Kid Omega, Unus and Shadowcat.

name: Moose Mansfield
deck: Moose is a quarterback for Midtown High

name: Prodigy
deck: One of the identities used by Spider-Man from the "Identity Crisis", now Ritchie Gilmore uses the costume. He was the leader of the now disbanded team: the Slingers.

name: Andromeda
deck: The beautiful and heroic Atlantean warrior is a member of the Defenders. Like Prince Namor: The Sub-Mariner, Andromeda defends her people and the surface dwellers with honor and might. She uses a serum that temporarily allows her to breathe air while on land. She has proven her mettle on both land and sea.

name: Marcus Stone
deck: Lt. Stone is the leader of Code: Blue, the NYPD's superhuman crime response division.

name: Squid
deck: Donny Callahan received augmented abilities by a criminal organization to become a super criminal called the Squid.

name: Mrs. Muggins
deck: Mamie Muggins was the landlord of Peter Parker (Spider-Man) in the 1970's and early1980's

name: Kirsten McDuffie
deck: A former Assistant District Attorney of New York City currently working at Nelson and Murdock law firm.

name: Pickles
deck: Pickles is a bamf, who works as the All-New All-Different X-Men's personal teleporter. Unlike his half-brother Nightcrawler, Pickles has no limit on his teleportation, and can go where he is directed. Pickles' main distinction from other Bamfs his his love for food.

name: Xandra
deck: Xandra is the bio-engineered daughter of Charles Xavier and Lilandra Neramani, cloned from their genetic material after Lilandra's assassination. She is the current Majestrix of the Shi'ar Empire.

name: Yon-Rogg
deck: Kree Commander Yon-Rogg, Enemy of Captain Mar-Vell and Ms. Marvel

name: Dark Angel
deck: Shevaun Haldane became the hero known as Dark Angel shortly after witnessing her father's death at the hands of Mephisto and discovering Mys-Tech's occult ties.

name: Elsie Dee
deck: Originally an android bomb developed by Donald Pierce to destroy Wolverine, Elsie-Dee and her partner Albert were instead able to overcome their programming and became Wolverine's allies. She and Albert are currently still traveling throughout the world and time in search of adventure.

name: Phastos
deck: Phastos is a third or fourth generation Eternal.

name: Windshear
deck: Colin Ashworth Hume, also known as Windshear of Alpha Flight, is a mutant with the power to manipulate hard-air molecules. He was depowered after M-Day.

name: Gibbon
deck: The Gibbon's unsuccessful attempts as a criminal and a hero branded him a loser. As a mutant, he retained his powers after "M-Day."

name: Batwing
deck: Jimmy transformed into Batwing after consuming chemically tainted water and came into conflict with Spider Man. Spider Man eventually befriended Jimmy and now he is currently a member of the Initiative.

name: Ravonna
deck: A time-traveling princess, conqueror, and assassin. Ravonna Renslayer has gone by many names: Terminatrix, Revelation, Nebula... but she can never escape her fate woven intricately with the Conquerer of Time, Kang.

name: Kruun
deck: Kruun is the former global ruler of the militaristic planet Breakworld. He has clashed with the X-Men on two occasions, but has since renounced his violent ways.

name: Rigger Ruiz
deck: Rigger Ruiz is an army member of Code Blue

name: Famine
deck: Famine is the son of Apocalypse and his wife Genesis and was one of the first Horsemen of Apocalypse. Like his mother and siblings, he was separated from Apocalypse when the island of Arakko was sealed away in the dimension of Amenth.

name: Mr. Fear
deck: Alan Fagan is the fourth and current Mr. Fear, and the nephew of the third Mr. Fear, Larry Cranston.

name: Jeryn Hogarth
deck: Daniel Rand's attorney.

name: Brandy Clark
deck: She is the Prime Director of Galador and the widow of the legendary Spaceknight ROM, with whom she produced two sons: Balin and Tristan. She was also the second person to hold the title of Starshine.

name: Destroyer (Aubrey)
deck: Roger Aubrey was a spy who worked behind enemy lines during World War Two, first known as the size-changing Dyna-Mite and later as the Destroyer - an identity he adopted from his boyfriend Brian Falsworth.  Member of the V-Battalion.

name: N'Dare Munroe
deck: N'Dare Munroe is the mother of Ororo Munroe, the X-Man known as Storm.

name: Astra
deck: Former member of Magneto's original Brotherhood. She later went rogue and attempted to gain revenge on him for unspecified reasons by creating a clone of Magneto named Joseph.

name: Prince of Orphans
deck: John Aman, the Prince of Orphans, is one of the seven Immortal Weapons. Mysterious even to those who cultivate unending mystery, Aman is one of the deadliest combatants on Earth.

name: Overdrive
deck: A villain who uses nanites to alter motor vehicles to his liking. Formerly working for Mr. Negative, he is now a member of the Sinister Six.

name: Andrew Forson
deck: The current Scientist Supreme of A.I.M.

name: Slug
deck: The successful business man and druglord for the Kingpin. He would be remembered as one of Marvel's largest and most abnormal villains.

name: Krait
deck: A member of professional killer group, Shi'ar Death Commandos.

name: Randall
deck: Randall was a member of Xavier's Security Enforcers, along with Bishop, Malcolm, and many others from The Days of Future Past Timeline (Earth-1191).  He traveled back in time to stop Trevor Fitzroy (and as later retconned, Hope Summers), but he lost his life before he could complete his mission.

name: Wing
deck: Wing was one of the students at Xavier Institute. He committed suicide after being de-powered by the alien Ord. His mutant power was flight.

name: Texas Twister
deck: A country boy through and through, Twister has fought for the good with S.H.I.E.L.D., and The Rangers. Never is he seen far from his Texas roots.

name: Monica Lynne
deck: Monica Lynne was the long time love interest of the Black Panther and became his fiance. The two first met when she saved him from drowning after he had an altercation with Killmonger. The two feel deeply in love, with her being his first and true love

name: Blackout
deck: Blackout is a super-villain who can manipulate Darkforce matter and energy and open portals to it's dimension. He formerly worked alongside Moonstone and subsequently joined the Masters of Evil and later the Thunderbolts.

name: Courier
deck: One of Gambit's close friends who's now stuck as a woman

name: D.W. Griffith
deck: David Griffith was a long time associate and friend of Luke Cage when they shared the same apartment-building in a movie theater.

name: Steel Serpent
deck: The son of Lei Kung who tried to challenge Shou-Lao illegally and was exiled. He left swearing revenge.

name: Kid Marvelman
deck: Kid Miracleman is the alter-ego of the orphan boy Johnny Bates. Though he was once Miracleman's loyal sidekick, over time he became a sadistic and violent sociopath, and his mentor's greatest enemy.

name: Eli Bard
deck: Eli Bard was a former politician from ancient Rome that became obsessively in love with the immortal Selene. After failing her in her ascension, she cursed him and since then, he has been finding ways to gain the Black Queen's favor back.

name: Manphibian
deck: An alien inspired by the Creature of the Black Lagoon and a member of the Legion of Monsters.

name: Uatu Jackson
deck: Uatu is a pre-teen genius who works in Horizon Labs.

name: Porcupine (Gocking)
deck: The second person to don the Porcupine costume and a foe to Captain America and the Daughters of the Dragon. He was also a member of the Thunderbolts Army during Civil War. He recently became a more heroic person when he was employed by Spider-Woman.

name: Eimin
deck: Twin sister of Uriel. One of the Apocalypse Twins.

name: Pestilence
deck: Pestilence is the daughter of Apocalypse and his wife Genesis and was one of the first Horsemen of Apocalypse. Like her mother and siblings, she was separated from Apocalypse when the island of Arakko was sealed away in the dimension of Amenth.

name: Solem
deck: An Arakii mutant with adamantium skin and a talent for seduction.

name: Doorman
deck: Herald of Oblivion and member of the Great Lakes Avengers.

name: Seraph
deck: Seraph met Wolverine as Patch in Madripoor.

name: Alexander Pierce
deck: One of Nick Fury's most loyal operatives.

name: Deathwatch
deck: Supernatural Villain

name: Alda Huxley
deck: Ambassador of the United Nations whom managed to make Magneto the new appointed leader of Genohsia.

name: Quicksand
deck: Villain with sand powers.

name: Nezarr the Calculator
deck: Nezarr the Calculator is a member of the Celestials, a race of cosmic beings who have conducted genetic experiments on countless worlds throughout the universe. Nezarr's sole duty is to examine and catalogue all data brought to him by the others, and produce the findings to Arishem the Judge.

name: Ghost Rider 2099
deck: A new, high-tech Spirit of Vengeance stalks the streets of Transverse City and struggles against the evil corporate entity D/Monix.

name: Dr. Takiguchi
deck:
Japanese Scientist enlisted by S.H.I.E.L.D. for his advice and expertise when Godzilla appears in America.

Died in Uncanny X-Men 515 at the age of 86 from old age.

name: Flag-Smasher (Morgenthau)
deck: The original Flag-Smasher, an anti-nationalist terrorist and founder of ULTIMATUM.

name: Nancy Whitehead
deck: A computer sciences student at Empire State University, and the roommate of Squirrel Girl

name: Simon Lasker
deck: The successor of the original Pyro, Simon Lasker seemingly has the same powers as the original. While initially manipulated into joining the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants, Simon has since reformed and joined the X-Men.

name: Vindaloo
deck: A member of the Acolytes

name: Deborah Summers
deck: Deborah Summers is the mother of Corsair, and the grandmother of Scot Summers (Cyclops)

name: Dragonfly
deck: One of Nefaria's Ani-Men, originally just a costumed crook who was later mutated into a permanent form. Can mesmerize others into immobility with the hum from her wings.

name: Carol Hines
deck: Hines worked for the scientists on the Weapon X project that reinforced Wolverine's bones with adamantium and tried to brainwash him into an obedient killing machine.

name: Slaymaster
deck: Slaymaster is one of the world's greatest assassins.

name: Sara Grey-Bailey
deck: Sara Grey was Jean Grey's older sister. Unlike Jean, Sara was not a mutant. She was absorbed by the Phalanx.

name: Roger Bochs
deck: Bochs was a genius inventor and developed a robot he nicknamed Box, that could act for him. He joined the Canadian superhero team Alpha Flight's training group Beta Flight. Roger Bochs was the original user of the Box armor.

name: Lorelei
deck: Known initially as Lorelei, Lani Ubanu is a Savage Land native who was mutated in order to become a terrorist in Magneto's service. She later served the High Technician.

name: Gwen Stacy Clone
deck: The Gwen Stacy clone was created by Professor Warren. She walked into Peter's life after the death of the original Gwen Stacy as a form of psychological warfare on Warren's part.

name: Abyss
deck: A member of The Garden and an avatar of creation, Abyss is an enemy of the Avengers. She plans to recreate Earth in a new vision and possesses the power of mind manipulation. She was ordered by Captain Universe to join the Avengers.

name: Stark Sentinel
deck: Initially build by Tony Stark during the Civil War. These Sentinels came under the control of the Red Skull.

name: Ravage 2099
deck: Ravage 2099 is a hero of Earth-928, he is a mutate, whose mutation is constantly changing and evolving. He went from the head of ECO to the leader of Hellrock in his time.

name: Infinity
deck: Infinity represents the infinite potential of existence. Her twin brother is Eternity, and his siblings are Death, Oblivion, and Galactus.

name: Volcana
deck: Volcana was given her power to become living plasma during the first Secret Wars by Dr.Doom. She is Titania's best friend and ex-girlfriend of Molecule Man.

name: Will o' the Wisp
deck: Previously a scientist, Jackson Arvad became Will o’ the Wisp after an accident caused his molecular structure to change, allowing him to control it at will.

name: Garokk
deck: The Self proclaimed sun god of the Savage Land

name: Foxbat
deck: Foxbat was an Inhuman and a member of the Dark Riders, a team of followers of Apocalypse.

name: Alchemy
deck: A mutant teen who can turn any substance into another chemical element. He often has trouble with trolls.

name: Druid
deck: Druid is the son of Dr. Druid and an amateur sorcerer. He has been recruited and trained by Nick Fury to serve as part of the Secret Warriors. It is said that one day he will become one of the great heroes. He has recently been recruited in to the Avengers.

name: Cartier St.Croix
deck: Ambassador to his country, an ally of Xavier and champion of mutant rights.

name: Hallow's Eve
deck: Ben Reilly's girlfriend and the villainess known as Hallow's Eve.

name: Bloodline
deck: Daughter of Blade and Safron Caulder

name: Hub
deck: The teleporter Hub was one of the few survivors in Genosha after the Sentinels started to eliminate the entire population of Genosha, around about 16 million of those deceased were mutants.

name: Nina
deck: Nina is one of a handful of genetically engineered anthropomorphic beings called "Mannites" created by the government to interface with computers by their own power.

name: Sunpyre
deck: Sunpyre, also known as Leyu Yoshida was a mutant and sister of former X-Man Sunfire. She had the same fire-based powers as her brother, but died after a brief stint with X-Corps.

name: King Bedlam
deck: The brother of Jesse Aaronson and the lover of Tarot. A ruthlessly ambitious killer who murdered his own parents, King Bedlam was depowered on M-Day.

name: Scatterbrain
deck: Scatterbrain/Fascination is a member of the Technet, and will eventually join the Special Executive. She may be a "loom-born" Gallifreyan mutant.

name: Sharon Xavier
deck: Wife first to Brian Xavier and then to Kurt Marko. Mother to Professor X and Cassandra Nova, stepmother to the Juggernaut.

name: Aleksander Lukin
deck: A roque Soviet general turned businessman who orchestrated the death of Red Skull.

name: Shockwave
deck: Nephew of of Sir Denis Nayland Smith and circus performer before being drafted by MI-6.

name: Marie D'Ancanto
deck: Marie D'Ancanto is former antagonist of the X-Men and a current ally, alongside the mutant lawyer, Evangeline Whedon.

name: Hit-Monkey
deck: A simian hit-man, seeking to avenge the deaths of his tribe members using skills he learned from the world's greatest assassin. He has a movie based on him in-universe. He also likes to shoot Deadpool. Sweet foot-shooting action!

name: Falcon (Torres)
deck: A young man who became the new Falcon after being experimented on by Doctor Mallus. After being imbued with Redwings DNA, Joaquin was unable to change back due to his new healing factor, courtesy of Redwings vampiric nature. Now, he fights crime as the new Falcon

name: Nebbish
deck: A little man that was the 'presenting' character to the Marvel Magazine named Crazy.

name: Libra (Brandt)
deck: Member of Zodiac

name: Margie
deck: Character of 40's Marvel.

name: Cordelia Frost
deck: Cordelia Frost is the younger sister of Emma, Adrienne, and Christian Frost.  Apart from being immune to her sister's telepathy, she has no confirmed powers.

name: Roberta
deck: Roberta is the robotic receptionist for the Fantastic Four.

name: Doctor Bong
deck: Doctor Bong is a former journalist turned mad scientist with an unhealthy obession for Beverly Switzler, who he first met in a life-drawing class. He's primarily an arch-enemy of Howard the Duck.

name: Contemplator
deck: The Contemplator is an Elder of the Universe from the Coal Sack Nebula. He has spent eternities in contemplation developing the powers of his mind and spirit.

name: Black Fox
deck: An aging cat burglar who is always on the look-out for that one last big job that will enable him to retire on the French Riviera.

name: Jahf
deck: Jahf is a guardian of the M'Kraan Crystal.

name: Jack Flag
deck: Former superstrong ally to Captain America and now galactic adventurer.

name: Crawley
deck: One of Jake Lockley's (Moon Knight) street contacts.

name: Screwball
deck: The world's first "live streaming super-villain." She commits crimes to get more hits on her webpage.

name: Bella Fishbach
deck: Bella is a co-worker of Peter Parker at Horizon Labs.

name: Crime-Master (Brant)
deck: Betty Brant's older brother who got into gambling debt with a gangster named Blackie, and the third person to become the Crime-Master.

name: Sapna
deck: Sapna is an Indian student who was chased by a mob and rescued by Magik. She has the mutant power to control the demons of Limbo and can see portals to other realms.

name: Alia Gregor
deck: Scientist of Orchis.

name: Genesis
deck: Wife of Apocalypse. When Okkara was split into Arakko and Krakoa, she stayed with their children on Arakko, while Apocalypse stayed on Krakoa and eventually returned to Earth.

name: Somnus
deck: Carl Valentino is a mutant with the power of Oneiromancy , resurrected by The Five in Krakoa.

name: Miles Brickman
deck: Miles Brickman is a U.S. Senator with a deep distruct and paranoia towards machines and mutants.

name: Tana Nile
deck: She is from the star-sun Rigel. She and her people were forced by Thor to discontinue their practice of 'colonizing' other civilized worlds.

name: Cat
deck: The Cat is a master martial artist, and former secret agent of the People's Republic of China.  His skill at melee and hand to hand combat rivals the top combatants in the Marvel Universe.

name: Slab
deck: Mutant who was in the short lived team Nasty Boys

name: Spencer Smythe
deck: Spencer Smythe was a expert in robotics and created robots designed to kill Spider-man. He died due to radiation poisoning he received from the materials his robots were made of.

name: The Shape
deck: A super-strong, nearly invulnerable large blob of a man, who is also a bit of a simpleton. Member of Marvel's Earth 31916 Squadron Supreme. Punching Shape is liking punching a large rubber ball.  He began as an analogue of DC Comics' Clayface and became more of an analogue of Plastic Man.

name: Mother Night
deck: The former nanny of the Red Skull's daughter, Sin.

name: Damian Tryp
deck: Damian Tryp is the founder and CEO of Singularity Investigations. He also is trying to prevent a possible future in which mutants are responsible for the collapse of civilisation.

name: Lionheart
deck: Kelsey was killed by Thunderball and resurrected by Captain Britain. She then had a brief stint with the Avengers.

name: DJ
deck: DJ is a mutant student at the Xavier Institute and a member of the Paragons. He was de-powered after M-Day and killed in the bus bomb attack. Only recently has he been resurrected, living on Krakoa.

name: Lewis Guthrie
deck: Lewis Guthrie, another younger brother of the X-Men - Husk and Cannonball.

name: Donald Blake
deck: Donald Blake was created by Odin to be an alter-ego of Thor so he could learn humility. They are now two separate beings

name: Nomad
deck: The son of Arnim Zola born in Dimension Z and raised by Captain America. Currently working under codename Nomad.

name: Cluster
deck: A female version of Fantomex cloned from one of his brains. She embodies the "nicest" part of the trio.

name: Melinda May
deck: Melinda May is a level 7 S.H.I.E.L.D. agent, nicknamed "The Cavalry". She's a veteran pilot and soldier with many years of experience. She withdrew from the duty as a field agent after an incident in Manama, Bahrain which left her slightly damaged. However, Melinda returned to the field when Agent Phil Coulson recruited her onto his team.

name: Grid
deck: Dinesh Deol is a new Inhuman who was saved by Medusa and her people from Hydra agents. He can see and manipulate electromagnetic fields.

name: Aaron Fischer
deck: A gay runaway who took up the mantle of Captain America to protect his fellow unhoused. "Defender of the Destitute."

name: Captain Ultra
deck: A lesser-known hero, Captain Ultra is nonetheless one of the cool guys of Marvel.

name: Bullet
deck: Bullet is a mercenary who serves as an agent of the United States Government. Bullet is a hitman for hire who has had encounters with Daredevil on numerous occassions.

name: Sunset Bain
deck: Sunset Bain is a ruthless businesswoman and a major enemy to Iron Man and Machine Man.

name: Mirage
deck: Mirage is a super-villain who uses life-like holograms to his advantage.

name: Cat-Man
deck: Two men have taken the identity of Cat-Man and were members of the Ani-Men.

name: Sprite
deck: The trickster Eternal.  Sprite looks like a child.

name: Parnival Plunder
deck: Brother to Ka-Zar and obsessed with technology.

name: Rachel Carpenter
deck: Daughter of Julia Carpenter - Spider-Woman / Arachne / Madame Web.

name: Rafael Scarfe
deck: Rafael was an NYPD official and a close friend to Misty Knight. He was her ex-partner in the unit when they where both on the force.

name: Mikaboshi
deck: Amatsu-Mikaboshi is the Japanese god of chaos and evil, an aspect of Oblivion. His goal was to put an end to creation and bring about a new age of chaos and void. After almost destroying the Multiverse, he was sealed off to a realm, where he dwells in a endless nothingess for all of eternity.

name: Exterminatrix
deck: As the daughter/prisoner of Doctor Midas, Exterminatrix would work on her father's crazy schemes and eventually inherit his company to work on her own.

name: Death Locket
deck: Harlan Ryker's daughter who was gravely injured by a Deathlok sent back in time to stop him from inventing the technology. Desperate to save her life, he replaced her damaged body parts with cybernetic implants.

name: Cullen Bloodstone
deck: Ulysses Bloodstone's son who was a student at the Braddock Academy before ending up in the Murderworld.

name: Reader
deck: A blind Inhuman from the Lor Tribe. Anything he reads becomes real.

name: Manon
deck: Young mutant saved by the X-men, secretly a Hound of Ahab to infiltrate and brainwash some X-men.

name: Lin Lie
deck: A college student based in Shanghai, Lin Lie originally fought evil as Sword Master when wielding the mystical sword of Fu Xi. After joining the New Agents of Atlas, Lie was chosen by Shou-Lao to become the new Iron Fist.

name: Spider-Boy (Briggs)
deck: A former sidekick of Spider-Man who was erased from history, Spider-Boy has been returned to a world that no longer remembers him.

name: Byrrah
deck: Byrrah is a Golden Age creation of Bill Everett.  He is the step-son of Emperor Tha-Korr, Namor's grandfather.  Byrrah has tried several times to take the throne of Atlantis for himself.

name: Mainframe
deck: Mainframe is a sentient computer program based upon Tony Stark's brainwaves and is one of the founding members of A-Next.

name: Doctor Demonicus
deck: Twisted genetic genius and enemy of Godzilla in Marvel Comics!

name: Bandit
deck:
Donyell Taylor is the brother of New Warriors founder Night Thrasher (Dwayne Taylor).

He recently became the second person to use the Night Thrasher identity.

name: Gatecrasher
deck: Leader of the Technet, a group of bounty hunters from various other-dimensional worlds.

name: Ann Weying
deck: Anne Weying was the ex-wife of Eddie Brock, and briefly wore the Venom symbiote.

name: Yu-Ti
deck: A teacher of Iron Fist and ruler of K'un-Lun.

name: Scream
deck: One of the five symbiotes forcibly spawned from the Venom symbiote by the Life Foundation. She eventually killed her symbiote siblings, and served as an enemy of both Venom and Spider-Man for some time. Her current host is Andrea "Andi" Benton,(formerly known as Mania)

name: Whiteout
deck: Whiteout is a Savage Land Mutate that is able to selectively blind people with light emitted from her body.

name: Bushman
deck: A skull-faced terrorist-for-hire who is considered to be Moon Knight's oldest and most formidable nemesis.

name: Shell
deck: A member of professional killer group, Shi'ar Death Commandos.

name: Cloud 9
deck: Cloud 9 was recruited by War Machine into The Initiative, and she has the ability to fly on what appears to be a chemical-based cloud.

name: Spirit of '76
deck: A wartime superhero who was the first man to replace Steve Rogers as Captain America.

name: Wraith (Watanabe)
deck: Yuri Watanabe is a NYPD Captain who rose through the ranks alongside Jean DeWolff, and is an ally of Spider-Man. She is also the current Wraith.

name: Leah
