deck: The loyal and dutiful handmaid and servant of the death goddess Hela. Leah's path seems to lead her directly into the presence of the trickster god Loki.

name: Ms. Thing
deck: Darla Deering was a trendy socialite who after a romantic encounter with Johnny Storm, wound up as a substitute member of the Fantastic Four. Now as a member of the team, she wears a suit previously used by the Thing when he was de-powered which grants her superhuman strength.

name: Uriel
deck: The heir of Archangel and one of the Apocalypse Twins.

name: Spider-Punk
deck: Spider-Punk is a variant of Spider-Man from Earth-138 but not a variant of Peter Parker. Instead, he is a variant of Hobie Brown. He is a rebellious punk rocker from a fascist America.

name: N'kalla
deck: N'kalla was a child gladiator made to represent the Skrulls in a mock Kree-Skrull War that was saved by the Fantastic Four and eventually adopted by Ben and Alicia Grimm

name: Cobalt Man
deck: Ralph Roberts, the Cobalt Man, is a disgruntled former Stark Enterprises employee. He created a duplication of the Iron Man armor out of cobalt.

name: Slyde
deck: Enemy of Spider-Man and sometimes ally of The Kingpin.

name: Milla Donovan
deck: Married to Matt Murdock, Daredevil.  She is also blind.

name: Debbie Harris
deck: A socilaite and former wife of Foggy Nelson.

name: Tower
deck: The size altering mutant known as Tower for the most part was a mercenary for hire, which led him to join the Alliance of Evil.  He was later killed by the X-Cutioner.

name: Sin-Eater
deck: The Sin-Eater was a former police detective with a double personality. He became the serial killer who also murdered Jean DeWolff. He quotes the Bible, justifying his murders as God's will.

name: Silverclaw
deck: With the ability to transform herself into the form of animals native to her homeland, Silverclaw was a close friend of the Avengers' butler Jarvis and later became an Avenger herself.

name: Foreigner
deck: The Foreigner is a highly intelligent, assassin and occasional mercenary who is also a of master of disguise. He has no powers but is in peak physical condition. He is the former husband of Silver Sable.

name: Tom Thumb
deck: The diminutive genius known as Tom Thumb from Earth-712 was the first to use the the name as a hero and resident brainiac of the Squadron Surpreme. The second man to use the name of Tom Thumb is a size altering member of another Earth's Squadron Supreme (Earth-31916).

name: Kamal
deck: Kamal is a powerhouse member of the Acolytes with superhuman strength and icy hard skin.

name: Jill Stacy
deck: Cousin of the late Gwen Stacy, and close friend to the Parker family.

name: Reignfire
deck: A clone of sorts of Sunspot. Led the second team of M.L.F.

name: Archie Corrigan
deck: Archie Corrigan is friend and pilot of Wolverine.

name: Hairbag
deck: Member of the Mr. Sinister's Nasty Boys

name: Alyosha Kravinoff
deck: The son of Kraven the Hunter, he too is a skilled hunter and tracker. Unlike his father his enhanced abilities are natural and he can talk to animals.

name: Jade Claw
deck: Suwan is a grand-niece of Yellow Claw and former lover of Jimmy Woo. She's now known as Jade Claw.

name: Trickshot
deck: Charles Bernard Barton (nicknamed Barney) is the older brother to Clint Barton. He was believed dead for many years, but recently returned and joined Norman Osborn's new Dark Avengers team.

name: Profiler
deck: Ulysses is a Nuhuman who can predict the future. He is the center around the new Civil War amongst the superhuman community.

name: Bobby Lathrop
deck: Young confidant of the Black Rider.

name: Jo-Venn
deck: Jo-Venn was a child gladiator force to represent the Kree in a mock Kree-Skrull War by The Profiteer, he was eventually saved by the Fantastic Four.

name: Lactuca the Knower
deck: Lactuca is an Omega-level mutant from Arakko with the power to know the location of anything in the universe.

name: Aqueduct
deck: Formerly known as Water Wizard, Aqueduct is a super-villain with the ability to manipulate water.

name: Diamondhead
deck: Diamond skinned crook and one of Nova's greatest enemies.

name: Askani
deck: A member of the Clan Askani charged with protecting the Summers family, which would serve to protect the future from Apocalypse.

name: Scorpia
deck: Elaine Coll, AKA Scorpia is a psychotic woman with a similar suit to that of the Scorpion and an enemy of Spider-Man.

name: Lucifer
deck: An alien who cost Professor X the use of his legs.

name: Ape-Man
deck: Two men have taken the identity of Ape-Man and were members of the Ani-Men.

name: Arranger
deck: Personal assistant to the Kingpin, oversaw various criminal operations.

name: Jason Ionello
deck: Part the "popular crowd" along with Flash Thompson, Brian "Tiny" McKeever, Seymour O'Reilly, and Sally Avril who were often picking on Peter Parker.

name: Devo
deck: A member of professional killer group, Shi'ar Death Commandos.

name: Carmilla Black
deck: Carmilla Black is the new Scorpion with chemical-based powers. However, she has no connection to the original Scorpion. Her mother genetically engineered her and others called the Wakers. Formerly part of S.H.I.E.L.D., Carmilla's current loyalties are a mystery, but she remains an effective spy.

name: Agony
deck: One of the five symbiotes forcibly spawned from the Venom symbiote by the Life Foundation, Agony has the unique ability to spit acid.

name: Coachwhip
deck: Coachwhip is a serpent-themed villain most often affiliated with either Viper or the Serpent Society.

name: Ka'ardum
deck: Ka'ardum is the major general of the Shi'ar military. He aided in removing Lilandra from the throne.

name: Troll
deck: Captured by the Thunderbolts during a mission and showing attachment to Songbird, Troll is one of the youngest and primal of the latest Thunderbolts members.

name: Thori
deck: Thori is a Hellhound with flames coming out of his mouth and the ability to speak.

name: Air-Walker
deck: Gabriel Lan is a former Herald of Galactus known as Air-walker, his best friend Pyreus Kril succeeded him as The Firelord.

name: Kurse
deck: Kurse was from a race called the Dark Elves and he is considered to be the most powerful of them all. Originally known as Algrim the Strong, after being mystically augmented by the Beyonder, his strength was quadrupled in comparison to Thor's later on making him one of the God of Thunders mightiest foes.

name: Domina
deck: The status of Domina and her seclusive Warclan are unknown since the catastrophic repercussions and consequences of the "Wild Sentinels" attack on the mutant island Genosha through the machinations of the genocidal Mummudrai now called Cassandra Nova who unleashed her merciless machines...killing over six million mutant inhabitants. It is presumed that Domina died in the destruction...

name: Gremlin
deck: Gremlin is the son of Gargoyle, who gave him superhuman intelligence.  He designed armor and weapons used by the Soviet Super-Troopers, in his huge secret Soviet base underground in the Arctic.

name: Fontanelle
deck: Fontanelle was a telepath hired to find out Gambit's role in the Mutant Massacre. She is the daughter of Amanda Mueller.

name: Lascivious
deck: The first Titania, a member of the Grapplers.  She was slain by the Scourge, then revived by The Hood in order to kill the Punisher.

name: Nuklo
deck:
Robert Frank Jr is the mutant son of the WW2 superheroes the Whizzer and Miss America. After his mother was exposed to radiation during an accident, Nuklo was sealed away in a time capsule for 25 years, in an attempt to decrease his radiation levels.
Being unleashed from his prison, he battled the Avengers. Despite his lack of intelligence, Nuklo became a powerful threat and even joined the V-Battalion alongside other WW2 Superheroes. Whether on his own or in a team, Nuklo is extremely dangerous.

name: Renee Majcomb
deck: Member of the Mutant Underground created by Professor X.

name: David Munroe
deck: David Munroe is the husband of N'Dare Munroe and is the Father Of Ororo Munroe

name: Jack Norriss
deck: Husband of Barbara Norriss. Former S.H.I.E.L.D. agent, intrepid Inside America TV reporter. Former sidekick to nighthawk but now his own hero.

name: Warrior Woman
deck: Julia Koenig was Nazi spy Madame Rätsel (a.k.a. Madame Mystery) during World War II.

name: Blur
deck: Speedster from the New Universe. He is the only survivor of his universe. Stranded on Earth-616, he decided to join the Squadron Supreme.

name: Red Ronin
deck: Previously a mere robot, the Red Ronin was recommissioned and redeveloped by Fujikawa Industries as an amnesiac cyborg who at first knew herself as only "Namie."

name: John Howlett Sr.
deck: John Howlett Senior is the husband of Elizabeth Howlett and father to John Howlett junior (named after him) and James Howlett (Logan/Wolverine)

name: Cynthia von Doom
deck: The wife of Werner von Doom and mother of Doctor Doom.

name: Niels
deck: The bouncing feline superhero who was caught in the same experiment which granted Speedball his powers.  Niels has fought minor villains & taken on the name Hairball in honour of Robbie Baldwin's secret identity, Speedball.  He is also a founding member of the Pet Avengers.

name: Ringer
deck: Keith Kraft is the super-villain Ringer who donned the costume following the alleged death of the original Ringer.

name: Unit
deck: Unit is a highly-intelligent android who uses manipulation and technological supremacy to further his agenda.

name: Mallory Book
deck: A very successful lawyer who has had a precedent-setting law career. Jennifer Walters used to work at the same law practice with her (Goodman, Lieber, Kurtzberg, and Holliway).

name: Ren Hoek
deck: Ren Hoek is a rage-filled chihuahua and best friend of Stimpy.

name: Killpower
deck: Killpower was genetically engineered by Mys-Tech's mad scientist Dr. Oonagh Mullarkey as a prototype fast-growing, throwaway super-soldier; tough, strong and not too bright, Motormouth's friendship made him a hero.

name: White Wolf
deck: The White Wolf was the leader of the Hatut Zeraze, the secret police of Wakanda. As a baby, he survived a plane crash that plummeted onto Wakandan land. He was then given Wakandan citizenship by King T'Chaka. White Wolf became T'Chaka's most loyal servant doing any and everything, no matter how brutal, to appease him.

name: Red Lotus
deck: Paul Hark is a mutant with enhanced physical attributes, making him a super-powered martial artist.

name: Richard Rory
deck: Richard Rory is a former disc jockey with an unlucky habit of getting tangled up in superhuman affairs.

name: Hilde
deck: Hilde is a young Asgardian girl whom lives among other Gods in Asgardia. She is the daughter of Volstagg and Gudrun and has a spirit for adventures. She is also known as Gunnhild or Hildy.

name: Piper
deck: There have been two Marvel characters going by the name Piper. One is a mutant and a member of the Morlocks, the other is a mutate of the savage land.

name: Basilisk
deck: Absorbing the Kree Alpha and Omega Stones, a small-time burglar was transformed into a powerful new being. With his new-found abilities, the cunning and sadistic Basilisk has caused carnage across the globe and faced heroes ranging from the Fantastic Four and Spider-Man, to Captain Marvel and the Punisher.

name: Witchfire
deck: Witchfire, whose real name is Ananym, is the daughter of the demon sorcerer Belasco (ruler of Limbo) and ex-member of Gamma and Beta Flight.

name: Psynapse
deck: Psynapse was an Inhuman and distant member of the Royal Family whom worked for Apocalypse as one the Dark Riders.

name: Zombie Deadpool
deck: Deadpool from Earth-2149 who ended up in Earth-616. Currently only a head, and a member of Deadpool Corps.

name: Masked Marauder
deck: Criminal with powerful Opti-Blasts that can temporarily blind a person.

name: Metalhead
deck: Eddie was a musician and a mutant in the year 2099. He has the power to turn his skin into any metal he touches.

name: Juston Seyfert
deck: A gifted teenage mechanic who managed to rebuild and reprogram a crashed Mark IV Sentinel.

name: Komodo
deck: Komodo a recruit of The Initiative recommended by Curt Connors (The Lizard). Komodo's appearance and powers are derived from Dr. Connors' lizard formula, which she stole and then altered to fit her own DNA.

name: Slingshot
deck: Daughter of the Johnny Horton, a.k.a. the first Griffin.  Recruited for Nick Fury's Secret Invasion strike force against the Skrulls.

name: S'yan
deck: S'yan, The Swift is a former king of Wakanda and Black Panther. He is the son of Azzari, The Wise and the younger brother to T'Chaka, The Great. He passed the title of Black Panther to his nephew T'Challa.

name: General Fortean
deck: One of the biggest threats to the Red Hulk. He is determined to avenge the death of his mentor General Thunderbolt Ross by killing the Red Hulk, without realising the Red Hulk's true identity.  Eventually becomes a new incarnation of Abomination.

name: Nur
deck: A new Inhuman who was a New York cop for almost 30 years. After he became an Inhuman, he joined their ranks.

name: Satan the Wonderhorse
deck: Satan is The Black Rider's horse.

name: Aphrodite Ourania
deck: The goddess Aphodite is a member of the Olympian Gods and the goddess of Love and Beauty. In the 1950s, she  was bored and went to Earth  and disguised as a mortal woman, working  in the Beauty Magazine and have a romantic relationship with publisher Whitney Hammond. But she later return to Olympos.

name: Kat Farrell
deck: Ms. Farrell is a reporter for the Daily Bugle and head of The Pulse

name: Cassie Lathrop
deck: Ex-girlfriend of Wolverine.

name: Letha
deck: Formerly a member of the Grapplers, Letha was slain by the Scourge of the Underworld during the Bar With No Name massacre. She was later revived by the Hood, who gave her rage-inducing powers.

name: Marcy Kane
deck: Marcy Kane is an alien in disguise at Empire State University. She has had relationships with the Jack of Hearts and Peter Parker (Spider-Man).

name: The Buzz
deck: The grandson of J. Jonah Jameson, Jack has rebelled against his upbringing, taking to the skies as the high-flying hero known as The Buzz.

name: Friday
deck: Aelfyre Whitmane's Kymellian spacecraft, Friday was named after Robinson Crusoe's loyal companion from Whitey's favorite Earth novel.  Like all other Smartsips, Friday is sentient and capable of rational thought.  She provided travel, knowledge & resources for Power Pack over the years.

name: Fred Davis
deck: A baseball player who took up the mantle of Bucky to trick the Red Skull when the Invaders were brainwashed. Months later, he officially became the second Bucky.

name: Birdy
deck: Birdy was a telepath who was Sabretooth's partner for a time. She learned to use her telepathy to temporarily calm Sabretooth's murderous rage, leading to his dependence on her until her death at the hands of Sabretooth's son, Graydon Creed.

name: Anne-Marie Hoag
deck: Founder and current owner of Damage Control.

name: Aneka
deck: The former fighting master of Wakanda's Dora Milaje. Sentenced to death for killing a corrupt Chieftain, Aneka and her lover Ayo left the Dora Milaje and became the Midnight Angels.

name: Pavitr Prabhakar
deck: The Spider-Man of Earth-50101. He has similar powers as the Earth-616 Spider-Man, except his powers are magical in nature.

name: Kymera
deck: The daughter of Storm and Black Panther from an alternate reality, and member of the X-Men.

name: Hunter's Moon
deck: A second Fist of Khonshu chosen during Khonshu's imprisonment by Asgardians. He originally rivaled Marc Specter, the current Moon Knight, before becoming a trustworthy member of Marc's Midnight Mission.

name: Escapade
deck: Shela Sexton, aka Escapade. She's trans, and she's also a mutant. Shela is a thief and a trickster, who uses gadgets to pull off her heists. She doesn't like to rely on her mutant power. She identifies as a supervillain — but a supervillain who only helps people.

name: Shortpack
deck: Shortpack is a mutant of diminutive size and telepathic communication. He was employed by Xavier in the Mutant Underground and partnered with Mystique.

name: Scarlett McKenzie
deck: Quark was a professional psychologist, spy and mercenary. She was also a love interest to her pawn Havok/Alex Summers.

name: Nick Katzenberg
deck: A former photographer of Daily Bugle and one of the biggest sleaze-bags you could ever hope to meet.

name: Arthur Nagan
deck: A man that has had his head placed on a gorilla's body.

name: Phillip Chang
deck: College classmate of Peter Parker at Empire State University

name: Lilith Drake
deck: Lilith is the daughter of Dracula. She bears a deep hate for him. Because of the way she became a vampire she is in a way the ultimate vampire; She is immune to all of their weaknesses but has all their strengths.

name: Cindy
deck: Teen romance character from Timely time.

name: Elizabeth Howlett
deck: Mother of James Howlett, better known as the man who would some day become Wolverine.

name: Willis Stryker
deck: Willis Stryker, formerly friends with Luke Cage, framed Cage, who ended up in prison. Stryker was a knife specialist. He died when one of his own customized explosive knives detonated.

name: Hellfire
deck: Codenamed Hellfire, J.T. James has the power to generate hellfire due to being descended from the original Phantom Rider. He was discovered and trained by Nick Fury to be one of Fury's Secret Warriors.

name: Spider-Bot
deck: Mechanical arachnid designed by The Superior Spider-Man (Doctor Octopus).

name: Xilo
deck: Xilo is an Omega-level mutant from Arakko with the power to manipulate earth.

name: Vibraxas
deck: The self-titled "Master Of Vibration" & the son of a Wakandan aristocrat & Wakanda scientist.

name: Ulysses
deck: Walter Charles is recruited into the Pantheon and becomes heir to the first Ulysses after he is killed during a mission.

name: Mickey Walker
deck: Younger brother of Patsy Walker/Hellcat.

name: Rick Sheridan
deck: Rick Sheridan was a happy, healthy college student who became the host of the alien Sleepwalker

name: Dreadnought
deck: Dreadnought was created for combat by Hydra

name: Poundcakes
deck: Poundcakes is a female wrestler with the ability to create shockwaves and tremors with her seismic boots.

name: Goldbug
deck: Goldbug is a minor villain, who was obsessed with gold. He has faced off against many heroes.

name: Gazer
deck: Gazer was a mutant that could use radiation as nourishment, and as a result lived on a space station in orbit.  After losing his powers on M-Day, Gazer would become Apocalypse's horseman War.

name: Kayla Ballantine
deck: Kayla Ballantine was the secretary and later girlfriend of Quasar(Wendell Vaughn), she later gained the power of the Starbrand.

name: Spike Freeman
deck: Spike Freeman was the owner of both the X-Force and X-Statix.  He did not care about the well-being of any team member, but rather only his money and ratings.

name: Dexter Bennett
deck: Rumor monger and scandal sheet printer, Dexter Bennett became the latest owner of the Daily Bugle after a hostile buyout of long-time owner J. Jonah Jameson.

name: Hulk Jr.
deck: Robert Bruce Banner Jr. is the son of The Incredible Hulk, the adopted stepson of The Hooded Man and is Second-in-Command of The New Defenders.

name: Melter (Colchiss)
deck: Chris Colchiss, or Melter, is a mutant with the power to melt any substance. He wishes to be a hero but isn't sure what is required of him to be one.

name: Animax
deck: Blake is a mutant with the ability to create genetic creatures out of her own DNA structure at her own will.

name: Disha Khan
deck: Disha Khan is Kamala's mother.

name: Cosmic Ghost Rider
deck: Alternate universe version of the Punisher (Frank Castle) who became a Ghost Rider and Herald of Galactus, and ultimately served Thanos.

name: Joystick
deck: Joystick is a former member of the Masters of Evil and the Thunderbolts. While with the Thunderbolts, it was discovered that Joystick was a double agent working for the Grandmaster and her objective was to steal the Moonstones of Baron Zemo.

name: Mayhem
deck: Brigid is a former New York City Police detective that gained the power to turn into a gas-like entity, able to release a poison gas. She also has razor-sharp nails. Mayhem has worked with Cloak & Dagger on many occasions.

name: Spymaster
deck: Spymaster is a master of espionage, and of industrial espionage in particular.

name: Ghaur
deck: Ghaur is a Deviant Priest and later de facto ruler of the race.

name: Yap
deck: Yap is an alien teleporter who is obsessed with Gatecrasher.

name: Stacey Kramer
deck: Former love of Cable.

name: Dreamstalker
deck: Nightmare's demonic horse which he uses for travel.

name: Kiden Nixon
deck: Kiden is a 16 year old girl from Alphabet City, a Manhattan neighborhood. After witnessing her father being murdered as a child, her family falls apart, and she delves into drugs.

name: Jeb Guthrie
deck: Jeb Guthrie is the younger brother of the X-Men, Husk and Cannonball.

name: Alisande Morales
deck: Ex-Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. that is investigating X-23's murders. Now is under HAMMER's authority.

name: Khn'nr
deck: Khn'nr was a Skrull impersonator of Mar-Vell. A sleeper agent, he fully believed himself to be Captain Marvel and chose to fight and die as Mar-Vell against the invading Skrull forces.

name: Gerry Drew
deck: The son of Spider-Woman (Jessica Drew) inherited spider-powers and had a short tenure as Spider-Man.

name: Onome
deck: A brilliant, young Wakandan

name: Andi Benton
deck: Flash Thompson's Philadelphia neighbor and student who was constantly pulled into his weird world. She bonded with Mania symbiote, the Scream symbiote, and now the Silence symbiote, while also inheriting the Hell-Mark from the Mania, making her a potential Hell-Lord.

name: Wesley
deck: A member of Fisk Industries and right-hand man to the Kingpin.

name: Lodus Logos
deck: Lodus Logos is a mutant from Arakko and a member of the Great Ring.

name: Jenny Swensen
deck: The first Spitfire, Professor Jennifer Swensen became an armored heroine after recovering her late father's M.A.X. suit from the evil Fritz Krozte. After this, Jenny began to help the government battle the proliferation of dangerous technology.

name: Chondu
deck: Mystician. A bartender at the Bar with No Doors.

name: Doppelganger
deck: The Spider-Man based doppelgänger created by Magus during the Infinity War.

name: Lissa Russell
deck: Sister of Werewolf By Night. Can transform into a Weredemon.

name: U-Man
deck: Atlantean warrior and scientist who allied himself with Nazi Germany and the Super-Axis.

name: Omega the Unknown
deck: Omega The Unknown, created by a dying alien race attempting to preserve its culture, was linked to James-Michael Starling, whom his creators had also created. Both were ultimately tragically destroyed.

name: Hypernova
deck: Hypernova is a member of the Shi'ar Death Commandos, and took part in the attack to kill Rachel Grey and her entire family.

name: Skull The Slayer
deck: James Scully is a trained soldier who gained enhanced strength and stamina when he wore the Scorpion Belt. He is currently a resident of Weirdworld.

name: Kingo Sunen
deck: He has has all the powers of the Eternals.

name: Ruby Summers
deck: Ruby Summers is the daughter of Cyclops and Emma Frost in Bishop's future.

name: Ashley Barton
deck: In the alternate reality of Old Man Logan, she is the daughter of Clint Barton (Hawkeye) and Tonya (youngest daughter of Peter Parker, Spider-Man). During the events of Spider-Verse is officially named Spider-Girl.

name: Agent Deems
deck: Agent of SWORD

name: Pestilence (Ichisumi)
deck: Final Horseman of Apocalypse.

name: Fauna
deck: A new young mutant who chose to join other mutants on Krakoa. He walked with and spoke to Jean Grey as she led a group to a Krakoan gate.

name: Dr. Karl Malus
deck: Fascinated by superhuman powers, the mad genius known as Doctor Malus will go to any lengths to satisfy his curiosity. He has personally created many superhumans, and is responsible for much of the Power Brokers' work in giving people superpowers.

name: Portal
deck: Director of A.R.M.O.R., Charles Little Sky is a mutant with the power to create portals to other dimensions.

name: Larry Trask
deck: Larry Trask followed in the footsteps of his mutant-hating father, Bolivar Trask, totally unaware that he was a mutant himself. After his father's death, he continued his father's work and improving on the original design, set out to take revenge on the X-Men.

name: Keith Kincaid
deck: Dr. Keith Kincaid is the model Odin used for the Don Blake persona he created as a punishment Thor.

name: Miracle Man
deck: "How do you fight a man who can accomplish miracles! That was the problem which confronted the Fantastic Four when they faced the threat of the Miracle Man... The Fantastic Four discovered that even miracles are not always what they seem... not when they are produced by a master hypnotist!"

name: Zombie
deck: Killed by his gardener Gyps and brought back from the dead by means of Voodoo, Simon William Garth unwillingly became the Zombie.

name: Golden Archer
deck: Wyatt McDonald is the finest archer of Earth-712, home to the Squadron Supreme. However, despite his brilliant skills, he has been removed from the Squadron for brainwashing his former girlfriend, Lady  Lark.

name: Philip Summers
deck: Philip Summers is a descendant of Black Womb/Amanda Mueller and the father of Corsair. He is also the paternal grandfather of Cyclops, Havok and Vulcan. He owns his own airline company.

name: Pulse
deck: The enigmatic mutant known as Pulse has the power to nullify other mutants' powers. He was brought to the X-Men by Mystique who wished to disrupt the relationship between Rogue and Gambit. The former cat burglar, and self-professed coward, joined the X-Men in a battle against Apocalypse.

name: Fabian LaMuerto
deck: The Son of Black Tarantula and Black Tarantula himself in MC2 universe.

name: Raymond Sikorsky
deck: Member of the National Security Council.

name: Khan
deck: Ruler of an alien invasion force from another dimension that invaded the 616 dimension in Madripoor. He was a master strategist and tactician, and was highly skilled in many forms of hand to hand combat.

name: Vin Gonzales
deck: A police officer in New York. Doesn't have faith that Spider-Man is a good guy.

name: Tran Coy Manh
deck: Older twin brother of the New Mutant Karma, Tran shared her mutant power to possess other living beings.  He used his power to murder others under his possession, and was employed by their Uncle who was a successful crime lord.

name: King Hyperion
deck: King Hyperion of Earth-4023 is an evil, corrupt, twisted and mentally deranged version of the Squadron Supreme's Hyperion. King Hyperion is a tyrannical and genocidal would-be conqueror of the Multiverse.

name: Sentinel Mark IV
deck: A damaged Mk VI Sentinel, reconstituted, reprogrammed and improved by Juston  Seyfert, initially using It to right some wrongs in his life, then later to stop Injustice.

name: Thane
deck: The son of Thanos and an unnamed Inhuman woman. Thane spent the majority of his life in a secret Inhuman city as a healer, until the day his father came to Earth to track him down and kill him.

name: Margaret Braddock
deck: The daughter of Captain Britain and Meggan. She is only a baby but already super-intelligent and able to talk. This caused much distress to her parents Megan and Brian.

name: Fisher King
deck: A powerless Arakki mutant who doesn't consider himself human, because humans are from Earth.

name: Chord
deck: A retired mercenary, Chord is Night Thrasher's legal guardian along with Chord's mother-in-law Tai, who raised him after his parents were killed. Also, the father of Silhouette and Midnight's Fire. Later, he would also become the guardian to Rage.

name: Zelda Kurtzberg
deck: Zelda was a young girl whom worked in a cafe in Greenwich Village, where the original X-Men used to go. She became X-Man Iceman's girlfriend.

name: Claire Temple
deck: A fierce night nurse who tended to superheroes. She was Luke Cage's love interest from his Hero for Hire days.

name: Tatterdemalion
deck: Tatterdemalion is a tap dancer and actor, turned criminal.

name: Shaper of Worlds
deck: A powerful being that developed from a Skrull Cosmic Cube.  He helped tutor Kubik, another sentient Cube, into maturity.

name: Ringtoss
deck: Ringtoss is part of the extraterrestrial cadre named the Technet. She is able to toss out energy rings from her faceplate which then binds beings it surrounds.

name: Edna McCoy
deck: Mother of Hank McCoy, better known as the X-men's Beast.

name: Crule
deck: The savage member of the Externals.

name: Ultimo
deck: Ultimo is a sentient weapon that was made by a group of unnamed aliens simply to destroy anything it encounters, save for its masters.

name: Nereel
deck: Nereel is a native of the Savage Land and a woman whom Colossus had a romantic relationship with. This relationship most likely produced a child, with Nereel the mother and probably Colossus being its father.

name: Morris Sloan
deck: A university professor that taught physics and Peter Parker was one of his student teachers.

name: Warshot
deck: Warshot is a member of the Shi'ar Death Commandos.

name: 3-D Man (Chandler)
deck: 3-D Man is a classic Marvel superhero and member of the Avengers. When wearing his 3-D glasses and concentrating, he had the ability to triple his strength, speed, and stamina. Although his character is essentially a 50's hero, he was created in the 1970's for the comic series, Marvel Premiere.

name: Gabriel Stacy
deck: Gabriel is the genetic son of Norman Osborn and Gwen Stacy.

name: Fuego
deck: Fuego was a member of the Children of the Vault, currently deceased.

name: Headsman
deck: Headsman was a employee of Norman Osborn. After successive failed attempts at defeating a certain wall-crawling superhero, he joined Norman Osborn's black ops Thunderbolts team.

name: Nakia Bahadir
deck: Friend of Kamala Khan.

name: Doyle Dormammu
deck: Doyle is half-Faltine, son of Dormammu, enrolled at Strange Academy.

name: Skybreaker
deck: Skybreaker is an Inhuman named Aireo the Floating Man.

name: Rumiko Fujikawa
deck: A former love interest for Tony Stark, Rumiko was the daughter of Kenjiro Fujikawa, the man who took over Stark's company when he was in the Heroes Reborn universe.

name: Tante Mattie
deck: Tante Mattie has spiritual abilities, healing, and telepathic contact with those near death.

name: Chance
deck: Mercenary who bets his services against his fees.

name: Destroyer (Marlow)
deck: Keene Marlow was a Golden Age hero of Marvel's predecessor Timely Comics. In the 1970's Destroyer was retconned into Brian Falsworth, heir & successor to the title Union Jack. Marlow later appeared as an aged hero who set out to kill all supervillians before dying of heart failure.

name: Leila Taylor
deck: Former love interest of and foil Falcon, Leila Taylor appeared in Marvel's Captain America as a member of a Black activism group and reporter.

name: Cyclone
deck: A French gangster who inherited the Cyclone suit and name from the deceased villain Andre Gerard.  Has worked with the Maggia and Justine Hammer's Masters of Evil, and even briefly operated as a member of Hawkeye's heroic Thunderbolts.

name: Tar Baby
deck: A morlock, deceased.

name: Waxworks
deck: A member of the other-dimensional bounty hunters called Technet.

name: Hemingway
deck: An extremely violent Morlock, Hemingway was a member of Gene Nation. He died, but was later briefly resurrected by Eli Bard & Selene via the Transmode Virus.

name: John Garrett
deck: Former agent of SHIELD who was made into a cyborg to save his life. Recently he's been helping Nick Fury take down Leviathan with his Secret Warriors.

name: Sat-Yr-9
deck: The former dictator of Earth-794, Sat-Yr-9 escaped to Earth-616, assuming the guise of Courtney Ross. She is now the White Queen of the Inner Circle.

name: Kronos
deck: A mysterious and rarely seen Eternal, the cosmic master of time within the Marvel continuum remains a powerful figure within the universe's large landscape. Once a Titan when the universe was young - he now resides between the space/time continuum as an ominous figure observing matters of galactic importance.

name: Lian Shen
deck: Dr Shen is an associate of the Shadow King.

name: Strongman
deck: Bruto the Strong Man of the Circus of Crime.

name: Combat Kelly
deck: Combat Kelly is the name of two Marvel characters of uncertain relation to each other.

name: Goom
deck: Goom is an alien entity from planet X. He possessed a wide variety of physical and mental powers as well as advanced technology.

name: Blue Eagle
deck: Blue Eagle was a longtime member of the Squadron Supreme, he died during a battle with Nighthawk's Redeemers.

name: Sentry #459
deck: One of the army of robot Intergalactic Kree Sentries. Sentry #459 was Captain Marvel's first nemesis on Earth.

name: Jamir Khan
deck: Aamir is Kamala Khan's older brother.

name: Forget Me Not
deck: A member of the X-Men whom nobody can ever remember

name: Maxime
deck: Young mutant saved by the X-men, secretly a Hound of Ahab to infiltrate and brainwash some X-men.

name: Alligator Loki
deck: Reptillian variant of Loki from an alternate reality.

name: Ken Ellis
deck: An ambitious reporter for the Daily Bugle. Perhaps most notably, he was the one that first named the Scarlet Spider.

name: Bengal
deck: Bengal is a martial artist who seeks vengeance on those that committed war crimes during the Vietnam War.

name: Magnus
deck: The son of Magneto and Rogue from Earth-27 and the first Exile to die on a mission.

name: Taku
deck: Taku is the Black Panther 's Minister of Information.

name: Uni-Mind
deck: The Uni-Mind is a collective organism that is created when the Eternals all merge together. Within the Uni-Mind, individual differences cease to matter and all Eternals become as one.

name: Valinor
deck: Black stallion enchanted to have bat wings and be able to fly

name: Feron
deck: Feron is the most recent in a 1,000 generation old line of potential magical hosts for the Phoenix Force.  His original teachings come from Necrom, who in the future is the Anti-Phoenix and the one Feron must stop.

name: Thug
deck: Thug of the Technet is a member of the same species as Legion of the Special Executive.

name: Norton McCoy
deck: The Father of Hank McCoy AKA the Beast. Norton worked in a nuclear plant and his exposure to nuclear radiation was the cause of Hank's mutation.

name: Victoria Montesi
deck: Victoria Montesi is a young woman whom is the last in line of a family of defenders against an ancient evil. She gets visions whenever a page of the evil Darkhold book is invoked. She and her team try to stop the gathering of the Darkhold book.

name: Thumbelina
deck: In the world of super model appearing heroes and villains, Thumbelina was a minority.  Short, Stout, Slow and always made fun of.  She was an original member of the MLF.

name: Dorrek VII
deck: Emperor Dorrek VII captured the Illuminati and began the infiltration experiments.

name: James Braddock
deck: The greatest fighter of his time as a member of the Captain Britain Corps. Braddock settled on Earth-616 & joined the Hellfire Club of London and fathered 3 children before being killed with his wife.

name: Crime-Master (Lewis)
deck: A gangster mob boss in New York City, Crime-Master is an old foe of Spider-Man.

name: Digger
deck: Digger is a villain who buries people alive. Also somewhat of a storyteller.

name: Blackcloak
deck: Black Cloak is a faithful servant of the corrupt Chancellor Araki, a highly respected member of The Shi'ar Death Commandos and the alien responsible for the destruction of Rachel Grey's Family. He was killed by Rachel as chaos began to descend on Chandilar following the murder of Empress Lilandra.

name: Black Racer
deck: Silent speedster of the Serpent Squad.

name: American Eagle
deck: The second man who took up the name American Eagle.

name: Kelda
deck: Lady Kelda is an Asgardian, returned to life after the latest cycle of Ragnarok by Thor. While the rest of her people had struggled to find their place in Midgard, Kelda found love in the form of a mortal, though he was murdered in Loki and Dr. Doom's schemes.

name: Scotty Logan
deck: Son of Wolverine & Maureen Logan.

name: Mania
deck: The Venom Clone was genetically engineered to wipe out humanity by a mutant strain of a nano-technological alien race. It bonded with a U.S. Army communications specialist Patricia Robertson and went on to find Eddie Brock to try to wipe out humanity

name: Omega Black
deck: A member of the Omega Clan.

name: Doombot
deck: A robot with the personality of Doctor Doom kept in Hank Pym's lab. In the aftermath of Age of Ultron, he was given the chance to redeem himself.

name: Ayo
deck: Ayo emerged as a defiant figure within the ranks of Wakanda's Dora Milaje, eventually co-founding the second Midnight Angels team alongside her romantic partner, Aneka.

name: Peter Spaulding
deck: Human friend of Machine Man.

name: Sandi
deck: Sandi served as secretary/receptionist for Deadpool and Agency X. She is also Taskmaster's on-again/off-again girlfriend.

name: Hector
deck: Member of the Pantheon.

name: G-Type
deck: A member of the group The Imperial Guard.

name: Presence
deck: The father of Darkstar and Vanguard, later became the father to a new breed of Dire Wraiths.

name: Century
deck: Century is a composite being made up from the 100 strongest residents of the planet Hodomur. Armed with a staff known as Parralax, Century arrived on Earth and inadvertently led a dangerous alien race to the planet, becoming indebted to the Avengers after believing himself responsible for the death of Wonder Man.

name: Joyboy
deck: A grotesque alien capable of making others wishes just as grotesque

name: Lord Shingen
deck: A former head of Clan Yashida and the father of Mariko Yashida. He returned to his manor after have been gone for years having incurred a debt to certain criminal organization possibly including the Hand.

name: Michael Rossi
deck: Rossi is a spy and military field officer.

name: Andrea Sterman
deck: Superhero biographer and therapist

name: Prince Wayfinder
deck: Prince Wayfinder of Ithacon is a blind time-traveler from Earth-7614 who evolved into The Enigma Force and created The Microverse using The Sword in the Star in order to save his people from total annihilation during their brief stay on Earth-616.

name: Dr. Gargunza
deck: A perverted genius scientist driven by a desire for immortality. He is a pastiche of Doctor Sivanna.

name: Tattooed Man
deck: A mutant that has the ability to instantly know all of the secrets of any person he touches. Subsequently, the tattoos on his body take the shape of the secrets he acquires.

name: Chrome
deck: One of the original Acolytes, Chrome saved Magneto's life when Asteroid M fell to Earth by using his power of transmuting elements to wrap him in a layer of metal.

name: Baron Von Blitzschlag
deck: Baron Von Blitzschlag is a recruit of The Initiative and a member of the research staff of the program.

name: Aguja
deck: A member of the group known as The Children of the Vault, adversaries of the X-men.

name: Adam Harkin
deck: Adam Harkin is a member of the Facility.

name: Xarus
deck: Xarus is the third son of Dracula who first appears in The Death of Dracula one shot.

name: Shogun
deck: Ex-soldier fused with the spirit of the deadly/demon/ninja Ogun (Wolverine's past teacher and once father figure).

name: Friday
deck: She's an A.I. created by Tony Stark to be his secretary.

name: Lydia Nance
deck: She is the director of Heritage Imitative Organization, a strong anti-mutant organization.

name: Rawhide Kid (Original)
deck: First character know as Rawhide Kid. Strangly, he was never named.

name: Xavin
deck: Xavin is a Skrull who came to Earth to marry Karolina Dean, a member of the Runaways. To avoid a multi-planet disaster, Karolina agreed to marry Xavin. Xavin is also training to become a Super-Skrull.

name: Overmind
deck: It was his goal to carry on the prophesy of the Eternals. "From Beyond the Stars Shall Come the Overmind - And He Shall Crush the Universe!"  He was stopped by a combination of the Fantastic Four, Doctor Doom and The Stranger.

name: Motormouth
deck: A British superhero with an attitude.

name: Ruckus
deck: Ruckus is a mutant and the leader of the Nasty Boys, a group of mercenaries employed by Mister Sinister.

name: Atalanta
deck: Atalanta is a member of the Pantheon.

name: Gloria Rider
deck: Richard Rider's (Nova) mother.

name: Johnny Dee
deck: Johnny Dee is a mutant with a tentacled face on his chest, which can create voodoo-dolls of people. After seeking sanctuary among the X-Men following Decimation, he betrayed the team and the entire mutant race by allying with a corrupt U.S. general for purely self-serving reasons.

name: Hardball
deck: Hardball was apart of the draft of Initiative recruits. A recent graduate of the of the Initiative training program. He recently betrayed the Initiative and became a member of HYDRA.

name: Rock Python
deck: Rock Python is a member of the Serpent Society who uses trick eggs to complement his rock-hard skin. He recently tried to turn his life around and tries to become a better man.

name: Sangre
deck: This ruthless individual was the leader of the Children of the Vault until his death. He was intelligent and well-respected by the others.

name: Joey Bailey
deck: Joey Bailey is the son of Sara Grey the sister of X-Man Jean Grey. Joey was one of the many members of the grey family to be killed by the Sh'iar Death Commandos.

name: Hurricane
deck: Hurricane is a mutant with the ability to summon gale-force winds.  As a member of the Dark Riders, he held a grudge against one of the X-Men, Storm. He was killed by Wolverine

name: The Beast
deck: Ancient Demon Lord of the Hand. During Shadowland he possessed Daredevil.

name: Giganto
deck: Giganto is a behemoth whale creature summoned by the Horn of Proteus. Namor would call upon Giganto to attack the surface world and the Fantastic Four.

name: Jimmy Yama
deck: Jimmy Yama is a student at Midtown High and is a longtime and close friend to May "Mayday" Parker a.k.a. Spider-Girl.  He also the cousin of Zane Yama a.k.a. J2, the son of the Juggernaut.

name: Detroit Steel
deck: Detroit Steel is a corporate armored mercenary produced by Hammer Industries. He is ready to defend the assets of your company at any price.  Changes the color of his armor, depending on the employer.

name: Combat Colin
deck: Colin is a bumbling military and gun enthusiast and want-to-be war hero. Teamed up with Semi-automatic Steve to form Colin's Gang.

name: War (Furius)
deck: Final Horseman of Apocalypse.

name: Famine (Lee)
deck: Final Horseman of Apocalypse, he plays his drumms.

name: Tier
deck: Tier is the son of Wolfsbane and Hrimhari. He is allegedly the beast of the Earth and the coming of the Apocalypse

name: Anachronism
deck: Anachronism is a student at The Braddock Academy. He is one of the teen heroes kidnapped by Arcade in Avengers Arena.

name: Jusuf Khan
deck: Kamala Khan's father.

name: Weapon H
deck: A discharged ex-soldier by the name of Clayton, who was kidnapped by the Weapon X program. Exposed to DNA of both the Hulk and Wolverine, he has a healing factor ability, adamantium claws and bones, and gamma-enhanced strength.

name: Orbis Stellaris
deck: A clone of Mister Sinister with black spade on his forehead.

name: Dorrie Evans
deck: Dorrie Evans was once a reluctant girlfriend of the Human Torch, she would constantly take second place to Johnny's adventures with the Fantastic Four. After their break-up she would get married and have children.

name: Crash Simpson
deck: Crash was a talented motor bike stunt man and a good friend and fatherfigure to Johnny Blaze.

name: Bodybag
deck: An alien mercenary part of the gang known as the Tech-Net, Bodybag is a strange creature. He has the ability to widen his mouth, secret a paralyzing gel, and hold his captives in sacks on his back.

name: Tullamore Voge
deck: A human from an alternate reality in which mankind evolved differently, Tullamore Voge (a.k.a. Vogue) is an extraterrestrial slaver and a powerful telepath.

name: Bluestreak
deck: The Bluestreak is a mutant gifted with superhuman speed.

name: Friedrich Von Roehm
deck: Friedrich Von Roehm was the Black Rook of the Hellfire Club.  He has the ability to undergo a werewolf-like transformation.

name: Uranos
deck: Uranos is one of the first generation of Eternals. After organizing a failed rebellion, Uranos and his followers were exiled to Uranus.

name: Bart Hamilton
deck: Harry Osborn's former psychiatrist and the third Green Goblin

name: Geoffrey Wilder
deck: Geoffrey Wilder is a crime boss in Los Angeles, and a member of the Pride. He is also the husband of Catherine Wilder, and father of Alex Wilder; a member of the Runaways.

name: Dryad
deck: Dryad was a member of Corsairs up until she was depowered on M-Day, and killed in the attacks that followed.

name: Gailyn Bailey
deck: Gailyn is the daughter of Sara Grey the sister of X-Man Jean Grey. Gailyn was one of the many members of the Grey family to be killed by the Shi'ar Death Commandos.

name: Terry Vance
deck: Golden age character, a school boy and detective

name: Hummingbird
real_name: María Aracely Josefina Peñalba de las Heras
deck: Aracely is a young Mexican girl whom Scarlet Spider saved from a shipping container.

name: Shaylee Moonpeddle
deck: Shaylee is a half-fairy/half-human whose parents were forced to split up before she was born. She is a student enrolled in Strange Academy.

name: Zoe Laveau
deck: Zoe is an undead New Orleans native enrolled in Strange Academy.

name: Shift
deck: Clone of Miles Morales, that Miles eventually adopted as a brother.

name: Oblivion
deck: Oblivion is the personification of the galactic void and the twin brother of Death, that once filled the multiverse before creation. part of Creation sprouted from him and will all return to him at the end of Time.

name: Flex
deck: Flex, a mutant, is a former member of Alpha Flight.  Depowered on M-Day, he was once able to transform his arms into highly durable, malleable sheets of metal which he often formed into metal blades.

name: Raptor
deck: Daughter of Blackie Drago in the MC2 timeline.

name: Harmony Young
deck: Model who dated Power Man.

name: Algernon Crowe
deck: A dark mage who sold his soul to Mephisto. He was a founding member of MyS-Tech, and later one of the Techno-Wizards.

name: Frog-Man
deck: Francois LeBlanc was the first Frog-Man and an original member of the Ani-Men. He is a batrachanthrope (Were-Frog) or frog/human hybrid.

name: Infectia
deck: Infectia was a mutant with Biokinetic Abilities.

name: China Doll
deck: China Doll is one of the members of Gatecrasher's Tech-Net, a band of extraterrestrial mercenaries. China Doll has the power to genetically alter the size of any biological being.

name: Deadbolt
deck: Deadbolt is a mutant and a member of the Dark Riders. He was killed by Wolverine, but resurrected during Necrosha.

name: Worm
deck: Worm is a Savage Land Mutate who secretes a liquid which he used to control the actions of others.

name: Crippler
deck: Formerly an agent of HYDRA, Crippler joined Silver Sable International as a key member of the Wild Pack

name: Lobe
deck: Lobe is a mysterious man who is hyperintelligent and the CEO of Sublime Corporation.

name: Blackjack O'Hare
deck: Blackjack O'Hare is a skilled mercenary from Halfworld

name: Supergiant
deck: A mentally unstable telepathic member of the Black Order who preys on the intellect of her victims.

name: Figaro
deck: Gambit's cat

name: Aero
deck: An architect by day, Lei Ling is the superhero protector of Shanghai known as Aero. Using her mastery over the element of wind, Aero is an Avenger-Adjacent and member of the New Agents of Atlas.

name: Starling
deck: Grandaughter of the Vulture, who supplied her with her own flight suit. She originally came to Brooklyn to get revenge against Tombstone but stayed after falling for Miles Morales.

name: Reese
deck: Moon Knight's receptionist at the Midnight Mission, after she was rescued by Moon Knight from the vampire that sired her.

name: Deathdream
deck: Member of the Outliers.

name: Colony
deck: Colony is a sentient hive-minded bug colony, and a member of the Shi'ar Death Commandos. It infests it's enemy, and devours their flesh.

name: Taurus (Lunt)
deck: Member of The Zodiac

name: Nightmask
deck: Keith Remsen is Nightmask a superhuman with the ability to enter the dreams of others.

name: Sister Maggie Murdock
deck: A nun and, ironically, the mother of the Daredevil.

name: Choir
deck: Young mutant with three extra mouths on her neck. She was de-powered on M-Day.

name: Kaluu
deck: A powerful black magician and peer of the Ancient One, Kaluu is also a sometimes-ally of Dr. Strange.

name: Charles Rider
deck: Richard Rider's (Nova) father.

name: Rubbermaid
deck: Rubbermaid was a member of Alpha Squadron. She was de-powered after M-Day and killed by Williams Strikers men during a raid on the Xavier institute.

name: The Bride of Nine Spiders
deck: Immortal Weapon of one of the Seven Cities of Heaven..her heart pumps the coldest blood imaginable...and horrors inconceivable to mortal men.

name: Jade Logan
deck: Daughter of Wolverine & Maureen Logan.

name: Sasha Hammer
deck: Daughter to Justine Hammer and the Mandarin, and grand daughter to Justin Hammer.

name: House of Shadows
deck: The House of Shadows is an extra-dimensional entity and a minor Dr. Strange foe. It takes the form of various haunted houses and is currently serving voluntarily as the headquarters for Moon Knight's new congregation, The Midnight Mission.

name: Randall Jessup
deck: A member of Bruce Banner's team of S.H.I.E.L.D. scientists who specializes in Renewable Energies.

name: Lucifer
deck: Gambit's cat

name: Redroot, the Forest
deck: Redroot the Forest is a pure-blood mutant reclaimed from Amenth. She is the Voice of Arakko in The Great Ring of Arakko.

name: J.A.R.V.I.S.
real_name: Just A Rather Very Intelligent System

name: Ransom
deck: A member of the Outliers.

name: Razorback
deck: Razorback was a mutant with the innate ability to drive any vehicle instinctively. He was depowered as a result of M-Day. He employed many gadgets in his crimefighter career.

name: Magdalene
deck: Magdalene was a hero from a different reality and later became an honorary member of the Avengers

name: Father Michael Bowen
deck: Father Bowen is a priest and the uncle and trust-person to Dagger.

name: Top Dog
deck: Top Dog is a very intelligent, talking dog who befriends a human child named Joey Jordan. Later revealed as an agent in disguise.

name: Brian Xavier
deck: Brian Xavier was the husband of Sharon and the father of Charles Xavier (Professor X) and Cassandra Nova.

name: Deacon Frost
deck: Deacon Frost, the man responsible for Blade's vampirism. A one of a kind vampire with the ability to control his victims.

name: Fred Duncan
deck: An agent of the FBI and a friend of Professor Xavier even before the beginning of the X-Men. He helped the X-Men in several missions.

name: Solarr
deck: Silas King was a drug smuggler who got his powers from extensive exposure to the sun when his bus broke down in the desert.  Franklin Richards created a copy of Solarr on Counter-Earth, where he's a member of Heinrich Zemo's Thunderbolts.

name: Professor Power
deck: Professor Power is a super-villain who blames Charles Xavier for the death of his mutant son. In his quest for revenge he encountered a number of superheroes.

name: New Son
deck: Gambit from an alternate reality in which he attained his power's full potential.

name: Suzi Endo
deck: Suzi Endo worked for Stark Industries and aided Force Works in defeating Ultron, Wonder Man and herself from an alternate time line.

name: Meld
deck: Former member of the U.S. army's Sentinel Squad O*N*E, Meld is a mutant active in mutant rights.

name: Locus
deck: A mutant with the ability to teleport. Locus is a loyal companion to Reignfire & was a foe of the original X-Force. Originally suspected to be a resurrected Magik, Locus infamously changed skin colour thereby dispelling all rumours.

name: Ezekiel
deck: Ezekiel Sims was a rich businessman who, in his younger years, ritualistically gained powers similar to those of Spider-Man. He wanted to use his powers to be a hero, but initially used them to found a corporation and became a member of the Spider-Society. He helped Spider-Man deal with Morlurn and many other beings who were after Spider-Totems.

name: Albion
deck: Peter Hunter was possessed by the Pendragon and became Albion.

name: It The Living Colossus
deck: It, The Living Colossus was a statue which the alien Kigors first animated, often falling under the control of Dr. Aloysius Vault; Robert O'Bryan foiled several of Vault's attempts to steal It.

name: Morgana Blessing
deck: A best-selling author of both fiction and non-fiction works, Morgana was a love interest to both Doctor Strange and his brother, Victor Strange.

name: Susan Austin
deck: A close friend to Eric Masterson whom sacrificed her own life to save that of Kevin and his mother.

name: Mr. Chambers
deck: Mr. Chambers is the right hand to the villain Arcade.

name: Tanya Anderssen
deck: Tanya Anderssen is Karl Lykos' girlfriend. During childhood he saved her from a flock of Pterodactyls.

name: Leonard McKenzie
deck: Father of Namor. He would fall in love with Princess Fen, the future mother of Namor.

name: Dr. Bromwell
deck: Bromwell is the family doctor for the Parker family.

name: Maximus Lobo
deck: Maximus Lobo is a lycanthrophic mutant.

name: Cloud
deck: Cloud is a nebula that took human form, and upon arriving on Earth was brainwashed by the Secret Empire. During a battle with the Secret Empire, the Defenders rescued Cloud and he/she joined the team.

name: Crystar
deck: Prince and later king of Crystallium, Crystar stands for the forces of Order and against Chaos. In more recent times, he became a resident of Weirdworld.

name: Jackpot
deck: Jackpot is a new registered hero with The Initiative who fights in New York City. There have been two people to take the Jackpot identity, Alana Jobson who died, and first and current heir Sara Ehret.

name: Samantha Parrington
deck: Samantha served as the official Valkyrie of Earth after she received Brunnhilde's blessing.

name: Bouncing Betty
deck: Physically augmented super-fighter and aerial combat specialist.

name: Dawn Greenwood
deck: Dawn is the traveling companion of the Silver Surfer and potentially the most important person in the universe. She would eventually marry Silver Surfer, and, after time travelling to the Sixth Cosmos, Surfer ensured her essence became the first light of her home cosmos.

name: Spider-UK
deck: Former Captain Britain Corps member, originated from Earth-833. After the Captain Britain Corps was seemingly lost and his universe wiped out by an incursion Spider-UK created the multiverse traveling group known as the Web Warriors and is its leader.

name: Masacre
deck: Masacre is a man whom lived in Mexico and was saved by Deadpool. Idolizing Deadpool, he became the Mexican Deadpool, known as Masacre.

name: Feint
deck: Carmen was part of a team that idolized the X-Men, even pretending to be mutants, until she became the only member of the team to develop mutant abilities.

name: Jitter
deck: A member of the Outliers

name: Dr. Noah Burnstein
deck: Dr. Noah Burnstein is a scientist whose experiments for the creation of super-soldiers have created several superhumans, most notably Luke Cage.

name: Janis Jones
deck: Janis Jones is the granddaughter of Rick Jones and Marlo Chandler. She is one of the allies of the Incredible Hulk.

name: Zuri
deck: Wakandian Warrior, formerly a close friend to King T'Chaka. A trusted aid and member of T'Challa's inner circle.

name: Sidney Levine
deck: Sky Wolves and Shield member

name: T-Ray
deck: Deadpool's Archnemesis, he tortured him by stealing his identity and resurrecting his wife. It's possible that T-Ray is the ORIGINAL Wade Wilson, and that Deadpool stole his identity.

name: Numbers
deck: The accountant of Technet.

name: Vessel
deck: Member of the Morlock extremist group, Gene Nation. Vessel gains strength from the souls of the deceased, similar to the powers that Threnody possessed.

name: Brain Drain
deck: A nihilist robot man and computer sciences student who was once a member of Hydra and is now a hero

name: Sumo
deck: Member of Stryfe's MLF.

name: Carlo Zota
deck: A scientist who joined other scientists in forming the Enclave, an organization dedicated in creating a new form in hopes of creating a better Earth.

name: Oneg the Prober
deck: Member of the enigmatic and powerful Celestials.

name: Phage
deck: One of the five symbiotes forcibly spawned from the Venom symbiote by the Life Foundation.

name: Fer-de-Lance
deck: Fer-de-Lance is a claw wielding assassin and member of the Serpent Society.

name: Desert Ghost
deck: Also known by his real name, Xi'an Chi Xan is the founder of the X-Men of the year 2099.

name: La Lunatica
deck: La Lunatica is a mutant from the X-Men 2099 reality who has acted as both friend and foe to the X-Men.

name: Chester Phillips
deck: US General.

name: Jemiah the Analyzer
deck: Jemiah the Analyzer is a member of the race of cosmic beings known as Celestials. He has been a part of the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th of the Celestial hosts that have visited Earth and other planets that the Celestials have conducted their genetic experiments on.

name: Dr. Sarah Kinney
deck: The surrogate mother and creator of X-23. It was recently revealed that she is X-23's biological mother due to her healing factor using some of Sarah's DNA to repair her embryonic cells.

name: Sabrina Morrell
deck: Sabrina "Bree" Morrell was a police lieutenant in San Francisco who frequently worked with Spider-Woman/Jessica Drew. She also had contact with the X-Men and was the one assigned the Carol Danvers case in "Avengers Annual" #10.

name: Toxic Doxie
deck: A gifted chemical biologist and geneticist, June Covington is Toxic Doxie. Aiding Norman Osborn in his escape from prison, Toxic Doxie went on to join his newest team of Avengers before her arrest and subsequent placement on the government's Thunderbolts team.

name: General Haywerth
deck: General Lewis Haywerth is a member of the Commission on Superhuman Activities and was the commanding officer for Nuke and GI Max. He also oversaw and directed the transformation of John Walker from Captain America to US Agent.

name: Arabian Knight (Qamar)
deck: Having uncovered the tomb of his ancestor who was a hero to his people, Abdul Qamar acquired his mystic weapons and set out to carry on the tradition of the Arabian Knight.

name: Oliver
deck: Gambit's cat.

name: Luna Snow
deck: After being exposed to an advanced cold fusion energy experiment, Seol Hee gained the power of cryokinesis. Seol took on the stage name Luna Snow and has become a K-pop superstar, while fighting injustice as an Agent of Atlas and a member of Tiger Division.

name: Doctor Sun
deck: Doctor Sun is a Chinese criminal scientist whose brain was removed and connected to China's most advanced computers. He was an enemy of the Fantastic Four, Nova and Dracula.

name: Murmur
deck: Murmur is a member of the Canadian superhero group Alpha Flight,led by the Guardian (James Hudson).

name: Stuff
deck: A member of the group The Imperial Guard.

name: Lindy Reynolds
deck: Lindy Reynolds was the wife of Robert Reynolds, the superhero better known as The Sentry.

name: Laura Brown
deck: Laura Brown is a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent and one time girlfriend of Nick Fury.

name: Charcoal
deck: Charles Burlingame was transformed into a stone-like entity by Arnim Zola. He joined the Thunderbolts but died during one of their missions.

name: Dr. Minerva
deck: The blue skinned Kree genetic scientist and spy to the home-world of Kree-Lar found Captain Mar-Vell's genetic attributes as a viable mate. Gaining similar powers to Ms.Marvel she joined the Kree Starforce and later would be a major player in the end of the aging Kree Empire.

name: Gosamyr
deck: Gosamyr is a member of an ancient race of alien beings. In line with her alien heritage, Gosamyr is a very beautiful and delicate creature.

name: Toro
deck: Member of the Young Allies.

name: Victoria Von Frankenstein
deck: Daughter of Ludwig Frankenstein and friend to his experiments

name: Janus
deck: Son of Dracula and Domini.

name: Mr. M
deck: Mister M lived in Mutant Town and led a quiet and reclusive life.  His psionic abilities give him power over almost anything at an atomic level, allowing him to do virtually anything he can imagine.

name: Isaiah Bradley
deck: Isaiah Bradley is the last surviving test subject of Dr. Reinstein's portion of Project: Rebirth to which he was an unwitting participant.

name: Wendell Rand
deck: Wendell Rand was the ward of Orson Randall, he learned how to fight at his side. After their falling out he went to K'un-Lun and earned the right to become the Iron Fist. Instead of facing Shou-Lao, he returned to Earth and fathered Danny Rand, the current Iron Fist.

name: Buck Cowan
deck: Best friend of Jack Russell. Featured throughout Marvel's Werewolf by Night series.

name: K'Kruhk
deck: K'Kruhk  was a Whiphid Jedi who fought in the Clone Wars. He survived Order 66 and went on to live for well over a century afterwards, being active during the days of Darth Krayt's Sith empire in 137 ABY.

name: Omega Red
deck: A member of the Omega Clan. He is the closest member in terms of appearance and powers to the original Omega Red.

name: Mysterio (Berkhart)
deck: Daniel Berkhart briefly posed as Mysterio as part of a larger plot, before taking up the Jack O'Lantern/Mad Jack identity. After Quentin Beck's suicide, Berkhart took up the mantle of Mysterio.

name: Daman Veteri
deck: Dr. Daman Veteri is a Nobel Prize winning Molecular Engineer who passed up job offers from Oscorp and Horizon Labs in order to work in Dr. Bruce Banner's team of S.H.I.E.L.D. scientists.

name: Roz Solomon
deck: Former S.H.I.E.L.D. agent and novice ecologist turned seasoned combat & espionage savant as an Agent of Wakanda.

name: Ginny Guzman
deck: Ginny is a mutant with telepathic powers

name: H.E.L.E.N.
deck: An A.I. created by Tony Stark as a replacement for J.A.R.V.I.S. that was modeled after Pepper Potts.

name: Raz Malhotra
deck: A technician expert in A.I. who was entrusted with the Giant-Man suit By Scott Lang

name: Summoner
deck: Grandson of Apocalypse, son of the Horseman, War

name: White Sword
deck: An immortal healer and bearer of the sword, Purity. He once led his 100 Champions into Amenth to fight to protect the mutants of Arakko, only to grow addicted to battle and turn on Arakko as well.

name: Calico
deck: A member of the Outliers.

name: Glob
deck: A number of individuals have appeared as the Glob. The First Glob is a mute, undead and unliving being.

name: Tamara Rahn
deck: She is an alien of a water-breathing extraterrestrial Banari race from the planet Laab.

name: Alyssa Moy
deck: The incredibly intelligent former girlfriend of the Fantastic Four's Reed Richard's.

name: Morg
deck: Bestowed with the Power Cosmic by Galactus, Morg becomes his new herald.

name: Bantam
deck: Bantam was Fitzroy's lackey and originated from the same timeline as the X-Man Bishop.

name: Hugo Natchios
deck: Elektra's father.

name: Gena Landers
deck: Gena manages and works in her own diner. She  was one of Jake Lockely's (Moon Knight) street contacts.

name: Queen Divine Justice
deck: Former Dora Milaje , Queen of the Jabari tribe,  possible future leader of the Jabari tribe/ White Gorilla Cult.

name: Arthur Stacy
deck: Gwen Stacy's uncle, investigator and ally of Spider-Man.

name: Nuke
deck: A superpowered hero who kept his identity a secret from even his own family, Nuke found out that his parents were dying from cancer, brought on by his own powers. He now serves on Squadron Supreme.

name: Mauler
deck: Former weapons manufacturer who fell victim to tough times and ended up becoming a bitter foe of noteworthy superbeings such as Iron Man, Daredevil, and the Taskmaster.

name: Ugly John
deck: Three-faced mutant from Australia.

name: Zora Risman
deck: Zora Risman, aka Deadeye, is a member of the X-Terminated. With her uncanny aim, she is Prophet's most trusted ally in the war against human oppression.

name: Maris Morlak
deck: Doctor Maris Morlak was once a brilliant scientist who joined other scientists in forming the Enclave, an organization dedicated to the creation of life itself in hopes of creating a better Earth. Shinski shares the creation of Adam Warlock and Kismet and the resurrection of Jean Grey, who had been placed in a cocoon by the Phoenix Force.

name: Manikin
deck: Dr. Whitman Knapp was born with the ability to shapeshift into 3 distinct beings in varying stages of Human Evolution. Each being has its own set of super powers, making Knapp a force to be reckoned with.

name: Rhapsody
deck: Blue-Skinned and musically brilliant, Rachel Argosy is a mutant with the power to elicit a plethora of supernatural effects with the music she plays. She is one of the few mutants to retain their powers post M-Day, and has run awry of X-Factor in the past.

name: Igor Drenkov
deck: A Soviet spy sent to America to learn the secrets of Bruce Banner's Gamma Bomb.

name: Mastodon
deck: David Alan Landers is a member of team called Displaced Paranormals 7 (DP7).

name: Diane Newell
deck: Diane Arliss Newell is the sister of Todd Arliss, aka Tiger Shark, and the wife of Dr. Walter Newell, aka Stingray.

name: SeGa
deck: Sega is an alien with a gaseous form. It is a member of the Shi'ar Death Commandos.

name: Emil Burbank
deck: Hyperion's greatest foe on Earth-712, being a mixture between Doctor Doom and Lex Luthor. On Earth-31916, he is a member of the Squadron Supreme whose only power is his incredible intellect, and has some villainous habits off and on.

name: Anita Blake
deck: Anita Blake is an animator, legal vampire executioner and consultant to the local St. Louis police force paranormal unit. The comics are based on the book series by Laurell K. Hamilton.

name: Wolvie
deck: A baby wolverine created by Mojo that lives in the Mojoverse. He is a member of the X-babies.

name: Paralyzer
deck: A mutant recruited by Magneto.

name: Megan Kinney
deck: Megan Kinney is X-23's cousin (and by extension Wolverine's niece).

name: Margo Damian
deck: Archeologist and girlfriend of the Eternal named Ikaris. She and her father found the Eternals after hundreds of years of absence. She died sometime later during a fight between the Eternals and the Deviants.

name: Captain Glory
deck: Captain Glory was the leader of the 18th Kree Diplomatic Gestalt and Noh-Varr's father.

name: Annie Richardson
deck: Annie Richardson is Jean Grey's childhood friend.

name: Wong-Chu
deck: Wong-Chu was the first foe of Iron Man.  He was a communist warlord active in the Vietnamese jungles in the 1960's.

name: Rebecca Banner
deck: Rebecca Banner was the wife of Brian and mother of Bruce Banner (Hulk). Tired of Brian's abusive behavior towards Bruce and herself, Rebecca attempted to leave him. She was attacked and killed by her husband.

name: Boom Boom Brown
deck: Friend of the Two-Gun Kid whom lived in the Wild West in America.

name: Aleph
deck: Aleph is an android member of The Garden. Unlike his fellow group members, he is designed to destroy worlds unfit for evolution.

name: Apex
deck: A student at the Braddock Academy and has been kidnapped by Arcade to fight for her life in Avengers Arena.

name: Zoe Zimmer
deck: Friend of Kamala Khan.

name: Hindsight
deck: Mutant with the power of psychometry.

name: Brandy Selby
deck: Brandy is the daughter of human immigrants in outer space. The White Event chose Brandy as the new Starbrand while she was still in the womb. When her mother died during childbirth, she was taken in by The Avengers, becoming an integral part of their fight against Mephisto.

name: Annihilation
deck: Annihilation is the Dark God of Amenth who possess anyone who wields The Golden Helm of Amenth. Annihilation along with the Shadow King, the Adversary, the First Fallen, le Bete Noir, and the Goblin Force are all implied to be different aspects of the same entity, an oppositional force to the Phoenix Force.

name: Kobak Never-Held
deck: Kobak is an Arakko mutant.

name: The Man with the Peacock Tattoo
deck: The Founder and Leader of Xeno. He is a clone of David Moreau.

name: Swordsman (Jarvert)
deck: Philip Jarvert was from an alternate universe and opposed the Avengers as a member of the Gatherers. After severing ties with the villains, he joined with the Avengers and is romantically involved with fellow Gatherer and Avenger, Magdalene.

name: Jacob Conover
deck: Jacob Conover was once a Daily Bugle employee and later headed his own criminal empire when he became the third criminal known as the Rose.

name: Martine Bancroft
deck: Morbius' fiancée, who died and later came back as a vampire to haunt him. She has died multiple times.

name: Powerhouse Pepper
deck: Powerhouse Pepper, the bald-pated "Puny Person With Potent Paws," was the creation and signature achievement of legendary cartoonist Basil Wolverton.

name: Siege
deck: John Kelly was the first attempt at creating a Deathlok cyborg. However, when the project failed he was killed. His brain patterns were later discovered by Michael Collins, as Deathlok, and reluctantly digitized into another cyborg body. John Kelly became the cyborg known as Siege.

name: Thais
deck: One of Vargas' bodyguards along with his sister. He helps protect Vargas from the X-Men.

name: Thaiis
deck: Twin sister of Thais and Vargas's bodyguard, she fought the X-treme X-Men in Mandripoor.

name: Varnae
deck: Varnae was the first vampire.

name: Dweller In Darkness
deck: The Dweller In Darkness is an incredibly powerful demon who originates from a dimension that is said to be higher than the sixth dimension.  He was responsible for assembling the Fear Lords.

name: Yeti
deck: Former member of superhero team First Line

name: Strikeback
deck: Anthony Davis was the first super-villain known as Ringer.  After his untimely near-death at the hands of the Scourge of the Underworld, he was rebuilt as the cyborg Strikeback.

name: Annalee
deck: A Morlock and Power Packs pretend aunt, deceased.

name: Lasher
deck: One of the five symbiotes forcibly spawned from the Venom symbiote by the Life Foundation.

name: Saul
deck: Former member of the team Externals, which consisted of individuals who were thought to be immortals.

name: Gaia
deck: Gaia is a empathic mutant from another dimension who has the psionic ability to reshape reality.

name: Punchout
deck: A Genoshan rebel she is in the Press Gang.

name: Glorian
deck: Glorian was a dying young man who was given great power by the Shaper of Worlds.

name: Hawkshaw
deck: Leader of the Press Gang, who capture Genoshan mutants who attempt to leave the country.

name: Grotesk
deck: The last member of an ancient underground race.

name: Phoebe Marrs
deck: A romantic interest of Namor.

name: Tri-Sentinel
deck: The Tri-Sentinel was originally three separate Project: NIMROD prototypes who were fused into a single entity by Loki's dark magic.

name: One Above All
deck: One Above All is the most powerful of the Celestials. He was mistaken for another God of Marvel Comics (The One-Above-All), because both share the same name.

name: Barney Bushkin
deck: Editer in Chief of the Daily Globe, the Daily Bugle's main competitor in New York City.

name: Senator Harrington Byrd
deck: Harrington Byrd was a politician. He sought to have Iron Man release his secrets to the federal government of the United States.

name: Aliyah Bishop
deck: Aliyah Bishop is the daughter of the X-Man Bishop and Sh'iar Royal Deathbird. So far she has only appeared in an alternate reality.

name: Shower
deck: A baby Storm created by Mojo that lives in the Mojoverse. She is a member of the X-babies.

name: Brün
deck: Brün is Bor's first valkyrie and leader of the Disir.

name: Darren Cross
deck: The ex-CEO of Cross Technological Enterprises and the first enemy of Scott Lang in his role as the second Ant-Man.

name: Sleeper
deck: Heroic spawn of the Venom symbiote, who has never had a regular host

name: Belle Taylor
deck: Romantic interest (and later wife) of the Outlaw Kid.

name: Flashback
deck: Flashback was one of the original members of Beta Flight, but when Department H went under he was recruited by Delphine Courtney into Omega Flight

name: Seward Trainer
deck: A genius in the fields of biology and genetic engineering as well as a close friend to Ben Reilly, the Scarlett Spider.

name: Elysius
deck: Elysius was genetically engineered in the Life-Baths of Titan by ISAAC. She has a son (Genis-Vell) and daughter (Phyla), and was a lover of Mar-Vell.

name: Huntara
deck: An alternate timeline aunt of Psi-Lord and half-sister of Reed Richcards. Her scythe opens dimensional gateways.

name: Absalom
deck: Once a member of the Externals, and the murderer of Caleb Hammer.

name: Tetherblood
deck: A member of Clan Chosen.

name: Maddie Baldwin
deck: Mother of Speedball/Penance.

name: Force
deck: A former minion of Justin Hammer who became an ally to Iron Man

name: Abe Zimmer
deck: A member of the board of directors for Accutech.

name: Humbug
deck: Former villain that can communicate with insects.

name: Dansen Macabre
deck: Dansen Macabre is a member of the Night Shift with mystical dancing abilities.  Her dance can hypnotize and even kill those who watch it.

name: Korath the Pursuer
deck: Korath the Pursuer was a Kree cyber-geneticist, former member of the Kree Starforce and the first Phalanx Select.

name: Barracuda
deck: The result of a savage upbringing and elite military training, Barracuda is a ruthless criminal and a killer for hire who haunted the Punisher for months.

name: Black Womb
deck: In 1891, after surviving a series of miscarriages, Amanda Mueller was accused of being the Black Womb killer.

name: Mystiq
deck: A male variant of Mystique who was a member of the Exiles.

name: Julius Rassitano
deck: Mad Dog Rassitano is a police sergeant in Code: Blue and he is an expert sharp shooter.

name: Julia Winters
deck: Julia Winters was a baby girl adopted by Nomad. Her mother was a drug addict who could not take care of her. Nomad named her Bucky and attempted to raise her.

name: Ai Apaec
deck: Ai Apaec is a Dark version of Spider-Man.

name: Ikol
deck: Ikol is the soul of Loki that is in the form of a magpie

name: Colonel Liger
deck: A British Army colonel who was scarred by Wolverine. He has been improved by Mys-Tech technology and he uses a voice activated weapon known as "Clementine", which can change ammo type on command.

name: Grace Powell
deck: Grace Powell is the mother of Chris aka Darkhawk

name: Carrion (McBride)
deck: Malcolm McBride was a rival student of Peter Parker who became the second Carrion. Able to rot flesh with just a touch, Carrion became an adversary to Parker's alter-ego Spider-Man.

name: Steve Hopkins
deck: Classmate of Peter Parker at Empire State University

name: Judas Traveller
deck: Judas Traveller is a world-renowned criminal psychologist and philosopher who craves to understand the true nature of evil using his favourite subject; Spider-Man

name: Talon
deck: Talon was an Inhuman born on Earths' Moon and was originally a disciple of the 31st Century's' Sorcerer Supreme, Krugarr.  Later became a member of the Guardians of the Galaxy.

name: Maxam
deck: Maxam is a powerful being who was sent from the future to stop Magus from destroying most of the human race.

name: Warhawk
deck: Mitchell Tanner was a career soldier during the Vietnam war. He was badly injured and Dr. Noah Burnstein transformed him into the deadly assassin known as Warhawk.

name: Kamikaze
deck: Able to fly and create explosions by touch (of which he is immune). Killed by Archangel.

name: Vostok
deck: Vostok formerly known as Sputnik is an original member of the Supreme Soviets that has the ability to manipulate mechanical systems.

name: Tweedle-Dope
deck: Tweedle-Dope is a member of the Crazy Gang.

name: Kate Waynesboro
deck: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who was romantically involved with the Hulk. Upon Hiroim the Shamed's death, Kate gained his "Oldstrong powers" and took his place as a member of the Warbound.

name: Harry S. Osgood
deck: Harry S. Osgood was Dazzler's manager, a stand up guy whom Dazller has her career to thank for

name: Zula
deck: Zula is an ally of Conan and Red Sonja. He is a warrior with a little sorcery under his belt.

name: Jack Frost
deck: Cast out of Asgard by the Frost Giants for being born puny, Jack Frost lives in the Arctic North unaware of his otherworldly past.

name: Dana D'Angelo
deck: Miguel O' Hara's girlfriend when he first became Spider-Man.

name: Kid Colossus
deck: Piotr Nikolaievitch Rasputin Jr. is the son of the X-man known as Colossus.

name: Aghanne
deck: A resident of Breakworld that sided with the X-Men. Tired of the endless war, suffering and death of her people she created a false prophecy in order to destroy her world.

name: Marianne Rodgers
deck: Precognitive and one-time fiance of millionaire industrialist Tony Stark. She suggested an appearance change for Iron Man.

name: Seymour O'Reilly
deck: Seymour was childhood friends with Peter Parker. He was later an admirer and close friend of Flash Thompson. He was eventually murdered by Venom

name: Prince Baran
deck: Prince Baran was a former ruler of Madripoor.

name: Alexander Lexington
deck: Former pilot of the Sentinel Squad O*N*E and former mutant, Lexington used to protect mutants taking refuge in the Xavier Institute.

name: Burst
deck: A disgraced Asian Kung-Fu speedster.

name: Verre
deck: An assassin who has the powers to turn invisible in direct sunlight.

name: Lady Deadpool
deck: A deadly female version of Deadpool from Earth-3010 who is now part of the Deadpool Corps.

name: Heinz Kruger
deck: One of Captain America's first enemies and the killer of Professor Erskine. His action let to Steve Rogers becoming the first and only Super-Soldier.

name: Brad Miller
deck: Brad Miller is one of May Parker's friends. He also use to be May's crush.

name: Maria Stark
deck: Wife of Howard Stark and mother of Tony Stark. She was abducted during World War II by Red Skull but survived. She was eventually killed in an accident.

name: Gorr
deck: Gorr the God Butcher is by far one of Thor's deadliest villains, whose sole purpose in life is to destroy all Gods/Elder-Gods across the Multiverse, believing them to be inherently cruel, capricious, and illegitimate. Armed with the mysterious Necroblade--a weapon that commands ancient, ebon energies--and an unyielding resentment for all things divine, Gorr was pushed to create the Godbomb which would have made them obsolete.

name: Jemma Simmons
deck: Jemma Simmons is a level 5 S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist. She is one of the youngest and most prominent members of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s research division, along with her inseparable friend Leo Fitz. She, along with Fitz, were recruited to Coulson's Team by Melinda May. While on the team, Simmons became friends with teammates Skye and Grant Ward.

name: Romeo
deck: Young Inhuman who works with Crystal.

name: Judge
