deck: Acquaintance and former roommate of Miles Morales and Ganke Lee, Judge was assigned to room with the two during the trios' first semester at Brooklyn Vision Academy. The two continually hid Miles' nightlife as Spider-Man from Judge, and he eventually got fed up with the secrecy and moved out. Despite that, he has remained on speaking terms with the duo and eventually found out about Miles' double life on his own.

name: Gazing Nightshade
deck: A member of the Raksha, she has assisted the X-men in a couple of missions.

name: Billie Morales
deck: Little sister of Miles Morales.

name: Galura
deck: Galura is a new citizen of Krakoa.

name: Paul Rabin
deck: Paul is a time traveler and the caretaker of two children being hunted down by an alternate version of his father, Dr. Benjamin Rabin. He is responsible for the destruction of his Earth.

name: Growing Man
deck: The Growing Man is a stimuloid that serves his master Kang the Conqueror.

name: Maelstrom
deck: One of the most dangerous villains in the Marvel Universe, Maelstrom once tried to collapse the universe into a black hole.

name: Freakshow
deck: One of the few Genoshan Genocide survivors and one of the many mutants to lose his abilities as a result of the Scarlet Witch's decimation.

name: Epoch
deck: Epoch is the omniscient protector of cosmic awareness. She chooses champions and endows them with the Quantum Bands to protect the universe; a role she inherited from Eon.

name: Lotus Newmark
deck: A telepath born in late 19th Century Japan, Lotus Newmark learned she could use the legendary dragonsbloom lotus flower to stem her aging. She was once an influential gangboss in the L.A. area who clashed with The Invaders during World War II and later Wonder Man. Lady Lotus was deeply involved in the political development of Siancong, and later become the self-proclaimed ruler of the entire country.

name: Devlor
deck: Devlor is a member of the Inhumans

name: Matriarch
deck: The Matriarch is the assistant to the leader of the Universal Church of Truth, the Magus. Whenever the Magus is not active, the Matriarch takes the position of power. There have been several Matriarchs of the Church.

name: Grotto
deck: Grotto is a friend of Turk Barrett and an occassional henchman for various crime lords.

name: The Fixer
deck: A crooked fixer of boxing-matches. He ordered the death of Jack Murdock, Matt (Daredevil) Murdock's father.

name: Freebooter
deck: Protege of Hawkeye and a member of A-Next.

name: Morgan Stark
deck: Morgan Stark is both the cousin of Tony Stark: the original Iron Man, the father of Arno Stark: the Iron Man of the year 2020 and the great-grandfather of Andros Stark: the Iron Man of the year 2093.  Had a brief stint as a supervillain known as Brass.

name: Neal Conan
deck: A sympathetic journalist

name: Noah Dubois
deck: Telepathic agent of Landau, Luckman, and Lake.

name: Alpha the Ultimate Mutant
deck: Created by Magneto to help him take over the world using Maelstrom's technology, Alpha turned on Magneto and the Brotherhood and transformed them into infants before flying into space.

name: Bombshell
deck: An expert juggler that specializes in explosives, Bombshell began her criminal career as a solo costumed mercenary.

name: Wipeout
deck: A member of the Genoshan Press Gang who can neutralize mutant or other superhuman powers at will.

name: Victoria Bentley
deck: Victoria Bentley is a magic practitioner and was once romantically linked to Doctor Strange.

name: Anne-Marie Cortez
deck: Fabian Cortez's sister and member of the Acolytes. She was wounded when humans invaded Asteroid M and shot her. After that Magneto beacome a leader of Acolytes.

name: Jamie Rodriguez
deck: A seeming ordinary man who became part of superhuman affairs when he found a golden necklace, containing Kulan Gath.

name: Arnie Roth
deck: Arnie Roth was a childhood friend of Steve Rogers, the future Captain America.

name: Jonas Harrow
deck: Jonas Harrow is a criminal doctor who is responsible for Hammerhead's implant and the powers of Kangaroo, Megawatt and Will o' the Wisp.

name: Delphyne
deck: Delphyne is a gorgon, and was once a high ranking General of the Amazons under the command of Princess Artume. Her affection for Amadeus Cho led her to betray her queen, and slay the Amazon Princess. Now Delphyne rules as Queen of the Amazons.

name: Boomslang
deck: Boomslang is a member of the Serpent Society that throws snake shaped boomerangs.

name: Pathway
deck: One of the mutant Dean twins, Laura tried to learn how to use her dimension crossing abilities as a member of Canada's Beta Flight Team, alongside her sister, Goblyn.

name: Death's Head 3.0
deck: Death's Head 3.0 is the predecessor to the original and Minion versions of Death's Head and was used as guards by the Red King on the planet Sakaar.

name: Tefral the Surveyor
deck: Tefral the Surveyor's sole duty is to survey every species The Celestials encounter on a planet.

name: Mindblast
deck: Mindblast is a career criminal and one of the few mutants to retain their powers after M-Day.

name: Hargen the Measurer
deck: Hargen the Measurer is a Celestial in charge of measuring.

name: Electro
deck: Golden age wonder robot and part of the World War II Superhero team known as The Twelve.

name: Maya Hansen
deck: A Genetic Re-programmer who is responsible for creating the Extremis Enhancile; a powerful bio-weapon which is utilized by Iron Man.

name: Butterball
deck: Butterball is a former recruit to the Initiative, and  is presently a part-time student of the Avenger's Academy. He is completely invulnerable to every kind of physical attack, but remains in the poor physical condition he was in when his mutation first manifested itself.

name: Winston Frost
deck: Winston Frost is the father of Christian, Adrienne, Cordelia and Emma Frost as well as the second richest man in the state of Massachusetts.

name: Mr. O'Donnell
deck: The owner of a bar in Madripoor, which is protected from Roche's henchman by Wolverine.

name: Glitter
deck: Glitter is a Shi'ar and a member of the Shi'ar salvagers crew.

name: Jat
deck: Jat is the communication expert in Sovel's vessel. He is a member of the Shi'ar salvagers crew and of Kree descent.

name: Blue Hulk
deck: The Blue Hulk appeares in the Marvel Mini strips, now is being written by Audrey Loeb

name: Thug
deck: A cowboy who is nearly indestructable and impervious to pain.

name: Cobra
deck: Piet Voorhees is the Dutch nephew of the original Cobra, Klaus Voorhees. He would take on the same moniker of Cobra and come into conflict with Angela Del Toro, the White Tiger.

name: Dogpool
deck: Dogpool is an alternate reality version of Deadpool and a member of the Deadpool Corps.

name: Max Fury
deck: Max Fury is a life model decoy prototype that is able to think for himself. He was reprogrammed using the Zodiac Key and is unique among LMDs because he does not have any AI programming.

name: Lord Montgomery Falsworth
deck: Lord Falsworth was the first Union Jack and also a member of Freedom Five and later the Invaders.

name: Omega White
deck: A member of the Omega Clan.

name: Hyperion (Construct)
deck: A duplicate of Earth-712's Hyperion which was created by the Grandmaster to fight the Avengers.

name: MeMe
deck: A mutant girl who was rescued by X-Force.

name: Eli Morrow
deck: The mysterious human spirit that brings Robbie Reyes back to life and inhabits his body, granting Robbie the powers of the All-New Ghost Rider.

name: SP//dr
deck: Peni Parker is a 14 year old girl and pilot of a mech suit called SP//dr. The machine only responds to the pilot that has the right DNA. In the mech suit's head, there is a radioactive spider that shares a psychic link with the pilot.

name: Bellona
deck: Bellona is a clone of X-23. Unique among her "sisters," including Laura, an anomaly during the process to create her resulted in her being born with oculocutaneous albinism.

name: Killian Devo
deck: Former S.T.R.I.K.E operative and Director of Orchis.

name: Ora Serrata
deck: Ora Serrata is a member of the Great Ring of Arakko who occupied the Seat of the Law at the Twilight Table. Now as chief legal officer, Ora Serrata is consulted on all legal matters and is the final arbiter of the Arakko law.

name: Jon Ironfire
deck: A mutant of Arakko and soldier of White Sword. He sided with Storm in her war against Genesis.

name: Kid Juggernaut
deck: The current avatar of Cyttorak

name: Leonus
deck: Leonus the Lion-Man is a member of the Inhumans and a supporter of Maximus the Mad.

name: Boris
deck: Boris was a friend of Werner von Doom the father of Doctor Doom, whom he faithfully served. He is the father of Valeria

name: Jason Powell
deck: Darkhawk's younger brother

name: Death-Stalker
deck: Previously known as the Exterminator, Death-Stalker became a terrifying criminal after gaining strange powers from an accident with the time-displacer ray.

name: Torpedo
deck: The first bearer of the suit that Turbo now uses.

name: Devos The Devastator
deck: Devos the Devastator's sole responsibility is to eliminate every life form that has any prospect of ever waging war.

name: Firebrand (Gilbert)
deck: Firebrand was a radical villain who learned how to make weaponry from Stark Industries.  He was killed by Scourge.

name: Knuckles
deck: Golden age character, one of the Young Allies.

name: The Jester
deck: The Jester is a member of the Crazy Gang.

name: Flying Tiger
deck: A former football player, Flying Tiger first appeared as an enemy of the original Spider-Woman, Jessica Drew.

name: Jonathan Powell
deck: Jonathan is Darkhawk's younger brother

name: Antibody
deck: A hospital surgeon that developed powers during a phenomenon called "The White Event". His power is to create a visible astral body which normally manifests in times of emotional stress.

name: Rock
deck: Samuel LaRoquette is recruited by Bruce Banner to be part of Project Hulkbuster. He would eventually be captured by the Leader and transformed into the deadly, elemental being known as the Rock.

name: Laufey
deck: Laufey is the father of Loki and King of the Frost Giants, he was recently brought back to life by Malekith in his War of the Realms.

name: Argon
deck: Argon was the son of the royal couple of Homeworld, planet of the Microverse. Like the Micronauts, He led the resistance versus the one who kills his family and takes control of his planet, Baron Karza.

name: Catherine Wilder
deck: Catherine Wilder is a crime boss in Los Angeles, a member of the Pride, and wife to Geoffrey Wilder. She is also the mother of Alex Wilder; a member of the Runaways.

name: Midnight's Fire
deck: A vigilante and a former member of the New Warriors.

name: Dog Brother #1
deck: Immortal Weapon of one of the Seven Cities of Heaven..hero to all the strays on all the streets of the world..a prankster assassin who rules the under city.

name: Mary Purcell
deck: Mary Purcell was a mutant who existed in a state of pure energy. She appeared as a green ghost.

name: John King
deck: John King is The Hood's cousin and closest confidant.

name: Tildie Soames
deck: Tildie Soames is a little girl who can bring her dreams to reality. She killed her parents when one of her nightmares came to life.

name: Gary Cody
deck: Member of Department X and close friend of the Guardian.

name: Jake Oh
deck: Former Eaglestar military contractor, turned Ex-S.H.I.E.L.D. agent, and new friend of James Rhodes. He helps with medical complications and has worn the War Machine armor to honor its placeholder.

name: Vulture (Drago)
deck: The second Vulture, who took the original Vulture's wings after tricking him into telling him their location. He was defeated by Spider-Man quite easily.

name: Ajax
deck: Member of the Pantheon and an ally to the Hulk

name: K'ai
deck: A sentient planet located in the Microverse

name: Spymaster (Abbott)
deck: The third Spymaster who worked alongside Ghost to kill Tony Stark.

name: Koi Boi
deck: Ken Shiga is a student at Empire State University and the crime-fighting partner of rookie hero Chipmunk Hunk. He has the power to talk to fish.

name: Singularity
deck: Mysterious being who arrived to Arcadia from the sky during Secret Wars. She quickly befriended Nico Minoru.

name: Willie
deck: Typical 1940s teenager, always trying to win Jinny's heart.

name: Robert L. Maverick
deck: The man that Thunderbolt Ross thought "Was a little much," and a decorated army vet, Robert L. Maverick would become a new Red Hulk, serving as one of A.I.M's U.S.Avengers.

name: Cleevus
deck: A mutant from the Planet Dartyus in the Negative Zone, Cleevus was banned from his world for a violent coupe against the rightful authorities on his world. He woke up on planet Earth and joined the latest incarnation of the Brotherhood of Mutants.

name: Jackie McGee
deck: A reporter investigating the return of the Hulk from the dead.

name: Opal Vetiver
deck: Bioengineer and member of Hordeculture.

name: Idyll
deck: Mutant prophet of Arakko

name: Weaponless Zsen
deck: A mutant who serves Ora Serrata. She was sent to work with Nightcrawler to find a runaway god.

name: Animalia
deck: Mutant rescued by the X-men from the Upstarts.

name: Obnoxio the Clown
deck: Obnoxio was an evil, obnoxious (hence the name) clown whom was the star of Crazy Magazine.

name: Nightwatch
deck: After finding a dark costume on the body of his older, slain self, the man known as Dr. Kevin Trench would eventually become the hero Nightwatch.

name: Jeffrey Garrett
deck: Jeffrey Garrett is a young mutant with teleportation powers. He died when Xorn Destroyed the Xavier Institute. He returned as a Ghost some time later. He is now assumed deceased permanently.

name: Hindsight
deck: Carlton LaFroyge is a former member of the New Warriors, who recently turned on the team and published the Warriors identities on his website after the Stamford Incident.

name: Phantom Eagle
deck: An ace pilot of German descent who fought against the Germans during World War I.

name: Tommy
deck: One of the Many sewer dwelling Morlocks

name: Jonathan Drew
deck: A scientist and father of Spider-Woman

name: Geist
deck: A Nazi cyborg who later joined to the CIA.

name: Gunhawk (Downing)
deck: An enemy of Wolverine.

name: Spidercide
deck: Spidercide is a clone of Spider-Man created by the Jackal (who has created the majority of the Spider-Man clones) who made Spidercide believe he was the true Peter Parker. Spidercide's insistence that he was the true Peter Parker led him down a road of violence and villainy.

name: Friction
deck: She is a member of team called Displaced Paranormals 7 (DP7).

name: Shinsky
deck: Doctor Wladyslav Shinski was once a brilliant scientist who joined other scientists in forming the Enclave, an organization dedicated to the creation of life itself in hopes of creating a better Earth.

name: Riot
deck: One of the five symbiotes forcibly spawned from Venom by the Life Foundation.

name: Victor Stein
deck: Victor Stein is a mad scientist. He is the husband of Janet Stein, and a member of the Pride. He is also the father of Chase Stein; a member of the Runaways.

name: Leash
deck: Leash is a member of the Savage Land Mutates. She and the rest of her team were genetically enhanced by Magneto, during his stint as the lord of the Savage Land. He did this in order to give them an edge over the Fall People, and keep them under control.

name: Trauma
deck: Trauma was one of the top recruits of The Initiative trained at Camp Hammond, specifically trained by by the New Mutant, Moonstar. His power to sense what people are afraid and then morph into their worse fear enabled him to be a prolific combatant and talented therapist.

name: Magician
deck: A former member of the Ultimate X-Men; Magician doesn't have any counterpart character in the Official Marvel Universe.

name: Sean Garrison
deck:
He is the father of Wallflower.

It is unknown if Sean Garrison retained or lost his mutant powers during the M-Day.

name: Wes Westin
deck: A talented artist, who has collaborated with Jimmy Yama in producing a Spider-Girl comic. He began a short relationship with Davida Kirby, but Davida begins to suspect his true feelings are for May and encourages him to tell her how he feels. The two are currently dating.

name: Sovel
deck: Sovel is a Shi'ar captain from a ship called Tath En'Ruhr (The Boneyard Dog).

name: Una
deck: Una was a Kree medic and the tragic first love of Captain Marvel.

name: Sasha Kravinoff
deck: Sasha was married to Kraven the Hunter.

name: Russell
deck: Co-leader of the Inferno Babies. He is a super speedster.

name: Cephalopod
deck: Molly Stanwick is a mutant and a former student of the Xavier Institute. She has tentacles in place of limbs.

name: Karasu
deck: A mutant who gained her powers post-AvX along with her twin brother. She was taken in by Ogun when she was a baby. Legion rescues them.

name: Michael Hawthorne
deck: A former S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who believes his country is on the border of chaos. He used necromancy to bring back undead Presidents in order to help restore the United States.

name: Eva Alexander
deck: Sam Alexander's mother.

name: Matthew Malloy
deck: Matthew Malloy is an Omega level mutant that SHIELD is after because of his incredible powers.

name: Guslaug
deck: Guslaug is a Frost Giant enrolled at Strange Academy.

name: Tarn the Uncaring
deck: Omega Level Mutant geneticist from Arakko who conducts twisted experiments on Arakki mutants to grow the ranks of his Locus Vile. Tarn sit on The Seat of Loss at The Great Ring of Arakko.

name: Rusty Rumple
deck: Housewife in 50's Marvel.

name: Condor
deck: Enemy of Nova from a race known as Bird-People.

name: Bogeyman
deck: Douglas Carmody was a bigot that hated the Power Pack children. He was cast into Limbo and met the demon N'Astihr where he transformed Carmody into the Bogeyman when he consumed some of his flesh.

name: Timberius
deck: Timberius the Tree-Dweller is an Inhuman and he supported Maximus the Mad.

name: The Host
deck: A mutant with the ability to commune with and control viruses, the Host considers herself a freedom fighter for viral diseases by liberating and spreading them among their human "oppressors."

name: Kierrok
deck: Ruler of the N'Garai

name: Stunner
deck: A former lover of Doctor Octopus and enemy of Spider-Man who uses virtual reality to become her alter-ego.

name: Shotgun
deck: Mercenary for hire.

name: Jake Olsen
deck: A New York paramedic that became the host of Thor for some time, much like Donald Blake was before him.

name: Nicodemus
deck: Member of the Externals.

name: Burner
deck: Originally Magneto's thug, now mutant activist.

name: Kristy Watson
deck: Kristy Watson is Mary Jane Watson's cousin whom lived with her and Peter Parker for a short period of time.

name: Reiko
deck: Blind Assassin for Tsurayaba Matsuo. Killed herself out of guilt for poisoning Wolverine's lover Mariko Yashida.

name: Axe
deck: Axe is a fury fighter

name: Police Chief Tai
deck: Police Chief Tai keeps the filth off the streets of Madripoor with the help of Wolverine.

name: Blue Shield
deck: Blue Shield is crimefighter who sought to destroy the mob from within.

name: Gorgilla
deck: A half-man/half-ape monster from Marvel's pre-Fantastic Four era.

name: Grovel
deck: Grovel is a Klyruvian bounty hunter and partner of Spat.

name: Ms. Steed
deck: An emissary of Onslaught in the Hellfire Club in London, Ms. Steed utilizes psionic blades to peel away layers of victims' psyches.

name: Gomurr The Ancient
deck: An ancient Master of the Martial Arts whom aided the X-men in their search for the Crimson Dawn.

name: Gudrun Tyburn
deck: Sorceress who sold her soul to Mephisto. She is a member of The MyS-Tech board.

name: Hazard
deck: Childhood friend of Charles Xavier

name: Tubby
deck: Golden age character, one of the Young Allies.

name: Bird-Brain
deck: A human-bird hybrid Ani-Mate who escaped from 'Paradise' Island, Bird-Brain was adopted by the New Mutants.  His attempts to help his fellow Ani-Mates led to the tragic death of Cypher.

name: Liz Moran
deck: Mike Moran's wife.

name: Maha Yogi
deck: A powerful conjurer of magic and illusions.

name: Midnight
deck: Formerly Moon Knight's self-appointed sidekick, he became a short-lived nemesis of his after being turned into a cyborg.

name: Thin Man
deck: In the 1930's, Bruce Dickson climbed high in the Himalayas and discovered the lost civilization of Kalahia. They taught him to become "thin" and stretch. He later fought alongside the Invaders.

name: Francesca Trask
deck: Francesca Trask, aka Fiend, is a member of the X-Terminated and daughter of Bolivar Trask.

name: Kron Stone
deck: Kron Stone is the half-brother to, and an adversary of Spider-Man 2099, and the man who murdered Punisher 2099's family. He became Venom 2099, and in the retelling Scorpion 2099

name: Catiana
deck: Tatiana is a mutant with the power to transform into any living being if she comes into contact with their blood. She retains her mutant powers after M-Day.

name: Projector
deck: Acolyte who joined under Cortez and aided in Cortez' assault on Wundagore.

name: Syndicate
deck: Matthew and Luke are conjoined twins with the mutant ability to generate electromagnetic pulses via their own beating heart.

name: Tricephalous
deck: The Tricephalous was genetically engineered by Deviant scientists on Monster Island, where it was intended to serve as part of Warlord Kro's monstrous invasion forces on the surface world.

name: Black Mariah
deck: Black Mariah was a drug racketeering 400-pound woman who crossed paths with Luke Cage. Cage went toe-to-toe with her and shut down her operation. She got her name from the alias of an ambulance, symbolizing the way she ran her operations.

name: Lady Stilt-Man
deck: A female criminal who adopted her codename in Stilt-Man's honor. Participated in Purple Man's Villains for Hire.

name: Cannon Foot
deck: The son of James Howlett

name: Scab
deck: One of the babies kidnapped by demons to open a portal to Earth during the Inferno, Scab grew in Limbo where 20 passed during the time of 4 years on Earth, Subjected to years of experimentation by Project Purgatory, Scab fought Sunspot & the other New Mutants.

name: Death (Javeed)
deck: Once a Final Horseman of Apocalypse, Sanjar Javeed is now Headmaster and professor at the Pan-Asian School for the Unusually Gifted.

name: Skinless Man
deck: A product of the Weapon Plus program who has a grudge against Fantomex.

name: Erik Selvig
deck: Erik Selvig is a character who was introduced within the Marvel Cinematic Universe. He first appeard in the movie "Thor" and was introduced into the mainstream comic books a few years later. There, he worked as a doctor for S.H.I.E.L.D.

name: Cyclone (Gerard)
deck: The first supervillian called Cyclone. He battled Spider-Man and Moon Knight but was later a victim to Scourge. Was momentarily revived by The Hood only to die again.

name: Atli Wodendottir
deck: One of three granddaughters of Thor in a distant future.

name: Frigg Wodendottir
deck: Thor's eldest granddaughter in a distant future, sister to both Ellisiv and Atli.

name: Ellisiv Wodendottir
deck: Granddaughter of Thor in a distant future.

name: Kushala
deck: The Sorcerer Supreme from the mid-1800s with powers similar to the Spirit of Vengeance.

name: Augusta Bromes
deck: Agrochemist and member of Hordeculture.

name: Toth
deck: Toth is a Weirdworld native with a love for swamps. He is a student enrolled at Strange Academy.

name: Germān Aguilar
deck: Germān is a young animage and a student enrolled at Strange Academy.

name: Soldier
deck: A reformed Hydra member, who joined the Midnight Mission to make up for his past. He ended up becoming a vampire.

name: Syzya of the Smoke
deck: Syzya of the Smoke is a Mutant of Arakko.

name: Machete
deck:
Three people have used the alias Machete. The current is Mariano López.

Ferdinand López, the first known Machete was a member of Batroc's Brigade and a mercenary for hire.

name: Stallior
deck: Stallior the Centaur is an Inhuman and a supporter of Maximus the Mad.

name: Steinbeck
deck: A mutant arm-dealer whom encountered and fought Mystique

name: Hornet
deck: Peter Parker was the first Hornet using a jetpack given to him by Hobie Brown A.K.A. Prowler. Later a science prodigy and handicapped with a palsied arm, Eddie McDonough adventured as the Slinger called Hornet and was killed by a brainwashed Wolverine.

name: Dirt Nap
deck: Once villainous, Dirt Nap was a leopard who changed his spots (well, his smile went from red to yellow, at least...).

name: Jude the Entropic Man
deck: Jude or the Entropic man has the power of decay and would return to earth when humanity begged for his gift.

name: Master Khan
deck: A sinister sorcerer "god" of K'un L'un. He has fought Iron Fist on several occasions.

name: Haywire
deck: A former member of the Redeemers and Squadron Supreme, Haywire has the ability to make limitless steel-like wire come from his fingers and can entangle people in them.

name: Harold H. Harold
deck: Harold H. Harold was a writer whom was facinated by vampires. As such, he became an ally to the first incarnation of the Dracula Hunters to defeat Dracula.

name: Rax
deck: Rax is a member of the Neo.

name: Caretaker
deck: Ally and mentor to both Johnny Blaze and Dan Ketch. Currently dead.

name: Jack Truman
deck: Jack Truman was a SHIELD agent trying to apprehend Cable. Truman captured his prey but learned he was being used in tests to create robotic agents by ExTechOp. Truman was injured while assisting Cable's escape and ironically wound up being experimented on himself and became the new Deathlok.

name: Halloween Jack
deck: Former Alchemax scientist who was granted powers through the Aesir program. After several transformations he settles for Halloween Jack but his absorption powers have made him a little crazy.

name: Orrgo
deck: One of the Marvel Monsters from the early 1960's. Years later, he would wreck havoc against planet Earth. The Defenders eventually managed to stop him.

name: Sam Buchanan
deck: Sam was an agent of Interpol that was tasked with protecting Victoria Montesi and thus became part of the Darkhold Redeemers.

name: Kofi
deck: An alien ally of Power Pack. Kofi is the son of Yrik and Onomi Whitemane and therefore, heir to the throne of the Kymellians. The Kymellians are alogoanthropes (Were-Horses, often mistaken for Centaurs whom are alogoanthropes but have human torsos and horse extremities) or human/horse hybrids. He was born with powers that are rare in the Kymellian race and is therefore a non-human mutant.

name: Red Queen
deck: Red Queen is the leader of the Crazy Gang.

name: Matthew Plunder
deck: Matthew Plunder is the Son of Ka-Zar and Shanna. He lives in the Savage Land.

name: Bloodaxe
deck: Murderous vigilante given the powers of a god by the axe of Skurge the executioner.

name: Stellaris
deck: Stellaris is an alien from a world that was judged unworthy by the Celestials. Recently, she was a member of Gamora's Graces who conquered Godthab Omega.

name: Ormond Wychwood
deck: Dark Mage who sold his soul to Mephisto for immortality.

name: Willow
deck: The blind cybernetic telepath from the space opera Dreadstar, Willow was created by Jim Starlin. She rises from victim to protector, and predator, while traveling with Dreadstar and his band of rebels.

name: Vibro
deck: A former geologist that was caught in an earthquake, where a machine imbued him with vibratory powers, though leaving him physically and mentally disfigured. He is currently stationed in Mandarin City Mongolia.

name: Jennie Royce
deck: An employee of the Heroes for Hire team when Luke Cage and Iron Fist just started their business.

name: Domo
deck: Domo is an Eternal. He was instrumental in the forming of the Uni-Mind.

name: Carmilla Frost
deck: Camilla is one of Killraven's Freedom Fighters.  She is a mother, a wife and Medic.

name: Ch'Vayre
deck: One of Apocalypse's prelates in the future charged with raising and training Stryfe to become the Chaos Bringer, Ch'Vayre became disillusioned with Stryfe's madness and turned on him and Apocalypse.

name: Oliver Raven
deck: The son of Gambit and Rogue, Oliver's powers are similar to his mother's while he also possesses telepathy, and the ability to fly.

name: Warren Worthington Jr.
deck: Warren Worthington, Jr. is the father of Warren Worthington III (aka Angel of the X-men).

name: Horse
deck: Horse is the strongest crew-member of the Shi'ar Salvagers.

name: John Maddox
deck: A dupe of Jamie Madrox, the multiple-man whom built a life for himself as a family man and pastor

name: Hiro-Kala
deck: Hiro-Kala was once an enslaved Shadow child. After the destruction of Sakaar, he learned of his heritage. He is the son of Hulk and Caiera the Oldstrong. He began a mission to travel the universe and purge it of the Old-Power.

name: Chat
deck: Chat is a mutant girl who can talk to animals and Peter Parker's girlfriend in the Marvel Adventures Spider-Man series.

name: K'Tor
deck: K'Tor is the Shi'ar Vice-Chancellor. He sicked Korvus after the X-Men.

name: Toko
deck: One of the mutant babies kidnapped by demons during the Inferno.

name: Trista
deck: One of the Inferno Babies.

name: Spike
deck: Gary Walsh is a mutant and former student of the Xavier Institute. He can extend spikes from his body.

name: Xanto Starblood
deck: A self described "extreme zoologist." Xanto appears to be just another brute but he is actually a universally renowned anthropologist, author and teacher. He is also capable of training Brood to be his bloodhounds.

name: Leo Fitz
deck: A brilliant but socially awkward engineer and Jemma Simmons' research partner.

name: Pei
deck: A young monk of K'un-Lun with the potential to be the next Iron Fist. Danny Rand was assigned to be her Thunderer.

name: Star
deck: Ripley Ryan was an anti-superhero reporter and former Kree test subject, who became the host for the Reality Gem after the gems were given life by the Soul Gem.

name: Irma Peterson
deck: Marvel character based in the radio situation comedy called "My Friend Irma"

name: Dusk
deck: Cassie St. Commons was a typical ESU student until a meeting with Black Marvel changed everything.

name: Angela Yin
deck: Photographer for the Daily Bugle.

name: Spike
deck: One of the members of X-Force/X-Statix

name: Julien Boudreaux
deck: Marius Boudreaux (father), Bella Donna Boudreaux (sister), Remy LeBeau (ex brother-in-law)

name: Goddess
deck: Goddess is the 'pure' and 'good' part of Adam Warlock when he expelled good and evil from his soul.

name: Arize
deck: Arize is the only mutant of the Spineless Ones. Due to his mutation, he has a more humanoid appearance than his brethren.

name: Lacuna
deck: Lacuna is a mutant who could stop time for various effects. She is one of the only mutant characters from the X-Statix series who wasn't killed off. She currently hosts a celebrity gossip show.

name: Amy Chen
deck: Mercenary for Silver Sable International. She is a former assassin, who is a martial artist and uses such weapons as a sword or a crossbow.

name: Peregrine
deck: Le Peregrine is France's native son and their premiere superhero. He made his first appearance in Marvel Super Hero Contest of Champions #1 - A Gathering of Heroes (June 1982).

name: Killian
deck: Killian the leader of the Crimson Pirates

name: Sergeant Tork
deck: A New York Police Department sergeant and good friends with the superheroes such as the Falcon and Captain America. He is also an ally to the Black Panther and Luke Cage.

name: Oddball
deck: A criminal Juggler. Formerly of the Death-Throws, an entire team of criminal jugglers. Yes, really.

name: Blue Diamond
deck: Blue Diamond was a former costumed hero from World War II who would later be transformed into a diamond hard body; he travels through space with his lover Star-Dancer.

name: Prodigal
deck: Prodigal is a mutant from the island of Genosha, and the leader of the X-Patriots. He can generate an energy field that causes rapid corrosion in metal, reducing anything metallic to rust in seconds.

name: Huntarr
deck: Huntarr is a human who was transformed by Baron Karza in order to destroy the Micronauts. In fact, he joins them to avenge his dreadful new apparence.

name: El Aguila
deck: A modern day Robin Hood, Alejandro Montoya has the power to shoot bursts of electricity through metal conductors.

name: Carter Blaire
deck: Judge Carter Blaire is the father of Alison Blaire (Dazzler).

name: Hitman
deck: Burt Kenyon was a Vietnam veteran who was kicked out of the marines for violent conduct. He began working for New York crime organizations soon afterward as a killer for hire.

name: Samuels
deck: Moon Knight's faithful butler for many years.

name: Dale Yorkes
deck: Dale Yorkes, a member of the Pride as well as a time traveler. He is the husband to Stacey Yorks, and father of Gertrude Yorkes; a member of the Runaways.

name: Vincente
deck: Vincente is a mutant with the ability to change his state from solid to liquid or gas. He can even make his vaporous form toxic to inhale. He first appeared in the Age of Apocalypse and a year later in the main Marvel Universe.

name: Tito Bohusk, Jr.
deck: Tito is an X-Man in the future as seen in Here Comes Tomorrow.

name: Washout
deck: Aquamorph mutant whom worked for the new Weapon X program after being turned down as a member of X-Force/X-Statix

name: Devourer of Souls
deck: Massive demonic entity who is one of Conan's most powerful and terrifying enemies. He is both a master swordsman and a practitioner of the dark arts, but his most terrible power is to consume souls.

name: Elias Bogan
deck: He is a formidable enemy of the X-Men and carries a particular animosity for Sage.

name: Amir
deck: An Atlantean covert operative who assisted Wolverine. She was also a romantic interest of his. She was killed by Shogun.

name: Evelyn Necker
deck: Creator of Death's Head II, Death Wreck and Death Metal. All of which rebelled against her programming and fled through time.

name: Hazel Frost
deck: Hazel Frost is the mother of Adrienne, Christian, Cordelia, and Emma Frost. And is also the wife of Winston Frost.

name: Lourdes Chantel
deck: A member of the Hellfire Club and mutant teleporter.

name: Michele Gonzales
deck: Michelle is the sister of Vin Gonzales and Peter Parker's former roommate.

name: Shadow Stalker
deck: Shadow Stalker tries to kill Wolverine's girlfriend

name: Ghost Rider (Jones)
deck: Alejandra temporarily replaced Johnny Blaze as the host of Zarathos and was later imbued with a fraction of Zarathos' power when the Spirit of Vengeance returned to Johnny Blaze

name: Kasey Nash
deck: Spider-Man 2099 character and Girlfriend of Gabriel O'Hara.

name: Harper Simmons
deck: A journalist that was contacted by Shadow King who revealed to him the truth about Archangel and X-Force. Later, he ended up on Earth-295 and joined the X-Terminated.

name: Darcy Lewis
deck: Darcy Lewis is a close friend of Jane Foster and first appeared in the Marvel Cinematic Universe in the film "Thor". When the character was later introduced into Marvel Comics, she was reimagined as a disgraced investigative journalist who went on to work for and form a close bond with the Scarlet Witch.

name: Kobik
deck: A combination of Cosmic Cube fragments that assumed the shape of a little girl. Initially used by S.H.I.E.L.D. to create Pleasant Hill.

name: Dr. McGowan
deck: Dr. Charlene McGowan is a former Shadow Base scientist who later defected and joined Gamma Flight.

name: Edith Scutch
deck: Botanical engineer and member of Hordeculture.

name: Precious
deck: Princess Python's trained giant snake.

name: Lost
deck: A formerly depowered mutant who has taken up a job in the mutant maternity ward. Because the babies' ear bones aren't fully developed, they are unaffected by her vertigo abilities.

name: Kafka
deck: Kafka is a young mutant  of Krakoa

name: Nancy Carter
deck: Girlfriend of Matt Hawk, the second Two Gun Kid.

name: Salvo
deck: Salvo is a member of the Warclan of the Neo. He converts his body into a state of liquid bio-metal that he can shape into projectile guns that draw ammunition from his body.

name: Witness
deck: Gambit of Earth-1191 became known as the Witness, as he was the only survivor of the betrayal of the mysterious X-Traitor. He became an immensely powerful figure of that time.

name: Magog
deck: Magog is a creature in the service of Mojo

name: Ricochet Rita
deck: Ricochet Rita was a former stuntwoman who left Earth to join Longshot's rebellion against Mojo.  Through a twist of time and fate, she was held hostage and transformed into Spiral, the X-Men's foe.

name: Psyklop
deck: Last hope for his people.

name: Rathcoole
deck: Mage who sold his soul to Mephisto. He is a member of The MyS-Tech board.

name: M'Shulla
deck: Member Of Killraven's Freemen who is a skilled crossbow user.

name: Joy Meachum
deck: Harold Meachum's daughter.

name: Oshtur
deck: Oshtur is a benevolent Elder Goddess and one of three vastly powerful beings who are collectively known as the Vishanti. She is depicted as a celestial being known as the Bright Lady of the Dawn. Oshtur is also associated with benevolent beings such as angels and faeries.

name: Randall Spector
deck: Randall Spector is the psychotic younger brother of Marc Spector. Jealous of Marc's life, Randall rivaled Moon Knight, first as a dark reflection as Shadowknight and then as the avatar of a different god as Jackal Knight.

name: Midnight Sun
deck: Once enemies, after their last battle Silver Surfer and Midnight Sun left each other on amicable terms.

name: Justin Baldwin
deck: Father of Speedball/Penance.

name: Kymri
deck: Blue-skinned princess from another dimension. Friend to Excalibur and love interest to Nightcrawler.

name: Kris Keating
deck: NYPD swat team leader who is not too fond of Spider-Man.

name: Darla
deck: A young girl whom first appeared when the X-man Longshot first came to earth, she was a member of a children street-skaters gang named "the Fatboys'. She and her friends often clashed, but also worked alongside, with Daredevil.

name: Lotus Shinchuko
deck: The woman who caused the Sons of the Tiger to disband.

name: Erica Sondheim
deck: One of the world's leading cardiac and neurological surgeons.

name: Hypno-Hustler
deck: The Hypno-Hustler is a jive-talking black soul Disco singer who uses his goggles and evil boots of death to hypnotize music lovers, alongside his backup band, "The Mercy Killers."

name: Big Wheel
deck: Jackson Weele is a villain who travels around through means of a giant wheel he himself created. Hence the name Big Wheel.

name: Stunt-Master
deck: Former villain that fought Daredevil that reformed and became part of the Initiative.

name: Lorna
deck: A woman raised in the jungle. She was created by Atlas Comics, Marvel's predecessor.

name: Stacey Yorkes
deck: Stacey Yorkes is the wife of Dale Yorkes, and mother of Gertrude Yorkes; a member of the Runaways. She's a time traveler as well as a member of the Pride.

name: Alice Hayes
deck: Wife of Gene and mother to Molly, Alice Hayes poses as a successful doctor, but is secretly a telepathic mutant, and a member of The Pride.

name: Z'Cann
deck: A mutant Skrull alien who is a member of Cadre K. She possesses powerful telepathic abilities.

name: Equinox
deck: Terry Sorenson, driven insane by his powers, began a life of crime to finance his mother's attempts to cure him. Equinox was one of the first villains in the Villains Anonymous(Vil-Anon) program.

name: Lenny Ballinger
deck: Lenny Ballinger is the head of the Damage Control company and its Head Foreman.

name: Pagon
deck: Pagon is a Skrull who arrived on Earth and impersonated the assassin known as Elektra for a time. Pagon led The Hand and sowed anarchy and distrust to pave the way for the Skrull invasion of the planet.

name: Time Traveler
deck: Time Traveler is the common name for an aspect of The Enigma Force which acts through an infinite number of physical humanoid shells. All of its shells are identical to Arcturus Rann except for the first which was representative of the originator of the Enigma Force and the creator of the Microverse, Prince Wayfinder.

name: Galacta
deck: Galacta is the estranged daughter of Galactus and has been living on Earth for an undetermined amount of time in the guise of a Human Woman named Gali. Recently, Galacta became the overseer in the multidimensional contest called Marvel Rivals.

name: Network Nina
deck: S.H.I.E.L.D. agent with the ability to pick up on psychic residue left behind by a person

name: Cortex
deck: X-Factor antagonist who mind controlled Monet St. Croix and Shatterstar into attacking former mutants. One of James Madrox's dupes that he sent into a future.

name: Francis Ketch
deck: Mother of Danny Ketch (who was for a time bound to the Ghost Rider).

name: Fire Knives
deck: Fire Knives is a mercenary who tried to kill Melita Garner.

name: Shauna
deck: One of the mutant babies kidnapped by demons during the Inferno, Shauna was raised in Limbo by the Government-funded Project Purgatory.

name: Raizo Kodo
deck: Raizo is a vampire samurai. He is somewhat of a rival to Dracula.

name: Nara
deck: Nara is an Atlantean and a student at The Braddock Academy. She is one of the teen heroes kidnapped by Arcade in Avengers Arena.

name: Melinda Leucenstern
deck: An Australian scientist and a former criminal whose record was cleared by S.H.I.E.L.D. so she can work in Bruce Banner's team of scientists.

name: Teresa Parker
deck: Teresa Parker is Peter Parker's long lost sister. She was on the run from the Kingpin when she revealed her connection to Peter Parker. She has recently returned to New York City.

name: Gabriel Reyes
deck: Robbie Reyes' disabled brother.

name: Josiah Guthrie
deck: Cannonball & Smasher's mutant superhuman-superguardian hyper-gestated baby.

name: Mosaic
deck: A former professional basketball player who underwent Terrigenesis, gaining the ability to transfer his mind from different hosts and while doing so, retain their thoughts.

name: Cole North
deck: A tough as nails, Homicide Detective from Chicago who has been tasked with bringing in Daredevil for the charge of murder.

name: Stiletto
deck: A mercenary for hire whom fought against Luke Cage, Captain America and Spider-man among others.

name: Shepard
deck: Shepard is a mutant and the brother of Prudence Leighton.

name: General Clarke
deck: A member of Department K.

name: Gudrun
deck: An Asgardian and wife to Volstagg the Voluminous.

name: Stardust
deck: Stardust is one of the oldest beings in the universe. It is a user of the Power Cosmic and was once a faithful Herald of Galactus.

name: Delilah
deck: Delilah is a deadly assassin.

name: Woodgod
deck: Woodgod is a genetically engineered sentient lifeform who physically resembles a satyr of classical Greco-Roman mythology, and who was crated by scientists David and Ellen Pace. The Paces employed cloning techniques to create Woodgod, combining human and animal genetic material.

name: Rosalind Sharpe
deck: A famous lawyer and Foggy Nelson's biological mother.

name: Greystone
deck: Reigning from the distant future of Earth #1191, Greystone first was a member of the X.S.E. Unhappy that their beliefs differed from the original ones, she created the X.U.E. to be more proactive.

name: Bloody Bess
deck: Bloody Bess is a member of the Crimson Pirates

name: Father Delgado
deck: Father Delgado is a Priest living in New York City who provided Cloak and Dagger with food and shelter.

name: Shirley Lewis
deck: Owner of the Daily Grind coffee shop and former employer of Ben Reilly, the Scarlet Spider.

name: Agamemnon
deck: The son of an Asgardian God and a mortal mother

name: Bronwen Gryffn
deck: Sorceress who sold her soul to Mephisto. She is a member of The MyS-Tech board.

name: Goblyn
deck: Goblyn was an unborn mutant whose life was saved when her twin sister Laura (Pathway) teleported her to the Dream World ruled by the Dream Queen.  Rescued by Alpha Flight, she would come to be a valued member of Beta Flight, alongside her sibling.

name: Matador
deck: Manuel Eloganto was a famous bullfighter from Spain.

name: Debrii
deck: A member of New Warriors.

name: Janet Stein
deck: Janet Stein is a mad scientist, as well as a member of the Pride. She is the wife of Victor Stein, and mother of Chase Stein; a member of the Runaways.

name: Vagabond
deck: Vagabond was a costumed adventurer who worked with Nomad and Demolition Man. She also was a member of Captain America's Stars and Stripes band of heroes.

name: Queen
deck: A Marine whose latent mutant abilities were activated by military experimentation. She was a military prisoner for many years before surfacing during Avengers Dissembled.

name: Atum the God Eater
deck: Atum the God Eater is the son of Gaea and the Demiurge. He is the most powerful of Gaea's children, being responsible for the destruction and retreat of all the Elder Gods.

name: Nina Da Costa
deck: Nina is the mother of the mutant Sunspot

name: Isolationist
deck: An unique man who is devoted to exterminating all mutants

name: Sarah Stacy
deck: Sarah is the daughter of Norman Osborn and Gwen Stacy and her older twin brother is Gabriel Stacy.

name: Prime Cotati
deck: Member of the Cotati.

name: Jazinda
deck: Daughter of the legendary Super-Skrull, partner to She-Hulk and member of the Lady Liberators.

name: Ulysses Archer
deck: Crimefighter, trucker and starship pilot.

name: Zodiac
deck: An anarchist villain who killed the Zodiac to steal their name.

name: Hippo
deck: He was a normal hippopotamus that was transformed into a humanoid hippopotamus by the High Evolutionary. His leg was bitten off by Mac Gargan/Spider-Man now he and other victims band together to destroy him.

name: Alex
deck: One of the inferno babies

name: Bob
deck: One of the inferno babies

name: Loca
deck: She was one of the inferno babies. She was a tracker.

name: Annie
deck: One of the last surviving LMDs of a brutal attack by the villainous Black Fog, Annie is assigned to help and watch over Thunderbolt Ross aka The Red Hulk. Despite her robotic nature, she and the red giant have grown to be very close friends.

name: Luca Aldine
deck: Blindfold's older brother.

name: Henry Hayes
deck: A former combat medic who joined Doctors Without Borders.  When he was given a sophisticated prosthetic leg, he was transformed without his knowledge into a new Deathlok, operating as a military sleeper agent.

name: Richard Parker (LMD)
deck: Duplicate of Richard Parker designed to destroy Spider-Man.

name: Mary Parker (LMD)
deck: Duplicate of Mary Parker designed to destroy Spider-Man.

name: Fuse
deck: Brother of Ramone and friend of Kate Bishop.

name: Phoenix 1,000,000 BC
deck: A cave woman who became the host body for the Phoenix Force.

name: Mr. Horse
deck: A humble horse from Vanaheim who is rescued by Jane Foster. Mr. Horse shows his appreciation by accompanying Jane, and later Runa, as a companion of the Valkyrior.

name: Lily Leymus
deck: Geneticist and member of Hordeculture.

name: Dessy
deck: Dessy, short for Despair, is a Limbo demon enrolled at Strange Academy.

name: Tony Stark A.I.
deck: An artificial intelligence patterned after Tony Stark, who temporarily filled in for his creator following Civil War II.

name: Miss Patriot
deck: A reporter from the Daily Bugle during the World War II who later became the superheroine Miss Patriot. She had romantic feelings for the Patriot.

name: Locust
deck: Dr. Hopper is Locust a mad scientist obsessed with becoming a famous Entomologist.

name: Red King
deck: The emperor of the planet Sakaar who took it over after making himself look like a hero.

name: Broadside
deck: Broadside is a member of Crimson Pirates.

name: Sea Dog
deck: Sea Dog is a member of the Crimson Pirates

name: Victor Palermo
deck: Victor Palermo was a tenant in Aunt May's boadring house

name: Zeitgeist
deck: Former leader of X-Statix, back when it was still called X-Force.  Has the power to spit a deadly acid.

name: Zsaji
deck: A healing woman from an alien race in Secret Wars. She has a short-lived love affair with the Human Torch, then a deeper affair with Colossus, as well as a side-fling with Deadpool.

name: Smuggler
deck: Conrad was the youngest of his brothers. Later is older brother Eric became a villian after coming out of the army. Now Conrad lives in pain for the rest of his life because of his brother.

name: Skrull Prime
deck: Prime Skrull is the last survivor of the non-Deviant Skrull race.

name: Bereet
deck: An alien filmmaker whom became close friends with the incredible Hulk

name: Matt Slade
deck: U.S.Marshal of the old west

name: Glorianna O'Breen
deck: Daredevil's girlfriend for a while. She's a photographer for the Daily Bugle.

name: Runner
deck: An Elder Of The Universe, the being known only as The Runner is over 5 billion years old and travels freely across the universe looking for the fastest beings to race with.

name: Pandemic
deck: Pandemic was an X-Men villain, obsessed with stealing mutant powers while working undercover as the team's physician.

name: Scotty Summers
deck: Scotty was the son of Havok and Madelyne Pyror. He was named after his believed deceased uncle Scott.

name: Dummy
deck: Dummy was an autistic mutant who was a student at the Xavier Institute.

name: Klara Prast
deck: Klara is a girl Karolina ran into during a time traveling ordeal in the early 1900's. After following her and finding out more about her life Karolina set out to help her. She then joined the Runaways.

name: Carlton Drake
deck: Carlton Drake is leader of the Life Foundation, he seeks to weaponize symbiotes for personal gain.

name: Gog
deck: Gog is a Tslin that was discovered by Kraven the Hunter who named him after a Biblical giant. Kraven used Gog to help build a kingdom in the Savage Land. Gog has had runs in with Spider-man, Ka-Zar and Hercules, Even being as muscle in the third incarnation of the Sinister Six. Later on it's revealed that Gog was a family pet, that was sent to Earth from a dying world.

name: Torgo
deck: Torgo, the robot ruler of Mekka is a fierce warrior that leads the Hulk-Hunters.

name: Gargoyle
deck: A Soviet scientist mutated by radiation and the first foe of the Hulk. He was later cured by Bruce Banner.

name: Henry Pym Jr
deck: Henry Pym Jr. is the son of Hank Pym and the Wasp in the alternate reality MC2. Another version of Henry Pym Jr. surfaced in the pages of the Avengers, where he was part of the Kid Avengers.

name: Alyssa
deck: The ever scheming leader of the all female Siren sect.

name: Saw Fist
deck: He is the Son of the Wolverine

name: Carson Wyche
deck: A Stark Industries employee.

name: Tim Cababa
deck: Stark Industries employee

name: Arkea
deck: The twin sister of Sublime, cast into space a billion years ago. She has since returned to Earth, seeking revenge.

name: Blindspot
deck: An illegal immigrant from China who invented a suit that allows him to become invisible. Under the guidance of Daredevil, he becomes a vigilante known as Blindspot.

name: Zenzi
deck: Wakandan who, with her powers of mind manipulation, brings the anger her fellow Wakandans hold for the king to the forefront of their mind. She incited the rebellion against T'Challa and all monarchs.

name: Brutha Nature
deck: Jacob Williams is a Krakoan mutant.

name: Django Maximoff
deck: Django is, apparently, the true father of the Scarlet Witch and Quicksilver. He had raised them, but until recently it was believed that Erik (Magneto) and Magda Lensherr where the twins' biological parents.

name: Maria Pilar Cortes
deck: The Deputy Minister of Spain who ran into Storm's team of X-Men whilst they were in Spain searching for Destiny's diaries

name: Tiny
deck: Brian "Tiny" McKeever was a friend of Flash Thompson's and part of the popular crowd. Currently, he's the head of security for Empire State University.

name: Morris Walters
deck: Jennifer Walters' (aka She-Hulk) father and Bruce Banner's uncle.

name: Xandu
deck: A student of the mystic arts, Xandu forever seeks the Wand of Watoomb.

name: Shooting Star
deck: A former circus performer and sharpshooter, her custom guns shoot stun-stars. Lover of Texas Twister.

name: Omerta
deck: Paulie Provenzano was a member of the X-Men for a brief time known as Omerta. A mafia-wannabe, he was often joking around and flirting with the female team members and was also very homophobic and prejudice towards team-mate Northstar.

name: Sanctity
deck: Sanctity was the daughter of Dr. Bolivar Trask and after traveling to Earth-811 (Cable's Reality) she became a disciple of Rachel Summers and led the Askani after Rachel died.

name: Detective Jacob Raven
deck: Detective from Utah who hunted down Kaine

name: Sledge
deck: A member of he deviants race, sledge is appears as an out of proportion human on crutches. He was allied with X force and Ulysses Dragonblood against the Damocles Foundation.

name: Daniel Kingsley
deck: The twin brother of the original Hobgoblin, Roderick Kingsley.

name: Phil Sheldon
deck: Phil Sheldon was a reporter/photographer in the Marvel Universe. He witnessed the rise of the superheroes and some of the great events and battles of the Marvel Universe.

name: Lukas
deck: One of the many mutants of Genosha that escaped to the States seeking assylum. He could take the shape of his target's worst fear.

name: Punisher Robot
deck: These half robot, half organic creatures hail from the outer rim of the universe. They are both ruthless and merciless fighting machines that were introduced to humanity by Galactus.

name: Glitter
deck: Stephanie constantly generates an energy field which sparkles around her, keeping her body in peak condition at all times, and allowing her to heal herself and others.

name: Marcy Pearson
deck: A former ally of Tony Stark and lover of James Rhodes, before she tried to frame him for murder.

name: Lucius Antonius Aquilla
deck: Lucius Antonius Aquilla is the ruler of Nova Roma and father of Magma of the New Mutants.

name: Trish Starr
deck: Egghead's niece. She encountered the Hulk and the Defenders on a few occasions.

name: Christine Palmer
deck: Those that have the title of Night Nurse use their skills to provide treatment to superheroes in need.

name: Gene Hayes
deck: Husband of Alice and father to Molly; Gene Hayes poses as a successful doctor, but is secretly a telepathic mutant, and a member of The Pride.

name: Tom Skylark
deck: Inhabitant of Earth-15104 (Earth-616 150 years in the future). He possesses the Rover, one of the last Sentinels.

name: Derek Khanata
deck: He's a wakandan SHIELD special agent.

name: Alison Double
deck: Alison Double was a member of STRIKE'S Psi Divison. She was also a good friend of Betsy Braddock.

name: The Knave
deck: The Knave is a member of the Crazy Gang.

name: Longneck
deck: A low level mutant at the Xavier institute.

name: Porlock
deck: A mage who sold his soul to Mephisto. Member of The MyS-Tech board and Techno-Wizards

name: Kate Neville
deck: Agent of SHIELD

name: Hecat'e
deck: Mutant from Bishop's future timeline and commanding officier of the X.S.E.

name: Ms. Lion
deck: A rambunctious male dog who belongs to Aunt May. Although he doesn't have any super powers, Ms Lion became a founding member of the Pet Avengers and saved his feline team-mate, Hairball.

name: The Unspoken
deck: The previous monarch of the Inhumans who was overthrown by Black Bolt, Medusa, Gorgon, and Karnak.

name: Detective Flint
deck: A NYPD detective who handles the Moon Knight-related cases.

name: Crimson Dynamo (Vadim)
deck: The twelfth Crimson Dynamo.

name: Clash
deck: One of Spider-Man's first fans, and an aspiring hero.

name: Starbolt
deck: Current Imperial Guard member and successor to the original Starbolt.

name: Karn
deck: A member of the inheritors and brother to Morlun, Karn hunts down Spider totems to redeem himself in the eyes of his family.

name: Rayshaun Lucas
deck: A young American boy whom became disillusioned with his country when the U.S. goverment tried to arrest members of the black superhero community such as Rage and Sam Wilson, whom at the time was Captain America. Eventually he became the hero known as the new Patriot.

name: Avalanche
deck: The successor of the original Avalanche, this unknown mutant seemingly has the same powers as the original. He has joined the New Brotherhood of Evil Mutants.

name: Emily Bright
deck: Emily Bright was born with the ability to wield magic and has used it for as long as she can remember. She is a student enrolled at Strange Academy.

name: Meridius
deck: A time manipulating King in Black, He is an evil future version of Eddie Brock.  Meridius rejects the King in Black's true purpose as a cosmic caretaker and desperately seeks a means of averting his fate.

name: Primus
deck: An artificial lifeform created by Arnim Zola, and sometimes ally of the Mad Thinker.

name: Copperhead
deck: Copperhead was an agent of Viper's who served on the Serpent Society for a brief period of time.

name: Aron the Rogue Watcher
deck: Replaced the Fantastic Four with evil duplicates and started a civil war within his own Watcher race.  Was killed by Uatu the Watcher when Aron was about the destroy the Fantastic Four.

name: Dakimh
deck: Dakimh is a powerful sorceror of earth's dimension.

name: Avia
deck: Avia is a member of the Genetic Council.

name: Kevin
deck: Human, son of Ruby, adopted by Volstagg.

name: Lifter
deck: A member of the Mutant Force (an offshoot of the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants), and the Resistants, who were formed to protest the Mutant Registration Act.

name: Cody Robbins
deck: Cody Robbins was Rogue's boyfriend until she drained all his life energy, leaving him in a coma.

name: Mr. Clean
deck: A human who massacred the mutants living in the sewers below London, England. He was chemically treated to have impervious skin.

name: Earth-Mover
deck: Former hockey player, trained by Wolverine who helped him find his totem, Shaman now guides him in the mystic arts.

name: Victor Strange
deck: The second Baron Blood and brother of Dr. Strange.

name: Tundra
deck: One of the Great Beasts and avatar of the power of the land.

name: Hoggoth
deck: Hoggoth is one of three vastly powerful benevolent beings who are collectively know as the Vishanti.

name: Ginger Jaye
deck: Ginger Jaye was Richard Rider's girlfriend at Harry's Truman High School in New York.

name: Princess Zanda
deck: Ruler of Narobia.

name: Tanaraq
deck: Tanaraq is one of the Great Beasts of the North. By making a deal with Tanaraq you gain the ability to transform into Sasquatch.

name: Tina Minoru
deck: Wife of Robert and mother of Runaways member Nico; Tina Minoru is a dark wizard, and member of the Pride.

name: Justicer Bull
deck: Justicer Bull is the Captain Britain on Earth-23238.

name: Orson Randall
deck: Orson Randall was the Iron Fist immediately preceding Danny Rand. He fought during the First World War but the horrors he witnessed made him turn to opium in order to cope.

name: Joelle Guthrie
deck: Joelle Guthrie is the younger sister of Cannonball and Husk.

name: Revenant
deck: A Valle Soleada mutant gang-member...

name: Forearm
deck: Forearm was a low level mutant who was a student at the Xavier academy.

name: Tuck
deck: Partner of Death's Head II.

name: Sparrow
deck: The daughter of Orson Randall who has been sentenced to guard the machine that bridges K'un-Lun and the world of men because of the crimes of her father. She became Yu Ti during K'un-Lun's reconstruction.

name: Werner von Doom
deck: Werner von Doom is Victor von Doom's (Doctor Doom) father.

name: Bull McGiveney
deck: Sergeant in the U.S. army and leader of the Maulers commandos.

name: Starhammer
deck: Starhammer was one of the few surviving members of the D'Bari race of aliens.

name: Sunstreak
deck: Sunstreak is a semi-reformed supervillain member of the Force of Nature.

name: Axeman Bone
deck: Axeman Bone of Imperia once killed the former King of Sakaar, After the Hulk devestated the planet, He now wages War against anything in his way.

name: Firepower
deck: A powerful robotic suit equipped with multiple weapons created by the US government. Firepower comes into conflict with Iron Man because it is equipped with stolen armor technology. A new suit was recently sunk by James Rhodes off the coast of Somalia.

name: Sui-San
deck: Sui-San was a female Eternal, wife of Mentor and mother to Thanos and Eros. She was killed by her son Thanos.

name: Megan Summers
deck: Megan Summers is a member of GeNeXt and the firstborn daughter of Scott and Emma Summers.

name: Hellhorse
deck: Once the horse of Black Knight, Elendil became Dreadknight's Hellhorse.

name: Cosmic Hulk
deck: A Hulk robot containing the Power Cosmic

name: Victor Hudson
deck: Victor Hudson is Romulus' blind and mute right-hand man.

name: Kára
deck: Kara is a Disir.

name: Hellverine
deck: A mysterious Demon that took over Wolverine's body while his soul is in Hell.

name: Maw
deck: Maw is one of the Inferno Babies. He has superfluous mouths with razor sharp teeth all over his body. The teeth in these mouths provide him with heightened invulnerability and he can speak and eat with these mouths. He and his brood were unaffected by the events of M-Day, however he is currently deceased.

name: Timothy
deck: Timothy is one of the Inferno Babies.

name: Doctor Spectrum (Obatu)
deck: Kinji Obatu was chosen by the Grandmaster to become Earth-616's Doctor Spectrum and a member of the Squadron Sinister.

name: Dancing Water
deck: A member of the Red Skull's S-Men. She claims to be the daughter of Avalanche.

name: Vista
deck: A Microneural Biologist and a huge fan of Bruce Banner suffering from Creutzfeldt–Jakob disease. She is part of Banner's team of S.H.I.E.L.D. scientists.

name: Daredevil
deck: A young boy named David Jarret whom was seemingly the last normal person on Earth. That was untill he died, and seemingly had the power to revive himself. In adulthood, he became Daredevil, a circus performer with the inability to die and be reborn despite his best wishes.

name: Hei Hei
deck: Angie Huang's pet monkey.

name: Pinch
deck: Pinch is a mercenary currently operating as a member of an assault team working for The Offer, alongside Wolverine and several other individuals. Her powers, if any, are currently unknown. She appears to be intimate with Logan, though it's unconfirmed whether they're involved.

name: Lost Boy
deck: Lost Boy  is a mercenary currently operating as a member of an assault team working for The Offer.

name: Chipmunk Hunk
deck: Tomas Lara-Perez is a student at Empire State University and the crime-fighting partner of rookie hero Koi Boi. He has the power to talk to chipmunks.

name: Kara Bohusk
deck: One of Beak's and Angel's six kids.

name: Snowguard
deck: Young activist that joined the Champions.

name: One Below All
deck: The One Below All is a malevolent cosmic entity and counterpart of the One Above All. It dwells in the Below-Place, the lowest level of hell, and is the source of gamma energy in the Marvel Universe.

name: Alvi Brorson
deck: The second born of an Asgardian palace guard and the powerful sorceress Enchantress, Alvi is an Asgardian enrolled at Strange Academy.

name: Lauri-Ell
deck: Half sister of Carol Danvers.

name: Leo Eng
deck: Leonara Eng is a teenage mutant living on Krakoa.

name: Princess
deck: The "Carnage 2.0" implanted in Deadpool by Harrower. It seems to have taken a liking to Wade.

name: Challenger
deck: Golden age hero.

name: Native
deck: She's a mutant with regenerative healing, six retractable bone claws and animal senses (just like Wolverine but without the adamantium).

name: Yandroth
deck: Enemy of Dr. Strange and the Defenders.

name: Hellinger
deck: Harlan Ryker (aka Hellinger) is the creator of Deathlok and the father of Deathlocket who sought to take over world and replace humanity with cyborgs under his control.

name: Tom Foster
deck: Tom Foster is the nephew of Bill Foster a.k.a. Black Goliath. After his uncle died, Tom took on the identity of the hero known as Goliath.

name: Red Norvell
deck: Roger Norvell or Red as he prefers to be known was a member of film crew making a documentary. He gained Thor like powers given to him by Loki to try and beat Thor.

name: Donald Trask
deck: Dentist from Alberquerque, New Mexico and the nephew of Bolivar Trask.

name: Gris-Gris
deck: Gris-Gris is a member of the New Orleans Assassins Guild.

name: Wolf
deck: Wolf is the rough-edged member of The Thunderiders.

name: Calypso
deck: The woman named Calypso has a history shrouded in mystery. She was the lover and partner of Kraven until he met his demise, and she carries on his hate for Spider-Man.

name: Whitewash Jones
deck: Golden age character, one of the Young Allies.

name: Steel Guardian
deck: Previously known as Red Guardian, Josef Petkus was an agent of several intelligence agencies, and was also a member of The Supreme Soviets and Winter Guard.

name: Jeff
deck: Golden age character, one of the Young Allies.

name: Rae LaCoste
deck: Rae LaCoste is a salon owner.  She was an acquaintance of Tony Stark, and ex girlfriend of James Rhodes.

name: Vic Martinelli
deck: Chief of Security at Stark International

name: Boris Korpse
deck: Dr. Boris Korpse is a master scientist and former henchman of the Black Cat.

name: Old Skull
deck: Old skull is a member of Killraven's group of Freedom Fighters.

name: Captain Savage
deck: Simon Savage was a United States Marine Corps Captain who is best remembered for having commanded the Leatherneck Raiders during World War II.

name: Count Tagar
deck: An evolved tiger that was created by the High Evolutionary.

name: Jerry Sapristi
deck: Cousin of Nick Fury.

name: Cuthbert Allgood
deck: One of Roland Deschain's childhood friends and fellow gunslinger.

name: Jann of the Jungle
deck: Jane Hastings was a stunt-woman and animal trainer who helped the local people of the Congo out in time of need. Becoming the adventurer Jann of the Jungle, she is a friend and ally to the Agents of Atlas.

name: Daria
deck: A prime sentinel that looked like a young teenage girl with her head shaved who helped Bastion conduct Operation: Zero Tolerance. She eventually switched sides, deciding to help Jubilee escape.

name: Snapdragon
deck: A martial arts master who has clashed with the avengers Black Widow and Captain America. She was a mercenary and assassin.

name: Ereshkigal
deck: A dimension-hopping Deviant who ended up possessing the Star Brand and nearly becoming the most powerful being in existence.

name: Black Widow (Voyant)
deck: Golden Age heroine and servant of Satan. She is part of the team of World War II heroes known as The Twelve.

name: Freak
deck: Junkie who hangs out at the homeless shelter where May Parker volunteers.

name: Goblin Force
deck: The polar opposite of the Phoenix Force, an evil entity that ruins everyone's life and reeks havoc to the universe.

name: Mayhem
deck: The clone of May Parker (Spider-Girl). She was biologically reengineered to be a symbiote hybrid. After naming herself April in order to interact with ordinary life, she gave herself the name Mayhem to operate under in her superhuman activities. April dies in a building explosion while fighting Spider-Girl.

name: Enchantress (Lushton)
deck: Sylvie Lushton was empowered by Loki and became the teenage sorceress known as the Enchantress who serves as a powerful member of the Young Masters.

name: Prince Pharoid
deck: Leader of the Aegyptians on the sandzone of homeworld known as Aegyptia.

name: Milo Gunderson
deck: Milo Gunderson was a mentally challenged mutant with super-strength. Taking advantage of his simple mind, Cyber gained control of his body.

name: Ex Nihila
deck: A female Ex Nihili. She is seen more promenantly during the events of Infinity, and even aids the Avengers in stopping the Incursions.

name: Lineage
deck: The head of the Nobili family who swore revenge on the Punisher after the death of his sons. He later became an enemy of the Inhumans and an ally to Maximus and the Unspoken.

name: Angie Huang
deck: A paralegal working at Jennifer Walters' law firm.

name: Agent Haines
deck: A SHIELD agent, tasked to bring in Magneto.

name: Wave
deck: Filipina superhero with hydrokinetic powers. Pearl Pangan is a hot-tempered working class hero from Cebu, who fights for her local community and everyone in the Philippines. She recently joined the international Agents of Atlas, and is a trainee member of the Filipino team Triumph Division.

name: Sister Dagger
deck: Esme is the leader of the House of the Deadly Dagger, sister of Shang-Chi, and champion of the Five Weapons Society.

name: Bedlam
deck: A version of Eddie Brock whose memories were stripped by Ben Reilly and Madelyne Pryor, resulting in a hollow façade of Venom that ultimately transformed into Bedlam after a confrontation with Synch of the X-Men.

name: Alpine
deck: Bucky's cat.

name: Ben Liu
deck: A mutant rescued by the Alaska team of X-men.

name: Temujin
deck: Temujin is the son of the Mandarin and a member of the Agents of Atlas. Inheriting the Mandarin's powerful rings, Temujin resolved to use his father's resources to bring tranquillity rather than terror to the world.

name: Hiro
deck: A young genius who invented Baynax, and became a member, and eventually the leader of the Japanese superhero team Big Hero 6.

name: Baymax
deck: A mighty robot created by Hiro Takachiho to be his bodyguard, and friend, and a member of Big Hero 6.

name: Stacy
deck: Former member of The Warheads and The Dark Guard.

name: Jeanie Johnson
deck: A fashion girl in 40's Marvel.

name: Eric Slaughter
deck: A long time member of the mob, Eric Slaughter employed a group of thugs, for various criminal activities in New York City.

name: Iron Maiden
deck: Super spy and agent of the former USSR, Iron Maiden has always lived in the shadow of Natasha Romanova, the Black Widow, and is quite jealous of her.

name: Marcus Kang
deck: Marcus Kang is the son of the time-travelling world conqueror known as Kang.

name: Lynn Michaels
deck: NYPD officer, Lady Punisher and one time S.H.I.E.L.D operative.

name: Scaleface
deck: Member of the group Morlocks as well as their sub-group the Tunnelers. She was killed by police and has been revived twice since.

name: Ice Phillips
deck: A Vietnam War soldier.

name: Hijacker
deck: The Hijacker was a minor criminal that used his Crime Tank called the Murder Machine to wreck havoc. He would meet his demise at the Bar with No Name as one of the victims of the Scourge of the Underworld, but was later resurrected.

name: Sir Ram
deck: Sir Ram has the ability to super leap and is easily strong enough to tear through a brick wall can lift about 7 tons and run at about 80 mph

name: Haven
deck: Radha Dastoor had within her a powerful mutant fetus that had stalled development and stayed within her as a sentient being. It had various abilities including the ability to act through its mother.

name: Harriet Palermo
deck: Harriet was a tenant of May Parker's boardinghouse

name: Sabreclaw
deck: Hudson Logan is the son of Wolverine on Earth-982(MC2). He is also the half-brother of Wild Thing.

name: Aegis
deck: Aegis is a superhero with a mystical impenetrable breastplate that generates force-fields.

name: Mephista
deck: Mephisto's daughter.

name: Nadia Blonsky
deck: Nadia Dornova is the wife of Emil Blonsky

name: Shakti
deck: Shakti channels tantric magic to use her power. In X-men: The End, she is a member of Mr. Sinister's Marauders.

name: Divinity
deck: In X-men: The End, Divinity was a member of Mr. Sinister's Marauders.

name: Technarx
deck: A member of a future incarnation of the Mister Sinister's Marauders in the X-Man the End. A possible counterpart of his exist in the 616 and was use by Doctor Doom to invade counter-Earth.

name: Mistress Love
deck: A cosmic being that is the embodiment of the abstract concept of love. It manifests as several differences in its appearance but most usually takes the form of a beautiful tall blond humanoid with pink colored flowing garbs.

name: Manacle
deck: Mutant agent of Ransome Sole and Elias Bogan.

name: All-American
deck: You're looking at the one and only Jack Magniconte, star quarterback for the New York Smashers! After developing paranormal powers, Jack founded Kickers, Inc. to use said abilities to help others handle off-the-wall problems that no one else could!

name: Zenobia
deck: Zenobia was a Nemedian concubine who became the queen consort of Conan, King of Aquilonia.

name: Captain England
deck: The Captain Britain of Earth-522

name: Clytemnestra Erwin
deck: Dr. Clytemnestra Erwin was a business partner with Morley Erwin (her brother) and Tony Stark in creating the company Circuits Maximus.

name: Nefarius
deck: Nefarius, formerly known as Moonstone, is an immensely powerful super-villain and an enemy of the Avengers.

name: Wraith (DeWolff)
deck: A victim of his own powers, Wraith went through various stages of mental stability using his psionic powers to act as a vigilante.

name: Junior Juniper
deck: Jonathan "Junior" Juniper was a member of the Howling Commandos during WWII.  He has the distinction of being the first recurring character to die in a Marvel comic, and one of the only Howling Commandos to perish in battle.

name: Robert Minoru
deck: Husband of Tina and father to Nico of the Runaways, Robert Minoru is a dark wizard and member of the Pride.

name: Rover
deck: Rover is one of the last Sentinels on Earth-15104. After 150 years of life, he has apparently become almost sentient. Companion to Tom Skylark, they join the ranks of the future X-Men to appose the Beast (who has been taken over by Sublime).

name: Ravenous
deck: Ravenous was one of Annihilus' highest ranking warriors and leader of the Seekers. He ruled the empire as a caretaker after Annihilus' death until losing the throne to Blastaar and becoming a prisoner of the Nova Corps.

name: Alain Johns
deck: Gunslinger and one of Roland Deschain's childhood friends.

name: Tom Lennox
deck: Tom Lennox was a member of Strike's Psi Division. He was romantically involved with Betsy Braddock. He was killed protecting her from the soldiers of Sir Jim Jaspers.

name: Patrick
deck: Patrick was cloned from the body of Michael Van Patrick (MVP) of the Initiative after his death, and is one of the Initiative's Scarlet Spiders. He is the last surviving Scarlet Spider.

name: Muramasa
deck: Muramasa is an excellent skillful smith of a violent and somewhat insane mind. All of his swords are extremely sharp which are bolstered through his the ability to put souls in his weapons making them infinitely more effective, and lethal. These soul blades hunger for the will of the soul used to make it.

name: Empress R'Klll
deck: Wife of Dorrek VII and mother of Anelle, she slayed her husband to become Empress. She died when Galactus ate Tarnax IV.

name: Colosso
deck: X-Men's training robot

name: Janice Cord
deck: The daughter of Drexel Cord, one of Tony Stark's business rivals. Janice later dated Stark.

name: Monster of Badoon
deck: The Monster of Badoon is the greatest weapon of the Brotherhood of the Badoon

name: Henry Russo
deck: A talented computer hacker, Henry Russo was The Punisher's last technical assistant, and abandoned son of scarred villain Jigsaw!

name: Conchata O'Hara
deck: Mother of Spider-Man 2099.

name: Stone
deck: Stone was a favored pupil of Stick and helped train both Daredevil and Elektra. Also, is second in command of the good ninja cell called Chaste to Stick.

name: Brad
deck: Leader of the Mystikos Sect.

name: Lieutenant General Fredricks
deck: Lieutenant General Fredricks is a minor Marvel character created by Jack Kirby. He is rather similar in appearance to Thaddeus Ross and has turned up in various Fantastic Four and X-Men stories.

name: Fred Sloan
deck: A friend of the Hulk.

name: Stanley Osborn
deck: The child of Menace.

name: Miriam Sharpe
deck: The mother of Damien Sharpe, one of the children who died in the Stamford incident. She became an activist urging for superhumans to be registered.

name: Tarantula (Vasquez)
deck: María is the fourth and current superhuman known as Tarántula. She is an accomplished martial artist and highly skilled in using the blades on her wrists and toes of her boots.

name: Goat-Faced Girl
deck: A member of the S-Men wearing a goat mask.

name: Weapon XIII
deck: A clone of Fantomex, he encompasses all of his original mutant-hunting Sentinel programming and killing compulsions.

name: Junk
deck: Weapon X test subject.

name: Doctor Spectrum (Nenet)
deck: A young female hero known as Nenet. She originated from a different reality [Earth 4290001] but has since joined a group of super-powered individuals known as the Squadron Supreme on Earth 616.

name: Norio
deck: The leader of the Raksha.

name: Iric Brorson
deck: The first born of an Asgardian palace guard and the powerful sorceress Enchantress, Iric is an Asgardian enrolled in Strange Academy.

name: Apex
deck: Prince Otherone of Noblor was chosen by the Power Gem after Adam Warlock imbued it with the ability to choose its own destiny.

name: Third Eye
deck: A psychic mutant who formerly worked as an arcane assassin.  Sentenced to the Pit by Krokoa's Quiet Council, and was released to hunt down Sabretooth.

name: Skidsy Spencer
deck: On-off boyfriend of Tessie the typist and frequent victim of the later's antics.

name: Pretty Persuasions
deck: A former stripper who first appeared as a member of Psionex and battled the New Warriors.

name: Dinah Soar
deck: The dead, one time girlfriend of Mr. Immortal and member of the Great Lakes Avengers

name: Augustus Pugliese
deck: A  lawyer for Goodman, Lieber, Kurtzburg and Holliway. His life was saved by Spider-man and ever since has dedicated himself to helping out super heroes. He had an unrequited crush on Jennifer Walters.

name: Honey Lemon
deck: Honey Lemon is a Japanese superhero and member of the Big Hero 6, who has a power purse in which she has access to another, unknown dimension from which she can pull out all kinds of items.

name: Mister Jip
deck: An evil ancient wizard who absorbs the lifeforce of others to survive. He can assume the form of any of his past victims. He was the very first apprentice of the Ancient One, the future teacher of Dr Strange.

name: Mojo II
deck: A clone of Mojo with a spine, Mojo II sought the overthrow of Mojo, though shared his affinity for slaves and gladiator reality entertainment.

name: Pearl
deck: Marvel "creative" replacement for Irma Peterson.

name: Mercy
deck: A missionary of extraterrestrial origin who takes it upon herself to kill those who don't have the strength to commit suicide out of despair, thinking she's doing them a favor.

name: Squorm
deck: A member of the The Imperial Guard.

name: Hannah Fairmont
deck: Receptionist at Memorial Hospital and the love interest to Jake Olsen.

name: The Fin
deck: Golden age character. He discovered he could breathe underwater, developed super-strength and found a magic sword.

name: Retro Girl
deck: Helped as a very young girl by Christian Walker, Calista Secor grew up to become the second Retro Girl. She is now mentored by Walker and a member of the supporting cast of Powers, a creator-owned series by Brian Michael Bendis and Michael Avon Oeming.

name: Viper (Dixon)
deck: One of the founders of the Serpent Squad and brother to Eel. He was eventually slain by Madame Hydra who usurped his name.

name: Enforcer (Delazny)
deck: A criminal mercenary and assassin for hire, operating mainly on the West Coast of the United States. He was killed by the Scourge.

name: Cybelle
