deck: Member of the group called the Morlocks, Cybelle is able to emit corrosive acid from her skin.

name: Dreadknight
deck: Bram Velsing was once a Latverian scientist, until he was disfigured by Doctor Doom. Declaring revenge, he became the Dreadknight.

name: Martin Soap
deck: An extremely unlucky NYPD detective assigned to head the Punisher Task Force.

name: Silver Dagger
deck: A former priest, the Silver Dagger is a self-appointed  executioner of blasphemous creatures and practioneers. He is a long-time foe of Doctor Strange and Werewolf by Night.

name: Raymond Warren
deck: Raymond Warren is a science teacher and mentor of Peter Parker while he was in school on Midtown High. He formed Peter by encouraging his love for science.

name: Achmed El-Gibar
deck: One of the most skilled thieves in Egypt and leader of the street urchins, Achmed was mostly known for taking in Storm after she lost her parents, and training her in the arts of thievery and hand to hand combat. He died several years after Storm joined the X-Men.

name: Master Hate
deck: A cosmic being that is the embodiment of hate

name: Reptyl
deck: Reptyl is a notorious space pirate who harbors a special hatred for any non-reptilian being.

name: Carrie Alexander
deck: A marine biologist whom allied with, and became a romantic interest of, Namor the Submariner

name: Pamela Hawley
deck: Pamela Hawley was a lover of Nick Fury during World War II. She was a medic of the British Red Cross. She was killed in a German air raid on London.

name: Eduardo Lobo
deck: Eduardo can turn into a werewolf

name: Anelle
deck: Mother of Hulkling and Skrull Royalty.

name: Scuzz
deck: Scuzz is a Paranormal who generates corrosives from his skin, and can throw it as "fireballs". He cannot shut his power off.

name: Bart Jones
deck: Father of Firestar.

name: Harokin
deck: Harokin is a deceased Asgardian who was once a foe of Thor. He was used by Hela, the Asgardian goddess of death, in an attempt to seduce Thor into entering Valhalla, the home of the honored Asgardian dead.

name: The Lord High Papal
deck: The current leader of the Church of the Instrumentality.

name: Iron-Hand Hauptmann
deck: A former Nazi and member of the Red Skull's villainous Exiles. Hauptmann wields a mechanical iron glove with abilities similar to the Satan Claw.

name: Kathryn Worthington
deck: Mother of Warren Worthington III a.k.a. the X-men's Angel.

name: Inertia
deck: Edith Freiberg, was a member of the Squadron Supreme who joined the team following the commands of Nighthawk, when the Squadron Supreme started their ill-driven Utopia Program,

name: Frank Dean
deck: Frank Dean is an alien exiled from his home world Majesdane. Husband of Leslie and mother to Karolina Dean, the Runaways member, he is also a founding member of The Pride.

name: Leslie Dean
deck: Leslie Dean is an alien exiled from her home world Majesdane. Wife of Frank and mother to Karolina Dean, the Runaways member, she is also a founding member of The Pride.

name: Specter
deck: Dallas Gibson was a member of the Corsairs training squad at the Xavier Institute. His mutant power enabled him to merge with his own shadow, granting him superhuman abilities. He was depowered post M-Day and one of the few students whom survived William Stryker's bus bomb, due to obtaining a ride home from his grandfather, rather than boarding the bus.

name: Black Marvel
deck: Golden age character.

name: John Porter
deck: Account Executive for Damage control.

name: Gargouille
deck: Gargouille was one of the Acolytes who aided Cortez' with his attack on Wundagore.

name: Dreamqueen
deck: Dreamqueen is the ruler of Liveworld, a dream dimension. She is also the daughter of Nightmare.

name: Anya Eisenhardt
deck: Anya was the first child of Magneto and his wife Magda.

name: Powerhouse
deck: Rieg Davan, professionally known as Powerhouse, is the strongman and energy siphoner of the superhumanoid group of heroes from the planet Xandar named The Champions of Xandar.

name: Dr. Zander Rice
deck: Dr. Rice was the surgical head of the project which created X-23. He was later killed by her.

name: Cerebro
deck: Cerebro a living machine that helps Magneto and the X-Men in the Mutant X universe.

name: Raksor
deck: He fought against the Kree Bel-Dann for the final resolution of the first Kree-Skrull War.

name: Heather Rand
deck: Born to Thomas Duncan, member of one of the wealthiest merchant families in the United States, she fell in love and married Wendell Rand, a businessman of obscure origins and later gave birth to a son named Daniel Thomas Rand.

name: N'Gassi
deck: One of King T'Challa's most trusted advisers & former Regent of Wakanda.

name: Jack Abrams
deck: A surgeon and member of the Purifiers.

name: Kuurth
deck: Kuurth, Breaker of Stone, is one of The Serpent's Worthy. He was in possession of The Juggernaut's body during Fear Itself and was using it to wreak havoc and instill fear across the United States.

name: Quickshot
deck: Quickshot is a Korean vampire. He is a member of the Forgiven.

name: Visigoth
deck: Visigoth is the brutish vampire member of the Forgiven.

name: Harper
deck: Genius scientist serving Bastion at Operation: Zero Tolerance

name: Nighteyes
deck: Nighteyes is one of the Forgiven. She is a vampire loyal to Raizo Kodo.

name: Malice
deck: Malice is an evil entity of unknown origin that possessed the vulnerable Invisible Woman after she lost her daughter and influenced her behavior in negative ways.

name: Mzee
deck: Mzee is a tortoise-like member of the Red-Skull's S-Men.

name: Living Wind
deck: Living Wind is a member of the Red Skull's S-Men.

name: Eobar Garrington
deck: Black Knight during the Crusades, was possessed by a time-travelling Dane Whitman.

name: Wendy Kawasaki
deck: Captain Marvel's personal assistant.

name: Harrison Snow
deck: The CEO of Serval Industries and bankroller for the All-New X-Factor team.

name: Forey
deck: Forey is the service dog of the blind Inhuman Reader and always travels by his side.

name: Swain
deck: A new Inhuman who started to work for Crystal. After terrigenesis, she developed a lizard tail.

name: Quark
deck: Former soldier for Mojo, whom later joined the rebellion. He is a friend of Longshot and Dazzler in the Mojoverse.

name: Gog
deck: An alien emissary to Mojo and father to Magog, Gog has had many run-ins with the X-Men and Longshot.

name: Coldblood
deck: Eric Savin oversaw the Ultra-Tech project for the U.S. Army. He discovered the project lead was a traitor and Eric was killed when he confronted the traitor. He was reborn as the cyborg Coldblood-7.

name: CLOC
deck: Cloc helps Sentry by telling him about crisis around the world.

name: Slither
deck: Slither is a mutant that has been a member of Mutant Force, Serpent Society and the second Brotherhood Of Evil Mutants.

name: Barbara Ketch
deck: Barbara Ketch was a sister to Dan Ketch, half-sister to Johnny Blaze and cousin to Jennifer and Andrew Kale.

name: Arthur Chekov
deck: Arthur Chekov was a native Eastern-Europian tenant of the boarding house of May Parker

name: Big Brain
deck: Mr. Fantastic's counterpart on Earth-982 (MC2).

name: Paris
deck: Paris is an empath and a member of the Pantheon.

name: John Watkins III
deck: Citizen V is a legendary hero that spans generations. The name has not only spread throughout a family but was also used by other people including superheroes, and even super-villains.

name: Brother Royal
deck: Leader of the Brotherhood of Badoon.

name: Maxie Shiffman
deck: Maxie Shiffman was Spider-Man's agent. He later became a temporary pawn of Mysterio.

name: Captain Atlas
deck: Captain Atlas is a warrior and decorated Captain of the Kree military who worked with Doctor Minerva during Operation: Galactic Storm.

name: Twilight
deck: Lenore constantly gives off light which induces fatigue in others while restoring her own life-force. She normally keeps herself fully covered to avoid harming others.

name: R.U. Reddy
deck: R.U. Reddy is the hot-headed loose cannon of The Thunderiders.

name: Mike Farrell
deck: Mike Farrell was a one-time friend of Steve Rogers who became a super-villain known as Super-Patriot.

name: Karl von Horstbadden
deck: Karl von Horstbadden (aka Fritz von Voltzmann) is a former Nazi scientist and the right-hand-man of the Yellow Claw.

name: Possessor
deck: One of the Elders of the Universe whose obsession is knowledge.

name: Simon Stroud
deck: Special Police Task Force Agent agent turned mercenary who has tangled with Man-Wolf and Morbius....

name: Jay Little Bear
deck: Member of The Laetherneck Raiders and the Deadly Dozen.

name: Barbara Denton Norriss
deck: Barbara Denton-Norris was originally a minor magic user, finding herself a pawn for much more powerful forces. She went insane. Her body served as a host to Valkyrie. Her disembodied mind later took over Brunnhilde's original body for a while. Much later Barbara was resurrected.

name: Gladiatrix
deck: A former wrestler, Gladiatrix turned over a new leaf and attempted to join the Avengers.  During Civil War, she worked with the Secret Avengers.

name: Skreet
deck: Skreet is a Chaos Mite and resembles a tiny, human-like fairy or a "Pixie...from Irish Folk Tales." She guided Thanos during the Annihilation comic book event.

name: Kenjiro Tanaka
deck: A close friend of Wendell Vaughn who worked with him both in S.H.I.E.L.D. and as a partner at Vaughn Securities.

name: Arch-E
deck: One of Hulk's Warbound.  He is the robotic looking one.  He was a communications bot and former slave until Hulk defeated the Emperor on Sakaar.

name: Fiery Mask
deck: Fiery Mask is a Golden Age hero and part of the group of World War II heroes known as the Twelve.

name: Tiger's Beautiful Daughter
deck: Immortal Weapon of one of the Seven Cities of Heaven..many a man has found his doom at her hand..or in her bed.

name: Colossusus
deck: A baby Colossus created by Mojo that lives in the Mojoverse. He is a member of the X-babies

name: Silver Scorpion
deck: Golden age character and honorary member of the Invaders.  Member of the V-Battalion's Penance Council.

name: General Demetrius Lazer
deck: The head of O*N*E* known who was openly anti-mutant.

name: Ismael Ortega
deck: Ismael Ortega is a police officer who patrolled Mutant Town. For a time he was partnered with X-Man and fellow law-officer Lucas Bishop.

name: Shelly Conklin
deck: Shelley Conklin is the Captain of Code Blue and follows the stratagemes of Lt. Stone

name: Doug Powell
deck: A mercenary for Silver Sable International.  Member of Silver Sable's Wild Pack alpha team.

name: Al MacKenzie
deck: Former member of SHIELD and the CIA

name: Joseph MacTaggert
deck: Ex-Husband of Moira Mac Taggert and Father of Kevin Mac Taggert aka. Proteus.

name: Cosmo
deck: Member of Shi'ar Imperial Guard

name: Azari
deck: Azari T'challa T'chacka Evan Duke of Wakanda, is the son of Black Panther and Storm.

name: Sigurd
deck: Sigurd, the Ever Glorious is a legend to Asgardians and considered to be the first hero. He had been living next door to the New Mutants, disguised as a young man named Zig.

name: Mudbug
deck: A lobster-resembling mutant recruited by Kade Kilgore.

name: Snot
deck: Student at the Hellfire Academy.

name: Czar Doon
deck: Member of the Slaughter Squad.

name: Teen Abomination
deck: A 13-year-old kid who gained powers similar to that of the Abomination after being exposed to a small amount of gamma radiation.

name: Peggy Rae
deck: Peggy Rae is Scott Lang (Ant-Man)'s ex-wife and the mother of Cassie Lang (Stature).

name: Max Brashear
deck: Blue Marvel's son.

name: Starbrand 1,000,000 BC
deck: A caveman who was the second Starbrand and member of Firehair's Avengers.

name: Iron Fist 1,000,000 BC
deck: Born one million years ago in the sacred city of K'un-Lun, Fan Fei was the first person ever to defeat the dragon Shou-Lao and win the power of the Iron Fist.

name: Quick
deck: A mutant of Arakko that survived Uranus' attack. She and her brother were adopted by Craig Marshall.

name: Corina Ellis
deck: Warden of Graymalkin Prison.

name: Deathurge
deck: The herald of Oblivion.

name: Crusader
deck: Arthur Blackwood heeds the call of his ancestors and becomes the Crusader. He has fought numerous heroes including Thor, Wolverine, Luke Cage and Nate Gray.

name: Powderkeg
deck: Secretes an explosive on his hands which is impact-detonated by his punches. It was either this name or "Boom Box". He is immune to his own explosions.

name: Planet Terry
deck: A Marvel/Star Comics original space-hero! Mostly for the younger kids.

name: Ladyhawk
deck: The hero known as Ladyhawk is actually two people, twins Regina and Rosetta Morgan.  Created to avenge the death of Falcon at the hands of their criminal father they later joined the New Warriors.

name: Misha
deck: Member of the Warheads.

name: Parnell Jacobs
deck: Parnell and Jim Rhodes fought together in the US Army. After Parnell quit the Army, he began selling weapons in the black market but the abduction of his wife, forced him to help Rhodes once again.

name: Gemini
deck: members of the Zodiac

name: Vakume
deck: Vakume was born in New Salem, Colorado and was a member of Salem's Seven.

name: Equilibrius
deck: Mutant member of the group known as The Beast-Brood/Savage Land Mutates. His gaze disables opponents by causing an intense feeling of vertigo.

name: Shamrock
deck: Granted her luck powers through supernatural means, Molly Fitzgerald become the crime fighting hero known as Shamrock.

name: Asmodeus
deck: A major Hell-Lord.

name: Brother Tode
deck: Warlord of the Deviants

name: Honcho
deck: Honcho is the leader of the motorcycle stunt team The Thunderiders.

name: Smart Alec
deck: A man with the computer brain, he is the smartest man in the world!

name: Blackwing
deck: The son of crime lord Silvermane, who struck out on his own to become a costumed criminal, using trained bats and martial arts to carry out his plans.  Has been a member of the Skeleton Crew, Hydra, the Masters of Evil, and Heavy Mettle.  An enemy of Captain America and the Thunderbolts.

name: Kray-Tor
deck: Kray-Tor was once a corupt judge in the Church of Truth before being trapped in the Soul World

name: Sugar Kane
deck: Pop star of the Marvel Universe. Former lover of Chamber.

name: Webwing
deck: A member of the Shi'ar Imperial Guard that resembles an Earth octopus.

name: Debra Levin
deck: Russian spy who worked for several intelligence offices.

name: Lucifer
deck: Demon. Ghost Rider villain.

name: Achilles
deck: Achilles is a member of the Pantheon and practically invulnerable.

name: Spat
deck: Spat & her partner Grovel are bounty hunters. She used to be partners with Gambit.

name: Lifeforce
deck: Lifeforce was a member of the Dark Riders.  She always spoke in whispers, and was killed by Wolverine.

name: Wyre
deck: Assassin for hire and a pale, if not outright, imitation of Cable.

name: Marilla
deck: Marilla was Luna's nanny, and her mother Crystal's nanny when she was a girl. She was murdered by a brain washed Tony Stark.

name: Desmond Marrs
deck: Marrs is a foe of Prince Namor.

name: T.E.S.S.-One
deck: TESS-One: Total Elimination of Super Soldiers was created by scientist  Daniel Schumann and programmed to act as a failsafe in case the members of the Super Soldier project was abusing its powers.

name: Conn
deck: Son of Conan and Zenobia.

name: Tongah
deck: Inhabitant of the Savage Land, chief of Fall People tribe and friend of Ka-Zar.

name: Walter Hardy
deck: The father of Felicia Hardy (the Black Cat). He was once known as the cat burglar called "The Cat".

name: Bernie Dillon
deck: Richard Rider's friend at Harry's Truman High School in New York.

name: Anteus
deck: A member of the Neo, Anteus is the powerhouse of the clan. He gets stronger the more in contact he is with the earth and the environment.

name: Albert Cleary
deck: Albert Cleary is a member of the Damage Control company. He is their controller.

name: Wraith
deck: Wraith's background is shrouded in mystery, he first appeared during the second part of the Annihilation Saga.  He is on a mission that is his own.

name: Googam
deck: Googam is an alien child, the son of Goom from Planet X.

name: Chance
deck: A young Korean refugee, Chance is a member of the Fallen Angels.  She is a young street thief with the mutant power to enhance or disrupt any mutant's X-Factor.

name: Kasper Cole
deck: A New York cop-turned superhero, once known as Black Panther, and now one of the many heroes to take the name White Tiger.  Has enhanced physical attributes derived from a synthetic copy of the Wakandan heart-shaped herb.

name: Shugah
deck: Shugah is one of the X-Babies created by Mojo. She is the 'baby-version' of Rogue

name: Ogeode
deck: A great wizard of Order responsible for changing Crystar into his crystal form. More recently, he was slayed by Goletta, the Wizard slayer and emerged in a cat-like form. He soon joined the heroes on their quest.

name: Sapphire Styx
deck: A mysterious woman who Wolverine meets in Madripoor, who attempts to seduce him, she is actually a mutant psychic vampire who sadistically drains the Life-Forces of innocent people with no remorse for her actions.

name: Dr. Rottwell
deck: Dr. Rottwell leads the Dunwich Sanatorium. He's a hopelessly insane genius whose gruesome machinations have earned him the nickname, Doctor Rot.

name: Kidpool
deck: Kidpool is a younger version of Deadpool from an alternative dimension but shares the same... quirks as the original.

name: Yu Komori
deck: On Earth-70091, Japanese High School student Yu Komori became Spider-Man instead of Peter Parker, like his American counterpart he uses his spider-like abilities to protect the people of Japan from those who would destroy them.

name: Janice Hollenbeck
deck: A Double-Agent during the Cold-War, she was killed by Sabretooth. Wolverine buried the Carbonadium-Synthesizer along with her in her casket.

name: Foolkiller (Gerhardt)
deck: Kurt Gerhardt is the third Foolkiller. He lived a pretty ordinary life... that was until his father was killed by muggers, he was made redundant from his job and his wife left him. Soon after, he became the Foolkiller after empathising with the second's view of the world.
A Rigellian recorder who set in motion a chain of events that led to Tony Stark becoming who he is today.

name: The Offer
deck: A crime boss who tends to make offers that are impossible to refuse.

name: Marisol Guerra
deck: New Young mutant.

name: Hitzig
deck: Herr Hitzig is a Nazi soldier from Magneto's past.

name: Hexadecimal
deck: A member of the Raksha who can control mechanical objects.

name: Whisper Doll
deck: A mutant from Madripoor and a member of the Raksha. Her abilities include an immunity to telepathy and combat, both armed and unarmed.

name: Ghost Rider 1,000,000 BC
deck: First Spirit of Vengeance. Member of the Avengers 1,000,000 BC.

name: Kayla
deck: Kayla is a Krakoan mutant who enters into a relationship with Colossus.

name: Jane Stacy
deck: Friend of Irma Peterson.

name: Sevyr Blackmore
deck: Arakkii pirate and crime lord.

name: Cam Long
deck: Cam Long is one of the mutants killed during the Sentinels' attack on Genosha, reappears as a citizen of Krakoa, probably resurrected by The Five.

name: Captain Bretland
deck: Captaine Bretland from Earth-904 is a member of the reformed Captain Britain Corps.

name: Capricorn (Weir)
deck: member of Zodiac.

name: Patch
deck: Owner of the Hell House and assignment dispatcher for mercenaries there. Sometimes employer/ally of Deadpool.

name: Slice
deck: Slice is a renegade ninja from the Arashikage Clan and a member of Cobra. He is a skilled swordsman whose attack emulates that of a scorpion. Slice sacrifices stealth and subtlety in favor of brutal and overwhelming attacks.

name: Dice
deck: Dice is a ninja employed by COBRA and the partner of Slice.

name: Tubs
deck: Friend of Patsy Walker

name: Vamp
deck: Vamp/Animus is an enemy of Captain America and Falcon

name: Centurious
deck: Supernatural Villain

name: Walrus
deck: Hubert Carpenter has been a guinea pig for his Uncle Humbert's experiments for a number of years that have been quite unsuccessful. Until one day when his uncle's Omicron-Ray Generator gave Hubert superhuman strength and his career as a criminal began. Beware the Walrus!!

name: Grim Hunter
deck: Grim Hunter is a fictional character by Marvel comics. Grim Hunter is one of the sons of the original Kraven The Hunter.

name: Sluggo
deck: Part of the Weapon X program, Sluggo is a friend to Deadpool, as well as a fellow mercenary

name: Annex
deck: A U.S. soldier, Alexander Ellis was an amputee whose search for a better prosthetic led him to becoming a technology-powered hero.

name: Barbara London
deck: Mother of Dazzler and Lois London. Originally a singer, later a music teacher.

name: Outlaw
deck: Emulating his idol, the Punisher as the Punisher in London.

name: Wild Thing
deck: Daughter of Elektra and Wolverine on Earth-982 (MC2).  Rina is considered to be just as deadly and unstoppable as Wolverine, and highly skilled ninja as Elektra.

name: Hamir The Hermit
deck: A former attendant for the Ancient One. He cared for him when he fell into a coma.

name: Nyoirin Henecha
deck: Nyoirin was the lover and master of ninja Kwannon and rival of the hand. He would ally with Matsuo so they would both have the woman they loved, leading to the mixing and merging of Kwannon with Psylocke.

name: White Dragon
deck: Leader of a gang called Dragon Lords in Chinatown in NYC. He is a master of the martial arts.

name: Trocero
deck: Trocero is the Count of Poitain, the mightiest province of Aquilonia.

name: Needle
deck: Needle is an older tailor who was mugged and lost one of his eyes. But he also gained a power to paralyze people with his gaze of his good eye.

name: Mindworm
deck: Mindworm was a homeless mutant who could leech the thoughts and emotions of those around him.

name: The Fourth Sleeper
deck: The Fourth Sleeper is a dangerous robot with the ability to become intangible and erupt like a volcano. Sleeper is also a member of the Skeleton Crew.

name: Network
deck: Network is a mutant that has the ability to interact with technology, at an intimate level. She is also a member of Alpha Squadron. She was depowered and then later killed when blown up by the Purifiers.

name: Left-Winger
deck: A friend of John Walker, also known as U.S.Agent, he was a former wrestler given super strength by the Power Broker.  He's dead now, having committed suicide.

name: Microbe
deck: Mutant member of the New Warriors with the ability to communicate with germs.  He was the adopted son of Night Thrasher, and co-starred in the New Warriors' reality television show when they confronted Nitro in Stamford.  Consequently, Microbe died in the explosion that kick-started the Civil War.

name: Go Go Tomago
deck: A founding member of Big Hero 6.

name: Sepulchre
deck: Currently going by Sepulchre, Jillian Woods was first known as Shadowoman.

name: Cadena
deck: Cadena is the new leader of the Children of the Vault, following Sangre's death.

name: Witch Woman
deck: Linda became Empowered by Mephisto and became Witch Woman.

name: Angus MacWhirter
deck: Boatman who develops a loathing for the X-Men after a ship he rents to them is destroyed by Magneto. He ends up later killed by Proteus.

name: Sophie Pettit
deck: Sophie is a waitress from the year 2043.

name: Bel-Dann
deck: Bel-Dann is a General in the Kree military. He is half-responsible for ending the first Kree-Skrull War.

name: Mr. Lao
deck: Mr. Lao is a man who gained eternal life by being cursed into a "lung dragon". He's got an important role in Atlas Foundation serving as a advisor for its khans during many centuries, including Jimmy Woo and his Inner Circle of allies, the Agents of Atlas.

name: Nigel Frobisher
deck: Merchant banker secretly in love with Courtney Ross.

name: Daisy Dugan
deck: Daisy Dugan is a supporting character in the X-MEN FOREVER series.  She is a SHIELD agent and relative of Dum Dum Dugan.

name: Oola Udonta
deck: The Centaurian Inhuman Queen.

name: Gail Collins
deck: Mother of Wallflower.

name: Donna Kiel
deck: An FBI agent who appears in Daken's new title 'Dark Wolverine'.

name: Samurai
deck: Ishiro Tsuburaya (Samurai) was a member of Mutant Liberation Front, with the same powers as his brother Kamikaze.

name: Inka
deck: Inka is a member of the Forgiven. She is a dark and mysterious figure. Fellow teammate, Visigoth listens to her.

name: Ghost Blade
deck: Sanjay is an Indian vampire. He is a member of the Forgiven.

name: Tiger God
deck: A cosmic entity worshiped as a god in K'un-Lun, the Tiger God represents the primal fear of the darkness beyond safety. His hosts wield the mystical amulets of the White Tiger.

name: Blizzard (Shapanka)
deck: The original Blizzard, Gregor Shapanka was also briefly known as Jack Frost.

name: Carrion (Warren)
deck: The original Carrion was a clone of Professor Miles Warren, created by Warren himself. He had infected this clone with a virus, which brought forth the creature known as Carrion.

name: Honest John
deck: Honest John, The Living Propaganda, is a member of The Red Skull's S-Men.

name: Mother
deck: An interdimensional parasite with the power of mind control over adults who was inadvertently summoned by Wiccan in attempt to bring back Hulkling's mother.

name: Captain America 2099
deck: An employee of Alchemax and leader of the Avengers of 2099.

name: Axel Bohusk
deck: One of Beak's and Angel's six kids.

name: Alloy
deck: Ramone is the superhero known as Alloy, Fuse's sister and Hawkeye's (Kate) ally. She assists the West Coast Avengers and enters a relationship with the Young Avenger, America Chavez.

name: Bruno Grainger
deck: Bruno Grainger is a thief and former henchman of the Black Cat.

name: Marianna Stern
deck: Marianna Stern is the High Priestess of Coven Akkaba, a group of magic users who worked with Morgan Le Fay against the newly-appointed Captain Britain (Elizabeth 'Betsy' Braddock) and her allies.

name: Tai
deck: An elderly Cambodian mystic and part time housekeeper, Tai has inhabited many roles throughout her tenure in the Marvel Universe. She was indirectly responsible for the formation of the New Warriors. Her daughter Miyami had two children with Andrew Chord, and they became the superhumans Silhouette and Midnight's Fire.

name: Purge
deck: A Genoshan mutant who joined Professor Xavier and Magneto during their time on the island.

name: Crime-Buster
deck: There have been three characters that have called themselves Crime Buster.

name: John Howlett
deck: John Howlett is a mutant and is the older brother of Wolverine. John Howlett appears in one of many of the possible futures in the Marvel Universe.

name: Manbot
deck: Manbot has a human head and a large robotic chassis with two legs but no arms.

name: Albion
deck: Albion is an alternate-Earth version of Brian Braddock, the Captain Britain of Earth-616.

name: Göndul
deck: Göndul is one of the Disir, a team of dangerous Valkyries who used to work for Bor, and now work for Hela.

name: Dr. Daniel Ridge
deck: Zapper is She-Hulk's childhood friend who grew up to be a renowned doctor.

name: Nebulon
deck: Enemy of the Defenders.

name: Gazelle
deck: Gazelle was born in New Salem, Colorado and was a member of Salem's Seven.

name: Easy Reader
deck: Easy Reader is a character who was created and portrayed by actor Morgan Freeman in a television show called "The Electric Company" and was also frequently seen in "Spidey Super Stories."

name: Quiet Bill
deck: Quiet Bill is a mutant who can open portals between dimensions.

name: Static
deck: Static was an Acolyte who joined Cortez on his attack on the X-Men, and later fought against Acolytes loyal to Magneto.

name: Black Crow
deck: Black Crow is a Native-American warrior who carries the mantle of the Earth Spirit. This allows him superhuman as well as mystical abilities.

name: Valeria
deck: Daughter of Boris and the childhood friend and sweetheart of Doctor Doom. She was later killed by demons because of Doctor Doom

name: Malice
deck: A former Dora Milaje, Nakia fell madly in love with Black Panther. She now goes by the alias Malice.

name: Dr. Killebrew
deck: The head of the facility that housed Weapon X's failed experiments. Also the man perhaps most responsible for making Wade Wilson into Deadpool.

name: Pirouette
deck: One of the former Genoshan Mutates seeking refuge in America. She becomes friends with Strong Guy.

name: Briquette
deck: The strongwoman of the Hell's Belles.

name: Sunturion
deck:
Scientist Arthur Dearborn volunteered to let his employer, Roxxon, convert him into microwave energy to prevent his life's work from being scrapped. He fought against and alongside Iron Man on a few occasions.

Mike Stone, a trucker, found another version of his armor and became the second Sunturion.

name: Tiboro
deck: Absolute Ruler of the Sixth Dimension.

name: Captain Albion
deck: The Captain Britain from Earth-523, whose neo-Elizabethan English Empire embraces America and most of Asia in a golden age of peace and prosperity.

name: David Ishima
deck: The landlord and romantic interest of Jessica Drew, the Spider-woman.

name: Jerry Morgan
deck: Jerry Morgan tried to replicate the size-changing experiments of Henry Pym (Ant-Man), but only succeeded in shrinking his own bones.

name: Typeface
deck: An ex-military villain-gone-hero, with an assortment of letters attached to his body.

name: Hellcow
deck: A Cow that was bitten by Dracula. Cow + Vampire = Hellcow. Truly horrifying.

name: Reverend Connover
deck: The husband of Hannah Conover and staunch mutant rights' activist, the revivalist Reverend preaches for mutant and human coexistence.

name: Icemaster
deck: Icemaster is an ice controlling villain. His original appearance was in a Hostess Fruit Pies ad.

name: Kathryn O'Brien
deck: An ex-CIA agent who teamed-up with the Punisher and later having his only surviving child in the MAX Universe.

name: Blue Streak (Swift)
deck: Jonathan Swift was the second Blue Streak who fought the Heroes for Hire and Thunderbolts.

name: Mister Fish
deck: Mister Fish, an infamous villain from Luke Cage's rogue gallery, was a man who worked for the Maggia. During a heist he was effected by the radioactive isotope that they were stealing, and instead of killing him, he was mutated into a fish humanoid.

name: Agent Young
deck: Head of the Division C in Washington. Now is under HAMMER's authority.

name: Soulstriker
deck: Member of the Black Dragon Death Squad. He was able to strike someones soul. His powers were presumably chi based but there is a chance that they were mystical.

name: Bobby Steele
deck: Bobby Steele was an American football player, gym owner. He was also the second husband of Marcy Masterson-Steele and stepfather to her son Kevin.

name: Miraclewoman
deck: When Doctor McCarthy speaks the trigger word "Kimota," she becomes the super-being Miraclewoman.

name: Yi Yang
deck: Yi Yang is 6000 year old leader of Dragon Tong.

name: Safron Caulder
deck: Lover of Blade the vampire hunter. She worked in a club in London, England, as a showgirl...

name: Onomi Whitemane
deck: She is the Queen of the Kymellian race. She was married to former King/current Ambassador Yrik Whitemane and conceived Kofi Whitemane of Power Pack notoriety. When the Kymellians were conquered by the Inhumans, Onomi became one of Black Bolt's wives. Kymellians are alogoanthropes (Were-Horses, often mistaken for Centaurs whom are also Alogoanthropes, but have human torsos and horse extremities) or human/horse hybrids.

name: Deborah Kinney
deck: Sister of Sarah Kinney, mother of Megan Kinney, and aunt of Laura Kinney (aka X-23).

name: Zero/One
deck: Dr. Kurinji was a scientist that worked for the Omnisapient Organization . After a freak accident where a techno-organic virus infected people and turned them into machines, Dr. Kurinji was transformed into a cybernetic hybrid due to the Red Hulk trying to save her.

name: Red Skull (Malik)
deck: The third known Red Skull, Albert Malik was a prominent Communist whom used the Red Skull identity.

name: Tarantula (Alvarez)
deck: The second man to call himself the Tarántula. Aspired to be a South American Captain America.

name: Modi Thorson
deck: Son of Thor & Hela.

name: Vorth
deck: The second member of the Time-Keepers.

name: Dangerous Jinn
deck: Dangerous Jinn is a Member of The Red Skull's S-Men.

name: Akili
deck: Member of the Wakandan Council and warrior of the Hatut Zeraze.

name: Red Widow
deck: A Red Room trained operative and former member of the Winter Guard, desperate to get back in the good graces of her home country, Russia.

name: Erasmus Mendel
deck: Erasmus Mendel was a member of the organization known as Orchis, who came together to deal with the threat of mutants. He led the mission to the space station, Orchis Forge to make sure that it would be able to support human lives after they bring it online. Mendel waited aboard his vessel until a ship came into sensor range. It happened to be a Shi'ar scout ship which Mendel believed carried a strike team of X-Men. This pushed Mendel to board the space station in order to deal with the threat.

name: Calvin Morse
deck: Calvin is an oprhan who's been in a number of foster homes. He wields a magic jacket and is enrolled at Strange Academy.

name: Charlie Tidwell
deck: A runaway who idolizes The Hulk and made a deal with the god of skinwalkers

name: Taj Nital
deck: Vampire Hunter turned into a Vampire

name: Major America
deck: Major America, or the "Anti-Cap", was a Navy cadet who participated in an experiment to boost his human abilities in an attempt to create an active Super Soldier for the Navy. He proved incredibly efficient but also an expendable liability to the government.

name: Zane Whelan
deck: A Marvel Comics character that was created specifically for an anti-drugs campaign.

name: Baron Blood (Crichton)
deck: Kenneth Crichton is the son of Spitfire who after becoming a vampire adopted the Baron Blood identity.

name: Patricia Robertson
deck: Patricia Robertson is a soldier who once wielded a clone of the Venom symbiote.

name: Comet Man
deck: Cosmically created superhero from the Marvel Universe with psionic powers.

name: Justin Pierce
deck: Information

name: Perrikus
deck: Perrikus is a warrior who joined the Dark Gods. He is fierce, strong, and almost indestructible.

name: Brutacus
deck: Brutacus was born in New Salem, Colorado and was a member of Salem's Seven.

name: Mercurio
deck: Half-transformed alien from the planet Gramos

name: Fifolet
deck: Marcus Fifolet is a member of the New Orleans Assassins Guild.

name: Darkoth
deck: Ex U.S.A.F. Major transformed into a demon.

name: Vixen
deck: Captain Britain foe, eventually turned into her namesake by Jamie Braddock

name: Fixx
deck: Reigning from the distant future of Earth #1191, Fixx was a commanding officer in the X.S.E. Unhappy that their beliefs differed from the original ones, she created the X.U.E. to be more proactive.

name: Mauvais
deck: Cannibalistic sorcerer

name: Steel Spider
deck: Originally idolizing Doctor Octopus, Ollie Osnick used his intellect to create a pair arms and become his sidekick. After a run in with the villain himself and being saved by Spider-Man, Ollie became a hero.

name: Achebe
deck: An enemy of T'Challa that sold his soul to Mephisto

name: Duane Freeman
deck: Government liaison.

name: Ramrod
deck: A powerhouse thug that has tangled with Spider-Man and Daredevil.

name: Ogre
deck: Ogre is a human inventer who has been classified as a genius.  Ogre worked with the Factor Three and the Thunderbolts as their strategist and technical support.

name: Morgan
deck: Crime boss from Harlem, New York.

name: Fireworks
deck: Fireworks is an expert of demolition.

name: Strider
deck: Winged horse with some magical abilities given to the Black Knight by the Lady of the Lake.

name: Cuckoo
deck: Kay Cera is the daughter of an immortal knight Adam Destine and a female Genie.

name: Free Spirit
deck: Cathy Webster's Free Spirit was not what Superia intended. She ends up working with Captain America and Jack Flag.

name: Alfredo Morelli
deck: Childhood friend of Richard Fisk, they planned on taking down the Kingpin, but Alfredo started to believe in their own lies and took over Richard Fisk's identity for a while.

name: Slayback
deck: One of Deadpool's villains, Slayback has returned from the dead to seek revenge on the Merc with a Mouth.

name: Knockout
deck: Knockout was the leader of the Femme Fatales.

name: Voice
deck: Jason Cragg acquired his abilities when he accidently breathed ionized atoms and gained the power to make anyone do anything he commanded. He would eventually become a member of the Skeleton Crew.

name: Bruiser
deck: A hitman who is able to shift his center of gravity to any part of his body. He is sponsored by several terrorist groups, which is why he wears the patches on his costume.

name: Carina Walters
deck: Collector's daughter and the wife of Michael Korvac.

name: Prospero
deck: A general of the Aquilonian army.

name: Charles Magnus
deck: Magnus is a sorcerer, as well as a friend and tutor to Jessica Drew, the Spider-woman. One of his main advisories is Morgan le Fey.

name: Iron Mask
deck: Western villain who wore a bullet proof helmet and suit of iron. His main advisory was Kid Colt.

name: Harold Meachum
deck: Wendell Rand's former business partner. He betrayed Wendell Rand in hopes of taking the company and Wendell's wife for himself.

name: Harris Hobbs
deck: Harris Hobbs is a reporter who is determined to prove Thor and Dr. Don Blake are the same person.

name: Rebecca Kaplan
deck: Rebecca Kaplan works as a psychologist for a living. She and her husband Jeff are the parents of the reborn Billy Kaplan, also known as Wiccan

name: Puck
deck: Zuzha Yu is the daughter of the original Puck of Alpha Flight and becomes a core member of the team just as he did.

name: MVP
deck: Michael van Patrick (MVP) was a recruiter of The Initiative recommended by Justice. MVP appears to have pushed his bodily condition to peak human level athlete. MVP is the great-grandson of Dr. Erskine, the inventor of the Super-Soldier Serum.

name: Scicluna
deck: Agent of the governmental agency Black Air.

name: Robin Chapel
deck: Robin is a part of the Damage Control company. She is it's Traffic Manager

name: Destiny
deck: Paul Destine became Destiny when he wore the Helmet of Power which was actually the disguised Serpent Crown. He would clash with Namor on numerous occassions until his death during their final battle.

name: Anthem
deck: Anthem is a member of the Order, and also field leader of the team.

name: Quoi
deck: Quoi is the member of the Cotati race, son of Avengers' Mantis and Swordsman and destined to be the Celestial Messiah.

name: The Executioner
deck: The Executioner is a member of the Crazy Gang.

name: Zadkiel
deck: Angel of Vengeance

name: The Hive
deck: Member of HYDRA and part of the HYDRA High Council.

name: Agnar of Vanaheim
deck: Citizen of Vanaheim, once an enemy of Balder, then he had a change of heart and became Balder's friend and servant.

name: Annie
deck: Annie ran into Noh-Varr while he was on the run from The Dark Avengers and helped him stop The Sentry. The two later formed a close friendship which ultimately resulted in the two falling in love and becoming a couple.

name: Tex Taylor

name: Thornn
deck: Member of Salem's Seven.

name: Dredmund Druid
deck: A mystical entity whom fought with Captain America and Doctor Strange on more then one occasion.

name: The Goth
deck: The Goth is a figure in charge of various inter-dimensional slave-trading groups such as the Goth (the team) and the Crimson Pirates.

name: Red 9
deck: Member of the Cavalry, the Initiative team assigned to the state of Georgia.

name: Barnacle
deck: Barnacle was a member of Acolytes.

name: John Steele
deck: John Steele was the original Super-Soldier, a precursor to Captain America, who has fought for his country since the Civil War. During World War II, Steele came under the control of the evil Shadow Council.

name: Oonagh Mullarkey
deck: Also known as Plasmer, The good half of Dr. Mullarkey's separated personality - an artificial, shape-shifting life form.

name: Firefall
deck: Firefall was an identity used by three Spaceknights in succession to each other.

name: Jesse
deck: Buster Witwicky's girlfriend

name: Torunn
deck: The daughter of Thor and Sif.  She is one of the Next Avengers of the animated movie.

name: T'Chanda
deck: The Black Panther and King of Wakanda during World War Two, who befriended a young Steve Rogers. He is the father of T'Chaka and S'Yan making him the grandfather of T'Challa, Shuri, and T'Shan.

name: Aladi Ko Eke
deck: The Badoon Inhuman Queen.

name: Doctor Noc
deck: Part of the mysterious Project Purgatory, Doctor Noc is a new villain for the New Mutants.  He seeks Illyana Rasputin's missing Bloodstones to complete his unrevealed agenda.

name: Legate
deck: Legate is a vampire lord. He leads the Warriors of Krieg Sect.

name: Freddie Stanachek
deck: Freddie Stanachek was a friend of Dazzler and later acquired the rights to her film.

name: Alana Jobson
deck: Alana Jobson was the second person to operate as the Initiative-registered superhero Jackpot (although she was the first person portrayed as Jackpot on-panel). She was a social worker who took over the Jackpot persona from Sara Ehret, using mutant growth hormone drugs to gain powers while in costume. She died in the line of duty.

name: Francis Klum
deck: Francis Klum is a teleporting mutant who acquired the Mysterio equipment to seek revenge against Spider-Man.

name: Douglas Rockwell
deck: Douglas Rockwell was the former chairman of the Commission of Superhuman Activities as well as the Red Skull's agent.

name: Jet Zola
deck: Arnim Zola's daughter from Dimension Z.

name: Crimson Dynamo (Turgenov)
deck: KGB Agent and the second person to wear the Crimson Dynamo Armor.

name: Crimson Dynamo (Nevsky)
deck: An assistant to Anton Vanko, Nevsky was sent to rebuild the Dynamo and gain revenge on Iron Man.

name: Plutonia
deck: Current Imperial Guard member

name: Scorpion Boy
deck: Scorpion Boy is a new student at the Jean Grey School for Higher Learning with an insectoid mutation.

name: Quasar (Kincaid)
deck: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent formerly stationed in Pleasant Hill who became the new Quasar.

name: Changamire
deck: A teacher of philosophy in Wakanda.

name: Black Panther 1,000,000 BC
deck: Earth's first Black Panther and member of the Avengers 1,000,000 BC

name: Gib
deck: Son of the Gibborim. He defended the Runaways against his own siblings and became part of the Runaways team soon after.

name: Sky
deck: Spyrican mutate gifted with feathered wings and a sonic scream, Sky was a member of the Unparalleled on the planet Spyre. She accompanied Johnny Storm when the Fantastic Four returned to Earth.

name: Talia Warroad
deck: A former SHIELD occult expert, who now works for the FBI after SHIELD dissolved

name: Coronary
deck: A superhuman villain with the power to manipulate biological organisms.  A member of the villain team Psionex, and a foe of the New Warriors.

name: Strange
deck: The Sorceress Supreme of Earth-928.

name: Codename: Spitfire
deck: Kathy Ling is a paranormal and a member of Psi-force.

name: Omoro
deck: Omoro is a citizen of Wakanda and was once King T'Challa butler. He now runs the Wakandan Consulate in New York by order of Black Panther.  Also despite his being old age, Omoro is an expert martial artist and a highly trained  & effective assassin.

name: Leo (Radford)
deck: Leo is a member of Zodiac

name: Don Fortunato
deck: A mob boss allied with Hydra and the Maggia.

name: Discus
deck: Discus is a mercenary for hire who normally works with his brother Stiletto and they have come into conflict with numerous heroes including Luke Cage, Iron Fist and Spider Man.

name: Order
deck: The manifestation of balance of the Counter-Earth

name: Butch
deck: A boy whom met Longshot during some time. Any more info is more then welcome.

name: Cheetah
deck: A foe of Captain America. He was killed by the Scourge of the Underworld and revived years later by the Hood, only to be promptly killed again.

name: Dominus
deck: Dominus is a super computer, built by an alien race and operated by robots. It was later used by Cable to substitute for his loss of his telepathy.

name: Lord Gator
deck: An evolved alligator.

name: Crusader X
deck: Captain Britain of Earth-2122

name: Demon Druid
deck: Ultimus aka. Demon Druid is a Kree Eternal. He is the only Kree Eternal to still be alive though.

name: Bludgeon
deck: A Member of the Cyber Ninjas, Bludgeon was endowed with cybernetic components that granted him Super Strength and Invulnerability.

name: Torbert Octavius
deck: The father of Dr. Octopus.

name: Rancor
deck: She is a fifth generation descendant of Wolverine on Earth-691

name: Gamecock
deck: A minor enemy of Captain America.  Eventually reformed and became friendly with Luke Cage

name: Boak
deck: Boak is a bio-organic construct.

name: Necrom
deck: The sorcerer supreme of Earth-148 (Ee'rath), Necrom defeated the heroes of his planet and enslaved them as zombies. Necrom also taught Feron and Merlyn, Roma's father, in the ways of magic.

name: Ward Meachum
deck: Brother of Harold Meachum and uncle to Joy Meachum.

name: Kathy Dare
deck: Kathy Dare. One of the deadlier love interests of Tony Stark

name: Captain Barracuda
deck: Modern-day pirate who makes use of advanced technology.

name: Philip Voight
deck: Former owner of the clinic for Paranormal research, now president of the United States in the New Universe continuity.

name: Candi
deck: One of the three girls that lived across the hall from Peter Parker when he lived in the Chelsea district.

name: The Nameless One
deck: The leader of an ancient race of demons known as The Undying Ones who ruled the Earth long ago.

name: Remo Williams
deck: Former Marine and police officer Remo Williams now assassin for Cure the secret goverment agency.

name: Miguel
deck: Miguel is the mage of the Spider Society

name: Ameridroid
deck: The Ameridroid is a twenty foot tall android in the form of Captain America, inhabited by the mind of self-loathing former Nazi spy and scientist. Ameridroid has the abilities of Captain America amplified to be proportional to its size.

name: Hodiak
deck: One of the Northern Gods. Father of Nelvanna, maternal grandfather to Snowbird.

name: Kristine Saunders
deck: Kristine Saunders was a friend of John Jameson and even had some run-ins with his counter ego, the Man-Wolf.

name: Mike Burley
deck: He used to bully Rich Rider (Nova) when he was in Harry's Truman High School in New York.

name: Valkin
deck: Valkin is an Eternal and was the leader of their Polar clan. He later became the leader of all the Eternals and left Earth when they joined the Uni-Mind.

name: The Brute
deck: Reed Richards of Counter-Earth, later escaped to Earth-1123 and became president of the United States.   His greatest claim to fame is that he came extremely close to killing the Invisible Girl.

name: Cockroach Hamilton
deck: Enemy to Luke Cage

name: Kurrgo
deck: Using a mentally-controlled robot, this unearthly ruler of a subjugated planet once caused the people of Earth to turn against the Fantastic Four! Kurrgo, the master of Planet X!

name: Red Shift
deck: Red Shift is a former Herald of Galactus.

name: Jean-Claude
deck: Jean-Claude is a master vampire who lives in the city of St. Louis. He is about 200 years old and is the manager of the local strip club Guilty Pleasures.

name: Ryder
deck: Leader of the Skrull Kill Krew.

name: Venture
deck: Cyborg hired by Alchemax to hunt down Spider-Man (2099).

name: Cike
deck: A baby Cyclops created by Mojo that lives in the Mojoverse. He is a member of the X-babies

name: Taboo
deck: A Marvel monster whom threatened humanity on two different ocassion. Years later, he appeared before the Hulk and did battle with him.

name: Tower
deck: X-Man of Earth-9997 (Earth X).

name: Tores
deck: Tores is the leader of a street gang in L.A. and Angelo Espinosa's a.k.a. Skin's former girlfriend. She possess the ability to absorb ambient psychic vibrations and channel it into explosive psionic force blasts.

name: Tyndall
deck: Tyndall is one of the greatest heroes of Weirdworld, as well as the companion of Velanna.

name: Bill Hollister
deck: D.A. turned-Mayoral Candidate Bill Hollister.  Father of Harry Osborn's girlfriend, Lily.

name: Shatterax
deck: The cold and calculating hunter named Shatterax Cybernetically enhanced Kree warrior was a onetime member to the empires Starforce.

name: The Marquis of Death
deck: Clyde Wyncham is the one and only mutant to have existed in his reality. He took the name Marquis of Death and spent countless centuries terrorizing and tearing apart The Multiverse. He taught Doctor Doom everything he knew. Finally he was killed by his own Apprentice.

name: Master Izo
deck: A master fighter supposedly mentioned in the "Book Of The Iron Fist."  He is over 100 years old.

name: Lenore Wilkinson
deck: Lenore Wilkinson is a depowered mutant who recently acquired the assistance of X-Factor following a series of ex-mutant slayings.

name: White Tiger
deck: Created by High Evolutionary from a white tigress, she is tasked with hunting down and killing Man-Beast.

name: Lobo
deck: Lobo is Red Wolf's adopted wolf and friend.

name: Homer, The Happy Ghost
deck: Created by Stan Lee and first drawn by Dan DeCarlo in 1955

name: Puff
deck: Puff is a female version dragon and friend of Lockheed.

name: Avoe
deck: The Dire Wraith Inhuman Queen.

name: Rigo Zapata
deck: One half of the luchadore/mercenary Zapata Brothers

name: Gus Zapata
deck: Half of the luchadore Zapata Brothers

name: Heather Noble
deck: Student at Midtown High and Classmate of May Parker.

name: Vengeance (Kowalski)
deck: A a former deputy sheriff of New Beulah Police Force who uncovered the Secret of highway 18. He was the first Ghost Rider created after Zadkiel temporarily took over Heaven. Most recently he has been seen in combat with the Secret Avengers.

name: Kevin O'Brien
deck: Kevin O'Brien was head of the research department at Stark Industries and a close friend of Tony Stark. After building the Guardsman armor, O'Brien became an adversary to the armored Avenger.

name: Dr. Kimmo Tuolema
deck: Doctor who perfected the Morituri Process.

name: Infestation
deck: Student at the Hellfire Academy who has insects living in her body.

name: Lady Waziria
deck: A Dark Elf of Svartalfeim and sorceress injured by Malekith the Accursed. She would later be turned into the new Kurse by Malekith.

name: Ana Cortes
deck: The daughter of a Colombian billionaire and heir to his fortune who acts as the latest Lady Deathstrike.

name: Eldrac
deck: Eldrac the Door is an Inhuman who was submitted to Terrigen Mist and transformed into an architectural-like being. His teleportation powers have helped countless Inhumans in their time of need.

name: Karé Kun
deck: Kare Kun is an X-wing pilot for the Resistance and a Black Squadron member.

name: Tetu
deck: Tetu is the leader of the Nigandan Army who sent the empath Zenzi to the Great Mound in Wakanda to incite a riot among the Wakandan miners and the military.

name: Albert Moon, Jr.
deck: Cindy Moon's brother.

name: Bashenga
deck: One of the first Black Panthers.  Wise and fearless, he closed off  the vibranium mound and formed a Panther Cult that would guard it against all intruders.

name: Eduardo
deck: Student at Public School 20 Anna Silver and classmate of Lunella Lafayette.

name: Trapster
deck: A young new millennial Trapster.

name: Mark Mason
deck: Detective in the Blonde Phantom stories.

name: City
deck:
1610: Living computer created by The Maker, it is the embodiment of the Dome which the Maker and the Children of Tomorrow.
616: City control the Vault used by the Children of the Vault.

name: Shay Marken
deck: Nurse at the Ravencroft Institute who began dating Spider-Man.

name: Elisbeth Von Strucker
deck: Elisbeth Von Strucker is the wife of Nazi Criminal, Baron Wolfgang Von Strucker. She is also the mother of the twin mutant team Fenris, A.K.A. Andrea & Andreas Von Strucker and Step-Mother to Werner Von Strucker of HYDRA. Currently the entire Von Strucker family, save Wolfgang, is deceased.

name: Pisces (Perricone)
deck: Pisces is an aquatic member of the Zodiac.

name: Firearm
deck: Firearm is a member of The Jury.

name: Ramshot
deck: Ramshot is a member of The Jury, and he fought Venom (Eddie Brock) at least once.

name: Blaze Carson
deck: One out of the many heroes of the Wild West. Blaze was a cowboy and sheriff to a small town.

name: Harrier
deck: Outfitted with a high-tech flight suit equipped with razor edged wings, Cardinal is one of the deadliest enemies of Night Thrasher and the original New Warriors.

name: Iridia
deck: An Inhuman girl who was granted the gift of flight, and butterfly wings, and partial insectoid physiology when she went through her Terragenesis.

name: Megatak
deck: Gregory Nettles was an industrial thief when a freak accident at an electronics show transformed him into Megatak. His ability to control electricity and electronic components brought him into conflict with Thor. Megatak would later meet his demise by Scourge but is resurrected years later by the Hood.

name: Turner D. Century
deck: Disgusted by the vulgarity of modern society, Turner D. Century tried to return humanity back to the more innocent times he adored. His campaign was halted by numerous heroes including Spider Woman, Spider Man and Dominic Fortune. He would be killed by the Scourge of the Underworld.

name: Stained Glass Scarlet
deck: An ex-nun who became a vigilante after being forced to kill her criminal son.

name: Agon
deck: The Father of Black Bolt and Maximus and the former king of the Inhumans.

name: Flying Dutchman
deck: A cursed Dutch pirate and former minion of Mephisto.

name: Ainet
deck: Storm's surrogate mother and a witch.

name: Sam Bullit
deck: Police officer

name: Poison
deck: Poison is a native from Cuba and the former host of an alien entity called Ylandris. She is super-strong, can levitate, and psionicly alter a person's flesh. She has used this power to inflict disease and illness on others.

name: Switch
deck: A sometimes member of the Hellions, Switch was a very dangerous young man. He had the mutant ability to switch bodies with another person.

name: Styx
deck: Styx is a killer for hire and half of the criminal duo Styx & Stone. Styx's touch drains the life from any living thing he touches.

name: Gus Grim
deck: And old friend to the New Mutant Dani Moonstar.

name: Justice Peace
deck: Justice Peace is a time-hopping mercenary hired by The Time Variance Authority to become the leader of their Temporal Law Enforcement Department. He is also Marvel's homage to Judge Dredd.

name: Skar
deck: Merciless hunter/assassin for the Martian Masters. He thoroughly enjoys his work.

name: Adora
deck: Queen of Xandar and the succeeding Nova Prime after Tanak Valt. The original Adora was killed when Nebula exterminated the Xandarians but soon replaced by her clone who later assisted in the revival of her species.

name: Pixie
deck: Pixie is an Eternal member of the First Line. Presumably she has standard Eternal powers, but prefers to use a "pixie dust" that temporarily turns people to stone.

name: Cagliostro
deck: Cagliostro is a black magician from the 18th Century who has been able to live for hundreds of years thanks to his knowledge of spells that maintain his youthful age. He has a strong rivalry with Dracula.

name: Sultan Magus
deck: Sultan Magus is the mysterious new powerhouse whose mythical kingdom of Sharzhad has become a destabilizing new force to be reckoned with.

name: Flag-Smasher (Thierrault)
deck: A global terrorist who uses violence to put an end to nationalism.

name: Somon
deck: The leader of the Great Beast

name: Feedback
deck: A young Canadian mutant who for a brief time was the bio-electric member of Beta Flight.

name: Lynx
deck: Used as an experiment by the organization known as They, Lynx was made into a feral, instinctual person and was used as a test-subject for the Panacea drug, which was capable of curing every disease known to man. She also had a brief romance with Wolverine.

name: Kariooq
deck: Kariooq is a member of the Great Beasts, supernatural beings who were exiled into their home dimension to keep them from overtaking the earthly realm. Kariooq first encountered Alpha Flight when they travelled to the Realm of the Beasts in an attempt to recover the soul of Walter Langkowski. Kariooq was easily defeated by Shaman who used ice, Kariooq's ancient enemy to stop the Great Beast.

name: Fantasma
deck: Fantasma is a Dire Wraith sorceress who was once a member of Russia's national superhero team, the Winter Guard.

name: Mole
deck: Mole is a Morlock who survived Sabretooth's attack on them by burrowing away.

name: Bambi
deck: Bambi and her two roommates once lived across the hall from Spider-Man. She is a single mother.

name: Peg Moonstar
deck: Peg Lonestar is Danielle Moonstar's mother.  Dani believed her mother had been killed by the Demon Bear.  However, both her parents had been transformed into the Demon Bear that haunted her nightmares.  Peg was restored to human form and lives on her family ranch with husband William.

name: Blackbyrd
deck: A detective who was real rough around the edges. He was feared by most criminals and even some cops.

name: Pallantides
deck: The commander of the Black Dragons, the elite imperial guards of Aquilonia.

name: Dollar Bill
deck: Dollar Bill is a friend of the Defenders.

name: Caps Cooper
deck: Friend of Nova.

name: Kaecillius
deck: Kaecillius is an enemy of Doctor Strange, that used to work for Baron Mordo

name: Josie
deck: Josie is a bar owner in Hell's Kitchen.

name: Fredzilla
deck: One of the newest members of Japan's premiere superhero team, Big Hero 6, Fred possesses the unique ability to channel the power and aura of a mysterious Kaiju, to enhance his physical abilities and augment his strength.

name: Raymond Coker
deck: Raymond Coker is a Jamaican immigrant once cursed with lycanthropy.

name: Spunje
deck: A mutant Skrull who is a member of Cadre K. He has the ability to absorb, store, and redirect energy.

name: Animus
deck: Animus is a Level 9 demon. He possesses no corporeal body of his own but instead jumps from host to host.

name: Black Axe
deck: Over 10,000 years old, Black Axe has become a master of every fighting technique and gained vast wealth. His axe matches the state-of-the-art technology of whatever era he is in.

name: Hex
deck: Hex is a human-genie hybrid.

name: John the Skrull
deck: John the Skrull was a Skrull duplicate of John Lennon. He worked for MI-13 under Pete Wisdom.

name: Impulse
deck: Impulse was given his powers by the Genetech corporation, along with 4 other individuals, to form the group Psionex. Impulse's endurance, reflexes and speed were enhanced.

name: M-Plate
deck: M-Plate is an androgynous amalgamation of the St. Croix siblings, including but not limited to Marius St. Croix, better known as Emplate.

name: Steel Wind
deck: Steel Wind is a longtime foe of Ghost Rider(Johnny Blaze).

name: Vic Slaughter
deck: Vic Slaughter was an ex-marine turned assassin, hired to kill Morbius. He later became a Vampire himself.

name: Calamity
deck: Calamity is a member of the Order.

name: Monstra
deck: Monstra is a member of the Imperial Guard. She uses her super strength, and four arms, to fight for the Sh'iar and seems to exhibit limited intelligence.

name: Slick
deck: Slick was a student at the Xavier Institute.

name: Miss Saccharine
deck: Miss Saccharine is an elderly mutant living among the mutant outcasts in the sewers of London, England.  Her sweat tastes as sweet as sugar.

name: Mad Man
deck: Philip Sterns, brother of Samuel Sterns AKA The Leader, was a brilliant nuclear physicist who was obsessed with the Hulk, and experimented himself with gamma-radiation to emulate the Hulk’s powers. He is searching for a way to tap into the hidden strengths that all Hulks have.

name: Caleb Alexander
deck: Caleb developed a theory about Namor's blood causing Namor's frequent rages and emotion imbalances. He worked on a blood-recirculator that would help Namor.

name: Spider-Man 2211
deck: Dr. Jamoff "Max" Borne is the Spider-Man of the year 2211. He is part of a future organization called the Time-Spinners, which seeks to prevent disruptions in the time field, and prevent any imbalance in the mainstream universe. He was killed by the Chameleon of 2211.

name: Tattoo Artist
deck: First appeared in young x-men issue #1.  The character Eric Gitter comes to La Jolla California to aquire  to a tattoo shop run by his friend to aquire tattoo's to fuel his own arsenal of powers.

name: Rock of the Buddha
deck: A member of the Black Dragon Death Squad.

name: Kraken
deck: Kraken was a master manipulator and a founding father of HYDRA. He specialized in helping people become who they were supposed to be. Secretly, he was killed and replaced by Jake Fury.

name: William Lonestar
deck: William Lonestar is father to Danielle Moonstar.  It was believed that he and his wife had been killed by the Demon Bear.  However, they had been transformed into the Demon Bear and sent to hunt their daughter.  Thanks to the New Mutants, both William and his wife Peg were returned to normal.

name: Tracy Burke
deck: Editor-in-chief of Woman Magazine and friend of Carol Danvers.

name: Krazy Krow
deck: Krazy Krow was Timely's answer to the Funny Animals craze from the 1950's!

name: Clown
deck: Following in the footsteps of the original Clown, the new Clown spreads anarchy and lunacy throughout the Marvel Universe!

name: Leonard Pimacher
deck: A Stark Industries employee. Later impersonated by Spymaster.

name: Susan Hatchi
deck: Susan Hatchi is the half-sister of karma

name: Sojobo
deck: A mutant who gained his powers post-AvX along with his twin sister. He was taken in by Ogun as a baby and raised by his organization until Legion rescued him.

name: N'Gora
deck: N'Gora is a ship commander who travels aboard the Tigress along with Belit and Conan.  He was among the first to threaten Conan upon his first arrival on The Tigress, but quickly became a friend an ally as time went on.

name: Mordecai Boggs
deck: Former manager of Rick Jones.

name: Iron Maiden
deck: Iron Maiden is a former villain and the self-styled master of Vibranium.

name: Alexis
deck: A highly advanced artificial intelligence from the Diamond, inhabiting the most advanced robot body on Earth.

name: Fuel
deck: Fuel is a mercenary currently operating as a member of "The Offer's" .

name: Zelda
deck: Zelda is a clone of X-23 and was part of the three sisters. She died during their mission against their creators.

name: Kes Dameron
deck: The father of Poe Dameron and a member of the Rebel Alliance, Kes served in the Pathfinders, a group of special ops who battled on foot on Endor.

name: Derek Bishop
deck: Father of Kate Bishop and criminal businessman

name: Scythian
deck: Scythian is an elder deity from the planet Dartayus, a planet from the Negative Zone. He was turned into stone eons ago, but was freed by one of the X-men's enemies.

name: Grendel Symbiote
deck: Dragon like symbiote that served Knull. Battled Venom (Eddie Brock) and Spider-Man (Miles Morales).

name: Sister Hammer
deck: Shi-Hua as Sister Hammer is champion of the Five Weapons Society.

name: Morgan Red
deck: Morgan is a trans mutant who goes by he/they. his best friend and housemate is Shela Sexton, aka escapade. Shela and Morgan live with a genetically engineered flying turtle named Hibbert, whom they "liberated" from a laboratory and keep as a pet. Morgan's mutant ability allows him to turn anything organic into chocolate. They are also a super-genius and are very resourceful.

name: Sakura Spider
deck: Hida Haruka is a young spider-powered hero from Japan.

name: Bronze
deck: A Chicago mutant who got the attention of Kitty Pryde and Emma Frost

name: Mathemanic
deck: A genius level mathematician and former member of Psionex and the Thunderbolts.

name: Randau
deck: A space parasite that feeds on the life energy of living beings.  The more he absorbs, the more powerful he becomes.  He has conquered a planet and feeds off the populace.

name: Romany Wisdom
deck: Romany Wisdom is the sister of mutant spy Peter Wisdom. Tied to the British Intel agencies of Black Air and covert operations, Romany has been both an ally and obstacle to mutant operators of Excalibur and X-Force.

name: Wally the Wizard
deck: A Marvel Comics original, Wally the Wizard got his own comic-book series as part of Marvel Comics' Star Comics imprint.

name: Tempus
deck: Tempus is a servant of Immortus, in his land of Limbo. Tempus is incapable of being killed as his body is constructed from Limbo Ice and will always reform no matter how many times it is destroyed.

name: Marius
deck: Marius was once the leader of the New Orleans Assassins Guild. Marius is also the father of Belladonna, once the wife of mutant and X-Men Gambit.

name: Count Duckula
deck: A cartoon parody of Dracula, Duckula began life as a villainous vampire in the Danger Mouse cartoon who was destroyed.  Duckula was resurrected ... only things did not go exactly as planned.

name: Jinx
deck: Jinx was a member of a group of mutants that lived in a devastated future. She was an ally to the X-Man Bishop.

name: King Britain
deck: In Earth-9997 Earth X version, of Captain Britain now King Britain, who is married to Medusa of the Inhumans.

name: Stone
deck: Second half of the criminal duo Styx and Stone who clashed with Spider-Man.

name: Devil
deck: One of a race of creatures from Tropica in the Microverse

name: Ace
deck: Ace was Illyana Rasputin's friend in the Age of Apocalypse reality. She worked in a prison camp with Rasputin in Seattle.

name: Neosaurus
deck: A member of The Imperial Guard.

name: Tex Morgan
deck: Another of Marvel early cowboy heroes.

name: Sharon Ginsberg
deck: Sharon Ginsberg used to be able to fly until her bat-like wings were ripped off. She went nuts as a result, her powers at that point manifesting themselves in the form of razor-sharp claws.

name: Teri Baltimore
deck: A Detective Inspector based in Australia.

name: Diego Sandoval
deck: Diego helped capture the X-Men.

name: Questa
deck: Questa is a member of the New Orleans Assassins Guild. He made his first appearance in Rogue #1 - An Affair to Remember (January 1995).

name: Aminedi
deck: Aminedi was a mutant member of the Desert Sword, later killed by the legacy virus.

name: Black Raazer
deck: Former Desert Sword member.

name: Dark Mother
deck: Precognitive/Telekinetic mutant leader of the Dark Sisterhood from Earth-811. Adversary to Cable. She was reportedly slain off panel after Mr. Sinister ordered his Marauders to obliterate all known mutant precognitives.

name: Roger Hochberg
deck: Roger Hochberg was a science grad student at Empire State University and a friend of Peter Parker. He dated Mia Carrerra. He has long since graduated.

name: Delphi
deck: Delphi is a member of the Pantheon and has the ability to see future visions and events.

name: Paradigm
deck: A Chinese boy with technopathic powers that was merged with the T-O Virus.

name: Dargo Ktor
deck: Dargo grew up on a future earth ruled by corporations. He was part of the Cult of the Hammer and with the power of Thor, helped to lead his people to freedom.

name: Megan McLaren
deck: Megan McLaren was a television reporter who covered various news regarding the Thunderbolts and the Avengers

name: Sentry
deck: Curtis Elkins is a former Vault Guardsman and is currently a member of The Jury.

name: Doomsday Man
deck: An indestructible robot created by the US government that merged with a human. Doomsday Man is a recurring villain of Carol Danvers.

name: Blip
deck: An electric entity whom was part of the Marvel Monsters

name: Crimson Crusader
deck: Crimson Crusader is a human-genie hybrid.

name: M.O.D.A.M.
deck: A female version of MODOK. MODAM stands for Mental Organism Designed for Agressive Maneuvers.

name: Speedfreek
deck: An assassin with super-speed and a drug addiction.  An enemy of the Hulk.

name: Psi-Hawk
deck: Psi-Hawk was once an experiment by the US government now he is a Cosmic spirit god who consumed and became the psi-force

name: Nth Man
deck: John Doe was an orphan who would become an assassin.

name: Miriam Drew
deck: Miriam is the mother of Spider Woman.

name: Big Ben
