deck: Young mutant with charisma powers.

name: Ivory Honeyshot
deck: A Light Elf from Alfheim and member of the League of Realms.

name: Decay
deck: Daughter of an anti-mutant activist, Georgia Dakei has been homeschooled since her mutant powers manifested. X-factor came to rescue her.

name: Zeb Orrelios
deck: A Rebel and member of the Ghost Crew. Garazeb, or "Zeb" as he is commonly called, is one of the surviving members of the Lasat race.

name: Tara Tam
deck: A tattoo artist who befriended Howard the Duck. Tara has shapeshifting powers.

name: Warbringer
deck: A Chitauri warlord who was tasked with recovering a stolen Chitauri Warship and killing the enslaved gladiators on board and Nova who helped them escape.

name: Jane Thorne
deck: Jane Thorne was the second person to take on the identity as Nemesis. She first appeared as the leader of Gamma Flight and later on also joined Alpha Flight's ranks.

name: Boogers
deck: Boogers is a demonic creature from Limbo that has taken a liking to Sapna.

name: Crescent
deck: Dan Bi is a young Korean girl and taekwondo prodigy, whose father worked for Morgan Le Fay. When her father was double-crossed by Le Fay, Dan Bi became a heroine when she discovered the Half Moon Talbak that summons a guardian bear spirit called Io.

name: Overtime
deck: A prisoner who is chosen by the Time Gem after the gems were given life by the Soul Gem.

name: Boy-Thing
deck: Boy-Thing is a being grown from Man-Thing

name: Nakia Cabral
deck: Tactician of the Maroons. Originally sent to infiltrate the rebellion she later  defected joining the struggle against the Intergalactic Empire of Wakanda.

name: Raneem Rashad
deck: A technopath with a grudge against Miles Morales.

name: Christina Xu
deck: Christina Xu is a young woman who lives with her parents at F.E.A.S.T., she took in Spider-Boy after he had saved her from Mr. Negative's Inner Demons.

name: Zora
deck: A recurring character in the Powers series by Brian Michael Bendis and Michael Avon Oeming, Zora was a century old superhero who got engaged to protagonist Christian Walker only to die soon after.

name: Scimitar
deck: Scimitar comes from a long generation of warriors and claims to be the master of bladed weapons. Scimitar's most hated foe is Iron Fist, but he also has come into conflict with members of Excalibur when he joined the Weaponeers.

name: Virgo (McLaughlin)
deck: Member of the Zodiac.

name: Sara Robbins
deck: Wife of The Hood.

name: Yukon Jack
deck: Former member of Alpha Flight and husband of teammate Snowbird.

name: Nestor Garcia
deck: Nestor is the owner of a bar in El Paso, Texas.

name: Jailbait
deck: A member of the Leader's Riot Squad, Jailbait has the mental power to create energy 'cages' around whatever she sees. The 'cage' keeps her prisoner confined until she loses focus.

name: Abner Little
deck: Ruthless and ambitious member of the Collectors

name: Behemoth
deck: She-Hulk villain.

name: Living Eraser
deck: The Living Eraser can 'erase' anyone, teleporting them to a fixed destination.

name: Lightbright
deck: Lightbright is a Somalian mutant who has been a heroine, a mercenary, and a terrorist in her few appearances.

name: Vic Chalker
deck: An adversary of the X-Factor team

name: Link
deck: Link was a telepath living in a disstopian future and became friends with Bishop.

name: Archer
deck: Hailing from the distant future of Earth-1191, Archer was a member of the X.S.E. But unhappy and feeling that his beliefs differed from the X.S.E., he became a member of the X.U.E. to be more proactive.

name: Mr. Nacht
deck: Mr Nacht works for Traveler.

name: Valentina Rychenko
deck: A Russian major to the prior Soviet Union. Valentina Rychenko is an ally of X-Force and an co-opt to an underground spy network and mercenary core.  She is also a loyal Russian nationalist.

name: Gryaznova
deck: An operative of Bastion implanted with the Prime sentinel tech who later on went to work with the Aguilar Institute

name: Eye Killers
deck: Soul-stealing demons from Native American mythology who have tangled with Dr. Strange and the X-Men.

name: La Bandera
deck: A Cuban mutant and freedom fighter who once fought alongside Wolverine.

name: Sister Salvation
deck: Mysterious healing figure who is nicknamed Sister Salvation.

name: Rambo The Dog
deck: Rambo was the pet dog of Rick Sheridan.

name: Shiver Man
deck: The Shiver Man is a mysterious bounty hunter that may or may not be a ghost. He is motivated by an obsession with giving the guilty what they deserve.

name: Mastermind
deck: Sentient computer and enemy of Captain Britain.

name: Leila Davis
deck: The former wife of the supervillain Ringer, Leila Davis began her own criminal career as Hardshell before eventually adopting the Beetle guise when the original Beetle became MACH-I.

name: Madame Reneau
deck: Former president of Genosha.

name: Jonathon Caesar
deck: A former mad, obsessive stalker of Mary Jane Watson.

name: Manslaughter Marsdale
deck: Spider-Man's enemy who is unable to feel pain.

name: Timeshadow
deck: Former soldier with the US Army, Timeshadow developed his mutant powers later in life and went on to become a member of Apocalypse's Alliance of Evil

name: Ani-Mator
deck: More commonly known as the Ani-Mator, Dr Frederick Animus was a rogue employee of The Right.  He used his scientific genius to create hybrid ani-mates such as Bird-Brain.  He was the New Mutants' foe during the Fall of the Mutants storyline, during which he murdered Cypher.

name: Fireflyte
deck: Fireflyte is the good and loving part of the Devils of the planet tropica. In fact, she is a melodious manifestation of the Enigma Force, strange force of the Microverse.

name: Iguana
deck: Dr. Connor's other reptilian experiment gone wrong who also battled Spider man

name: Sen. Eugene Kligger Stivak
deck: A prominent U.S. Senator, and head of The Corporation's east coast division.

name: Sayge
deck: The Sayge is an ancient wizard from the far east.

name: Billy Bob Rackham
deck:
Racist prison warden who terrorized Luke Cage. He was eventually busted down to guard when a reformist came to the prison. In an act of revenge, Rackham accidently caused the process that changed Luke Cage.

He would later re-appear to seek revenge, but justice prevailed with him being hit and killed by a speeding ambulance.

name: Whit Hammond
deck: The publisher of Beauty Magazine, and the romantic interest of the goddess Venus when she came to Earth in the 1950s.

name: Gregory O'Sullivan
deck: A member of the Warheads.

name: Fallen One
deck: A vengeful, dark herald of Galactus, chosen long before the Silver Surfer.  The Fallen One appeared briefly, before and during the "Annihilation" story arc.

name: Lunatik
deck: Lunatik is a constantly evolving life-form who, over time, has gradually gained great strength and power.

name: Agent Axis
deck: Enemy of the Invaders

name: Jay
deck: Agent Jay is a member of the Men In Black.

name: Kay
deck: Agent Kay is a member of the Men In Black, and is Jay's partner.

name: The Profile
deck: A slimy informant of Moon Knight. He has the ability to see the answers to what people want. He often uses them to his own personal gain and is forced to answers questions for Moon Knight.

name: Electric Eve
deck: Electric Eve was a member of the Chicago branch of the Morlocks.

name: Hannah Levy
deck: Hannah Levy was a mutant who had pretensile tongue and the required a diet of insects, she resided in Mutant town till she was depowered by M-day.

name: Lazaer
deck: Lazaer is seen every time Wolverine has a near-death experience. Wolverine talks about having to fight Lazaer for his life every time this happens. Lazaer uses a huge sword to fight with. Wolverine seems to have killed Lazaer when they were both alive.

name: Tantra
deck: Tantra was a mutant with an elephant like appearance, and was a student at the Xavier institute.

name: Tick Tock
deck: Tick Tock can see up to one full minute into the future and uses his abilities in the villainous group called the Night Shift.

name: Prometheus
deck: Prometheus is a member the Pantheon. Prometheus was born with a deformed face that looks horribly burned. Prometheus drives a very high tech vehicle created by the Pantheon engineers called the Argo.

name: Ferret
deck: Detective during World War II whom solved crimes involving Nazi's.

name: Moomba
deck: Moomba is a giant alien imprisoned on Earth and eventually put into the hands of an African tribe.

name: Red Queen
deck: The daughter of Hank Pym and Janet Van Dyne who led the Revengers.

name: Cynosure
deck: Member of the Luminals and deputy council of the Xarthian Peace-keeping delegation in Knowhere.

name: Otis Banner
deck: Otis is one of Banners grandchildren.

name: Anti-Man
deck: Arch-nemesis and best friend of Adam Brashear, also known as the Blue Marvel. His power is unstable so he can only exist in our world for brief periods of time. Anti-Man was made into Galactus first Herald of Life.

name: Alfie
deck: Alfie is a kid and a friend of Longshot, Butch and Darla. In new mutants annual 2 he is transformed in Straight arrow by mojo and spiral.

name: Roy Stone
deck: Member of the Leatherneck Raiders.

name: Al Harper
deck: Al Harper is a physicist and friend to the Silver Surfer

name: Julie Angel
deck: Julie was Frankie Raye's roommate and one of Johnny Storm's love interests

name: Gruning
deck: German member of the villainous Exiles who prefers to fight with a whip.

name: William Rawlins
deck: Rawlins was a treacherous CIA agent featured in the Punisher Max series.

name: Prosimian
deck:
Ultimate Universe character
He is one of several super-evolved apes freed by the Brotherhood of Mutants from a lab. Prosimian is responsible for arranging the rescue and psychic deprogramming of Magneto during Ultimate X-Men 25

name: Lou Ann
deck: Lou Ann was Rick Jones's girlfriend during his singing career in the 1970's Marvel Comics.

name: Toad-In-Waiting
deck: Toad's apprentice.

name: Katherine Glover
deck: Captain Katherine Glover works for the United States Special Forces, she is in charge of Flash Thompson's Venom missions overseas. Kat is shown to be a strong and courageous woman, whom can take care of herself.

name: Ernst Sablinova
deck: Father of Silver Sablinova (aka Silver Sable), Ernst Sablinova was the founder of the Wild Pack in its original mission to hunt down Nazi war criminals.  He worked with the Symkaria government to do this.

name: Imp
deck: Anders Nobel is a mutant with horns. He is a former student of the Xavier Institute.

name: Winston
deck: Spider-Man 2099 baddie.

name: Scatterbrain
deck: Scatterbrain was a second generation member of Strikeforce Morituri. He had telepathic powers.

name: Pastor Hail
deck: A robot pastor built and programmed by Maximilian von Katzenelnbogen to turn Idie away from the Jean Grey institute. He is based on televangelists and considers mutation a form of sin which combined with his appearance suggests his design was inspired by Willaim Stryker.

name: Joelle
deck: Joelle was a loving mother that was granted immortality to be with her daughter. As her daughter grew old, Joelle sought out a way to end her life and be with her upon her death. She turned to a life of thievery in order to find a way to end her life.

name: Calcabrina
deck: A witch of the Murder Circus and servant to Azazel sent to gather souls for him prior to becoming indebted to Frankensteins Monster.

name: Jesse Alexander
deck: Sam Alexander's father who used to be a member of the Black Novas.

name: Butler
deck: A doctor working for the Weapon X Program.

name: Iron Nail
deck: A former S.H.I.E.L.D. agent driven by the desire to overthrow the Western government.

name: Wendigo (Cartier)
deck: On the verge of insanity he ate the flesh of his mortally wounded friend Henri Cluzot. In doing so, he fell victim to the curse that transformed him into the Wendigo.

name: Lancelot Steele
deck: Lancelot Steele was Dazzler's Road Manager and Bodyguard

name: Siphon
deck: A new Weapon X project. It is said that even Cornelius was scared of him.

name: Shredded Man
deck: A villainous Inhuman who wishes to evolve every human genetically so they are as powerful as him, but under his control.

name: Maddy Cho
deck: Amadeus Cho's younger sister, but more responsible and equally genius.

name: Sparky
deck: Sparky is the Visions' pet robot dog.

name: Muse
deck: A serial killer who turns his victims into art.

name: Ying Liu
deck: A Red Room chemist that was Nadia Pym's former lab partner.

name: Doctor Shapiro
deck: Dr. Shapiro is a super intelligent cat that works for Stark Unlimited

name: Apoth
deck: AI obssesed with Kwanon.

name: Fish
deck: Fish is a young Brazilian mutant who joined others to leave Brazil and join the mutant nation of Krakoa. The Brazilian Navy attempted to prevent the small group from leaving but the mutants were rescued by Kitty Pryde's Marauders.

name: Hibbert
deck: Hibbert is a genetically engineered flying turtle that was rescued by Escapade and Morgan Red. He currently lives with them in a shared home. He often sits on Morgan’s head.

name: Amass
deck: A member of the Threslhold, a group of mutants from the past that travelled to the future seeking the help of the Krakoan mutants.

name: Web-Weaver
deck: A variant of Spider-Man of Earth-71490 but not a variant of Peter Parker. Web-Weaver is a gay fashion student when not being a Spider-Hero.

name: Terraformer
deck: Terraformer is a plant creature created by Plantman that gained sentience and free will. Terraformer is also an original member of the team known as the Force of Nature.

name: Silk Fever
deck: Min Li Ng is a Vietnamese pyrokinetic who originally went by the name Firewall. After leaving her team, Force of Nature, she joined the Folding Circle and took the name Silk Fever.

name: Harness
deck: Harness is a mutant agent of A.I.M. Foe of X-force and the New Warriors.  She used her son, a mutant called Piecemeal, as a pawn in a plan to ressurect Proteus.

name: Network
deck: He is a paranormal and the leader of the group Psi-force. He can push people into following his mental commands.

name: Dangard Ace
deck: Dangard Ace along with Raideen and Combattler were taken from Japanese cartoons and turned into a comic book to go along with the Shogun Warriors toy line and the Force five cartoon series.

name: Behemoth Jack
deck: Reptilian host of The Eleventh Hour Special.

name: Stu Cicero
deck: A hardcore Marvel Comics fan working for the law firm of Goodman, Lieber, Kurtzberg, & Holliway.  Friend of She-Hulk.

name: Aries (Lassiter)
deck: Marcus Lassiter was the first Aries in the original incarnation of the Zodiac Cartel.

name: Trickshot (Chisholm)
deck: Trickshot is an assassin and professional criminal who trained Hawkeye in the Bow and Arrow.

name: Gomi
deck: A clever but quiet young man, Gomi received cybernetic implants which can create a devasting telekinetic force.  With his two cyborg lobsters, he became a member of a group of young misfits, mutants, and runaways known as the Fallen Angels.

name: Buzz
deck: Buzz was a regular customer to the Daily Grind, a place where Ben Reilly (the Scarlet Spider) used to work. (Buzz is not to be mistaken for the superhero "Buzz" from the Spider-girl comics).

name: Centennial
deck: A former Canadian police officer and army veteran, Rutherford Princeton is revived from a twenty-year coma by Dr. Walter Langkowski/Sasquatch and soon joins Alpha Flight as Centennial.

name: Wysper
deck: Wysper is a member of The Jury.

name: Immundra
deck: A member of the Imperial Guard who was killed by Cassandra Nova

name: Payback
deck: Former police officer turned vigilante, Eddie Dyson went from enemy of the Punisher to one of his allies when his family were killed by the mafia!

name: Carnivore
deck: Andreas Zorba became Carnivore when he touched the Fearsome Fist of Farallah .

name: Jerry Hunt
deck: Jerry Hunt or Gerald Hunt is an agent of S.H.I.E.L.D stationed in London. After encountering Spider-Woman (Jessica Drew), Jerry takes a extended leave of absence from S.H.I.E.L.D and  follows her to Los Angeles, where he becomes Spider-Woman's love interest.

name: Turac
deck: Turac is an ancient Turkish Warlord who was transformed into a Vampire by Dracula himself.

name: Sir Lyan
deck: Evolved lion and Knight of Wungadore

name: Rynda
deck: She is the of wife of King Agon and the former Queen of Inhumans. She is the mother to Black Bolt and Maximus and grandmother to Ahura. Like her husband, she was killed when a Kree starship crashed into their laboratory.

name: The Veil
deck: An Iraqi mutant who was part of the team Desert Sword.

name: Blind Faith
deck: Not much is known about Blind Faith's history prior to his first known rebellion against the Soviet's mutant genocide program, which brought him in contact with the original X-Factor team.

name: Karima
deck: Karima is a young orphan mutant with psionic abilities.

name: Chakra
deck: Chakra works under Judas Traveller.

name: Medea
deck: One of Judas Traveller's followers.

name: Red Fowler
deck: Red Fowler was the stunt cyclist for the Quentin Carnival before Blaze arrived.

name: Lucky
deck: The Tanner family cat. ALF has tried to eat him on several occasions.

name: Antonio Argent
deck: Before losing his powers Antonio could fly and control fire. Like Magma he couldn't be injured by fire.

name: Jimmy-6
deck: A mobster whom from time to time crossed paths with Ben Reilly, the Scarlet Spider.

name: Louise Hastings
deck: Archeologist and occultist friend of Victoria Montesi. Has strong knowledge of the Darkhold.

name: Nisanti
deck: Nisanti is a demon who powers Parker Robbins (a.k.a. The Hood). With his invisibility granting cloak and levitating boots, Nisanti caused Parker to become reliant on his demonic powers so that he would be an easy vessel for bringing Dormammu to Earth.

name: Queen Mother Maraud
deck: The Queen and Mother of the Snarks, she is coldhearted and brutal to her loyal soldiers.  She was an on-going & deadly enemy of Power Pack. Usually scheming to steal their powers, Maraud was banished by Emporer Bhadsha, but remained a threat

name: Angela Lipscombe
deck: Angela Lipscombe once dated Bruce Banner. She has helped Bruce in his hour of need.

name: Nahrees
deck: Nahrees is a member of the Inhumans

name: Lord Tyger
deck: Evolved tiger.

name: Mindy Brown
deck: Mindy Brown is the wife of Prowler / Hobbie Brown.

name: Snake Marston
deck: A former member of the Satan Squad, and a current member of the Enforcers.

name: Nurse Fester
deck: Nurse Fester used to be nurse at the Dunwich Sanatorium until Dr. Rottwell took over, and experimented on her.  She is now Dr. Rottwell most loyal employee.

name: Garthan Saal
deck: Garthan Saal absorbed the vast majority of the entire Nova-Force, minus the tiny fraction Rich Rider contained. The power drove Saal insane, he subsequently attacked Earth and battled the Avengers.

name: Giraud of Haven
deck: In the 30th century, Giraud is the 9th version of the Phoenix since Jean Grey.

name: Sinsear
deck: General Haight's assassin from the future.

name: Plasma
deck: Mutant niece of the Living Pharaoh. Once a love interest to Havok.

name: Geatar
deck: Nebula's second in command

name: Salomé
deck: Salomé is a powerful sorceress, former member of the Blood and the Fallen.

name: Ray Coffin
deck: Ray Coffin is a retired Astronaut and was the first human to become Captain Universe.

name: Hump
deck: Member of the Morlocks.

name: Kala
deck: Kala, Queen of the Netherworld. Originally an Iron Man foe, later consort to the Mole Man.

name: Seera
deck: Princess of the Chosen on an unnamed planet, which X-factor's ship sends them to.

name: Katy Kiernan
deck: Katy Kiernan is a reporter for the Daily Inquisitor and ally of the current Venom.

name: Lil' Longshot
deck: A baby Longshot created by Mojo that lives in the Mojoverse. He is a member of the X-Babies.

name: Lil' Havok
deck: A baby Havok created by Mojo that lives in the Mojoverse. He was part of the X-Babies.

name: Alexander Flynn
deck: Alexander Flynn was born to an unnamed Gypsy woman in Latveria. He claimed to be an illegitimate son of Dr. Doom.

name: Tuetun
deck: Tueton is the cosin of Hanover Fist

name: Sassafras
deck: Sassafras is the pet dog of Beast and the New Defenders

name: Paul Same
deck: Narcoleptic split-personality sleepwalker, eccentric artist, and a good friend of Howard the Duck.

name: Arisen Tyrk
deck: Arisen Tyrk is an extremely powerful sorcerer who uses both sorcery and science to rule Other-Realm.

name: Yuri Petrovich
deck: Yuri Petrovich was the fourth Crimson Dynamo who ended up imprisoned in a gulag after an encounter with the Winter Soldier that left him badly scarred.

name: Asti
deck: A mystical entity whom encountered Doctor Strange a few times.

name: Snake-Dance
deck: Former leader of the Apache tribe, Mr. Littletree possesed the power to control any snake and was also immune to snake's venom.

name: Meredith McCall
deck: Meredith McCall's family is killed by the Face Thief. She would join forces with Iron Man and the Masters of Silence to battle this demon.

name: El Conquistador
deck: The X-Men come into conflict with El Conquistador when he steals an experimental solar generator.

name: Quietus
deck: A mutant whom worked at the Seattle Core during the Age of Apocalypse.

name: Jolen
deck: Jolen is a member of the Inhumans

name: Russian
deck: A mercenary killer brought to the United States of America by Ma Gnucci to deal with the Punisher. He was decapitated by the Punisher. He was revived and given hormones that enhanced his strength.

name: Black Swan
deck: A Deadpool and Agent-X foe.

name: Americop
deck: Disillusioned at the law's inability to protect society from the lawless, Houston police officer Bart Gallows resigned from the force and became America's self-appointed top law-enforcement official: Americop.

name: Ashake
deck: Ashake lived throughout Kenya during part of the Pharaonic times.  She was a powerful sorceress and virtually identical to the modern heroine Storm, who is Ashake's "granddaughter many times removed".

name: Redstone
deck: Redstone is a super-powered character associated with the Squadron Supreme. On Earth-712, where his powers are magical in nature, giving him strength from the Earth. In the Supreme Power universe, he is a serial killer with powers derived from Hyperion's DNA. He is an analogue to both DC Comics' Black Adam and Geo-Force.

name: Anne
deck: Her last name has yet to be revealed, Anne is the sultry secretary for Damage Control.

name: Gene Strausser
deck: Head of Research and Development at Damage Control.

name: Stefan Szardos
deck: Stefan is the first born of Margali, and Kurt's foster brother. When the two were boys they were very close. Stefan feared of turning to the Dark power that was in him.

name: Kiwi Black
deck: Kiwi Black is of Maori descent, and also the son of Azazel of the Neyaphem and half-brother of Nightcrawler and Abyss.

name: Supernaut
deck: Sgt. Michael Fields is Supernaut, a member of the Order. The heavy artillery Machine inside and out.

name: Grogg
deck: Grogg was a huge Marvel monster that threatened the civilization.

name: The Thunderer
deck: Golden age hero.

name: Mr. E
deck: Golden age detective and member of the World War II superhero group known as The Twelve.

name: Arnold Astrovik
deck: Father of Justice.

name: Simone DeSantos
deck: A fellow student of May (Spider-Girl) Parker.  She has a bit of an...attitude. She is also the daughter of Rene DeSantos, who is a member of the Goblin Cult.

name: Tartarus
deck: Tartarus is a member of the Neo capable of making people experience their worst nightmares.  He is the brother of Elysia.

name: Zealot
deck: Mutate #665.  Zealot is a mutate who challenged Magneto for Genosha.

name: Roche
deck: A crime lord, who hires a mercenary to kill Wolverine after he stops his men from intimidating a bar owner in Madripoor.

name: Highwayman
deck: US Archer's arch enemy/brother.  He is now a demon known as the Highway Man

name: Hideko Takata
deck: Professor of Geophysics

name: Psionics
deck: Psionics is the daughter of Lightwave and a descendant of Polaris and is a member of The New Defenders.

name: Cyburai
deck: Hiro was a Cybernetic Samurai Warrior of the Tatsu clan known as the Cyberai. He betrayed his Oyabun for love.

name: Steve Coffin
deck: Steve Coffin is the son of Ray Coffin, the original Captain Universe, and was the second human to become Captain Universe. In the years since losing The Uni-Power, Steven has become obsessed with regaining it by any means possible.

name: Glenda Sandoval
deck: Ex Wife of Parnell Jacobs , childhood friend and love interest War Machine

name: Zawavari
deck: A Wakandan witchdoctor who assisted the Black Panther at a time of need.

name: Tomas Rodriguez
deck: Tomas Rodriguez was the young son of Jaime Rodriguez, Nimrod's human friend.

name: Coat of Arms
deck: Coat of Arms is the founder and member of the Young Masters.

name: Executioner (DuBois)
deck: The son of the Circus of Crime's Princess Python, Danny DuBois' was inspired by the Punisher to become a vigilante known as the Executioner. He soon joined the Young Masters and later took over leadership of the team following Fear Itself.

name: Genji Odashu
deck: Genji Odashu was one of three co-protagonists of the "Shogun Warriors" series. She was a Japanese professional test pilot and was chosen to pilot Combatra.

name: Steven Deschain
deck: A noble gunslinger, father of Roland and ruler of Gilead.

name: Douglas Thompson
deck: Douglas "Doug" Thompson was the lover and later husband of Snowbird. He was a Mountie she met in her identity of Anne McKenzie, police officer. They had a son together. Doug was killed by Pestilence.

name: Enki Sunrise
deck: Detective Enki Sunrise is one of the new protagonists of the third volume of Powers, a creator-owned series by Brain Michael Bendis and Michael Avon Oeming. She replaced Deena Pilgrim as partner to Christian Walker.

name: John Farson
deck: Responsible for the destruction of Gilead, John Farson is consider to be one of Roland Deschain's greatest enemies. He answers only to one person and that is The Crimson King.

name: Red Wasp
deck: Once known as terrorist Insect Queen she is on her way to reforming by Gregory Stark's Avengers.

name: Samuel Holden
deck: An anthropology Professor in New York City. One of the few humans to remember the Celestials coming to Earth.

name: Mister Murray
deck: A man trying to capture and auction the Native.

name: Mister Willoughby
deck: Mister Murray's partner.

name: Francis Barton
deck: The son of Hawkeye and Mockingbird in alternate future.

name: Mama-Ji
deck: She is the Mother of Indra. She also shows that she cares for him, unlike his father.

name: Rav Gavaskar
deck: Rav is the father of Indra.

name: Alix Buchanan
deck: Wife of Professor Henry Buchanan, Alix was devoted to her husband.  However she was kidnapped by Damnian Tryp when X-Factor were trying to uncover Henry's work for Singularity Investigations.

name: Black Fog
deck: A Legend of Terror and Might in India, Black Fog was transformed into a biologically enhanced machine of pain and misery at the hands of the villainess Zero/One. He is responsible for the deaths of several LMDs that where connected to Red Hulk.

name: Marty Smith
deck: Boom Boom's drunken, abusive father.

name: Marcus Roston
deck: Marcus Roston is a Hollywood star living in LA who has connections to the underground.

name: Claire Hudson
deck: Claire Macneil Hudson is the daughter of Guardian & Vindicator.

name: Marcus Immortus
deck: Marcus Immortus is the son of Immortus and Revelation, who used mind control to make Ms. Marvel fall in love with him.

name: B.R.A.I.N.
deck: Created by a secret cult of Bavarian scientists with hopes of ruling the world. Instead, it is an over-sized brain shaped killing machine that likes Dixieland Jazz.

name: Abigail Marigold
deck: Abigail Marigold was a school inspector who was turned into a Wendigo by the Hellfire Club.

name: Mother
deck: The woman Fantomex believes to be his mother. She is the woman who worked alongside Father & Brother to replicate Jim Hammond, the original Human Torch.

name: Sagittarius (LMD)
deck: Part of Scorpio's (Jake Fury) LMD Zodiac team.

name: Shane Preston
deck: Emily Preston's husband.

name: Verity Willis
deck: A woman who can see through all lies, and Loki's best friend.

name: Eddie Dean
deck: A member of Roland Deschain's ka-tet, Eddie is a recovered heroin addict from 1987 New York.

name: Jennix
deck: A member of an ancient race of Totem Hunters.

name: Spider-Man J
deck: One of several japanese Spider-Men.

name: The One
deck: A mechanical brute constructed by the Fooh to serve as the final challenge of the Iron Fist.

name: Evaan Verlaine
deck: A Y-Wing pilot of the Rebel Alliance and a good friend of Leia Organa.

name: Killer Thrill
deck: Crazy bounty hunter with psychic powers.

name: Murd Blurdock
deck: The best defense attorney in the galaxy who lost his echo-senses in an accident, but possibly gained an unknown 'Visual Sense' instead.

name: Adria Lafayette
deck: Lunella Lafayette's mother.

deck: Sandy Verduga is a special forces agent who worked to track down the hulk.  She's also the mother of Doc Samson's child.

name: Colonel Hendershoot
deck: Colonel Hendershoot is Lieutenant General Fredricks/ Fredericks right-hand-man. Similarly powerless against the Vanisher and Count Nefaria.

name: Captain America-X
deck: Little is known about the mutant who replaced the original Captain America. His unstable mutant powers which gave him control over great psionic energy led to him having beserker rages and attacking anybody whom he believed was against the United States.

name: Penny Newsom
deck: The only named member of the Sublime Corp's 'New X-Men'. She is the only person to still be in possession of the mutant genome inhalers. She originally had the drug that  gave her Angel's wings but she is now known to be in position of an Emma Frost and Phoenix

name: Lylla
deck: Rocket Raccoon's soulmate and heiress to Mayhem Mekaniks toys

name: Jerome Hamilton
deck: A scientist who joined other scientists in forming the Enclave, an organization dedicated in creating a new form in hopes of creating a better Earth.

name: Eddie Harris
deck: Works at Demlar Insurance alongside Aaron Stack.

name: Face
deck: Formerly an actor, Face is a Cenobite with a large collection of human faces that he staples onto his own head. Ever the thespian, he now runs the Grand Theater in Hell where he shows public torment.

name: Validator
deck: Leader of Omega Flight sent to investigate the Origin Bomb site in Regina, Canada. The rest of her team was killed, but she was changed by the event.

name: Mondo
deck: A member of the Hellfire Academy that looks like a female version of Mojo.

name: Drexel Walsh
deck: A senator who was involved with backing the original Weapon X project. He was later murdered by a brainwashed Wolverine.

name: Adrian Sammish
deck: Adrian Sammish is the field director for the Commission on Superhuman Activities.

name: Shri
deck: A student of the Pan-Asian School for the Unusually Gifted who is believed to be the modern reincarnation of Durga.

name: Michael Peterson
deck: Friend of New Warrior Slapstick.

name: Tempest Monroe
deck: Tempest Monroe is Miguel O'Hara's girlfriend and the mother of his son, Gabriel II.

name: Manifold Tyger
deck: Manifold Tyger is a member of the Providian Order, posing as a S.W.O.R.D. agent.

name: Blake Burdick
deck: Blake Burdick is a police officer and the new husband of Peggy Rae, ex-wife of Scott Lang (Ant-Man) and Cassie Lang (Stature)

name: Vin
deck: Vision's synthezoid son and Vivi twin.

name: Mur-G'nn
deck: Mur'Gnn is the sorceress of the Knights of the Infinite.

name: Telekinian
deck: An Inhuman who befriended Hellcat.

name: Deadpool 2099
deck: The daughter of Wade Wilson and Shiklah. She takes up the "Deadpool" name in 2099 and holds a bitter grudge against her father and half-sister Eleanor Camacho.

name: Irelle
deck: A young Inhuman girl. She is the daughter of Auran, she has a twin sister named Treste.

name: L'ulo L'ampar
deck: A male Duros who served in the Rebel Alliance as an A-Wing pilot in Green Squadron, L'ulo became Green Leader during the battle of Endor when Arvel Crynyd rammed the Executor's bridge. He later became a member of Black Squadron while working with the Resistance.

name: Elisa Sinclair
deck: A strange woman who introduced Hydra to Sarah and Steve Rogers.

name: Bu Jun
deck: Chinese mutant who agreed to enter in suspended animation to survive the Terrigen Mists.

name: Jack Casey
deck: Photographer, reporter, and friend of Jeff Mace & Mary Morgan.

name: Odessa Drake
deck: Leader of the New York branch of the Thieves Guild and an enemy of Spider-Man and Black Cat.

name: Daycrawler
deck: Daycrawler is a member of a new superhero team that patterned his look on the X-Men's Nightcrawler.

name: Zheng Yi
deck: Brother of Zheng Zu.

name: Quantum
deck: Chosen by the Space Gem after the gems were given life by the Soul Gem.

name: Bren Waters
deck: A teenager who bonded with Toxin during the events of King in Black

name: Marcus Momplaisir
deck: A Beyond Corporation employee in charge of their Spider-Man project

name: Wilde
deck: A King in Black from the timestream He is a version of Eddie Brock in bitter cynicism.

name: Gemma Shin
deck: Host of the Agony symbiote

name: Tabitha Briggs
deck: Tabitha Briggs is Bailey Briggs'mother. She once have been turned into a humanimal like her son. She recently regained her human form.

name: Powerlift
deck: Protege of Doc Samson and therapist to Miles Morales

name: Gust
deck: A Brooklyn superhuman and ally of Miles Morales

name: Schwarzchild
deck: A former Orchis human turned into a mutant by 3K

name: Bloodstrike
deck: The son of an American G.I. and a Vietnamese woman, Eric Conroy is the super strong mutate called Bloodstrike who, as a member of the Folding Circle, opposed the New Wariors.

name: Canis
deck: New York City Crime Boss

name: Dolph
deck: And assassin original hired by Grace of the Omni Corporation, later mutated into a freakish monster

name: Philippe Bazin
deck: A New York mob boss with strong interests in collecting magical artifacts.

name: Kwinn
deck: Kwinn is an Inuit Mercenary who worked for the CIA, MI-6, and KGB.

name: Jinx
deck: Jinx is the grandson of Louise Hastings, of the Darkhold Redeemers, and a powerful adept in the mystic arts.

name: Desak
deck: Known as the slayer of gods, Desak was once a simple man, but was transformed into a being capable of defeating any god by the Spirit of the Jewel, the Designate.

name: Crimson Sage
deck: Robot modeled after Scarlet Witch.

name: Teri Martin
deck: Teri Martin was the single mother of a mutant girl, Ashley Martin. Professor X was interested in Teri for a brief time.

name: Thunderbolt
deck: The original Thunderbolt was Bill Carver, an African-American D.A. from Harlem.

name: Mind-Wave
deck: Mind-Wave wears a helmet that allows him to hear the thoughts of any individual within close proximity. He attacks New York City with his massive think tank but is eventually taken down by Daredevil. Mind-Wave would meet his end by Scourge during the Bar with No Name massacre.

name: Suicide
deck: Suicide has the power to heal from anything and can only be killed by killing Ghost Rider. If Suicide ever manages to kill Dan Ketch, he himself would die.

name: Sammy Silke
deck: Samuel "Sammy" Silke is a fictional character in the Marvel Comics universe, appearing in the series Daredevil. He is the son of one of the antagonist Kingpin's friends and associates

name: Ransome Sole
deck: Ransome Sole is a member of the Neo and brother to Domina.

name: Boone
deck: One of Judas Traveller's followers

name: Cactus
deck: Cactus is a humanoid cactus plant created by Dominus. He attacks with his sharp needles and has the ability to regenerate certain body parts.

name: Battering Ram
deck: Battering Ram was a mutant member of the X-force team that later became X-Statix.  He was one of the first members to die in the line of action.

name: Dr. Niles Roman
deck: Dr. Niles Roman is a Cold War era spymaster, scientific director then mutate conspiracist war criminal . An enemy of X-Force during 2001 'Counter X' series.

name: Bando Saburo
deck: One of Wolverines trainers when he was in Japan. Bando had a deep influence upon Logan's behaviour as he was teaching him to control his rage in the ways of a samurai.He found the same end as Itsu by the monstrous figure Romulus.

name: Mary Octavius
deck: Mother of Dr. Octopus

name: Venomm
deck: Former ally to Erik Killmonger, Venomm is presently allied with T'Challa.

name: Wildstreak
deck: A former gymnast with a strength suit after she lost the ability to use her legs

name: Gary Paretsky
deck: Gary Paretsky was the family physician of the Mastersons. He was also a close family friend.

name: Ma Gnucci
deck: The ruthless matriarch of the Gnucci crime family who was left a quadruple amputee after an encounter with the Punisher.

name: Spacker Dave
deck: Former neighbor of Punisher, Mr. Bumpo and Joan.

name: Grimm Chamber
deck: Character from Earth-295, the Age of Apocalypse.

name: Demon-Ock
deck: Demon-Ock is presumably an alternate Doctor Octopus from the Age of Apocalypse. He opposed the most recent X-Force team when the latter team visited Earth-295.

name: Caledonia
deck: Greatly skilled in swordsmanship, she fights with courage in the ways of the great warriors of old.

name: Kolomaq
deck: Beast of the Snows

name: VanDoom Creature
deck: VanDoom creature is one of Marvel's monsters.

name: Sister Maria De La Joya
deck: Sister Maria is a nun whom lives in South America and looked after an amnesic Joseph, Magneto´s clone, for some months.

name: Token
deck: A ghost haunting the X-mansion's biosphere, part of the Danger Room.

name: Dawnsilk
deck: In the late 37th-early 39th century, Dawnsilk was a member of the Clan Chosen.

name: Zigfried Trask
deck: Daughter of Bolivar Trask in the X-Men Forever continuity. She revitalized the Sentinel program for the Consortium in South America and created the Neo-Sentinels.

name: John Bushmaster
deck: Super powered crime lord.

name: Bloodshed
deck: Formerly petty criminal caught by Spider-Man, took on armored and super-strong identity, twice encountered Spider-Man in his efforts to avoid death at the hands of his criminal employers.

name: Leir
deck: The Celtic God of Lightning, storms and the spear. Thor and Leir are lightning god allies.  Former god of the sea.

name: Timmy Jones
deck: Timmy is son of police officer & single-parent Charlotte Jones.  When Archangel dated Charlotte, Timmy grew fond of the blue-skinned mutant.  However, because of his mother's association with the X-Men, Timmy was targeted by kidnappers.

name: Battleaxe
deck: Battleaxe was a member of the Grapplers, a female wrestling group gone bad, and Superia's Femizons.

name: Baron Gregor Russoff
deck: Baron Gregor Russoff is an ancestor of Jack Russell who terrorized Transia as a werewolf and later became a thrall of Chthon.

name: Zharkah
deck: One of the Rejects, she befriends Beast thinking he is a Reject.

name: Carlos Lobo
deck: Carlos can turn into a werewolf

name: Evan Swann
deck: Dr. Evan Swann was once a professor of physics who worked at Empire State University and is one of the tutors who made Peter Parker into the man he is today. Swann was also a wielder of the Captain Universe powers.

name: Karthon
deck: A Lemurian who served Naga as leader of the Questers. Karthon killed Naga and became ruler of Lemuria.

name: Lockup
deck: A mutant with the power to paralyze others that was turned into a Brood by Harry Palmer, a human turned Brood, and would come into conflict with the X-Men.

name: Spitball
deck: Robert Delgado's mutant power is to hurl super-heated balls of plasma from his mouth. He was turned into a Brood by Harry Palmer, a human turned Brood, and would come into conflict with the X-Men.

name: Whiphand
deck: A mutant that was turned into a Brood by Harry Palmer, a human turned Brood, and would come into conflict with the X-Men. He whips electricity by his stretchable hands to his opponents.

name: Dr. Nemesis (Stockton)
deck: A common enemy of Hank Pym.

name: Ethan Thurm
deck: Ethan Thurm of Thurm Super-Management Inc has a number of clients that went through strength augmentation.

name: Greensong
deck: Frog. Friend of Throg. She was attracted to Thor in his frog form.

name: Leora
deck: Leora is the Queen of Ophir. She enters an alliance against King Conan of Aquilonia and fights several large battles against the hero. Her last attempt to strike at Conan ends in disaster, as she is killed by Conan's daughter Radegund.

name: Niord
deck: Niord is the Chief of Asgard.  He befriends Conan and battles alongside him.

name: Winda Wester
deck: The wisping-- I mean lisping psychic ally of Howard the Duck. Like all Howard the Duck characters, she's a little... special in the head.

name: Brynocki
deck: A toy-like robot created by Mordillo.

name: Donna Maria Puentes
deck: Donna Maria met Captain America after her cousin Hector Santiago better known as the Swine had kidnapped Steve Rogers and transported him to Rio De Muerte.

name: Otto Vermis
deck: A high ranking HYDRA agent whom recruited Jessica Drew for his organization.

name: Prince Rey
deck: Member of They Who Wield Power.

name: Gargantus
deck: A giant sea-creature whom threatened humanity. One of the Marvel Monsters.

name: December
deck: December is a mutant superhero with the power to generate sub-zero wind blasts

name: Lupa
deck: Lupa is a member of the group Savage Land Mutates. The Savage Land Mutates are a villain team made by Magneto based in the Savage Land.

name: Titannus
deck: Titannus is a product of the Skrull equivalent of the Super-Soldier program.

name: Quantum
deck: Quantum is a member of the Dakkamites, he can move short distances at fast speeds to make it seem he is in many places at once.

name: Smitty
deck: Head of the stone quary where James and Rose stay at. Smitty falls in love with Rose.

name: Larisa Mishchenko
deck: Cousin of Colossus and Magik.

name: Ophis
deck: Ophis was a member of the Neyaphem. He was killed by Wolverine.

name: Lara the Illusionist
deck: Lara was a mutant illusionist and a resident of Mutant Town. She was depowered by M-day.

name: Jillian
deck: Jillian was a member of the Neyaphem, a group of demonic looking mutants who were banished to the brimstone dimension. Jillian bears an uncanny likeness to Nightcrawler.

name: Ko-Rel
deck: Ko-Rel was a Kree stellar captain drafted into the Nova Corps to protect a critically injured Nova Prime during Annihilation Conquest. She died performing her duty but her identity was later used by the Xandarian Worldmind as a new personality template.

name: Detective Sykes
deck: A detective investigating the return of the New Warriors.

name: Immortalis
deck: Mortigan Goth was made immortal by Mephisto 800 years ago.

name: Rob Silverman
deck: Frenchie DuChamp's partner and physical therapist to Marc Spector.

name: Mallen
deck: A domestic terrorist who was mutated by the Extremis drug.

name: Mogul
deck: Enemy of Asgard

name: Zephyr
deck: Zephyr was a member of the Elementals. She has became an ally of the Avenger Ms Marvel and has also been an ally and lover to the Asgardian thunder god Thor.

name: Ulluxy'l Kwan Tae Syn
deck: Guardian of the Bloodgem. He could not be killed except by the energy of the Bloodgem

name: No-Name
deck: The mysterious member of GeNext. She is a member of the Neo race.

name: Rico
deck: Part of the new generation of X-Men.  He's the rebel in the group. Not really interested in being an X-Man. Just wants to play his guitar and rock out.

name: Snap
deck: Caught in an ionic energy surge when Wonder Man lost control of his powers, Ginger would find that she had gained super powers and would later join the short-lived team known as the Crazy 8.

name: Subject X
deck: Subject X or rather Agent X-13 is a Mutant Field Agent from a parallel universe who is sent on missions to other realities in order to activate Ghost Boxes. Once he does Deathlok-Class Security Unit Sentinels are sent through the Boxes and are used to conquer and annex the parallel Earths that Subject X has visited.

name: Taryn O'Connell
deck: US Archer's former girlfriend.

name: Red Raven (Dania)
deck: Dania is the daughter of Red Raven. She is one of the teen heroes kidnapped by Arcade in Avengers Arena.

name: Alex Ultron
deck: Alex Ultron was constructed using the 16.0 version of the original Ultron's programming to create his own artificial intelligence. Alex is also Natalie X's boyfriend and a member of the Fantastic Force.

name: Aileen Ritter
deck: The niece of Cort, the trainer of gunslingers. Aileen was to be betrothed to Roland and became the first female Gunslinger.

name: Mrs. Lee
deck: Mother of Jubilee of the X-Men.

name: Myron MacLain
deck: Dr. Myron MacLain was a metallurgist and inventor who created the vibranium shield of Captain America and the metal known as "adamantium". In the latter he had been a precursor in Lord Dark Wind/Kenji Oyama.

name: Ling McPherson
deck: Ling McPherson was a bodyguard and a partner with Bethany Cabe of the firm Cabe & McPherson, Security Specialists. She became a supporting character in the first Iron Man series.

name: Threkker
deck: Extra-Terrestrial Mercenary

name: Richard Carson
deck: Richard Carson was one of three co-protagonists of the "Shogun Warriors" series. He was an American professional stuntman and was chosen to pilot Raydeen.

name: Ilongo Savage
deck: Ilongo Savage was one of three co-protagonists of the "Shogun Warriors" series. He was a marine biologist from Madagascar and was chosen to pilot Dangard Ace.

name: Thelius
deck: Thelius was an Eternal and a member of the Uranian subsect who received the Quantum Bands. Calling himself Crusader, he believed he was the 1950s superhero known as Marvel Boy and went mad.

name: Phillip Carlisle
deck: Phillip Carlisle is the step father of Tandy Bowen, the superhero better known as Dagger.

name: Scrier
deck: Scrier is a godlike being that claims to be the architect of Earth

name: Lihla
deck: Lihla was the daughter of Axeman Bone and sworn herself to Hiro Kala. She remained at his side hoping for his love right up until her death.

name: Rebecca Raven Lebeau
deck: The second child of Gambit and Rogue, Rebecca first appeared in the "X-Men the End" series.

name: Red Vulture
deck: Jimmy Natale was unwillingly transformed into the new Vulture by Professor Charles Goss, who used technology similar to what created the Scorpion. This new Vulture has actual wings and fangs, and can spit acid. He blames J. Jonah Jameson for his transformation into the Vulture.

name: Kathy Bohusk
deck: Mother of Barnell Bohusk.

name: Fearmaster
deck: A villain from 2099, he is the main antagonist of Punisher 2099 in the early issues of that series. Fearmaster's right hand has the ability to transmute objects and people with his touch.

name: Jian
deck: A high ranking Atlantean soldier.

name: Igor
deck: Count Duckula's butler

name: Nanny
deck: Count Duckula's nanny and housekepper.

name: Grigori
deck: The infantile gorilla who replaced Mikhlo in the Super-Apes. He possesses the same superpower as his predecessor: super-strength.

name: Nedda
deck: Nedda is Marc Spector's maid. Along with Samuels (Spector's butler), she helps to keep his affairs in order.

name: Caiman
deck: Caiman is a reptilian Genoshan mutant that is a member of Unus' gang.

name: Lightning Rod
deck: A Genoshan mutant who emits lightning from his body.

name: Mr Taylor
deck: Former drug addict whose life was turned around when he was inducted into the Purifiers. However, he was ostracised by his peers when he was duped into admitted Rictor into their base during Messiah CompleX & hired Arcade to exact his revenge upon Mutant Town.

name: Lucian Von Doom
deck: In a divergent 2099 reality, Lucian is the succesesor of the original doctor doom and the master of the Black Panther.

name: Dafi
deck: Dafi is Aghanne's attendant.

name: Adam
deck: Gideon's personal assistant

name: Carlton Kilgore
deck: Father of Kade Kilgore and a preeminent arms dealer.

name: Quirk
deck: Naomi Soon-Li Torrijos-Washington, or Quirk as she called herself, was a rapper and singer who wound up the target of the Government for her subversive lyrics. She wound up an ally and love interest to John Eisenhart (the Hulk) and wished to run away with him.

name: Ángel
deck: Ángel is a mexican guy who works for Nestor Garcia.

name: Sasquatch
deck: Alpha Flight believed this Sasquatch was a mutated Walter Langkowski, but he was really a actual sasquatch that Department H captured in the Canadian wilderness.

name: Immortal Man
deck: God of Tabula Rasa.

name: Charlie Chainsaws
deck: A insane serial killer who used to saw his victims and then stack up their bodies. He was one of Dr. Rot's patients at Dunwich Sanatorium who replaced his hands with chainsaws.

name: Parvez
deck: A descendent. Father wants to use his power.

name: Brava
deck: 3rd Generation member of Strikeforce Morituri. Has super strength.

name: Kashmir Vennema
deck: A villain who sought profit through use of the Multiverse.

name: Ralph Quentin
deck: Former owner of The Quentin Carnival when John Blaze was employed.

name: H. Warren Craddock
deck: The last of the four Skrulls from the initial encounter with the Fantastic Four.

name: Letrong Giap
deck: A Vietcong Captain during the Vietnam War whom encountered Nick Fury as well as Frank Castle (the Punisher) on different occasions.

name: Libra (LMD)
deck: Created by Scorpio (Jake Fury) using the Zodiac Key to serve as members of his own Zodiac team.

name: Don Lamaze
deck: Otto Octavius' former classmate and his professor while he was in possession of Peter Parker's body.

name: Esteban Ortega
deck: Son of Ismael and Armena Ortega. Esteban is a mutant (like his mother) with telekinetic abilities.

name: Spymaster (Lemon)
deck: A former student of Taskmaster who became Spymaster and led Espionage Elite. He was eventually killed by Sinclair Abbott who usurped his identity.

name: Ud
deck: The troll.

name: Ren Kimura
deck: A 21 year old girl with great dancing skills who manifested her powers after being exposed to the Terrigen Bomb. She was saved by Valkyrie and Misty Knight and befriended Annabelle Riggs.

name: Auntie Mayhem
deck: Irving Forbush's *ahem* 'beloved' aunt.

name: Volga
deck: A Russian arms dealer who has been conducting experiments on mutants, turning them into living weapons.

name: Amber Grant
deck: Daily Bugle photographer and roommate of Ruth Hart.

name: Queen of Angels
deck: The monarch of Heven responsible for kidnapping Odin's daughter who was raised as the warrior Angela.

name: Ziggy Karst
deck: New Young mutant.

name: Daemos
deck: A member of the Inheritors and a brother of Morlun.

name: Claude Potier
deck: Claude Potier is a member of the New Orleans based Thieves Guild

name: Virginia
deck: Vision's synthezoid wife.

name: Lady Hellbender
deck: An alien warrior who captures monsters of different planets.

name: Sarah Rogers
deck: The mother of Steve Rogers.

name: Jack Craw
deck: Attacked Magik and Storm while they were looking for Sapna.

name: Anne Tenna
deck: Attacked Magik and Storm while they were looking for Sapna.

name: Enoch
deck: Attacked Storm and Magik while they were looking for Sapna.

name: Spectra
deck: Attacked Storm and Magik while they were looking for Sapna.

name: The World-Eater
deck: The World-Eater is a powerful entity from another reality who sustains himself, using and eating energy from other dimensions .

name: Priya Aggarwal
deck: Nadia Pym wants to recruit her for her new lab.

name: Major X
deck: Major X is the son of Cable from another dimension called X-istence.

name: Sickle Priest
deck: Johan Richter, a former World War II Nazi pilot whom became the Sickle Priest for The Hand.

name: Mother Mold
deck: A next-generation Master Mold Sentinel designed to create other Master Molds on a industrial scale, and believed by mutants to be the precursor to Nimrod.

name: Mudgear the Recanter
deck: Member of the Locus Vile under the service of Tarn the Uncaring.

name: Mother Rapture
deck: Member of the Locus Vile under the service of Tarn the Uncaring.

name: Sick Bird
deck: Member of the Locus Vile under the service of Tarn the Uncaring.

name: Amino Fetus
deck: Amino Fetus is a member of the Locus Vile, in the service of Tarn the Uncaring. The Vile take great care to ensure that Amino Fetus does not eat.

name: Cherub
deck: A member of a new superhero team who patterned his look on the X-Men's Angel

name: Marvel Guy
deck: Marvel Guy is a member of a new superhero team that patterned his look on the X-Men's Marvel Girl.

name: Taaia
deck: Heroic scientist from the Sixth Cosmos and mother of Galactus.

name: The Artist
deck: A serial killer who greatly admires Carnage.

name: Librarian
deck: After the Human-Machine-Mutant War which saw the rise of Homo Novissima, successors of Homo Sapiens, and the near-extinction of mutants. The Librarian kept the few remaining mutants in a Preserve.

name: Kobb
deck: Loolo's young brother and survivor of Uranus' attack of Arakko.

name: Bagra-ghul
deck: A demon that Wolverine refers to as The Stitcher

name: Amaranth
deck: A new student of the Scarlet Witch and Agatha Harkness.

name: Shinobu Kageyama
deck: Troubled teen who became the host for Shadow King in the 6160 Ultimate Universe.

name: Symbie
deck: Former prisoner of Xanto Starblood, liberated by Spider-Man

name: Laura Dunham
deck: Laura was Nova's girlfriend during his duration with the New Warriors.  She was feisty & distracted him from his attraction to Namorita.

name: Foolkiller (Everbest)
deck: The first person to become the Foolkiller. He is a vigilante serial-killer on a mission to eliminate the amoral "fools" in society. There have been five people who have assumed the mantle.

name: Broadband
deck: Broadband can access all manner of electronic communications,and project them to others.

name: Bloodtide
deck: Bloodtide is an Atlantean mutate and a member of the Fathom Five.

name: Frank Zapruder
deck: Better known as "Filthy Frankie," Zapruder is mutant gang leader in Mutant town. He has the power to excrete different smells based on his emotions.

name: Robota
deck: A female robot friend of Planet Terry's after he rescued her from a junk heap.

name: Bill the Lobster
deck: Bill is a green lobster cyborg, endowed with super strength and intellect.  Unlike Don he is a normal green lobster who is only enhanced by his cybernetic implants.

name: Lance
deck: Lance is the son of the hitman known as Bullet.

name: Dr. Katherine Reynolds
deck: Once an assistant professor in parapsychological studies of an university in St. Louis, Katherine Reynolds became involved in occasional struggles with supernatural affairs after she met Daimon Hellstrom, and later when joined the Legion of the Night.

name: Rapture
deck: Formerly an agent of SHIELD's Psi-Ops division. She and her black ops team, the Contingency, were trained to kill mutants but went rogue and now work for themselves.

name: The Agent
deck: A highly covert operative only accessible online under the codename "The Agent," Rick Mason was a free-lance agent specializing in data on non-lethal handling of superhumans.

name: Amanda Fairmont
deck: Hannah Fairmont's daughter.

name: Joe Smith
deck: A former boxer whom is friends with the Amazing Spider-man

name: Mick
deck: Human, son of Ruby, adopted by Volstagg.

name: Man-Eater
deck: Former member of the Intruders and Wild Pack.

name: Bolt
deck: Robot modeled after Quicksilver.

name: Harvest
deck: A Japanese fisher-woman who later became a Young God.

name: Simyon Kurasov
deck: Kurasov is the self-made monarch of much of Moscow's underworld.

name: Shiva
deck: Shiva is a powerful and nearly indestructible robot created by Weapon X to be used in the instance of one of their agents going rogue.

name: Geldoff
deck: Geldoff, also known as Proton was a recruit for The Initiative. He was killed during the Skrulls' Secret Invasion. In the Ultimate Universe he is a mutant who originates from Latveria.

name: Emmy Doolin
deck: Daughter of Sgt. Doolin, a war buddy of Wolverine who was killed in the Canadian wilderness. She blamed Wolverine and the Hunter in Darkness for his death.

name: Wide Load Annie
deck: Wide Load Annie is a former trucker and the current proprietor of the Star Stop.

name: Poppa Wheelie
deck: Former drag racing champion and proprietor of the Star Stop.

name: AC-DC
deck: Conjoined Warpie twins. One is negatively charged and the other is positively charged. They can deliver a massive electrical shock to someone if they both touch them at the same time.

name: Mr. Nobody
deck: Mr. Nobody is a normal man wearing a high-tech suit that allows him to teleport. He works for the Kingpin of crime.

name: Headhunter
deck: Headhunter is an albino that can control people that look into her eyes.

name: Killerwatt
deck: Killerwatt is a member of the Revengers and the Savage Six.

name: Rorgg King of the Spider-Men
deck: Rorgg was King of The Spider Men and part of the Marvel Monsters.

name: Earth Sentry
deck: Infused with Kree alien powers, he watches guard over the Earth

name: Majeston Zelia
deck: Majeston Zelia is the ruler of the Dark Gods and a major enemy of Odin.

name: Gigantus
deck: Gigantus is one of the Marvel Monsters from the early 1960's. He has appeared a few times inside Marvel Continuity.

name: Omnibus
deck: The Leader's former right hand man and nemesis of the Hulk. For a short amount of time he was the leader of the hidden fortress Freehold in the Arctic.

name: Mindscan
deck: Mindscan is a powerful mentalist from the mutant run planet Haven. A capable field commander she served as Rancor’s most trusted lieutenant. She and her associates fought the Guardians of the Galaxy.

name: Hellspawn
